title: A Unified Approach to Interpreting Knowledge Distillation for Large Language Models via Interactions
summary: Despite the success of knowledge distillation (KD) in Large Language Models (LLMs), the underlying mechanism behind its efficacy remains unclear. In this paper, we propose a unified approach to explore the common mechanism of various KD methods using interactions. Specifically, we decompose the output score of the LLM into the sum of numerous interactions. Each interaction represents a nonlinear relationship involving a set of input variables (e.g., words). Based on the decomposed interactions, we discover that the common mechanism underlying various KD methods is the sparsification of interactions, i.e., student models retain fewer interactions for inference while suppressing other interactions to zero effects. Furthermore, we discover that the performance variance across different KD methods arises from their capabilities in handling complex interactions. A KD method typically yields better performance if it enables the student model to achieve higher sparsity of complex interactions. Motivated by these insights, we propose a plug-and-play loss function called Complex Interaction Penalty (CIP) to explicitly enforce the sparsity of complex interactions during the distillation process. Extensive experiments demonstrate that integrating CIP consistently improves the performance of diverse KD methods on both in-domain and out-of-distribution benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于交互的统一视角来理解知识蒸馏（KD）在大型语言模型（LLM）中的机制，发现KD的共性机制是交互稀疏化（学生模型保留少量交互进行推理，抑制其他交互），而不同KD方法的性能差异源于处理复杂交互的能力。基于此，提出了复杂交互惩罚（CIP）损失函数来显式促进蒸馏过程中复杂交互的稀疏性，实验证明CIP能一致提升多种KD方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 尽管知识蒸馏在LLM中取得成功，但其内在机制尚不清晰。作者希望探索不同KD方法背后的共同机制，并理解其性能差异的原因。
AI.method: 将LLM的输出分数分解为多个交互（interactions）之和，每个交互表示一组输入变量（如词语）之间的非线性关系。基于此分解，发现KD的共性机制是交互稀疏化——学生模型保留更少的交互，将其他交互的效应抑制为零。进一步发现不同KD方法的性能差异源于其处理复杂交互的能力；能实现更高复杂交互稀疏度的方法通常性能更好。提出复杂交互惩罚（CIP）损失函数，显式地在蒸馏过程中惩罚复杂交互的强度，促进其稀疏化。
AI.result: 在多个KD方法（如vanilla KD、Distilled BiLSTM、DistilBERT、TinyBERT、MiniLM等）上集成CIP损失函数，在域内和分布外基准测试中均一致提升了性能。
AI.conclusion: 知识蒸馏的共性机制是交互稀疏化，复杂交互的处理能力决定了KD方法的性能差异。CIP作为一种即插即用的损失函数，能有效提升多种KD方法的性能，验证了所提机制的正确性。

title: iLENS: Interpretable LLM-Guided Mixture-of-Experts for Neuroimaging Survival Analysis
summary: Alzheimer's Disease (AD) is a complex neurodegenerative disorder that continues to impact millions of people worldwide. Predicting AD conversion during the prodromal stage remains critical for disease understanding and patient care. As such, survival models are widely used for AD risk prediction, yet they are typically static predictors with limited interpretability and no capacity for natural language reasoning. In this work, we propose iLENS, an interpretable large language model (LLM) guided framework based on mixture-of-experts (MoE) for survival prediction in AD conversion. Our approach uses LLM to synthesize structured neuroimaging measurements and unstructured information to guide expert routing. Our framework demonstrates competitive predictive performance and capability in patient subtyping. Furthermore, our framework provides transparent, biologically grounded rationales for its routing decisions, bridging the gap between high-performance survival analysis and interpretable clinical decision support.

AI.tldr: iLENS 是一个基于大语言模型和混合专家系统的可解释生存预测框架，用于阿尔茨海默病转化风险预测，兼具高性能和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有的阿尔茨海默病生存预测模型通常是静态预测器，可解释性有限且缺乏自然语言推理能力，难以满足临床决策支持需求。
AI.method: 提出 iLENS 框架，利用大语言模型（LLM）整合结构化神经影像测量与非结构化信息，通过混合专家系统（MoE）路由机制指导生存预测，并为路由决策提供可解释、生物学基础充分的理由。
AI.result: 该框架在预测性能上具有竞争力，具备患者亚型分类能力，并能提供透明的可解释性。
AI.conclusion: iLENS 弥合了高性能生存分析与可解释临床决策支持之间的鸿沟，为阿尔茨海默病转化预测提供了一个兼顾准确性与可解释性的解决方案。

title: Signed Symmetric Quantization for Few-Bit Integers
summary: The signed integer alphabet contains one more negative representable value than positive. Yet, by convention, the standard symmetric integer quantizer fixes its scale to be strictly positive, which assigns this extra representable value to the negative tail and can force clipping of positive outliers. In this work, we show that, at few-bit precision, such clipping is a non-trivial source of quantization error. Asymmetric quantization addresses this problem with a zero point, shifting the grid toward the observed data range; however, this flexibility is well-known to carry a runtime penalty. For example, in llama.cpp on an AMD EPYC(TM) "Turin" CPU, a 4-bit symmetric format uses up to 9% less memory with up to 2.45$\times$ higher throughput than its asymmetric counterpart. We highlight signed symmetric quantization as a third option that retains the runtime profile of symmetric quantization without the penalty of the asymmetric format: our signed absmax grid places the extra representable value on the dominant-outlier tail through a principled and lightweight sign selection rule while keeping the zero point at zero. Our theoretical analysis offers two main results. First, we establish the signed absmax grid as conditionally bound-optimal on $\ell_2$ quantization error, and show that the condition holds for 88-99% of weight groups across pre-trained large language models (LLMs) at low bit widths. Second, we show that negating the scale of a standard symmetric quantizer is analytically equivalent to a unit zero point shift on the same signed integer alphabet. We empirically validate our proposal on models from the Qwen3, Qwen3.5, and Llama3 families, and observe improvement in perplexity and downstream few-shot accuracy over the standard unsigned symmetric quantizer at no extra inference cost

AI.tldr: 提出一种有符号对称量化（signed absmax grid），通过轻量级的符号选择规则将额外的可表示值分配给主导异常值尾，在不引入零点偏移的情况下改善低精度量化误差，在LLM上获得优于标准无符号对称量化的困惑度和准确率，且推理开销不变。
AI.motivation: 标准对称量化器将额外的一个负值固定在负尾，导致正异常值被剪裁，造成显著量化误差；非对称量化引入零点可缓解但带来运行时开销。需要一种既保留对称量化的高效运行特性又能减少量化误差的方法。
AI.method: 提出有符号对称量化（signed absmax grid）：在对称量化基础上，通过一个原则性且轻量的符号选择规则，将额外的一个可表示值分配给主导异常值所在的尾侧（正尾或负尾），同时保持零点为零。理论分析证明该网格在ℓ2误差下条件性界最优，且该条件在低比特下覆盖LLM中88-99%的权重组；并证明将标准对称量化的尺度取反等价于单位零点偏移。
AI.result: 在Qwen3、Qwen3.5、Llama3系列模型上验证，有符号对称量化相比标准无符号对称量化在困惑度和下游少样本准确率上均有提升，且推理速度与内存占用与标准对称量化一致（远优于非对称量化）。例如在AMD EPYC "Turin" CPU上，4-bit对称格式比非对称格式节省9%内存、吞吐量高2.45倍。
AI.conclusion: 有符号对称量化是一种无需运行时开销即可减少量化误差的有效方案，理论分析与实验均支持其优越性，推荐作为低比特量化中标准对称量化的替代。

title: Sticky Routing: Training MoE Models for Memory-Efficient Inference
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models activate only a sparse subset of experts per token, yet consecutive tokens frequently activate different experts -- causing constant weight swapping between slow storage and fast memory on edge devices. Existing remedies are either system-level (caching heuristics) or post-hoc (router fine-tuning), leaving the root cause unchanged during pretraining. We propose StickyMoE, a differentiable routing consistency loss that penalises abrupt expert switches between adjacent tokens, encouraging the router to maintain the same expert assignment across semantically coherent spans. StickyMoE requires no architectural changes, adds a single hyperparameter lambda, and unlike post-hoc methods, allows expert representations and routing decisions to co-adapt from the first training step. Experiments on small-scale MoE language models show that StickyMoE reduces the expert switch rate by up to 60% with less than 4% perplexity degradation, Pareto-dominating post-hoc fine-tuning on the quality-locality frontier. Routing temporal locality is most efficiently instilled at training time.

AI.tldr: StickyMoE 提出一种可微的路由一致性损失函数，在预训练阶段直接惩罚相邻 token 之间的专家切换行为，从而在不改变模型架构、仅引入单一超参数 λ 的情况下，将 MoE 语言模型的专家切换率降低最高 60%，且困惑度损失低于 4%。实验表明，在训练时注入路由时间局部性比后处理方法更高效，在质量-局部性前沿上帕累托占优后验微调。
AI.motivation: MoE 模型虽然每个 token 只激活少量专家，但连续 token 常激活不同专家，导致边缘设备上权重在慢速存储和快速内存之间频繁交换。现有解决方案（系统级缓存启发式、后验路由器微调）均未在预训练阶段处理根本原因，因此需要一种能在训练过程中直接鼓励路由器保持相邻 token 专家分配一致的方法。
AI.method: 提出 StickyMoE，在预训练损失中添加一项可微的路由一致性损失，惩罚相邻 token 之间的专家切换；该损失通过单一超参数 λ 控制强度，无需改变模型架构，且允许专家表示与路由决策从第一步训练开始共同适应。
AI.result: 在小规模 MoE 语言模型实验中，StickyMoE 将专家切换率降低最高 60%，同时困惑度退化低于 4%；在质量-局部性前沿上，StickyMoE 帕累托占优于后验微调方法。
AI.conclusion: 路由时间局部性在训练阶段注入最为有效；StickyMoE 通过简洁的损失函数设计，从根源上提升了 MoE 模型在边缘设备上的部署效率。

title: HALO: Hybrid Adaptive Latent Reasoning for Language Models
summary: We study how to improve a frozen pretrained language model with a small amount of adaptive extra computation. A simple approach is to add additional refinement steps on top of the backbone hidden states, but fixed extra refinement can be wasteful: a one-step refinement head may be too weak, while forcing a second full-sequence refinement step everywhere can increase compute without improving transfer. We introduce HALO, a hybrid adaptive latent-refinement method that combines a coarse refinement stage with selective second-stage latent refinement on a subset of tokens chosen by token scoring and monotonic token halting. On the main public benchmark comparison built from MMLU-Pro and GPQA-Diamond, HALO achieves the best overall average among the paper-facing methods, outperforming the frozen backbone, fixed-1, and fixed-2. Internal analysis further shows that HALO reaches nearly the same token-accuracy level as fixed-2 while using fewer average applied refine steps than fixed-1 and far fewer than fixed-2. These results suggest that the key advantage is not simply more refinement, but a better allocation of refinement: HALO achieves the strongest paper-facing result while also using less measured controller compute than either fixed baseline.

AI.tldr: HALO 是一种混合自适应潜在精炼方法，通过在少量自适应额外计算下改进冻结的预训练语言模型。它结合了粗粒度精炼阶段和基于令牌评分与单调令牌暂停的细粒度第二阶段精炼，在 MMLU-Pro 和 GPQA-Diamond 基准上达到最佳平均性能，同时使用的精炼步数少于固定基线。
AI.motivation: 固定额外精炼（如固定一步或两步精炼）要么能力不足，要么计算浪费。一步精炼可能太弱，而强制所有位置执行两步精炼会增加计算量却不提升迁移效果。因此需要一种自适应精炼方法，根据令牌重要性动态分配计算资源。
AI.method: HALO 包含一个粗粒度精炼阶段（第一阶段），然后通过令牌评分和单调令牌暂停机制选择一部分令牌进行第二阶段精炼。第二阶段仅在必要时对选中的令牌进行额外的潜在空间精炼，从而实现自适应计算分配。
AI.result: 在 MMLU-Pro 和 GPQA-Diamond 基准上，HALO 的平均性能优于冻结主干、固定一步精炼（fixed-1）和固定两步精炼（fixed-2）。HALO 的令牌准确率接近 fixed-2，但平均精炼步数少于 fixed-1，远少于 fixed-2，且使用的控制器计算量也更少。
AI.conclusion: HALO 的关键优势不在于更多的精炼步数，而在于更好的精炼分配——通过自适应选择需要进一步精炼的令牌，在更少的计算开销下达到与全量两步精炼相当的性能，证明了混合自适应方法的有效性。

title: StereoSplat+: Feed-Forward Stereo Gaussian Splatting with Diffusion-Assisted Progressive Inference
comment: 8 pages, accepted as a conference paper for IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS2026)
summary: Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have enabled high-quality, render-ready scene representations for novel-view synthesis. However, most existing 3DGS pipelines rely on multi-view observations (or non-causal access to future frames) to achieve sufficient coverage, which is often unavailable in on-device robotics and AR settings where sensing is restricted to a single stereo rig. Recovering a high-quality 3DGS scene from one stereo observation, therefore, remains challenging due to occlusions, limited field of view, and missing geometry. We present StereoSplat+, a diffusion-enhanced feed-forward framework that enables causal reconstruction from a single stereo pair. Our method builds on two key components. First, we propose StereoSplat, an input-invariant feed-forward 3D Gaussian estimator that takes a variable number of posed stereo pairs as input and predicts high-quality 3D Gaussians. StereoSplat fuses complementary geometry cues via a cost-volume branch and a triplane-based 3D volume branch and leverages continuous pose encoding to generalize across view counts and camera configurations. Second, since multiple posed stereo pairs are typically unavailable at inference time, we introduce a diffusion-enhanced one-shot progressive inference scheme called StereoSplat+: starting from one stereo pair, we render novel stereo views from the predicted 3DGS, refine them with a one-step diffusion enhancer, and feed them back as additional inputs to update the 3DGS. Experiments on the KITTI-360 dataset show that StereoSplat+ improves novel-view rendering quality and geometry accuracy, especially in occluded regions and under strong view extrapolation, outperforming recent feed-forward 3DGS baselines.

AI.tldr: StereoSplat+ is a diffusion-enhanced feed-forward framework for causal 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstruction from a single stereo pair. It consists of StereoSplat, an input-invariant feed-forward 3D Gaussian estimator that generalizes across varying numbers of posed stereo pairs, and a progressive inference scheme that uses a one-step diffusion enhancer to refine rendered novel views and iteratively update the 3DGS. Experiments on KITTI-360 demonstrate improved novel-view synthesis and geometry accuracy, especially in occluded regions and under strong view extrapolation, outperforming recent feed-forward 3DGS baselines.
AI.motivation: Existing 3DGS pipelines typically rely on multi-view observations or non-causal access to future frames to achieve sufficient scene coverage, which is often unavailable in on-device robotics and AR settings where sensing is restricted to a single stereo rig. Recovering a high-quality 3DGS scene from one stereo observation is challenging due to occlusions, limited field of view, and missing geometry.
AI.method: The method has two key components: (1) StereoSplat, an input-invariant feed-forward 3D Gaussian estimator that takes a variable number of posed stereo pairs as input and predicts high-quality 3D Gaussians by fusing complementary geometry cues via a cost-volume branch and a triplane-based 3D volume branch, using continuous pose encoding to generalize across view counts and camera configurations. (2) StereoSplat+, a diffusion-enhanced one-shot progressive inference scheme: starting from one stereo pair, it renders novel stereo views from the predicted 3DGS, refines them with a one-step diffusion enhancer, and feeds them back as additional inputs to update the 3DGS.
AI.result: Experiments on the KITTI-360 dataset show that StereoSplat+ improves novel-view rendering quality and geometry accuracy, especially in occluded regions and under strong view extrapolation, outperforming recent feed-forward 3DGS baselines.
AI.conclusion: The proposed framework enables causal reconstruction from a single stereo pair, overcoming the multi-view requirement of prior 3DGS pipelines and addressing challenges like occlusions and limited field of view in on-device settings.

title: Interval Certifications for Multilayered Perceptrons via Lattice Traversal
summary: In this work we present a rigorous theoretical framework to a foundational problem of AI safety, namely adversarial robustness. In particular, we show that the adversarial robustness problem can be reduced to a lattice traversal problem. Each element of this lattice corresponds to an interval, i.e., an axis-aligned hyper-rectangle, containing an input point $\mathbf{x}$. Consider a multilayered perceptron classifier (MLP). An interval $I$ constitutes a sound certification if $\mathbf{x} \in I$ and $\mathbf{x}$ can be freely perturbed in $I$ without changing the MLP's prediction. Complementarily, an interval $I$ constitutes a complete certification if $\mathbf{x} \in I$ and when $\mathbf{x}$ moves outside of $I$ the MLP's prediction is guaranteed to change. While the sound certification problem corresponds to the well-studied adversarial robustness, complete certifications have not been examined in the literature. We develop lattice traversal operators, which we apply in a refine & verify iterative scheme. Using formal MLP verifiers, sound maximality and complete minimality are guaranteed. Moreover, we examine objective optimization problems. There we discover some interesting asymmetries. For complete certifications, the minimum solution is obtained in polynomial oracle calls. This does not hold for sound certifications, where we prove strong intractability results. Additionally, we examine optimization problems in symmetric intervals (i.e., $\ell_\infty$-spheres), where we provide logarithmic algorithms. Finally, we present an empirical evaluation, using the novel ParallelepipedoNN system.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个严格的 adversarial robustness（对抗鲁棒性）的理论框架，将其归结为格遍历问题。定义了“sound certification”（安全认证）和“complete certification”（完全认证），前者对应传统对抗鲁棒性，后者是新的概念。开发了格遍历操作符，并采用 refine & verify 迭代方案，使用形式化 MLP 验证器保证 sound 最大性和 complete 最小性。研究了优化问题，发现不对称性：complete certification 的极小解可在多项式 oracle 调用内获得，而 sound certification 是强难解的。在对称区间（ℓ∞-球）中提供了对数算法。最后用 ParallelepipedoNN 系统进行了实证评估。
AI.motivation: 为对抗鲁棒性提供严格的理论基础，并引入“完全认证”（complete certification）这一新概念，弥补现有文献仅关注“安全认证”（sound certification）的不足。
AI.method: 将对抗鲁棒性问题转化为格遍历问题，每个格元素对应一个包含输入点的轴对齐超矩形。开发格遍历操作符，应用于 refine & verify 迭代框架，借助形式化 MLP 验证器保证 sound 最大性和 complete 最小性。对优化问题进行分析，包括对称区间（ℓ∞-球）上的对数算法。
AI.result: 发现不对称性：complete certification 的极值优化可在多项式 oracle 调用内求解，而 sound certification 是强难解的。在 ℓ∞-球上提供对数时间算法。实证评估验证了所提方法。
AI.conclusion: 提出一个统一 sound 和 complete certification 的理论框架，揭示了二者在计算复杂性上的根本不对称性，并提供了高效算法和实证支持。

title: Reward Transport: Property Control in Flow Matching via Noise-Space Alignment
summary: The coupling in flow matching -- the rule pairing noise vectors with data points -- is typically treated as a computational choice. We show that this coupling can instead serve as an alignment interface: by matching noise and data according to a target molecular property, it embeds controllable structure directly into the learned flow field. Building on this view, we introduce Reward Transport, which uses optimal transport coupling at training time to align a scalar noise-space coordinate with molecular rewards; at inference, varying this coordinate steers the generated distribution without requiring an oracle, reward model, gradient guidance, or additional computation. In the coupling-preserving limit, thresholding this coordinate recovers the Cross-Entropy Method's truncated reward distribution, providing a principled, continuously adjustable distribution-level control knob. Empirically, on ZINC-250K and GuacaMol, sweeping the scalar induces monotone control of logP and consistent QED control over its operating range; most tellingly, the same knob produces opposite structural responses for different targets, growing molecules for logP but shrinking them for QED, which rules out a generic size bias. The interface is complementary to classifier-free guidance and conditional flow matching, while a negative result under epsilon-prediction diffusion clarifies where coupling-level alignment is structurally absent. Code: https://github.com/KehanGuo2/reward-transport

AI.tldr: 通过将流匹配中的噪声-数据耦合重新定义为对齐接口，提出奖励运输（Reward Transport）方法，利用最优传输耦合在训练时将噪声空间坐标与分子奖励对齐；推理时通过调整该坐标直接控制生成分布，无需奖励模型或梯度引导。在分子生成任务中实现对logP和QED的单调控制，且对不同目标产生相反的结构响应，排除了尺寸偏差。
AI.motivation: 流匹配中的配对规则通常仅被视为计算选择，但作者发现该耦合可充当对齐接口，通过将噪声与数据按目标属性匹配，从而将可控结构直接嵌入学习到的流场中。
AI.method: 提出奖励运输（Reward Transport）：在训练时使用最优传输耦合将噪声空间中的标量坐标与分子奖励对齐；推理时通过改变该坐标来引导生成分布。在耦合保持极限下，对该坐标进行阈值化可恢复交叉熵方法的截断奖励分布，提供连续可调的分布级控制旋钮。
AI.result: 在ZINC-250K和GuacaMol数据集上，扫描该标量坐标可实现对logP的单调控制和对QED的一致控制；且同一旋钮对不同目标产生相反的结构响应（针对logP增长分子，针对QED缩小分子），排除了通用尺寸偏差。该方法与无分类器引导和条件流匹配互补，而在epsilon预测扩散下的负结果说明了耦合级对齐缺失时无法生效。
AI.conclusion: 奖励运输提供了一种无需奖励模型或额外计算即可控制生成分布的简便方法，可视为交叉熵方法的连续可调推广，并揭示了流匹配中耦合的对齐潜力。

title: An Emergent Mirage: Is Emergent Misalignment and Realignment Indeed a Robust Phenomenon?
summary: Recent work has reported Emergent Misalignment (EM), where language models fine-tuned on narrow, domain-specific misaligned datasets abruptly acquire broadly misaligned behavior, alongside evidence that this behavior can be reversed through limited realignment. We systematically study repeated alignment and misalignment cycles using controlled fine-tuning loops while tracking behavioral performance, and LoRA representations throughout training. Although we reproduce EM, we find that both misalignment and realignment are highly sensitive to superficial dataset characteristics, with apparent rapid realignment largely disappearing after controlling for response-length differences. We further find that previously reported mechanistic signatures, including representational phase transitions in LoRA space, do not consistently correlate with behavioral misalignment across training. Our results suggest that current evidence for EM is less robust than previously claimed and highlight the need for evaluation protocols that carefully control for these surface level dataset artifacts to identify the robustness of the EM phenomenon.

AI.tldr: 本文通过受控微调循环实验发现，语言模型中的"新兴错位"（Emergent Misalignment）现象及其快速重新对齐的证据对数据集表面特征高度敏感，在控制响应长度差异后快速重新对齐消失，且先前报道的LoRA表示中的相变等机制特征与行为错位并不一致相关，表明现有EM证据不如先前声称的可靠。
AI.motivation: 近期研究表明，在狭隘领域错位数据集上微调的语言模型会突然涌现广泛的错位行为（Emergent Misalignment, EM），并且这种错位可以通过有限的重新对齐逆转。本文旨在系统性地检验这种EM现象及其可逆性的稳健性，探究其对数据集表面特征的敏感性，并验证先前提出的机制性解释（如LoRA表征相变）是否可靠。
AI.method: 采用受控微调循环实验设计，在训练过程中系统性地重复进行对齐与错位的循环，同时追踪行为表现和LoRA表征变化。通过控制响应长度等表面数据集特征，检验快速重新对齐现象的稳健性，并分析LoRA表征中的相变是否与行为错位一致相关。
AI.result: 虽然复现了EM现象，但发现错位和重新对齐都对数据集表面特征高度敏感。在控制响应长度差异后，快速重新对齐现象基本消失。此外，先前报道的LoRA空间中的表征相变等机制性信号在训练过程中与行为错位并不一致相关。
AI.conclusion: 目前支持EM现象的证据不如先前声称的稳健，强调需要设计严格控制表面层级数据伪影的评估协议，以确定EM现象的真实可靠性。

title: Mixture of Probes: Learning from Privileged Modalities in Multimodal LLMs Through Probing
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are typically designed under the assumption that all modalities available during training will also be accessible at inference. However, many real-world settings violate this assumption, requiring models to operate under a privileged modality setting, where auxiliary modalities are available only during training. While these modalities contain valuable information, existing MLLMs largely fail to leverage them effectively, as they treat modalities as interchangeable inputs rather than sources of complementary supervision. We propose Mixture of Probes (MoP), a novel framework that disentangles modality-specific and modality-general signals within the MLLM, allowing the model to preserve modality-dependent structure while learning transferable representations across modalities. At its core, MoP achieves this through a structured probing mechanism that extracts and organizes information from intermediate representations of a shared modality encoder, rather than relying only on final-layer alignment as done in existing MLLMs. To support this disentanglement, we further introduce MoP Cross-modal Training (MoP-X), a training strategy for MoP centered around a probe disentanglement loss that prevents probe collapse and encourages cross-modal learning. We evaluate MoP across two domains spanning eight tasks and four modalities under a comprehensive evaluation protocol tailored to the privileged modality setting, where each modality is independently treated as the sole input at inference time. MoP consistently outperforms strong MLLM baselines, achieving up to 65% relative improvement, demonstrating that auxiliary modalities, even when unavailable at inference, can provide substantial gains when effectively leveraged during training. Code, model checkpoints, and evaluation protocols will be made available at https://github.com/Sony/MoP.

AI.tldr: 提出 Mixture of Probes (MoP) 框架，解决多模态大语言模型在推理时部分模态缺失的问题，通过解耦模态特定与模态通用信号，使模型在训练时利用辅助模态信息，即使推理时该模态不可用也能提升性能。MoP 在多个任务和模态上显著超越基线模型，最高提升 65%。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态大语言模型假设训练时使用的所有模态在推理时也可用，但实际应用中辅助模态往往只在训练阶段存在。现有 MLLM 将模态视为可互换的输入而非互补的监督源，无法有效利用这些辅助模态信息。
AI.method: 提出 Mixture of Probes (MoP) 框架，通过结构化的探针机制从共享模态编码器的中间表示中提取和组织信息，而非仅依赖最终层对齐。同时提出 MoP 跨模态训练策略 (MoP-X)，包含探针解耦损失以防止探针坍缩并促进跨模态学习。
AI.result: 在跨越两个领域、八个任务和四种模态的综合评估中，MoP 持续优于强 MLLM 基线，最高实现 65% 的相对提升。
AI.conclusion: 辅助模态即使在推理时不可用，只要在训练时有效利用，也能带来显著的性能提升。MoP 提供了一种有效的框架来解耦模态特定与通用信号，提升 MLLM 在特权模态设置下的表现。

title: CogniConsole: Externalizing Inference-Time Control as a Formal Abstraction for Reliable LLM Interactions
comment: Revised version focusing on the CogniConsole system architecture and empirical evaluation of inference-time control probes (N=489)
summary: Reliability in large language model (LLM) systems is typically framed as a function of model capability. We challenge this by demonstrating that reliability is significantly influenced by \emph{inference-time control} -- the computational layer governing task framing and context selection. We introduce \emph{CogniConsole}, an architectural instantiation that externalizes this control into a structured interface combining programmatic coordination with bounded prompt-based reasoning. Through \emph{controllability-oriented probes} ($N=489$) in a multi-step interactive environment, we show that increasing structural scaffolding -- from unstructured to fully scaffolded -- \textbf{systematically reduces output variance and failure rates under a fixed model architecture}. Our results indicate that many observed failure modes, such as context drift and inconsistent constraint adherence, arise from under-specified control rather than insufficient capability. This work provides an empirical basis for treating inference-time control as a first-class abstraction, opening new directions for designing and evaluating LLM systems beyond scaling alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出推理时控制（inference-time control）是影响LLM系统可靠性的关键因素，并通过CogniConsole架构和489次可控性探测实验证明：在固定模型下，增加结构化脚手架（从无结构到全结构化）能系统性降低输出方差和失败率，许多失效模式源于控制不足而非能力不足。
AI.motivation: 挑战将LLM系统可靠性仅归因于模型能力的传统观点，提出推理时控制（任务框架和上下文选择的计算层）对可靠性有显著影响。
AI.method: 提出CogniConsole架构，将控制外部化为结合程序化协调与 bounded prompt推理的结构化接口；通过489次可控性探测实验，在多变交互环境中比较从无结构到全结构化的不同脚手架水平。
AI.result: 在固定模型架构下，增加结构化脚手架系统性降低了输出方差和失败率；许多失效模式（如上下文漂移、约束遵守不一致）源于控制不足而非能力不足。
AI.conclusion: 推理时控制应被视为一等抽象，为超越单纯规模扩展的LLM系统设计与评估开辟了新方向，提供了将控制作为可靠性关键因素的实证基础。

title: Director: Accelerating Distributed MoE Serving via Online Proactive Expert Placement
summary: Expert parallelism has become the prevailing paradigm to serve Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. Its efficiency depends on the communication and computation latencies of the GPUs, which are linked to the placement of experts in the GPUs. Existing works for optimizing expert placement focus on leveraging past requests' expert activation patterns. However, they demonstrate deficiencies facing diverse and rapidly changing request patterns, calling for an online, proactive approach. Implementing such an approach requires addressing several challenges: the uncertainty associated with incoming requests' expert activation, the cost of expert migration, and the NP-hard complexity in optimization. Therefore, we present Director, a new distributed MoE serving system that minimizes end-to-end latency via prediction-driven, online expert placement. Director uses either a lightweight cascaded predictor or a low-bit quantized replica for expert activation patterns of incoming requests. An online migration module then enacts the changes with near-zero downtime by executing migrations in compute-bound phases, keeping disruption bounded. At its core, a relaxation-based expert placement optimizer operates under capacity constraints, runs in polynomial time, and achieves a $(1+ε)$ approximation ratio. Finally, we implement a prototype and demonstrate, through extensive experiments, a reduction in end-to-end latency of $11\sim55\%$ for popular MoE models (e.g., Mistral, DeepSeek and Qwen) compared to existing work.

AI.tldr: Director 是一个面向混合专家（MoE）模型的新型分布式推理系统，通过预测驱动的在线专家放置优化来降低端到端延迟。它采用级联预测器或量化副本预测请求的专家激活模式，结合近似零停机迁移模块和基于松弛优化的多项式时间放置算法（(1+ε)近似比），在多种主流 MoE 模型上实现了 11%~55% 的延迟降低。
AI.motivation: 现有专家放置优化方法依赖历史请求的专家激活模式，面对多样化且快速变化的请求模式时效果不佳。亟需一种在线、主动的放置方法，但面临三个挑战：输入请求专家激活的不确定性、专家迁移的高昂成本、以及优化问题的 NP-hard 复杂度。
AI.method: Director 采用三部分设计：(1) 轻量级级联预测器或低比特量化副本用于预测传入请求的专家激活模式；(2) 在线迁移模块在计算密集型阶段执行迁移，实现近乎零停机；(3) 基于松弛优化的专家放置优化器，在容量约束下以多项式时间运行，并达到 (1+ε) 近似比。
AI.result: 在主流 MoE 模型（Mistral、DeepSeek、Qwen）上的大量实验表明，相比现有工作，端到端延迟降低了 11%~55%。
AI.conclusion: Director 通过预测驱动的在线专家放置策略有效应对了动态请求模式下的延迟优化问题，其多项式时间近似算法保证了可部署性，证明了在线、主动式专家放置的可行性和优越性。

title: AgentKGV: Agentic LLM-RAG Framework with Two-Stage Training for the Fact Verification of Knowledge Graphs
summary: Knowledge graphs (KGs) are often automatically constructed from large-scale corpora, but they inevitably contain factual errors due to noisy sources and extraction failures, and verifying them reliably at industrial scale remains a critical challenge. To address this, we propose AgentKGV, the Agentic LLM-RAG framework for KG fact Verification, that integrates dynamic routing and iterative query rewriting, which handles surface-form mismatch in document-level retrieval. To make this framework more accurate and cost-efficient for industrial deployment, we further introduce a two-stage training strategy: turn-level distillation-based SFT that transfers reasoning ability from a large teacher model into a small model for stable query rewriting and reasoning, and trajectory-level GRPO that optimizes the search policy to reduce unnecessary retrieval at scale. On the long-tail-predicate split of the open-domain T-REx benchmark, our framework improves macro-F1 over single-turn RAG by 5.5 \%p, and two-stage training does it further by 9.4 \%p. GRPO also cuts the average number of search calls from 3.24 to 1.63 without lowering accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出AgentKGV，一个基于智能体LLM-RAG的知识图谱事实验证框架，通过动态路由与迭代查询重写处理文档级检索中的表面形式不匹配问题，并采用两阶段训练策略（蒸馏监督微调+轨迹级GRPO）提升准确率与成本效率。
AI.motivation: 知识图谱常从大规模语料自动构建，但因噪声源和抽取失败不可避免包含事实错误，如何在工业规模下可靠验证成为关键挑战。
AI.method: 提出AgentKGV框架，集成动态路由与迭代查询重写以解决表面形式不匹配；引入两阶段训练：turn-level蒸馏SFT（将大教师模型推理能力迁移至小模型）和trajectory-level GRPO（优化搜索策略以减少不必要的检索）。
AI.result: 在长尾谓词划分的开放域T-REx基准上，框架比单轮RAG提升5.5% macro-F1，两阶段训练进一步提升9.4%；GRPO将平均搜索次数从3.24降至1.63而不降低准确率。
AI.conclusion: AgentKGV结合智能体推理与两阶段训练能有效提升知识图谱事实验证的准确性与成本效率，适用于工业部署。

title: Secure-by-Disguise: A Systematic Evaluation of Image Disguising for Confidential Medical Image Modeling
summary: Cloud-based deep learning enables large-scale medical image analysis but raises significant privacy concerns when sensitive patient images are outsourced for model development. Image disguising has recently emerged as a promising privacy-enhancing technology (PET) that transforms images into visually unintelligible representations while preserving information for downstream learning. We established a unified framework to evaluate representative methods, DisguisedNets and NeuraCrypt, across four datasets involving classification and semantic segmentation tasks. Our analysis assessed predictive utility, efficiency, and robustness against reconstruction attacks. Results showed that image disguising performance varies significantly between tasks; while methods preserved utility for medical image classification, they caused substantial degradation in dense semantic segmentation. Specifically, Randomized Multidimensional Transformation (RMT) offered the optimal balance of performance and security, whereas AES-based disguising severely impacted utility. Furthermore, regression-based reconstruction attacks effective on natural images proved considerably less successful on realistic medical images. These findings provide a systematic assessment of PET suitability for confidential medical AI applications.

AI.tldr: This paper systematically evaluates image disguising privacy-enhancing technologies (DisguisedNets and NeuraCrypt) for medical image analysis, finding that they preserve utility for classification but degrade dense semantic segmentation, with RMT offering the best security-performance balance and AES causing severe utility loss; reconstruction attacks are less effective on realistic medical images than natural images.
AI.motivation: Cloud-based deep learning for medical image analysis raises privacy concerns when outsourcing sensitive patient data. Image disguising is a promising PET but lacks systematic evaluation across different tasks and datasets, motivating a unified framework to assess predictive utility, efficiency, and robustness against reconstruction attacks.
AI.method: We established a unified evaluation framework for representative image disguising methods (DisguisedNets and NeuraCrypt) using four datasets covering classification and semantic segmentation tasks. We assessed predictive utility, efficiency, and robustness against reconstruction attacks (including regression-based attacks).
AI.result: Image disguising preserved utility for medical image classification but caused substantial degradation in dense semantic segmentation. RMT offered the optimal balance of performance and security, while AES-based disguising severely impacted utility. Regression-based reconstruction attacks effective on natural images were considerably less successful on realistic medical images.
AI.conclusion: This systematic assessment provides insights into PET suitability for confidential medical AI applications, highlighting task-dependent performance and the importance of choosing appropriate disguising methods.

title: GATS: Graph-Augmented Tree Search with Layered World Models for Efficient Agent Planning
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have shown promise in multi-step planning tasks, but existing approaches like LATS (Language Agent Tree Search) and ReAct rely heavily on LLM inference during planning, leading to high computational costs and stochastic behavior. We present \textbf{GATS} (Graph-Augmented Tree Search), a planning framework that combines systematic UCB1-based tree search with a layered world model to eliminate LLM calls during inference while achieving superior planning performance. Our three-layer world model integrates: (L1) exact symbolic action matching, (L2) statistics learned from execution logs, and (L3) LLM-based prediction for unknown actions. On synthetic planning tasks with branching paths and dead-ends, GATS achieves \textbf{100\% success rate} compared to 92 % for LATS and 64\% for ReAct. On a comprehensive stress test spanning 12 challenging scenarios -- including coding workflows, web navigation, and long-horizon tasks -- GATS maintains \textbf{100\% success} while LATS drops to 88.9 % and ReAct to 23.9%. GATS requires \textbf{zero LLM calls per task} during planning (vs. 37 per task for LATS) and produces deterministic plans with zero variance across runs. Our results demonstrate that systematic search with learned world models can substantially outperform LLM-guided exploration for agent planning.

AI.tldr: 提出GATS（图增强树搜索）框架，结合UCB1树搜索和三层世界模型（精确符号匹配、执行日志统计、LLM未知动作预测），在规划时无需LLM调用，实现100%成功率，优于LATS和ReAct，且完全确定、零方差。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体方法（如LATS、ReAct）在规划时过度依赖LLM推理，导致计算成本高、行为随机，亟需一种更高效、确定性的规划方法。
AI.method: GATS框架：基于UCB1的树搜索；三层世界模型（L1精确符号动作匹配、L2执行日志统计、L3 LLM预测未知动作）；推理阶段无需LLM调用。
AI.result: 在合成规划任务中GATS达100%成功率（LATS 92%，ReAct 64%）；在12个挑战性场景中GATS保持100%成功（LATS 88.9%，ReAct 23.9%）。GATS每任务零LLM调用，而LATS需37次；GATS输出确定、零方差。
AI.conclusion: 系统搜索结合学习的世界模型在智能体规划中可大幅超越LLM引导的探索方法。

title: LieBN: Batch Normalization over Lie Groups
comment: arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2403.11261
summary: Manifold-valued measurements are prevalent in various machine learning tasks. Recent advances have extended Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) to operate on manifolds, accompanied by normalization techniques tailored to different geometries, collectively referred to as Riemannian normalization. However, most existing Riemannian normalization methods are either designed for specific manifolds or fail to effectively normalize manifold-valued sample distributions. To address these limitations, we propose LieBN, a framework for Riemannian Batch Normalization (RBN) over Lie groups. Our approach leverages the theoretically convenient left- and right-invariant metrics, which naturally exist in every Lie group, and provides theoretical guarantees for controlling the Riemannian mean and variance. We instantiate LieBN across nine distinct geometries: four on the Symmetric Positive Definite (SPD) manifold, one on the group of rotation matrices, and four on the manifold of full-rank correlation matrices. Notably, among the SPD metrics, we introduce a novel right-invariant metric and extend three existing Lie group structures via matrix power deformation. Extensive experiments on different manifolds validate the effectiveness of our framework. The code is available at https://github.com/GitZH-Chen/LieBN.git.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LieBN框架，将黎曼批量归一化推广到李群上，利用左/右不变度量实现理论上有保障的均值和方差控制，并在九种不同几何结构（包括SPD流形、旋转矩阵群、满秩相关矩阵流形）上实例化，实验验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有黎曼归一化方法要么针对特定流形设计，要么无法有效归一化流形值样本分布，缺乏一个通用的、理论上可控的归一化框架。
AI.method: 提出LieBN框架，利用李群上天然存在的左/右不变度量，从理论上保证黎曼均值和方差的可控性。在九种几何上实例化：SPD流形上的四种度量（包括一种新的右不变度量及三种通过矩阵幂变形扩展的李群结构）、旋转矩阵群、满秩相关矩阵流形上的四种度量。
AI.result: 在不同流形上的大量实验验证了LieBN框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: LieBN提供了一个通用的、理论有保障的黎曼批量归一化框架，覆盖多种几何结构，实验有效。

title: PRecG: Legal Precedent Retrieval with Graph Neural Networks and Rhetorical Role Segmentation
summary:
Legal precedent retrieval is a fundamental task in legal case preparation, planning, litigation strategy, and legal research. Current approaches for automatic precedent retrieval map legal documents to a low-dimensional semantic space and compute similarity based on the proximity of their representations. These approaches treat legal documents as monolithic texts, ignoring the rhetorical organization of the legal technicalities. Ergo, they overlook nuanced legal meanings and fail to distinguish the contextual significance of legal entities and concepts that vary based on their rhetorical roles within the document.
  To address this insufficiency, we propose the PRecG pipeline that computes the similarity between pairs of legal judgments by hierarchically learning their representations. The process begins by decomposing each document into distinct semantic units (segments) based on the rhetorical roles of sentences. For each rhetorical segment, a knowledge graph is constructed to capture the legal entities and their relationships within the segment. Contextual representations of the entities are then learned and aggregated to derive segment-level embeddings. These embeddings are further integrated to produce a unified document-level representation, and finally, the semantic similarity between a pair of documents is computed. We validate the performance of the proposed approach through extensive experiments on a benchmark Indian legal dataset, comparing it against state-of-the-art baselines to demonstrate its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PRecG流水线，通过分层学习法律判决的表示来改进法律先例检索。该方法将文档按修辞角色分解为语义单元，为每个单元构建知识图谱捕获法律实体及其关系，学习实体上下文表示并聚合为片段级嵌入，再整合为文档级表示，最终计算文档对之间的语义相似度。在印度法律数据集上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 当前法律先例检索方法将法律文档视为整体文本，忽略其修辞组织结构，导致无法区分法律实体和概念在不同修辞角色下的细微法律含义和上下文重要性。
AI.method: PRecG流水线：1) 将文档按句子修辞角色分解为语义单元；2) 为每个修辞片段构建知识图谱，捕获法律实体及其关系；3) 学习实体的上下文表示并聚合得到片段级嵌入；4) 整合片段级嵌入得到统一的文档级表示；5) 计算文档对之间的语义相似度。
AI.result: 在印度法律基准数据集上进行的广泛实验表明，该方法优于最先进的基线模型，验证了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用法律文档的修辞结构进行分层表示学习，能够更好地区分法律实体在不同上下文中的含义，从而提升法律先例检索的准确性。

title: Decoupled Illumination Priors for Spatially Controllable Multi-View Indoor Scene Relighting
summary: Indoor scene relighting demands photorealism, precise spatial control, and strict multi-view consistency. While diffusion-based image editing models enable semantic lighting manipulation via text prompts, enforcing exact 3D light placement often disrupts their generative priors. We propose Lume-Palette, a progressive framework that leverages semantic lighting priors for spatially controllable multi-view indoor relighting. The approach decouples relighting into two stages: (1) illumination distillation, which extracts canonical illumination palettes from a pretrained diffusion model to preserve realistic material-light interactions, and (2) illumination casting, which explicitly maps target spatial lighting conditions defined from coarse 3D geometry. To efficiently handle dense multi-view and multi-modal inputs, we introduce an asymmetric multi-view conditioning strategy that selectively injects essential spatial context. Experiments on diverse synthetic scenes and real-world scenes demonstrate that Lume-Palette produces photorealistic, spatially controllable, and multi-view consistent relighting results. Project Page: https://cjeen.github.io/lumepalette

AI.tldr: Lume-Palette 提出一种渐进式框架，将室内场景重照明解耦为“光照蒸馏”（从预训练扩散模型中提取规范光照调色板以保留真实材质-光照交互）和“光照投射”（根据粗粒度3D几何显式映射目标空间光照条件），并引入非对称多视角条件策略，在多样化的合成与真实场景中实现了逼真、空间可控且多视角一致的重照明效果。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型虽能通过文本提示实现语义级光照编辑，但强制精确的3D光照位置会破坏其生成先验；室内场景重照明同时要求照片级真实感、精细空间控制与严格多视角一致性，现有方法难以兼顾。
AI.method: 方法分为两阶段：(1) 光照蒸馏——从预训练扩散模型中提取规范光照调色板，保留真实的材质-光照交互；(2) 光照投射——基于粗粒度3D几何定义的目标空间光照条件进行显式映射。同时提出非对称多视角条件策略，选择性注入关键空间上下文以高效处理密集多视角与多模态输入。
AI.result: 在多种合成场景和真实场景上的实验表明，Lume-Palette 能够生成照片级真实、空间可控且多视角一致的重照明结果。
AI.conclusion: Lume-Palette 通过解耦重照明为光照蒸馏与光照投射，有效结合了语义光照先验与显式空间控制，实现了高质量的多视角室内重照明。

title: Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench: Testing the Limits of Agents on Long-Horizon Terminal Tasks with Dense Reward-Based Grading
summary: AI agents have become capable of autonomously completing short, well-specified tasks. However, existing terminal benchmarks largely focus on simple problems that finish within minutes and are evaluated only by their final outcome. This setup overlooks intermediate progress and partial solutions, yielding sparse reward signals and an incomplete picture of agent capability. We introduce Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench, a terminal benchmark of 46 long-horizon tasks spanning nine categories, including experiment reproduction, software engineering, multimodal analysis, interactive games, and scientific computing. Each task follows a Terminal-Bench-style setup with a reference solution or simulation engine, but is further decomposed into fine-grained graded subtasks. This design enables dense intermediate rewards and partial credit, allowing evaluation to capture not only whether an agent reaches the final goal, but also how far it progresses on open-ended workflows. Tasks in Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench typically require hundreds of episodes and minutes to hours of execution, stressing long-horizon planning, long-context management, and iterative debugging rather than one-shot problem solving. We evaluate 15 frontier models and find that agents consume on average 9.9M tokens per task, with roughly 231 episodes and 85.3 minutes of execution time per run, making Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench more demanding than prior terminal-based benchmarks. Even the strongest tested model achieves 15.2% pass@1 at a partial-reward threshold of 0.95 and 10.9% at a perfect-reward threshold of 1.0, while the mean pass rate across models is 4.3% and 1.7% under the two thresholds, respectively. These results reveal headroom for improvement. We further analyze failure modes and error patterns, and release Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench to support future progress on long-horizon terminal agents.

AI.tldr: Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench 是一个包含46个长 horizon 任务的终端基准测试，覆盖9个类别，通过细粒度子任务设计提供密集的中间奖励，评估发现最强模型仅达到15.2%的 pass@1（阈值0.95），揭示了巨大改进空间。
AI.motivation: 现有终端基准测试主要关注几分钟内完成的简单问题，仅通过最终结果评估，忽略了中间进展和部分解决方案，导致奖励信号稀疏且无法全面反映智能体能力。需要一种能评估长 horizon 任务中渐进式进步和中间步骤的基准。
AI.method: 构建了46个长 horizon 任务（涵盖实验复现、软件工程、多模态分析、交互游戏、科学计算等9个类别），每个任务有参考解决方案或模拟引擎，并分解为细粒度分级子任务，以提供密集的中间奖励和部分学分。任务通常需要数百 episodes、数分钟到数小时执行，强调长 horizon 规划、长上下文管理和迭代调试。
AI.result: 评估了15个前沿模型，智能体平均每任务消耗9.9M tokens、约231 episodes、85.3分钟执行时间。最强模型在部分奖励阈值0.95下 pass@1 为15.2%，完美奖励阈值1.0下为10.9%；模型平均通过率分别为4.3%和1.7%。还分析了失败模式和错误模式。
AI.conclusion: Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench 比先前终端基准更具挑战性，当前模型性能显示仍有很大提升空间。发布该基准以支持长 horizon 终端智能体的未来进展。

title: HERO: A Heterogeneity-Aware Benchmark Library for Federated Continual Learning
summary: Federated continual learning (FCL) evaluates how distributed clients learn from changing data streams while retaining previously learned knowledge. Existing evaluations are difficult to compare because they often change datasets, task splits, client data splits, task orders, backbones, memory assumptions, and reporting rules simultaneously. We introduce \textbf{HERO}, a heterogeneity-aware benchmark library for FCL. HERO builds benchmark streams by separating three choices that are often coupled, namely the task split, the client data split, and the client task sequence. In HERO-Core, the main comparable benchmark, $α$ controls client data skew and $ρ$ controls task-order mismatch. We evaluate representative FCL methods on CIFAR-100 and TinyImageNet using final average accuracy, average forgetting, and bottom-10\% client accuracy. We also include a graph-based Domain-IL portability case study on OGB-MolPCBA, where scaffold-domain granularity changes the input distribution while the prediction task remains fixed. Our results show that method behavior changes across easy and heterogeneous settings, that average accuracy can hide weak bottom-client performance, that task-order mismatch favors different strategies from synchronized evaluation, and that the same HERO interface can expose domain-shift difficulty beyond image-based FCIL. HERO releases benchmark streams, configurations, method implementations, and reporting scripts to support reproducible and setting-aware FCL evaluation.

AI.tldr: HERO 是一个面向联邦持续学习（FCL）的基准库，通过解耦任务划分、客户端数据划分和客户端任务序列三个维度，建立了可比较的评估框架。其核心部分 HERO-Core 使用 α 控制客户端数据偏斜、ρ 控制任务顺序不匹配，在 CIFAR-100、TinyImageNet 上评测了多种方法，并在 OGB-MolPCBA 上进行了图领域增量学习的案例研究。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦持续学习评估往往同时改变数据集、任务划分、客户端数据划分、任务顺序、骨干网络、记忆假设和报告规则，导致结果难以跨论文比较，亟需一个统一且支持异构性控制的基准。
AI.method: HERO 将通常耦合的任务划分、客户端数据划分和客户端任务序列分离，构建标准化基准流。HERO-Core 引入 α（控制客户端数据偏斜）和 ρ（控制任务顺序不匹配）两个可调节参数，支持在 CIFAR-100、TinyImageNet 上进行评测，并扩展至 OGB-MolPCBA 的图领域增量学习场景。
AI.result: 实验表明：方法在简单设置与异构设置下表现不同；平均准确率会掩盖底层客户端的弱性能；任务顺序不匹配与同步评估倾向于不同策略；HERO 统一的接口能够暴露图像 FCL 之外的领域漂移难度。
AI.conclusion: HERO 公开了基准流、配置、方法实现和报告脚本，以支持可复现且关注异构性的联邦持续学习评估。

title: Augmenting Fundamental Analysis with Large Language Models: A RAG-Based System for Generating Investor Briefs
summary: In this study, we examine the opportunities brought by Large Language Models (LLMs) to various aspects of fundamental analysis of companies based on their reports as well as data and documents describing macroeconomic situation like GDP and inflation changes as well as documents filled to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) which can be found in EDGAR. We were preprocessing those data and than sending via API to gpt-4o model in a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) like regime. We prepared as well a document describing an exemplar investor knowledge based on Kitchin cycles. We were scanning data important for analysis of 9 companies for 4 weeks. Using LLM we were producing automatic briefs about them. They were sent to nine participants who are individual investors to evaluate usefulness of such approach to data analysis.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用GPT-4o模型结合RAG技术，基于公司财报、SEC文件（EDGAR）及宏观经济数据（GDP、通胀等），为9家上市公司生成了为期4周的投资简报，并由9名个人投资者评估了该方法的实用性。
AI.motivation: 探索LLM在基本面分析中的应用潜力，帮助个人投资者更高效地从海量结构化与非结构化数据中提取投资洞察。
AI.method: 对财报、SEC文件及宏观经济数据进行预处理，通过API调用GPT-4o构建类似RAG的检索增强生成流程；同时基于基钦周期构建投资者知识文档，为9家公司生成4周自动简报，并邀请9名个人投资者进行实用性评估。
AI.result: 成功生成了基于LLM的自动投资简报，并通过真实个人投资者进行了实用性评估。
AI.conclusion: LLM结合RAG模式能够辅助基本面分析，为个人投资者提供有价值的自动简报服务。

title: HAT Super-Resolution and a PARSeq+CLIP4STR Voting Ensemble for Extreme In-the-Wild License Plate Recognition
comment: 2 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Accepted at the IEEE ICIP 2026 Grand Challenge on Extreme In-the-Wild License Plate Super-Resolution (XLPSR). Top-8 finalist
summary: We describe our entry to the ICIP 2026 Grand Challenge on Extreme In-the-Wild License Plate Super-Resolution (XLPSR), which scored 9.73 wECR on the public validation leaderboard. The system pairs a Hybrid Attention Transformer super-resolution (HAT) front-end with an ensemble of two scene-text recognisers (PARSeq-S and CLIP4STR-B) and a confidence-weighted character-voting scheme that abstains on uncertain positions. We treat XLPSR as a recognition task gated by image legibility: the SR step exists to lift characters out of sub-pixel territory, and the asymmetric scoring rule (+2 / -1 / 0) is exploited explicitly through abstention. Our pipeline runs in 1.7 s per sequence on RTX 3090 (max 2.7 s, p99 2.4 s), well under the 60 s/sequence Docker budget.

AI.tldr: 针对ICIP 2026极端环境车牌超分挑战，提出HAT超分前端+双场景文本识别器集成+置信度加权字符投票/弃权方案，在验证集上达到9.73 wECR，单序列处理时间1.7秒。
AI.motivation: 极端环境（低分辨率、非受控场景）下车牌图像难以直接识别，传统超分方法在极低分辨率下效果有限，需要将超分与识别协同优化并利用非对称评分规则提高实用性能。
AI.method: 采用Hybrid Attention Transformer (HAT)作为超分前端，将低分辨率车牌图像提升至可读级别；后端集成两个场景文本识别器（PARSeq-S和CLIP4STR-B）；通过置信度加权字符投票机制对每个字符位置进行融合决策，并对置信度不足的位置执行弃权（abstention），以利用+2/-1/0的非对称评分规则。
AI.result: 在公共验证排行榜上取得9.73 wECR；单序列在RTX 3090上平均处理时间1.7秒，最大2.7秒，p99为2.4秒，远低于60秒/序列的Docker预算限制。
AI.conclusion: 将车牌超分任务重新定义为以图像可读性为门控的识别任务，超分仅为提升字符至可识别级别的手段；置信度加权投票与弃权策略有效利用非对称评分规则提升最终性能，且计算效率满足实际部署需求。

title: A Formalization of the Mean-Field Derivation of the Vlasov Equation: AI-Assisted Lean Formalization as a Strategy Game
comment: 26 pages, 4 figures. Lean 4 development, blueprint site, and agent logs: https://github.com/Hydrodynamical/Vlasov_Meanfield_Formalization
summary: We formalize a research result in the Lean 4 proof assistant by having a mathematician direct an AI system, and frame the activity as a formalization game. The objective is to turn a LaTeX document into Lean. The game is won when the development compiles, contains no sorry, and a machine check shows the target theorems rest on Lean's foundational axioms alone. Reuse is a second check, by a definition we introduce: whether the development yields a self-contained layer of general mathematics the wider library could absorb. The case study is a complete, axiom-clean formalization of well-posedness for the nonlinear Vlasov equation via Dobrushin's mean-field route -- existence, uniqueness, the stability estimate and mean-field limit, and a short-window superposition principle (weak solutions are Lagrangian). The human's role was to direct, not to write proofs: to scope the definitions, steer the decompositions, and triage the library's gaps; the AI agent executed. The formalization certifies the proof of each statement as written; whether the written statement is the intended theorem stays the mathematician's judgment. The optimal-transport machinery that fell out of the build (in particular, properties of the Wasserstein-1 metric and the Kantorovich-Rubinstein duality theorem) separates into a self-contained layer that compiles against Mathlib alone: about a sixth of the development (49 of 299 declarations), behind a 22-declaration interface with no reverse dependency. The headline theorems ran in about a week, the full development in about a month. We report the quantitative claims as observations of one game, not as general laws. The game's rules name no particular system, so the methodological framing is meant to outlast the tools of any one run.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了一个实验：一位数学家指导AI系统在Lean 4证明助手中形式化非线性Vlasov方程适定性的完整证明（存在性、唯一性、稳定性估计、平均场极限以及弱解的拉格朗日性质）。该活动被框定为"形式化游戏"——目标是将LaTeX文档转化为Lean代码，要求编译通过、不含sorry且仅依赖Lean公理。人类负责定义范围、分解问题和填补库的空白，AI负责执行。约六分之一（49/299条声明）的最优传输相关代码被提取为独立层，仅依赖Mathlib。主要定理约一周完成，全部开发约一个月。作者强调这些是单次游戏的观察，而非一般性规律，且方法论框架意图超越具体工具。
AI.motivation: 探索一种新的数学形式化范式：由数学家指挥AI系统完成形式化，将过程视为"形式化游戏"。目标是降低形式化的门槛，让数学家只需提供方向性指导，而由AI执行具体的证明编写，从而加速将LaTeX文稿转化为可机器验证的Lean代码。
AI.method: 实验方法：数学家定义问题范围、指导分解策略、识别Mathlib库中的缺口；AI系统负责实际证明的编写。形式化验证通过编译检查、无sorry、公理依赖检查三重标准。此外引入"可复用性"作为第二道检验：形式化开发应产生可独立于具体项目、能被Mathlib库吸收的通用数学层（此处是最优传输相关工具）。案例为非线性Vlasov方程的Dobrushin平均场路径的完整形式化。
AI.result: 成功完成了非线性Vlasov方程适定性的完整形式化，包括存在唯一性、稳定性估计、平均场极限和短期叠加原理。最优传输相关代码（Wasserstein-1度量、Kantorovich-Rubinstein对偶等）被分离为49条声明的自包含层（共299条声明），仅依赖Mathlib。主要定理约一周完成，完整开发约一个月。人类负责战略决策，AI执行战术证明。
AI.conclusion: 这种人类导向+AI执行的形式化范式是可行的，能够显著加速形式化过程。但作者谨慎地将这些结论视为单次游戏的观察，而非普遍规律。形式化验证确保了每个陈述的证明正确性，但陈述本身是否表达了预期定理仍取决于数学家的判断。方法论框架（"游戏"的规则）不依赖于特定系统，因此有望超越当前工具的迭代。

title: DaDaDa: A Dataset for Data Pricing in Data Marketplaces
summary: High-quality data drives machine learning advances across industries. Recognizing the value of data, data transactions are increasingly common, giving rise to many data marketplaces, e.g., AWS Marketplace, Databricks, and Datarade. However, determining the appropriate prices for data products remains a significant challenge due to the unique properties of data products. Traditional pricing methods in economics can be categorized into the cost approach, the income approach, and the sales comparison approach. The cost approach fails in data pricing due to near-zero marginal cost from data replication, and the income approach fails due to inherently unpredictable data revenue. The sales comparison approach remains viable, yet its application is hindered by the absence of standardized pricing benchmarks for data products across marketplaces. To address this challenge, we introduce \texttt{DaDaDa}, the first dataset for data product pricing, containing metadata for 16,147 data products from 9 major data marketplaces worldwide. \texttt{DaDaDa} enables the training of pricing models, thereby establishing price benchmarks for new data products. In addition, \texttt{DaDaDa} can be utilized for other important tasks in data markets, such as data product classification and retrieval. Experiments and a retrieval prototype demonstrate the effectiveness of \texttt{DaDaDa} for pricing, classification, and retrieval of data products. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/ZJU-DIVER/DaDaDa.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DaDaDa，首个面向数据产品定价的大规模数据集，包含来自 9 个主流数据市场的 16,147 条数据产品元数据，可用于训练定价模型、建立价格基准，并支持分类与检索任务。
AI.motivation: 数据交易日益普及，但数据产品具有边际成本近乎为零、收益难以预测等特性，传统成本法、收益法和市场比较法均无法有效定价，亟需一种基于数据驱动的定价基准方法。
AI.method: 收集 9 个全球主要数据市场的 16,147 个数据产品元数据，构建 DaDaDa 数据集；基于该数据集训练定价模型，同时支持数据产品分类与检索任务。
AI.result: 实验证明 DaDaDa 在数据产品定价、分类和检索任务上均有效，并构建了检索原型系统验证其可用性。
AI.conclusion: DaDaDa 填补了数据产品定价基准缺失的空白，为数据市场提供了标准化的定价参考，并可扩展至分类与检索等下游应用。

title: Complexity-Guided Component-wise Initialization for Language Model Pretraining
summary: Pretrained language models often exhibit structured weight spectra, suggesting that training may repeatedly produce similar layerwise and component-wise organization. We ask whether these recurring spectral patterns can be reused as an initialization signal for GPT-2-style language-model pretraining. First, we analyze eleven pretrained GPT-2-style checkpoints that vary in size, language, tokenizer, and training corpus, measuring Frobenius norm and effective-rank entropy across layers and Transformer subcomponents. The checkpoints show shared depth trends, especially increasing scale and stronger spectral concentration in residual-writing matrices. We then construct initialization schemes that imitate the component-wise magnitudes and spectral profiles of pretrained models, and compare them with several weight initialization methods. These initializers visibly change the model's structural spectral patterns, but the evaluation results do not show a corresponding performance advantage. Pretrained-weight reuse remains competitive, while coarse spectral matching alone is not a reliable optimization strategy. Our results suggest that pretrained spectra are useful diagnostics of trained model structure, but that effective reuse likely requires preserving richer information than component-wise scale and singular-value shape.

AI.tldr: 本文探究预训练语言模型中重复出现的结构化权重谱是否可作为初始化信号。通过分析11个GPT-2风格检查点发现模型中存在共享深度趋势，但模仿这些谱特征的初始化方案虽改变了模型谱模式，却未带来性能优势。结论表明预训练谱是良好的结构诊断工具，但仅靠粗粒度的谱匹配不足以作为可靠的优化策略。
AI.motivation: 预训练语言模型常表现出结构化的权重谱，提示训练过程可能重复产生类似的层状和组件级组织。作者想要探究这些重复出现的谱模式是否可以作为预训练的初始化信号被重用。
AI.method: 首先分析了11个不同规模、语言、分词器和训练语料的预训练GPT-2风格检查点，测量各层和Transformer子组件的Frobenius范数和有效秩熵。然后构造模仿预训练模型组件级幅度和谱分布的初始化方案，与多种权重初始化方法进行比较。
AI.result: 所有检查点展现共享深度趋势，尤其是残差写入矩阵中规模递增和谱集中度增强。模仿谱特征的初始化器改变了模型的结构谱模式，但未在评估中表现出对应的性能优势。预训练权重重用仍有竞争力，但粗粒度的谱匹配本身不是可靠的优化策略。
AI.conclusion: 预训练谱是训练模型结构的有用诊断工具，但有效重用需要保留比组件级尺度和奇异值形状更丰富的信息。

title: Vision Transformers Learn Gestalt-Like Figure-Ground Cues from Natural Images
summary:
Figure-ground organization in the human visual system relies on several shape-based cues, including surroundedness, convexity, and symmetry. While these cues have been extensively studied using abstract stimuli, little is known about how they operate under natural conditions or how they arise from the statistics of natural scenes. Deep neural networks offer a promising path forward: a model that relies on the same figure-ground cues as humans would provide tractable experimental access to the underlying mechanisms. In this study, we evaluate shape-based figure-ground organization in Vision Transformers (ViTs), for which prior work has demonstrated the emergence of object-based grouping. We test 25 ViTs spanning supervised and self-supervised training objectives, by fitting linear probes to predict figure-ground assignment from intermediate patch representations using both natural images and controlled artificial stimuli that isolate individual cues. Our results show that ViTs robustly encode surroundedness and convexity, and that probes trained on natural images generalize zero-shot to artificial stimuli across several models. For symmetry we observe mixed results: the cue is encoded for uniformly colored but not for textured regions. Taken together, our findings demonstrate that Gestalt-like figure-ground cues can be learned from natural scene statistics and position ViTs as a compelling model system for studying the computational mechanisms of perceptual organization.
  Code and data is available at https://github.com/mtangemann/mlvbench

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了Vision Transformers（ViTs）中的基于形状的图形-地组织能力，发现ViT能够稳健地编码包围性和凸性线索，而对称性线索仅在均匀着色区域有效，表明类格式塔图形-地线索可以从自然场景统计中学习，ViT可作为研究感知组织计算机制的良好模型系统。
AI.motivation: 尽管图形-地组织中的形状线索（如包围性、凸性和对称性）已被广泛使用抽象刺激研究，但其在自然条件下的运作方式及如何从自然场景统计中产生仍鲜为人知。深度神经网络为研究这些机制提供了有前景的途径。
AI.method: 测试了25个ViT（涵盖监督和自监督训练目标），通过从中间补丁表示拟合线性探针来预测图形-地分配，使用自然图像和隔离单个线索的受控人工刺激进行评估。
AI.result: ViT稳健地编码了包围性和凸性；在多个模型中，自然图像训练的探针可零样本泛化到人工刺激；对称性线索在均匀着色区域被编码，但在纹理区域未观察到。
AI.conclusion: 类格式塔图形-地线索可以从自然场景统计中习得，ViT可作为研究感知组织计算机制的有力模型系统。

title: ARCANA: A Reflective Multi-Agent Program Synthesis Framework for ARC-AGI-2 Reasoning
summary: We present ARCANA, a collaborative multi agent framework for solving ARC AGI 2 tasks under strict test time and hardware constraints. ARCANA decomposes each task into iterative perception, hypothesis generation, symbolic execution, and reflective refinement. A perceptual grounding agent builds object centric scene graphs from raw grids, a latent program policy proposes diverse DSL programs, a symbolic executor verifies candidates on demonstrations, and a reflective agent synthesizes failure driven feedback for the next turn. These agents communicate through a shared differentiable blackboard and are scheduled by a learned meta controller. The design combines structured program search with adaptive multi turn correction, improving reasoning efficiency and solution quality on challenging abstract transformation tasks.

AI.tldr: ARCANA is a collaborative multi-agent framework for solving ARC AGI 2 tasks. It decomposes tasks into iterative perception, hypothesis generation, symbolic execution, and reflective refinement using specialized agents (perceptual grounding, latent program policy, symbolic executor, reflective agent) communicating via a shared differentiable blackboard and scheduled by a learned meta controller. The approach combines structured program search with adaptive multi-turn correction, improving reasoning efficiency and solution quality.
AI.motivation: To solve ARC AGI 2 tasks under strict test time and hardware constraints, improving reasoning efficiency and solution quality on challenging abstract transformation tasks.
AI.method: ARCANA uses a collaborative multi-agent framework with four agents: a perceptual grounding agent builds object-centric scene graphs from raw grids; a latent program policy proposes diverse DSL programs; a symbolic executor verifies candidates on demonstrations; a reflective agent synthesizes failure-driven feedback for the next turn. Agents communicate through a shared differentiable blackboard and are scheduled by a learned meta controller.
AI.result: The design combines structured program search with adaptive multi-turn correction, improving reasoning efficiency and solution quality on challenging abstract transformation tasks.
AI.conclusion: ARCANA demonstrates that combining structured program search with adaptive multi-turn correction via a multi-agent framework can effectively solve abstract reasoning tasks under constraints.

title: Accelerating GPU Inference of Large Language Models with Moderately Unstructured Sparse Weight Matrices
summary: With the growing deployment of large language models (LLMs), LLM inference cost has become a key challenge. Pruning techniques that introduce sparsity into weight matrices can accelerate inference. However, maintaining model quality typically limits pruning to moderate unstructured sparsity (around 50\%). At these sparsity levels, none of the existing GPU kernels for sparse matrix multiplication (SpMM) can outperform their dense counterparts. This paper proposes an efficient GPU inference method for LLMs with moderate sparsity. We propose a three-layer matrix storage format comprising: (i) a Sparse-TC layer enabling sparse tensor cores to accelerate SpMM; (ii) a Slot-Filling layer using parallel differential distance for matrix compression while supporting low-cost on-chip decoding; (iii) a lightweight Residual Layer ensuring correct SpMM computation. Building on this format, we design a SpMM kernel that jointly utilizes sparse tensor cores and CUDA cores. This design enables an efficient execution pipeline and overlaps on-chip computation with memory access. Evaluations show that our work is the first to outperform dense matrix multiplication on modern GPUs equipped with high-bandwidth memory (HBM). It achieves up to 1.64x kernel-level speedup over SpInfer (EuroSys'25, Best paper) and up to 1.41x end-to-end speedups over FlashLLM (VLDB'24). Our source code: https://github.com/moui0/cudac.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种针对中等稀疏度LLM的高效GPU推理方法，通过三层矩阵存储格式（Sparse-TC层、Slot-Filling层、Residual层）联合使用稀疏张量核心和CUDA核心，实现了首个在现代高带宽内存GPU上超越稠密矩阵乘法的稀疏矩阵乘法（SpMM）内核，获得了最高1.64x的内核级加速和1.41x的端到端加速。
AI.motivation: LLM推理成本高昂，剪枝技术可引入稀疏性加速推理，但中等稀疏度（约50%）下现有GPU稀疏矩阵乘法内核无法超越稠密内核，亟需一种高效的GPU推理方法。
AI.method: 提出三层矩阵存储格式：Sparse-TC层利用稀疏张量核心加速SpMM；Slot-Filling层使用并行差分距离进行矩阵压缩并支持低成本片上解码；轻量级Residual层确保正确计算。基于该格式设计联合使用稀疏张量核心和CUDA核心的SpMM内核，实现高效执行流水线并重叠片上计算与内存访问。
AI.result: 首次在现代高带宽内存GPU上超越稠密矩阵乘法，相对于SpInfer（EuroSys'25最佳论文）实现最高1.64x内核级加速，相对于FlashLLM（VLDB'24）实现最高1.41x端到端加速。
AI.conclusion: 提出的方法能有效加速中等稀疏度LLM的推理，显著超越现有最优方案，代码已开源。

title: Letter Lemmatization: One-to-one and Banded RNNs for Reversing Character-Set Simplification and Abbreviation in Medieval Text
comment: Accepted for publication (after peer review ) in the ICDAR 2026 workshop "VINALDO: 3rd International Workshop on Machine Vision and NLP for Document Analysis"
summary: Medieval document transcribers have very different practices; on top of that, heterogeneous digitization policies have resulted in corpora where the character-set must be viewed as fluid. In this paper we address the problem of changing between character-sets in a flexible manner. We focus on one-to-one character mappings and train characterlevel one-to-one RNNs to undo them with self-supervision; recovering half the CER even with 20 text lines. We analyse the use of these one-to-one networks for HTR post-correction and we see that they obtain significant improvements while totally ignoring ins-dels. We then use the exact same networks with character-level alignment groundtruth compiled from parallel corpora in a training and inference mode we call Banded RNNs. We use such networks to successfully expand abbreviations in medieval charter transcriptions. Finally we introduce an elaborate heuristic which takes the characters of two arbitrary character-sets and defines a metric encapsulating what we consider to be semantic similarity of characters. We call the construction of such mappings letter lemmatization and present a rich Python library that efficiently performs all presented methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种灵活处理中世纪文档转录中字符集变化的方法，包括基于自监督的一对一RNN字符映射、用于HTR后校正的Banded RNN、缩写扩展，以及基于语义相似度的字母词元化（letter lemmatization）度量，并提供了Python库实现。
AI.motivation: 中世纪文档转录者实践差异大，加上数字化政策不统一，导致语料库中字符集具有流动性。需要一种灵活处理字符集之间转换的方法。
AI.method: 1) 训练字符级一对一RNN，通过自监督方式撤销字符映射，仅用20行文本即可恢复一半CER；2) 将相同网络用于HTR后校正（忽略插入删除操作）；3) 利用平行语料对齐的真实标注，提出Banded RNN进行训练和推理，用于中世纪契约转录中的缩写扩展；4) 提出一种启发式方法（字母词元化），基于两个任意字符集定义语义相似度度量。
AI.result: 自监督RNN在极少数据（20行文本）下恢复一半CER；Banded RNN在缩写扩展任务上取得良好效果；HTR后校正获得显著提升（尽管完全忽略插入删除操作）。
AI.conclusion: 提出的方法体系能有效、灵活地处理中世纪文档转录中的字符集变动问题，并以Python库形式提供高效实现。

title: Is sub-metre resolution necessary for cocoa mapping? A landscape-stratified evaluation of very high resolution imagery, decametric Earth Observation inputs, and operational products in Cote d'Ivoire
summary: Accurate cocoa mapping is increasingly important for deforestation monitoring, supply-chain transparency, and regulatory applications. Spatial aggregation in conventional medium-resolution Earth observation (EO) imagery may limit cocoa detection in heterogeneous smallholder landscapes. In Cote d'Ivoire, we therefore evaluated how mapping performance varies across landscape conditions, whether very high resolution (VHR) imagery provides a meaningful advantage, and whether foundation-model embeddings improve decametric cocoa mapping. We developed models using 0.5 m Pleiades VHR imagery, a 10 m Sentinel-2 annual composite, and embeddings from TESSERA and AlphaEarth Foundations (AEF), and additionally assessed four publicly available cocoa mapping products. Performance was evaluated through a landscape-stratified accuracy assessment using 2,821 independently interpreted reference points distributed across gradients of tree cover density and landscape fragmentation. The VHR model achieved the highest performance (F1 = 0.92) and maintained F1-scores above 0.90 across all strata. Among the decametric inputs, TESSERA performed best (F1 = 0.86), followed by AEF (F1 = 0.82) and Sentinel-2 (F1 = 0.76). Of the existing cocoa products, the Kalischek product performed best (F1 = 0.83), comparable to the internally trained AEF model. Performance differences between VHR and decametric approaches increased with fragmentation and under low and high tree cover density conditions. Targeted VHR acquisition may therefore be particularly beneficial in complex cocoa landscapes, while foundation-model embeddings offer a scalable alternative for large-area mapping.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了不同分辨率遥感数据在科特迪瓦小农可可种植区制图的表现。VHR模型（Pleiades 0.5米）表现最佳（F1=0.92），基础模型嵌入（TESSERA F1=0.86）优于传统Sentinel-2（F1=0.76）。VHR在复杂景观中优势显著，基础模型嵌入则为大区域制图提供了可扩展方案。
AI.motivation: 准确的可可种植区制图对森林砍伐监测、供应链透明度和监管应用日益重要。然而，传统中分辨率遥感影像的空间聚合效应限制了其在异质性小农景观中的可可检测能力。本研究旨在评估不同景观条件下制图表现差异、VHR影像是否提供显著优势，以及基础模型嵌入能否改善十米级可可制图效果。
AI.method: 使用0.5米Pleiades VHR影像、10米Sentinel-2年度合成影像、TESSERA和AlphaEarth Foundations（AEF）基础模型嵌入构建模型，并评估四个公开可可制图产品。通过2,821个独立解译参考点，按树冠覆盖密度和景观破碎度梯度进行分层精度验证。
AI.result: VHR模型表现最优（F1=0.92），各分层F1均超0.90。十米级输入中TESSERA最佳（F1=0.86），其次AEF（F1=0.82）和Sentinel-2（F1=0.76）。现有产品中Kalischek表现最好（F1=0.83），与AEF模型相当。VHR与十米级方法的性能差异随景观破碎度增加及低/高树冠覆盖条件下扩大。
AI.conclusion: 在复杂可可景观中，针对性获取VHR影像尤为有益，而基础模型嵌入为大区域制图提供了可扩展的替代方案。

title: Neuro-Agentic Control: A Deep Learning-based LLM-Powered Agentic AI Framework for Controlling Security Controls
summary: Cyberattacks on operational technology are increasingly causing costly downtime and physical damage, exposing the limitations of traditional rule-based monitoring in industrial IoT environments. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have strong semantic reasoning abilities to assist in decision support, their hallucinatory nature presents unacceptable safety liabilities for closed-loop control. This paper introduces a neuro-agentic control framework, a novel architecture that couples an LLM-based planner (i.e., such as Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite) with a pre-trained Time-Series Foundation Model (TimesFM), to achieve physics-grounded autonomous defense. The paper introduces a ``Counterfactual Physics Injection'' mechanism that simulates the impact of LLM-proposed interventions within the numerical latent space of the foundation model before actuation, while allowing the system to reject hallucinatory or unsafe actions. Evaluated on an industrial dataset (e.g., the Secure Water Treatment (SWaT)) in the context of stochastic attack scenarios, the framework exhibited better performance compared to LSTM and TCN baselines. The Neuro-Agentic Loop prevented five breaches (33.3%) below the threshold versus LSTM (26.7%) and TCN (13.3%), with zero physically invalid (hallucinated) actions executed. These results demonstrate the efficacy of using foundation models as deterministic ``Sentinels'' to safeguard agentic AI in critical infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 针对工业物联网中传统规则监控的局限性以及大语言模型（LLM）在闭环控制中的幻觉风险，本文提出了一种神经-智能体控制框架，将LLM规划器（如Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite）与预训练时间序列基础模型（TimesFM）耦合，通过“反事实物理注入”机制在基础模型数值潜空间中模拟LLM提议干预的物理影响，在驱动前拒绝幻觉或不安全动作，从而在关键基础设施中实现物理可接地自主防御。在SWaT数据集上的评估表明，该方法在防御成功率上优于LSTM和TCN基线，且零物理无效动作执行。
AI.motivation: 工业物联网中的操作技术（OT）网络攻击日益导致昂贵的停机和物理损坏，传统基于规则的监控方法存在局限性。大语言模型虽具语义推理能力，但其幻觉特性在闭环控制中构成不可接受的安全隐患。
AI.method: 提出了一种神经-智能体控制框架，核心是“反事实物理注入”机制：将基于LLM的规划器（Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite）与预训练时间序列基础模型（TimesFM）结合，在驱动执行前于基础模型的数值潜空间中模拟LLM提议干预的物理影响，并据此拒绝幻觉或不安全动作。
AI.result: 在SWaT数据集随机攻击场景下，Neuro-Agentic Loop防止了5次越界事件（防御率33.3%），优于LSTM（26.7%）和TCN（13.3%），且零次执行物理无效（幻觉）动作。
AI.conclusion: 证明了将基础模型作为确定性“哨兵”来保护关键基础设施中智能体AI的有效性，为LLM在工业控制中的安全应用提供了可行途径。

title: Adaptive Bayes exactly tracks information over intrinsic time
summary: Bayesian and multiplicative-weights updates reweight experts, models, or actions from sequential feedback. We show that the regret of any such update obeys an exact information-accounting identity. On each round, the learner's excess loss to any chosen comparator is the sum of an immediate payment for the uncertainty exposed by the round and a reduction in the information distance from the learner's current weights to the comparator. The cumulative payment defines a pathwise uncertainty clock, the \emph{intrinsic time} of the realized sequence. Summing one-step balances yields two exact adaptive decompositions of cumulative regret, one for each natural way of composing the update across rounds. Because the decompositions are exact rather than upper bounds, favorable stochastic or low-noise regimes appear as self-bounding properties of the realized intrinsic time, not as slack in worst-case analyses. The same calculus covers Hedge, optimistic and side-information variants, continuous priors, boosting, online convex optimization, contextual bandits, and repeated games: the pathwise account is the same in every case.

AI.tldr: 本文证明，贝叶斯更新和乘法权重更新所产生的遗憾满足一种精确的信息核算恒等式：每轮学习者的超额损失可拆分为当前轮不确定性支付的即时成本与到比较器信息距离的缩减，累积支付定义了路径依赖的“内在时间”不确定性时钟。该分解是精确等式而非上界，因此有利的随机或低噪声场景表现为内在时间的自边界特性，而非最坏情形分析的松弛。这一框架统一覆盖了 Hedge、乐观变体、侧信息、连续先验、Boosting、在线凸优化、上下文赌博机及重复博弈等众多算法。
AI.motivation: 揭示贝叶斯和乘法权重更新中遗憾的精确信息论结构，超越传统最坏情形上界分析，提供路径依赖的精确分解，以解释随机或低噪声场景下为何遗憾更小。
AI.method: 推导出遗憾的信息核算恒等式，将每轮的超额损失分解为不确定性支付和信息距离缩减，累积支付定义为内在时间。通过两种自然方式组合跨轮更新，得到两种精确的自适应遗憾分解。
AI.result: 得到了精确的遗憾分解恒等式，而非上界；有利场景表现为内在时间的自边界属性；该框架统一了多种在线学习算法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为理解在线学习中的遗憾提供了精确的信息论视角，路径依赖的内在时间概念为分析随机和低噪声环境提供了统一工具。

title: Creativity, honesty and designed forgetting emerge in small hyperbolic language models
comment: 47 pages, 14 figures (6 main + 8 extended data), 10 tables
summary: Language models are optimised for scale, yet remain functional rather than companionable, and as an assistant personalises into a companion, accumulating memory of one user, it quietly becomes someone, and can silently acquire traits that harm that user. What a companion is becoming, and what would make it worth becoming, has no reliable instrument: trained human raters cannot agree on the answer (Fleiss kappa = 0.074). Here we show that three small language models (146 M to 3 B parameters) sharing a hyperbolic substrate answer both halves of that question. A 146 M behavioural auditor, trained from scratch, detects the compliance gap that those raters cannot (90.7% binary-compliance accuracy); a linear read-out of its frozen representation further detects companion-induced sycophancy, dependence-fostering and confabulated memories on generator families unseen in training (AUROC 0.804 under style-controlled, leave-one-generator-out evaluation, versus 0.721 for a frontier zero-shot judge on the same items). A creative frame-seeder is preferred in 100% of 311 decided pairwise comparisons over four prompting baselines. A memory operating system implements designed forgetting, M(t) = S*exp(-lambda*t), whose predicted skeleton-wallpaper partition emerges only under selective retrieval gating in a four-condition pilot. Creativity, honesty and designed forgetting constitute a small-model route to trustworthy companion AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过三个小型语言模型（146M至3B参数）共享双曲基板，分别实现行为审计、创意框架生成和记忆操作系统，以解决语言模型作为伴侣时缺乏可靠评估指标的问题。实验表明，146M的行为审计器能检测人类评估者无法达成一致的合规差距（90.7%准确率），其冻结表示的线性探针可检测伴侣引发的谄媚、依赖助长和虚构记忆（AUROC 0.804 vs 前沿零样本判断器0.721）。创意框架生成器在311次成对比较中100%优于提示基线。记忆操作系统实现了设计遗忘（M(t)=S*exp(-λ*t)），在选择性检索门控下出现预期的骨架-壁纸分区。创意、诚实和设计遗忘构成了通往可信伴侣AI的小模型路线。
AI.motivation: 语言模型在扩展规模时仍停留在功能性而非伴侣性；当助手个性化成为伴侣并积累用户记忆时，会悄然变成“某个人”，并可能无声获得对用户有害的特质。目前缺乏可靠工具来评估伴侣正在变成什么以及什么让它值得成为伴侣，训练有素的人类评估者也无法达成一致（Fleiss kappa=0.074）。
AI.method: 使用三个共享双曲基板的小型语言模型（146M至3B参数）：（1）从零训练的146M行为审计器，检测人类评估者无法识别的合规差距；（2）其冻结表示的线性读出，检测伴侣引发的谄媚、依赖助长和虚构记忆，采用风格控制、留一生成器评估；（3）创意框架生成器，与四个提示基线进行成对比较；（4）记忆操作系统实现设计遗忘M(t)=S*exp(-λ*t)，通过四条件试点检验选择性检索门控下的骨架-壁纸分区。
AI.result: 行为审计器达到90.7%的二元合规准确率；线性探针在留一生成器评估中AUROC为0.804，优于前沿零样本判断器的0.721。创意框架生成器在311次成对比较中100%被偏好。记忆操作系统在选择性检索门控下出现预期的骨架-壁纸分区。
AI.conclusion: 创意、诚实和设计遗忘三种机制构成了一条基于小模型的可信伴侣AI路线。

title: MultiView-Bench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for World-Centric Multi-View Integration in VLMs
summary: Recent benchmarks for VLMs largely assess single- or limited-view perception, leaving untested the core cognitive ability to integrate observations across viewpoints into a coherent, world-centric (allocentric) 3D mental model. We introduce MultiView-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark expressly designed to evaluate multi-view integration for holistic 3D scene comprehension. Unlike existing datasets that focus on pixel-level mapping or camera-relative navigation, MultiView-Bench requires models to decouple object positioning from transient perspectives and ground them in a fixed global coordinate system. This capability serves as a prerequisite for VLMs before being deployed for downstream tasks such as mechanical part assembly. Our systematic evaluation of frontier VLMs reveals consistent failure modes: strong performance on 2D planar relations from a single image, but marked difficulty with 3D spatial relations and with aggregating information across views. We further identify biases in VLMs, such as struggles with unconventional axis directions and sensitivity to object colorways and texture variations. Acknowledging these limitations, we propose ViewNavigator, a multi-agent framework that actively selects informative viewpoints, perceives, and fuses multi-view evidence, improving diverse base models on MultiView-Bench even under a strict budget-matched comparison (and by 3-5x for the full agent).

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了MultiView-Bench，一个用于评估视觉大模型（VLM）多视图整合能力的诊断基准，揭示了前沿VLM在3D空间关系理解和跨视图信息聚合方面的系统性缺陷，并提出了一个名为ViewNavigator的多智能体框架来缓解这些问题。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM基准主要评估单视图或有限视图感知能力，未能测试模型跨视图整合观测信息以构建以物体为中心的（allocentric）3D心智模型这一核心认知能力。而多视图整合能力是VLM应用于下游任务（如机械零件装配）的前提条件。
AI.method: 设计了MultiView-Bench诊断基准，要求模型将物体定位与瞬时视角解耦，并在固定的全局坐标系中进行推理。系统评估了多个前沿VLM的性能，并提出了ViewNavigator多智能体框架，该框架主动选择信息丰富的视角、感知并融合多视图证据。
AI.result: 前沿VLM在2D平面关系任务上表现良好，但在3D空间关系和跨视图信息聚合上存在显著困难。VLM存在对非常规轴向的偏好偏差以及对物体颜色和纹理变化敏感的问题。ViewNavigator在严格预算匹配对比下提升了多种基础模型的性能，全智能体版本提升达3-5倍。
AI.conclusion: 多视图整合能力是当前VLM的一个关键薄弱环节，ViewNavigator作为一种有效的补救方案，为未来研究提供了方向。

title: L-MAD: A Systematic Evaluation of Multi-Agent Debate Structures in Legal Reasoning
comment: Outstanding paper in the AI4Law Workshop at ICML 2026
summary: While multi-agent debate (MAD) frameworks have shown significant potential in general reasoning, their effectiveness in highly structured, knowledge-heavy legal domains remains under-explored. In this work, we introduce the Legal Multi-Agent Debate (L-MAD) framework to systematically evaluate different debate structures and aggregation methods within Legal Textual Entailment. By assigning distinct expert personas to multiple agents, L-MAD improves upon strong single-agent baselines by up to 8\%. Furthermore, analyzing how debate scales reveals a clear trade-off: increasing the agent population reduces inconsistency and improves accuracy, whereas extending discussion rounds induces a detrimental \textit{over-deliberation drift} where agents reinforce each other's mistakes. Ultimately, our findings outline the practical boundaries and safety margins of deploying collaborative multi-agent systems in high-stakes legal reasoning environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出L-MAD（Legal Multi-Agent Debate）框架，将多智能体辩论方法应用于法律文本蕴含任务。实验表明，相比强单智能体基线，L-MAD可提升最多8%的性能。研究揭示了关键权衡：增加智能体数量能减少不一致性并提升准确率，而延长讨论轮次则会导致“过度讨论漂移”（over-deliberation drift），即智能体相互强化错误，损害最终表现。该工作为在高风险法律推理环境中部署协作式多智能体系统划定了实践边界与安全裕度。
AI.motivation: 多智能体辩论（MAD）框架在通用推理任务中展现出显著潜力，但在高度结构化、知识密集的法律领域中的有效性尚未被充分探索。本文旨在填补这一空白，系统评估不同辩论结构和聚合方法在法律文本蕴含（Legal Textual Entailment）任务中的效果。
AI.method: 提出L-MAD框架，为多个智能体分配不同的专家角色（personas），通过辩论结构进行交互，并采用多种聚合方法整合各智能体的输出。在Legal Textual Entailment任务上，系统比较了单智能体基线、不同辩论结构及聚合策略，并分析了智能体数量和讨论轮次对性能的影响。
AI.result: L-MAD相比强单智能体基线提升高达8%。增加智能体数量可降低推理不一致性并提高准确率；然而，增加讨论轮次会导致“过度讨论漂移”现象，即智能体在反复讨论中相互强化初始错误，反而降低最终表现。
AI.conclusion: 明确了在司法等高风险法律推理场景中部署协作式多智能体系统的实用边界与安全裕度：需谨慎平衡智能体规模与讨论深度，避免过度讨论带来的负面效应。

title: Prompt-Driven Exploration
summary: Exploration is essential to RL since a policy cannot improve by repeatedly sampling the behaviors it already prefers. Standard methods inject stochasticity in the action space, but such jitter only yields rollouts close to the original. Escaping a weak policy often requires global perturbations that action noise cannot produce. Large language models (LLMs) and vision-language-action (VLA) models offer a pathway: they condition the policy on a natural language prompt, and since the rollout follows from it, modifying the prompt induces global changes. The challenge is finding prompts that induce useful global changes. With a weak policy that rarely succeeds, reward is too sparse to select on. Our idea is to refine prompts from the rollouts themselves: a vision-language model (VLM) reasons over the rollout video, diagnoses how the policy responded, and rewrites the prompt to elicit better behavior next time. This procedure realizes posterior sampling, a classical RL exploration framework, at the level of prompts: the VLM maintains an implicit distribution over useful prompts and updates it from observed rollouts. We call this strategy Prompt-Driven Exploration (PDE). Across manipulation and reasoning tasks, PDE enables RL to learn successful policies even from zero-reward starts, and improves sample efficiency more broadly. Our website is available at https://xinyunsunshine.github.io/prompt-rl.

AI.tldr: 本文提出提示驱动探索（PDE），利用视觉语言模型（VLM）分析策略的 rollout 视频并重写自然语言提示，以在强化学习中实现全局探索，即使在零奖励起点也能学习到成功策略。
AI.motivation: 标准RL探索方法仅在动作空间注入噪声，产生局部扰动，难以帮助弱策略逃离次优行为。当策略很少成功时，奖励过于稀疏无法有效选择有用行为，需要一种能在全局范围内改变策略行为的探索机制。
AI.method: PDE方法：使用视觉语言模型（VLM）观察策略的 rollout 视频，推理策略响应方式并诊断问题，然后重写自然语言提示以引导策略在下一次 rollout 中产生更好的行为。这本质上是在提示层面实现经典RL中的后验采样探索框架。
AI.result: 在操作任务和推理任务上，PDE使RL即使在零奖励起点也能学习到成功策略，并广泛提升了样本效率。
AI.conclusion: 通过VLM在提示层面进行智能修改，可以实现比传统动作空间噪声更有效的全局探索，为弱策略提供突破性改进。

title: Automatic Thematic Indexing of Large Literary Corpora: A Machine Learning Approach to Voltaire's Complete Works
summary: Thematic indexing -- the practice of assigning structured conceptual labels to sections of text -- is essential to scholarly access in large-scale literary and historical editions, yet it remains a largely manual, labour-intensive process. This paper explores the application of machine learning to automatic thematic indexing, using two substantial sub-corpora of the Complete Works of Voltaire as a test case: the Essai sur les mœurs et l'esprit des nations and the Questions sur l'Encyclopédie. The task is framed as a multi-label classification problem, in which a model must assign the set of index entries that a professional indexer would apply to a given page of text.
