We compare a range of approaches -- from encoder-based models with classification heads to generative large language models (LLMs) fine-tuned via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) -- spanning model sizes from approximately 3 to 120 billion parameters. Our best-performing model, from the Mistral family in a 4-bit quantised configuration, achieves F1 scores of up to 0.67; we argue that these figures represent lower bounds, given the inherent subjectivity of professional indexing and the frequency with which model predictions prove semantically valid despite diverging from the print index. We further evaluate cross-corpus generalisation and conduct a detailed qualitative analysis of model behaviour on literary and rhetorical features of the source texts that prove particularly resistant to automated treatment. Our findings have implications for the broader challenge of providing structured thematic access to large-scale literary and historical corpora.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了利用机器学习对大型文学和历史文本进行自动主题索引的方法，以伏尔泰全集的两个子语料库为测试案例，将任务构建为多标签分类问题，比较了从编码器模型到生成式大语言模型（通过LoRA微调）等多种方法，最佳模型（Mistral系列4位量化配置）取得了最高0.67的F1分数，并论证了由于专业索引的主观性和模型预测的语义有效性，这些分数应被视为下限。
AI.motivation: 主题索引对于大型文学和历史版本的学术检索至关重要，但目前主要依赖人工完成，过程劳动密集且效率低下。因此，探索自动化主题索引的方法具有重要的实际意义。
AI.method: 将任务建模为多标签分类问题，使用伏尔泰《论风俗》和《百科全书问题》两个子语料库作为测试数据。比较了多种方法：基于编码器的模型（带分类头）和通过低秩适配（LoRA）微调的生成式大语言模型，模型规模从约3亿到1200亿参数不等。最佳模型为Mistral系列的4位量化配置。
AI.result: 最佳模型（Mistral系列4位量化配置）取得了最高0.67的F1分数。作者认为这些分数应被视为下限，因为专业索引本身存在主观性，且模型许多与印刷索引不同的预测在语义上仍然有效。研究还评估了跨语料库泛化能力，并对文学和修辞特征进行了定性分析。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为自动化主题索引提供了可行的技术方案，证明了机器学习在大型文学和历史语料库中提供结构化主题访问的潜力，同时揭示了在文学和修辞特征处理上存在的挑战。

title: C-GAP: Class-Aware and Online Prompting Improves Vision-Language Models on Imbalanced Classes
summary: Safety-critical perception systems must reliably detect rare object classes within small label spaces, a setting that long-tailed detection methods, designed for hundreds of classes with dense annotation, fundamentally do not address. Open-vocabulary detectors offer a promising alternative, as they use natural language queries at inference time, making prompt quality a first-class lever for detection performance. We exploit this property to address class imbalance: rather than retraining models or collecting additional annotations, we ask whether iteratively refining the language prompts, fed to frozen detectors, can improve minority class detection. We introduce C-GAP Caption-Guided Augmentation and Prompting), a detector-agnostic, annotation-free framework that operates in two phases. First, we establish a composite caption baseline combining per-image scene descriptions with class-quantity context, which we show outperforms scene-description only or class-quantity-only prompts across multiple open-vocabulary architectures and benchmarks. Second, an LLM iteratively refines each image's caption individually, with trials triaged into accept, tentative, or regenerate buckets based on minority-class AP@0.5 against a dynamic threshold derived from the composite baseline. Refinement terminates early once sufficient AP@0.5 gain is achieved. No detector weights are updated at any stage. Our experiments shows that C-GAP improves minority-class average precision up to 53% over the baselines. On COCO, C-GAP improves minority-class AP@0.5 by ~81% relative over the composite baseline (17.69 -> 32.09). Experiments confirm that composite captions provide the critical foundation for effective refinement: using scene-description-only or class-quantity-only prompts as the refinement starting point yields diminishing returns, supporting both stages of C-GAP as necessary contributions.

AI.tldr: C-GAP is a detector-agnostic, annotation-free framework that improves minority-class detection in open-vocabulary detectors by iteratively refining language prompts using an LLM, starting from a composite caption baseline (scene description + class quantity context). Experiments show up to 53% improvement in minority-class AP, and ~81% relative improvement on COCO minority-class AP@0.5.
AI.motivation: Safety-critical perception systems need reliable detection of rare object classes in small label spaces. Long-tailed detection methods for hundreds of classes with dense annotation are not suitable. Open-vocabulary detectors using natural language queries at inference time offer a promising alternative, but prompt quality is critical. The paper asks whether iteratively refining language prompts can improve minority class detection without retraining or extra annotations.
AI.method: Two-phase framework: (1) Composite caption baseline combining per-image scene descriptions with class-quantity context, outperforming scene-only or quantity-only prompts. (2) LLM iteratively refines each image's caption individually, with trials triaged into accept/tentative/regenerate buckets based on minority-class AP@0.5 against a dynamic threshold derived from the composite baseline. Refinement terminates early once sufficient gain. No detector weights are updated.
AI.result: C-GAP improves minority-class average precision up to 53% over baselines. On COCO, minority-class AP@0.5 improved by ~81% relative over composite baseline (17.69 -> 32.09). Composite captions are critical foundation; using scene-only or quantity-only prompts as starting point yields diminishing returns.
AI.conclusion: Iterative prompt refinement via LLM, starting from a composite caption baseline, effectively improves minority class detection in frozen open-vocabulary detectors without retraining or extra annotations. Both stages of C-GAP are necessary contributions.

title: MedRealMM: A Real-World Multimodal Benchmark for Chinese Online Medical Consultation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in online medical consultation, yet existing benchmarks remain poorly aligned with real clinical practice. Many rely on synthetic conversations or patient simulators, omit patient-uploaded medical images, or evaluate open-ended clinical responses using multiple-choice or lexical-overlap metrics that poorly reflect clinical quality. We introduce \textbf{MedRealMM}, a large-scale benchmark for multimodal online medical consultation built from de-identified patient-doctor interactions collected from a nationwide Chinese internet hospital. MedRealMM uses a Multimodal Clinical Challenge Point (MCCP) extraction framework to identify clinically demanding moments in authentic consultation trajectories and converts each into a standardized next-response generation task while preserving the preceding text-image context. Each instance is paired with a case-specific rubric refined by physicians that rewards clinically desirable behaviors and penalizes unsafe, unsupported, or contradictory responses. The current release contains 5,620 real-world multimodal cases spanning 64 clinical departments. We evaluate 19 general-purpose and medical-specialized LLMs, including text-only and multimodal systems. Our results show that image information is critical for reliable clinical performance and that current frontier models remain below the online physician response. Although some frontier models satisfy as many or more positive clinical criteria than physicians, they trigger more negative criteria, indicating that safety-sensitive error avoidance remains a central bottleneck. MedRealMM offers a realistic and reproducible benchmark for evaluating multimodal medical reasoning in real-world online consultation. The dataset will be publicly available on Hugging Face at https://huggingface.co/datasets/jdh-algo/MedRealMM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 MedRealMM，一个大规模多模态在线医疗咨询基准，基于真实医患对话数据构建，包含 5,620 例真实案例，覆盖 64 个科室。通过多模态临床挑战点（MCCP）提取框架识别咨询中的关键时刻，并转化为标准化下一轮回复生成任务。评估了 19 个通用和医学专用 LLM，发现图像信息对临床性能至关重要，现有前沿模型在安全性方面仍落后于真实医生。
AI.motivation: 现有医学基准与真实临床实践脱节：多依赖合成对话或患者模拟器，忽略患者上传的医学图像，或使用多选题、词重叠等指标评估开放式临床回复，无法反映真实临床质量。
AI.method: 从全国互联网医院收集脱敏的真实医患对话，提出多模态临床挑战点（MCCP）提取框架，识别咨询轨迹中的临床关键节点，将其转化为标准化下一轮回复生成任务，保留前文文本-图像上下文。每个实例配有由医生细化的专属评分规则，奖励临床理想行为，惩罚不安全、无依据或矛盾的回答。
AI.result: 评估 19 个模型发现：图像信息对可靠临床性能至关重要；当前顶尖模型仍低于真实在线医生回复水平；部分模型满足的正面临床标准数量与医生相当或更多，但触发的负面标准也更多，表明安全敏感的错误避免仍是核心瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: MedRealMM 提供了一个真实、可复现的多模态医学推理评估基准，揭示了当前模型在真实在线咨询中的不足，尤其是安全性方面的短板。

title: How are linear representations learned? Exact solutions to the dynamics of abstraction
summary: In artificial and biological neural networks, concepts are often encoded as consistent linear directions in representation space. In deep learning, this idea is known as the linear representation hypothesis and underpins many interpretability and control methods based on linear probes, from concept detection to activation steering. Yet while prior work has studied whether such directions should exist $\textit{after}$ training, the dynamics of how they emerge $\textit{during}$ training remain poorly understood. Here, we develop a framework to study the alignment of concept directions during training - a process we call "abstraction". In a minimal linear network setting, we obtain exact solutions for the full trajectory of abstraction. These solutions reveal key analytic principles governing abstraction: (i) data and target geometry jointly determine abstraction at the end-of-learning, (ii) abstraction improves with network depth, and (iii) initialization scale controls the maximum abstraction reached during training. Extending our theory to nonlinear networks, we analyze how the choice of nonlinearity affects abstraction dynamics: erf networks approximate the linear theory, while abstraction in ReLU networks depends less on target geometry and more on input geometry. Across both, we prove a striking attenuation law: both nonlinearities weaken abstraction in activations relative to preactivations. We find evidence for this law in open models (DINOv3, Gemma 4) and apply our theory to improve linear probe generalization in LLMs. Together, our results provide a dynamical theory of abstraction with implications for interpretability and control.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了"抽象化"（abstraction）框架，研究神经网络训练过程中概念线性方向对齐的动态过程。在最小线性网络中获得了精确解，揭示了数据与目标几何、网络深度、初始化尺度对抽象化的影响规律；推广到非线性网络后，发现erf网络近似线性理论，ReLU网络更依赖输入几何，并证明了非线性会削弱激活层相对于预激活层的抽象化（衰减定律）。在DINOv3、Gemma 4等开放模型中验证了该定律，并将其应用于改善LLM线性探针的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 先前工作主要研究训练后概念线性方向是否存在，但对训练过程中这些方向如何涌现的动态过程理解不足。本文旨在填补这一空白，建立研究训练中概念方向对齐（抽象化）的理论框架。
AI.method: 在最小线性网络设定中推导抽象化完整轨迹的精确解；并将理论扩展到非线性网络（erf和ReLU），分析非线性函数对抽象化动态的影响。通过数学推导证明衰减定律，并在DINOv3、Gemma 4等真实模型中进行验证。
AI.result: 发现了抽象化的三个关键原理：(i)数据与目标几何共同决定学习结束时的抽象化程度；(ii)网络深度越大抽象化越好；(iii)初始化尺度控制训练中达到的最大抽象化。在非线性网络中，erf网络近似线性理论，ReLU网络更受输入几何影响；并证明了一个衰减定律：非线性会削弱激活层相对于预激活层的抽象化。在开放模型中找到证据，并将理论成功应用于提升LLM线性探针的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 本文为训练过程中概念抽象化提供了动态理论，对神经网络的可解释性和控制方法具有重要启示。

title: Letting the Data Speak: Extracting Keywords from Crowdsourced Collections with AI
summary: Identifying and assigning keywords at scale is a technical, practical, and ethical challenge for crowdsourced collections. This article reports the findings of the "Extracting Keywords from Crowdsourced Collections" project, which used the Their Finest Hour Online Archive, a crowdsourced Second World War digital collection hosted by the University of Oxford, as a case study. The project evaluated three Natural Language Processing approaches to automate keyword extraction: Named Entity Recognition, Keyword Extraction, and Topic Modelling. It tested these approaches across a range of artificial intelligence techniques, from traditional statistical methods to modern GenAI neural networks. Our quantitative and qualitative findings indicate that Natural Language Processing approaches offer real potential for keyword extraction at scale in crowdsourced collections, but that no single method offers a complete solution and that model choice significantly shapes results. We argue that in crowdsourced collections, where metadata is the direct product of engagement with living contributors, automated keyword extraction raises distinct stewardship responsibilities that must be addressed alongside technical performance. Open-weight, extractive models emerge from our evaluation as best placed to support responsible deployment, while generative AI, despite its abstractive potential, introduces accountability risks that anyone managing crowdsourced collections should weigh carefully.

AI.tldr: 本文以牛津大学"他们最辉煌时刻"在线档案为案例，评估了NER、关键词提取和主题建模三种NLP方法在众包数字藏品中自动提取关键词的效果。研究发现NLP方法有潜力但无单一方法能完全解决问题，模型选择显著影响结果，并提出在众包藏品中自动关键词提取需承担特殊的 stewardship 责任。开源权重、抽取式模型最适合负责任部署，而生成式AI尽管有抽象潜力但存在问责风险。
AI.motivation: 众包藏品中关键词的规模化识别与分配面临技术、实践和伦理三重挑战，现有方法缺乏系统性评估，且自动提取在涉及活态贡献者场景下的 stewardship 责任未被充分关注。
AI.method: 以牛津大学 Their Finest Hour Online Archive 众包二战数字藏品为案例，评估三种NLP方法（命名实体识别、关键词提取、主题建模），涵盖从传统统计方法到现代GenAI神经网络的多项AI技术。采用定量与定性混合评估方法对比分析。
AI.result: NLP方法在众包藏品规模化关键词提取中展现出真实潜力，但无单一方法能提供完整解决方案；模型选择对结果有显著塑造作用；开源权重、抽取式模型更适合负责任部署；生成式AI存在问责风险。
AI.conclusion: 在众包藏品中，元数据是直接与活态贡献者互动的产物，自动关键词提取需同时解决技术性能与 stewardship 责任。推荐采用开源权重、抽取式模型，审慎对待生成式AI的部署。

title: Video Generation Models are General-Purpose Vision Learners
summary: Driven by next-token prediction, NLP shifted from task-specific models into powerful generalist foundation models. What, then, is the equivalent catalyst needed to achieve a general-purpose model in computer vision? In this paper, we contend that large-scale text-to-video generation serves as a strong pre-training paradigm for computer vision, providing the necessary spatiotemporal priors, vision-language alignment, and scalability required for general visual intelligence. We introduce GenCeption, which leverages a pre-trained video generative diffusion backbone to define a feed-forward perception model, capable of performing various vision tasks steered by text instructions. Empirical results demonstrate that GenCeption achieves state-of-the-art performance across a diverse suite of tasks, including depth, surface normal, and camera pose estimation, expression-referring segmentation, and 3D keypoint prediction, often matching or surpassing specialized models (e.g. DepthAnything3, SAM3, D4RT, VGGT-Omega, Sapiens, David, Genmo, and Lotus-2). Furthermore, the video generative pretrained backbone outperforms alternative pretraining paradigms (e.g., V-JEPA, and Video MAE) under comparable settings. Importantly, GenCeption exhibits preliminary data and model scaling properties along with exceptional data efficiency, where it achieves comparable performance with leading models like D4RT and VGGT-Omega with 7 to 500 less training data. Finally, GenCeption also exhibits intriguing emergent behaviors: a model trained exclusively on synthetic human videos generalizes to real-world footage and out-of-distribution object categories (e.g., animals and robots). These findings suggest that video generation is not merely a synthesis tool, but a foundational path toward generalist vision intelligence for the physical world. Project page: https://genception.github.io

AI.tldr: 本文提出GenCeption，利用大规模文本到视频生成作为视觉预训练范式，通过预训练的视频生成扩散骨干网络构建前馈感知模型，在深度估计、法线预测、相机位姿估计、分割和3D关键点预测等多项视觉任务上达到SOTA，展现出优异的数据效率和涌现行为，证明视频生成是通往通用视觉智能的基础路径。
AI.motivation: 探索能够像NLP中的next-token prediction那样，作为计算机视觉领域通用基础模型催化剂的预训练范式。作者认为大规模文本到视频生成具备所需的时空先验、视觉-语言对齐和可扩展性，可能成为这一催化剂。
AI.method: GenCeption利用预训练的视频生成扩散模型作为骨干，构建前馈感知模型，通过文本指令指导多种视觉任务的执行。只需一次前向传播即可完成推理，无需迭代去噪过程。
AI.result: 在深度估计、表面法线、相机位姿、表达指代分割和3D关键点预测等多任务上达到SOTA；视频生成预训练优于V-JEPA、Video MAE等替代范式；数据效率极高，用7-500倍更少数据即可达到D4RT和VGGT-Omega等领先模型的性能；仅用合成人体视频训练即可泛化到真实场景和未见物体类别。
AI.conclusion: 视频生成不仅是合成工具，更是通往物理世界通用视觉智能的基础路径。GenCeption展示了数据/模型缩放特性和涌现行为，为通用视觉模型提供了新的预训练范式。

title: KV-PRM: Efficient Process Reward Modeling via KV-Cache Transfer for Multi-Agent Test-Time Scaling
summary: Process Reward Models (PRMs) have been proven to be highly effective in guiding test-time scaling (TTS) methods, which significantly boost the capabilities of LLM-based multi-agent systems. However, existing PRMs are text-based: they re-encode the entire trajectory text from scratch. In long multi-agent rollouts, the scoring cost, growing quadratically with respect to sequence length L, creates a severe computational bottleneck, severely limiting PRMs' application in long-context scenarios. To resolve this, we introduce KV-PRM, a highly efficient process reward model that eliminates the heavy text re-encoding by directly reading the KV cache produced naturally during the LLM's generation phase. By processing a single "verify token" against the pre-existing KV cache, KV-PRM reduces the scoring cost from O(L^2) to O(L). We formally prove that the KV cache contains strictly greater information capacity than text, and is more efficient for downstream reward modeling. Empirically, across the MATH, GSM8K, and AIME benchmarks, KV-PRM matches or strictly outperforms text-PRMs under various TTS methods such as Beam Search, MCTS, and Weighted Voting, with up to a 5,000x reduction in scoring FLOPs, a 37x reduction in latency, and a 34x reduction in per-sequence memory footprint compared to text-based PRMs.

AI.tldr: KV-PRM 是一种高效的过程奖励模型，通过直接利用 LLM 生成阶段自然产生的 KV 缓存来避免重新编码整个轨迹文本，将评分成本从 O(L²) 降低到 O(L)，同时保持或超越文本 PRM 的性能，并实现高达 5000 倍的 FLOPs 缩减、37 倍延迟降低和 34 倍内存占用减少。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于文本的过程奖励模型（PRM）在长多智能体 rollout 场景中需要从零重新编码整个轨迹文本，导致评分成本随序列长度 L 呈二次增长 O(L²)，造成严重的计算瓶颈，限制了 PRM 在长上下文场景中的应用。
AI.method: KV-PRM 通过直接读取 LLM 生成阶段自然产生的 KV 缓存，仅处理一个"验证 token"来针对预先存在的 KV 缓存进行评分，从而将计算复杂度从 O(L²) 降低到 O(L)。理论上证明了 KV 缓存比文本包含更严格的信息容量，且更适用于下游奖励建模。
AI.result: 在 MATH、GSM8K 和 AIME 基准测试上，KV-PRM 在各种 TTS 方法（如 Beam Search、MCTS 和 Weighted Voting）下匹配或严格优于文本 PRM。同时实现了高达 5000 倍的评分 FLOPs 缩减、37 倍延迟降低和 34 倍每序列内存占用减少。
AI.conclusion: KV-PRM 通过消除文本重新编码的二次成本瓶颈，为 PRM 在长上下文场景中的高效应用提供了可行方案，在保持甚至提升性能的同时大幅降低了计算开销。

title: Optimizing Against Safety Representations: Activation-Guided Adversarial Suffixes and the Geometry of Refusal
comment: Accepted at the AAAI 2026 Summer Symposium Series. This paper was presented at the ICLR Re-Align workshop under a different name, "Accelerating Adversarial Suffix Optimization via Continuous Relaxation and Activation-Guided Objectives"
summary: Behavioral alignment in large language models often masks fragile internal safety representations. Recent work suggests that refusal behavior is mediated by low-dimensional directions in activation space. This raises questions about how such representations are structured, localized, and accessed by optimization. We study adversarial suffix attacks as a probe of representational alignment. We introduce Activation-Guided GCG, which replaces output-based objectives with losses that directly target a model's internal refusal direction. Across several objective variants, we find that suppressing refusal globally across all layers and positions is more effective than targeting a single layer-position pair. This suggests that safety representations are distributed across the forward pass rather than causally localized to a single site. We further introduce Soft-GCG, a continuous relaxation of discrete suffix optimization using Gumbel-Softmax. Soft-GCG achieves a 33 $\times$ speedup over standard GCG while improving attack success rates. Evaluating across model scales, we find that smaller models remain vulnerable while larger models resist both activation- and suffix-based attacks at our compute-constrained settings, consistent with larger and better safety trained models being harder to jailbreak. Together, our results clarify how safety mechanisms are encoded and can be broken in contemporary models. These insights provide concrete guidance for designing more robust and representation-aware alignment strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文通过引入Activation-Guided GCG和Soft-GCG两种方法，研究了大语言模型中安全表征的结构与可攻击性，发现安全表征分布在前向传播过程中而非局部化，并提出Soft-GCG实现了33倍加速，同时揭示更大模型更难被越狱。
AI.motivation: 探究大语言模型中对齐行为背后脆弱的内部安全表征是如何结构化、局部化以及被优化过程所利用的，从而理解安全机制的本质与可攻击性。
AI.method: 提出Activation-Guided GCG，用直接攻击模型内部拒绝方向（refusal direction）的损失函数替代输出层面的目标；引入Soft-GCG，利用Gumbel-Softmax对离散后缀优化进行连续松弛，实现高效攻击。
AI.result: 全局抑制所有层和所有位置的拒绝方向比攻击单个层-位置对更有效；Soft-GCG相比标准GCG取得33倍加速并提升攻击成功率；小模型仍然脆弱，而大模型在计算受限条件下对两类攻击均有抵抗力。
AI.conclusion: 安全表征在前向传播中是分布式的而非局部化的，这为设计更鲁棒且关注表征的对齐策略提供了具体指导。

title: WILDTRACE: Benchmarking Natural Evidence Trails in Long-Context Reasoning
summary: Answering complex questions over long documents frequently requires integrating evidence that the source itself disperses naturally across distant passages. In an incident report, the operating condition, design flaw, and missed safety check that jointly explain a disaster may appear dozens of sections apart; in a novel, a character's true motive may surface only through scenes far removed from the moment it becomes relevant. This source-internal evidence integration is central to real-world long-document analysis, yet existing benchmarks largely sidestep it. Needle probes, planted facts, and reverse-engineered multi-hop chains embed evidence that may differ from the host text in distribution, placement, or register, making it unclear whether strong performance reflects genuine source reasoning or distributional artifacts. We introduce WILDTRACE, a benchmark of 481 tasks over 214 naturally occurring long-form sources such as technical incident reports and lesser-known literary narratives, where all evidence trails arise from the document's own causal, temporal, and narrative logic. Drawing on Pearl's causal hierarchy and prior multi-hop reasoning typologies, we define seven source-internal evidence geometries that characterize the distinct relational demands of analytical reading in long documents. A source-first construction pipeline mines candidate trails from document structure before writing questions; each item then undergoes multi-stage validation covering clue necessity, answer groundedness, rubric fidelity, contamination resistance and answerability. As models are increasingly entrusted with real-world high-stakes analytical tasks, this gap between accessing information and reasoning over naturally dispersed evidence emerges as a defining challenge for the next stage of long-context research.

AI.tldr: WILDTRACE is a benchmark of 481 tasks over 214 naturally occurring long documents (incident reports, literary narratives) where multi-hop evidence arises from the document's own causal/temporal/narrative logic rather than planted facts. It defines seven source-internal evidence geometries and uses a source-first pipeline with multi-stage validation, highlighting the gap between information access and reasoning over naturally dispersed evidence in long-context QA.
AI.motivation: Existing long-document QA benchmarks rely on needle probes, planted facts, or reverse-engineered multi-hop chains that embed evidence differing from the host text in distribution/placement/register, making it unclear whether strong performance reflects genuine source reasoning or distributional artifacts. Real-world analytical tasks require integrating evidence naturally dispersed across a document (e.g., incident reports, novels).
AI.method: WILDTRACE uses a source-first pipeline: (1) mine candidate evidence trails from document structure (causal, temporal, narrative logic) before writing questions; (2) define seven source-internal evidence geometries based on Pearl's causal hierarchy and prior multi-hop reasoning typologies; (3) multi-stage validation covering clue necessity, answer groundedness, rubric fidelity, contamination resistance, and answerability.
AI.result: A benchmark of 481 tasks over 214 naturally occurring long-form sources (technical incident reports, lesser-known literary narratives) where all evidence trails arise from the document's own internal logic. The benchmark systematically tests models' ability to reason over naturally dispersed evidence rather than artificially planted cues.
AI.conclusion: As models are increasingly entrusted with real-world high-stakes analytical tasks, the gap between accessing information and reasoning over naturally dispersed evidence emerges as a defining challenge for the next stage of long-context research. WILDTRACE exposes this gap and provides a rigorous benchmark to drive progress.

title: MOSAIC: Adaptive Inter-layer Composition for Efficient Heterogeneous Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved success using homogeneous Transformers to process multimedia data. Recent studies show that heterogeneous structures interleaving efficient mechanisms, like linear attention, improve both performance and inference latency over homogeneous designs. However, these efforts rely on handcrafted static mixing patterns, which are sub-optimal and difficult to adapt to specific hardware. To bridge this gap, we propose Multi-Objective Search for Adaptive Inter-layer Composition (MOSAIC), a hardware-aware search method that automatically transforms homogeneous models into optimized heterogeneous architectures. MOSAIC integrates diverse efficiency mechanisms--including linear, sparse, and low-rank operators--into a unified search space. By formulating the selection as a multi-objective Mixed Integer Programming (MIP) problem, our method identifies optimal configurations that maximize downstream performance under strict hardware latency constraints. To mitigate performance degradation from structural transitions, we introduce a two-stage parameter recovery process: global off-policy distillation to stabilize internal representations, followed by a dual-teacher on-policy distillation leveraging a 235B oracle for knowledge expansion and the original 4B teacher for distributional stability. We validate MOSAIC through MOSAIC-4B, derived from Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct. Results demonstrate that MOSAIC-4B matches the baseline's performance across multiple benchmarks while requiring less than 2% of the original training cost. Furthermore, it substantially improves inference efficiency, achieving 1.76x prefilling and 2.54x decoding speedups.

AI.tldr: A hardware-aware search method (MOSAIC) that automatically transforms homogeneous Vision-Language Models into optimized heterogeneous architectures with diverse efficiency mechanisms (linear, sparse, low-rank), achieving performance match with less than 2% training cost and significant inference speedups (1.76x prefilling, 2.54x decoding).
AI.motivation: Heterogeneous structures interleaving efficient mechanisms improve performance and latency over homogeneous Transformers, but existing designs rely on handcrafted static mixing patterns that are sub-optimal and difficult to adapt to specific hardware. Thus, an automatic, hardware-aware search method is needed.
AI.method: MOSAIC (Multi-Objective Search for Adaptive Inter-layer Composition) integrates linear, sparse, and low-rank operators into a unified search space, formulates selection as a multi-objective Mixed Integer Programming (MIP) problem to maximize downstream performance under hardware latency constraints, and uses a two-stage parameter recovery process: global off-policy distillation to stabilize internal representations, followed by dual-teacher on-policy distillation using a 235B oracle and the original 4B teacher.
AI.result: MOSAIC-4B, derived from Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct, matches baseline performance across multiple benchmarks while requiring less than 2% of the original training cost, and achieves 1.76x prefilling and 2.54x decoding speedups in inference efficiency.
AI.conclusion: MOSAIC effectively automates the transformation of homogeneous models into heterogeneous architectures optimized for both performance and hardware latency, demonstrating substantial efficiency gains with minimal training cost.

title: Scoped Verification for Reliable Long-Horizon Agentic Context Evolution under Distribution Shift
summary: Deployed LLM agents rely on agentic context, the model-external textual control content assembled by an operational harness. In this work, the mutable component of that context is a persistent system-level instruction that is updated from operational experience while the model, tools, and harness remain fixed. Over long evolution horizons, flat-text maintenance makes verification increasingly difficult as accumulated instructions grow and interact. We propose Graph-Regularized Agentic Context Evolution (GRACE), which maintains the persistent instruction component as a typed semantic graph and validates proposed updates within the local typed neighborhoods of modified nodes. Accepted graph updates are reconstructed as incremental edits to the textual instruction checkpoint used at deployment. We evaluate GRACE within a fixed telecom agent harness derived from $τ^2$-bench under a controlled distribution-shift protocol. Across five independent replications, GRACE improves strict reliability, measured by pass^3, from the Gemini 2.5 Flash zero-shot value of 0.091 to 0.673$\pm$0.136 at the final checkpoint. This exceeds a Gemini 3.1 Pro zero-shot reference of 0.242 on the same held-out set, while the flat-text HCE baseline finishes at 0.191$\pm$0.051. These results identify two requirements for reliable long-horizon context evolution, a structural substrate that makes verification local and a consolidation mechanism that keeps accumulated instruction content usable.

AI.tldr: GRACE 是一种图正则化的智能体上下文演化方法，将持久性系统指令维护为类型化语义图，并在局部邻域内验证更新，显著提升了 LLM 代理在长期部署中的可靠性，在电信场景下将 pass^3 从 0.091 提升至 0.673±0.136，远超纯文本基线和 Gemini 3.1 Pro 零样本参考值。
AI.motivation: 部署的 LLM 智能体依赖可变的系统级持久指令（agentic context）进行演化，但纯文本维护方式在长期演化中会导致指令积累、相互交互，使得验证越来越困难，可靠性下降。因此需要一种结构化的方法来支持可靠的长期上下文演化。
AI.method: 提出 Graph-Regularized Agentic Context Evolution (GRACE)，将持久指令组件维护为类型化语义图，在修改节点的局部类型化邻域内验证提议的更新；接受的图更新被重构为对部署所用文本指令检查点的增量编辑。
AI.result: 在固定电信智能体框架（来自 τ^2-bench）和受控分布偏移协议下，五次独立重复实验中，GRACE 将 Gemini 2.5 Flash 零样本的 pass^3 从 0.091 提升到最终检查点的 0.673±0.136，超过 Gemini 3.1 Pro 零样本的 0.242，而纯文本 HCE 基线仅为 0.191±0.051。
AI.conclusion: 长期可靠的上下文演化需要两个要素：使验证本地化的结构基底（structural substrate）和保持累积指令内容可用的整合机制（consolidation mechanism）。

title: Pattern-Aware Graph Neural Networks for Handling Missing Data
comment: 2026 International Conference on Advances in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AAIML), 20-22 March 2026
summary: Missing data is ubiquitous in real-world datasets. Traditional methods either discard incomplete samples or apply imputation techniques that ignore potentially informative missingness patterns, implicitly assuming that missingness occurs randomly. However, missingness patterns might provide additional information. We propose pattern-aware graph neural networks that explicitly encode which features are missing alongside observed values. We used four encoding strategies -- learned embeddings, frozen random embeddings, statistical features, and hierarchical representations -- across seven UCI datasets with naturally occurring missingness. Our Pattern-aware methods achieve substantial improvements over baselines, with an average improvement of 17\% in balanced accuracy and 22\% in F1-macro across all datasets. The benefits vary significantly by dataset: annealing shows dramatic improvement (+80\% balanced accuracy), while hepatitis and soybean show minimal gains (+4--5\%). Notably, even simple random pattern embeddings perform comparably to learned embeddings (0.650 vs 0.663 balanced accuracy), suggesting that distinguishing between patterns may be more important than task-specific optimization. Our ablation study reveals that attention mechanisms, while helpful, are not critical when pattern information is available -- simple mean aggregation with pattern awareness achieves 0.640 balanced accuracy compared to 0.645 for attention-based variants.

AI.tldr: 提出模式感知图神经网络，通过显式编码缺失特征模式来处理现实数据中的缺失值问题，在多个数据集上平均提升17%平衡准确率和22%宏F1分数。
AI.motivation: 传统缺失值处理方法要么丢弃不完整样本，要么采用忽略信息性缺失模式的插补技术，隐含假设缺失随机发生。然而缺失模式可能提供额外信息，因此需要显式编码缺失模式以利用这些信息。
AI.method: 提出模式感知图神经网络，采用四种编码策略（学习嵌入、冻结随机嵌入、统计特征和层次表示）来显式编码缺失特征与观测值，并在七个UCI数据集上评估。
AI.result: 模式感知方法在平衡准确率上平均提升17%，在宏F1上平均提升22%。不同数据集提升差异显著（退火数据集提升80%，肝炎和大豆仅提升4-5%）。简单的随机模式嵌入与学习嵌入性能相当（0.650 vs 0.663平衡准确率）。消融实验显示注意力机制非必要，简单均值聚合与模式感知即可达到0.640平衡准确率（注意力变体为0.645）。
AI.conclusion: 模式感知方法能有效利用缺失模式信息提升性能；区分不同缺失模式可能比任务特定优化更重要；注意力机制在提供模式信息时并非关键。

title: Towards Detecting Inconsistencies in End-to-end Generated TODs
comment: arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2407.11857
summary: Generative AI is profoundly transforming the core technologies behind conversational systems, shifting from component-based to end-to-end approaches. However, Large Language Models (LLMs) may still generate inconsistencies, a critical issue particularly in Task-Oriented Dialogues (TODs), where system responses must strictly adhere to information from a domain knowledge base (e.g., restaurants in a city). A single hallucination (e.g., suggesting a non-existent restaurant) can lead to severe task failures. We investigate a method for automatically detecting inconsistencies by conceptualizing TODs as a Constraint Satisfaction Problem (CSP), where variables represent dialogue segments referencing the conversational domain, and constraints among variables capture dialogue properties such as turn coherence and adherence to domain knowledge. We propose a pipeline that first identifies variables in a target dialogue and then applies a CSP solver to identify valid solutions. By comparing the target dialogue with valid variable assignments, we can detect inconsistencies and suggest minimal changes to ensure dialogue consistency. We demonstrate the high accuracy of the CSP-based approach in detecting inconsistencies, and provide a detailed analysis of our findings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将任务型对话（TODs）建模为约束满足问题（CSP），通过识别对话中的变量并应用CSP求解器找出有效解，与目标对话对比以自动检测不一致性（幻觉），并建议最小修改来确保一致性。实验表明该方法具有高准确率。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型（LLMs）在任务型对话中可能产生与领域知识库不一致的回复（如推荐不存在的餐厅），导致任务失败。现有方法难以有效检测此类不一致性，因此需要一种自动化检测方法。
AI.method: 将任务型对话视为约束满足问题（CSP）：变量表示对话中提及领域知识的片段，约束条件包括对话轮次连贯性、领域知识一致性等。首先识别目标对话中的变量，然后使用CSP求解器找出所有有效变量赋值，通过与目标对话对比来检测不一致性，并给出最小修改建议。
AI.result: 基于CSP的方法在检测不一致性方面取得了高准确率，并提供了详细的实验结果分析。
AI.conclusion: CSP方法可有效检测任务型对话中的不一致性，未来可用于提升LLM生成对话的可靠性。

title: STEAM: Stable Self-Training with Elastic Matching and Adaptive Purification
summary: Cross-view geo-localization (CVGL) aims to achieve GPS-free localization by matching drone-view images with corresponding satellite-view images. Existing supervised methods rely on large-scale manually annotated cross-view image pairs, making them costly and difficult to scale. In contrast, existing unsupervised approaches typically depend on generative models or clustering-based stage-wise optimization, which are prone to distribution bias and the accumulation of noisy pseudo-labels. To address these limitations, we propose STEAM (Stable Self-Training with Elastic Matching and Adaptive Purification), an end-to-end unsupervised cross-view geo-localization framework that performs self-training directly on real drone and satellite images. Specifically, the proposed Stable Spatial-Aware Module enhances the stability of feature representations, Elastic Matching discovers high-quality cross-view pseudo-labels, and Adaptive Purification dynamically maintains a reliable pseudo-label repository throughout the self-training process. Extensive experiments on the University-1652 and SUES-200 benchmarks demonstrate that STEAM achieves state-of-the-art performance among all existing unsupervised methods and delivers performance comparable to supervised approaches, validating the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed framework. The source code is available at https://github.com/wsx-heu/STEAM.git.

AI.tldr: 提出STEAM，一种端到端无监督跨视角地理定位框架，通过稳定自训练、弹性匹配和自适应净化，在无人机-卫星图像匹配任务中达到现有无监督方法最优性能，且可媲美监督方法。
AI.motivation: 现有监督方法依赖大规模人工标注的跨视角图像对，成本高且难以扩展；现有无监督方法依赖生成模型或聚类式阶段优化，容易产生分布偏差和噪声伪标签累积。为解决这些问题，需要一种直接在真实无人机和卫星图像上进行自训练的无监督框架。
AI.method: 提出STEAM框架，包含三个核心模块：1) 稳定空间感知模块(Stable Spatial-Aware Module)增强特征表示的稳定性；2) 弹性匹配(Elastic Matching)发现高质量跨视角伪标签；3) 自适应净化(Adaptive Purification)在自训练过程中动态维护可靠的伪标签库。整个框架以端到端方式直接在真实图像上执行自训练。
AI.result: 在University-1652和SUES-200基准上，STEAM在所有现有无监督方法中达到最优性能，且性能与监督方法相当，验证了其有效性和优越性。
AI.conclusion: STEAM通过稳定自训练、弹性匹配和自适应净化三个创新模块，有效解决了无监督跨视角地理定位中的分布偏差和噪声伪标签问题，实现了无需人工标注的高性能定位，为CVGL任务提供了可扩展的实用解决方案。

title: Toward Auditable AI Scientists: A Hypothesis Evolution Protocol for LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly expected to play a central role in AI-driven scientific discovery. Equipped with broad knowledge, flexible reasoning, and tool use, they have the potential to autonomously explore and solve scientific problems by repeatedly proposing hypotheses, testing them, and revising their beliefs in the light of the evidence. In current agents, however, these hypotheses, tests, and belief updates are buried in unstructured logs, and no mechanism lets the agent or the human researcher audit that process. Here we propose the Hypothesis Evolution Protocol (HEP), an agent harness that provides hypothesis generation, evaluation, and evolution as explicit, auditable operations. On materials-science research tasks, a HEP-equipped agent operates the hypothesis--test--evidence--belief cycle that planning-style agents lack, generalizes across research questions, and exploits the protocol more fully as the base LLM becomes more capable. These results mark a step toward auditable AI scientists, whose scientific reasoning can be inspected, verified, and built upon.

AI.tldr: 提出假设演化协议(HEP)，使LLM智能体能够显式地进行假设生成、评估和演化，实现可审计的假设-测试-证据-信念循环，在材料科学任务上表现出色。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM智能体的假设、测试和信念更新过程隐藏在非结构化的日志中，缺乏可审计机制，使得智能体或人类研究者无法审查这一过程。
AI.method: 提出假设演化协议(HEP)，将假设生成、评估和演化作为显式、可审计的操作，构建假设-测试-证据-信念循环。
AI.result: HEP赋予的智能体能够运行规划型智能体所缺乏的假设-测试-证据-信念循环，跨研究问题泛化，并且随着基础LLM能力增强而更充分地利用该协议。
AI.conclusion: HEP标志着迈向可审计的AI科学家的重要一步，其科学推理可以被检查、验证和在此基础上构建。

title: A Machine Learning Surrogate for Component Criticality Ranking in Interdependent Power-Communication Networks
summary: Cyber-physical power systems are vulnerable to cascading failures caused by tight interdependencies between power and communication infrastructures. Evaluating these failures over large N-k contingency sets with a high-fidelity simulator is computationally prohibitive for resilience planning. Using the previously published Modified Implicative Interdependency Model (MIIM) as the ground-truth cascade simulator, this paper develops a machine-learning surrogate that predicts contingency severity from leakage-free structural features and derives a component-criticality ranking for prioritized hardening analysis. On the IEEE 118-bus system, the Gradient Boosting surrogate achieves Spearman correlations of 0.849 for per-contingency severity prediction and 0.853 for per-component criticality ranking, while remaining stable across three independently sampled datasets. MIIM-derived component criticality itself reproduces only to a Spearman of approximately 0.85 under the present sampling pipeline, and the surrogate operates at this empirical ceiling to within sampling variation. Topological centrality measures on the full interdependent network provide meaningful baselines (Spearman 0.60-0.69), and feature ablation shows that the surrogate's advantage is driven primarily by inter-layer dependency information. These results support a two-stage workflow in which the surrogate rapidly ranks candidate components and MIIM is reserved for selective verification.

AI.tldr: 本文针对电力-通信耦合系统的大规模连锁故障评估计算成本过高的问题，提出了一种基于梯度提升的机器学习代理模型，利用无泄漏的结构特征预测N-k事故严重性并推导组件关键性排序。在IEEE 118节点系统上，该代理模型在事故严重性预测和组件关键性排序上分别达到0.849和0.853的斯皮尔曼相关系数，接近基于MIIM高保真模拟器的经验上限（约0.85），显著优于拓扑中心性基线（0.60-0.69）。特征消融实验表明代理模型的优势主要来自层间依赖信息。最终提出了代理模型快速排序+MIIM选择性验证的两阶段工作流。
AI.motivation: 电力-信息物理耦合系统易受连锁故障影响，但使用高保真模拟器评估大规模N-k事故集在计算上不可行，难以支撑韧性规划中的组件加固优先级分析。
AI.method: 以Modified Implicative Interdependency Model (MIIM)为真实模拟器，提取无泄漏的结构特征，训练梯度提升（Gradient Boosting）代理模型以预测事故严重性和组件关键性排序。在IEEE 118节点系统上进行验证，通过特征消融分析特征贡献。
AI.result: 梯度提升代理模型在事故严重性预测上斯皮尔曼相关系数0.849，在组件关键性排序上0.853，跨三个独立采样数据集保持稳定。模型性能接近MIIM本身在该采样流程下的经验上限（约0.85），显著高于拓扑中心性基线（0.60-0.69）。层间依赖信息是代理模型优势的主要来源。
AI.conclusion: 提出的代理模型能高效且准确地预测连锁故障严重性和组件关键性，支持先由代理模型快速排序候选组件、再由MIIM选择性验证的两阶段工作流，为韧性规划中的加固分析提供可行方案。

title: DKCD: Domain Knowledge-Enhanced Causal Discovery from Unstructured Data
summary: Causal discovery from unstructured data is a challenging yet underexplored task in high-expertise domains such as healthcare, finance, and education. Existing methods typically leverage the general knowledge of large language models (LLMs) to identify causal factors from unstructured data and annotate them into structured data for causal graph construction. However, they remain limited by two key challenges (CHs): (CH1) insufficient identification of latent factors, which are implicit in the data yet essential for causal discovery, due to the lack of domain-specific knowledge; and (CH2) unreliable factor annotation, caused by the lack of domain-grounded reasoning, which propagates errors to the resulting causal graphs. To address these challenges, we introduce a novel Domain Knowledge-enhanced Causal Discovery framework (DKCD) for causal discovery from unstructured data in high-expertise domains with three interconnected components: (1) Knowledge Mining: It retrieves relevant domain knowledge based on observable factors to support subsequent causal reasoning. (2) Knowledge-guided Causal Reasoning: Reasoning with relevant knowledge, it discovers latent causal factors to address CH1 and generates key causal clues for more accurate data annotation to address CH2. (3) Causal Structure Discovery: It constructs the final causal graphs based on a more complete factor set and accurate annotations. Experiments on two domain-specific datasets show that DKCD significantly improves both causal factor identification and causal graph construction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向高专业领域非结构化数据的因果发现框架DKCD，通过引入领域知识来解决潜在因素识别不足和因素标注不可靠两大挑战，实验表明该方法在因果因素识别和因果图构建方面显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有因果发现方法在处理医疗、金融、教育等高专业领域的非结构化数据时存在两个关键挑战：(CH1) 缺乏领域知识导致难以识别数据中隐含的潜在因果因素；(CH2) 缺乏领域驱动的推理导致因素标注不可靠，进而影响因果图构建的准确性。
AI.method: DKCD框架包含三个互联组件：(1) 知识挖掘——基于可观察因素检索相关领域知识以支持后续因果推理；(2) 知识引导的因果推理——利用相关知识推理发现潜在因果因素（应对CH1）并生成关键因果线索以提升标注准确性（应对CH2）；(3) 因果结构发现——基于更完整的因素集合和精确标注构建最终因果图。
AI.result: 在两个领域专用数据集上的实验表明，DKCD在因果因素识别和因果图构建两方面均取得显著提升。
AI.conclusion: DKCD通过引入领域知识驱动的推理，有效弥补了现有方法在高专业领域非结构化数据因果发现中的不足，同时解决了潜在因素识别和标注可靠性两个核心问题。

title: On Locality and Length Generalization in Visual Reasoning
summary: A striking feature of the human visual system is that it ingests visual information through a series of local foveated glimpses, rather than a single global computation. This makes human vision distinctly different from most popular computer vision models in use today, which input images globally and in a single shot. A natural question therefore is whether local, sequential vision models may provide any fundamental computational benefits in addition to being biologically more plausible than global models. In this work, we investigate this question from the perspective of visual state tracking and length generalization. Inspired by recent studies of length generalization in language models, we study the behavior of vision models trained on simple vision tasks that require the aggregation of local information across an image. Our experiments reveal that, similar to language models, vision models can learn to exploit global shortcuts and thereby fail to generalize over task length or complexity. We also show that recurrent vision policies based on strictly local perception can mitigate these failures, thereby allowing models to generalize on these tasks. Our results show that local attention may be an essential overlooked requirement for robust compositional generalization.

AI.tldr: This paper investigates whether local, sequential vision models (inspired by human foveated vision) offer computational benefits over global, single-shot models for visual state tracking and length generalization. Experiments show that global models exploit shortcuts and fail to generalize, while recurrent policies with strictly local perception mitigate these failures, suggesting local attention is crucial for robust compositional generalization.
AI.motivation: To determine if local, sequential vision models provide fundamental computational benefits beyond biological plausibility, given that human vision uses foveated glimpses rather than global computation.
AI.method: Studied vision models on simple tasks requiring aggregation of local information across an image, comparing global models to recurrent vision policies based on strictly local perception, similar to length generalization studies in language models.
AI.result: Global models learn to exploit shortcuts and fail to generalize over task length/complexity, whereas recurrent local perception policies mitigate these failures and enable generalization.
AI.conclusion: Local attention may be an essential overlooked requirement for robust compositional generalization in vision models.

title: OpenProver: Agentic and Interactive Theorem Proving with Lean 4
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the 19th Conference on Intelligent Computer Mathematics (CICM 2026)
summary:
In this system paper, we present OpenProver, an open-source system for LLM-driven automated theorem proving (ATP) with integrated Lean 4 formal verification. OpenProver integrates a Planner-Worker-Verifier architecture inspired by recent ATP agentic systems such as Aletheia. A Planner agent maintains a compact Whiteboard scratchpad and an unbounded Repository of intermediate findings, and decomposes mathematical work into parallel Workers.
  OpenProver is fully open-source, offers reproducible evaluation through automatic formal verification of generated proofs, and provides an interactive terminal interface for human-guided proof search. In interactive mode, OpenProver allows the human operator to monitor and steer the proof search process, motivated by the established human-AI synergy in interactive code generation.
  To showcase the potential for quantitative ablation experiments enabled by automatic formal verification, we evaluate OpenProver on ProofNet and compare it with a simple baseline. OpenProver is publicly available at https://github.com/kripner/OpenProver.

AI.tldr: OpenProver是一个开源的大语言模型驱动自动定理证明系统，采用Planner-Worker-Verifier架构，集成Lean 4形式化验证，支持可复现评估和交互式人机协同证明搜索。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM驱动的自动定理证明系统（如Aletheia）缺乏开源实现和可复现评估机制，且人机协同证明搜索的支持不足。作者旨在提供一个完全开源、具备自动形式化验证能力、支持交互式人机协同的系统，以推动该领域的可复现研究和实际应用。
AI.method: 采用Planner-Worker-Verifier三层架构：Planner代理维护紧凑的Whiteboard暂存区和无界Repository存储中间发现，将数学工作分解为并行Worker任务；集成Lean 4进行自动形式化验证；提供交互式终端界面，支持人类操作员监控和引导证明搜索过程。
AI.result: 在ProofNet基准上对OpenProver进行了评估，并与简单基线进行了比较，展示了自动形式化验证在定量消融实验中的潜力。
AI.conclusion: OpenProver作为一个完全开源、具备自动形式化验证和交互式人机协同能力的ATP系统，为LLM驱动定理证明领域的可复现研究和实际应用提供了基础平台。

title: SafeExplorer: An Unbiased Policy Gradient for Reinforcement Learning with Recovery Interventions
summary: Training reinforcement-learning agents directly on physical robots makes every fall costly, since a fall can damage the platform and cannot be undone like a simulator reset; the goal is therefore to minimize falls during training rather than trade them off against return, as constrained Markov decision process (MDP) formulations do. A standard mitigation hands control to a separate recovery policy whenever the agent leaves a designer-specified safe region (a subset of state space it should stay within), but the resulting mixed-policy rollouts silently bias every on-policy update, and the importance-sampling correction that would remove this bias is ill-defined whenever the recovery policy is deterministic. We address this bias with a drop-in modification of proximal policy optimization (PPO). Its core is an unbiased policy-gradient estimator that uses the score function only at safe timesteps and never evaluates the recovery policy's density, so it stays valid even when the recovery policy is deterministic, exactly where importance sampling breaks, and it empirically dominates importance sampling even when the recovery policy is stochastic. Because the recovery policy still makes credit assignment slow near the safe-region boundary, two further components accelerate learning: a closed-form value for recovery-triggering states when dynamics and recovery are deterministic, and an imitation loss that copies recovery actions only when recovery succeeds. On a three-environment, five-seed benchmark, the resulting algorithm reduces training-time falls by factors of 233x, 48x, and 26x on HalfCheetah, Ant, and Unitree Go1 over standard PPO, while matching or exceeding PPO's final reward, and on Ant, where the recovery policy is unreliable, it is the only method that reaches 80% of the best final reward.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无偏的PPO改进算法，通过仅在安全时间步使用得分函数估计策略梯度，避免了恢复策略带来的偏差，在物理机器人训练中大幅减少摔倒次数（最高233倍），同时保持或提升最终奖励。
AI.motivation: 在物理机器人上训练强化学习智能体时，每次摔倒都可能损坏平台且无法像仿真器那样重置，因此需要在训练过程中最小化摔倒次数。现有的安全区域+恢复策略方法会导致混合策略轨迹偏置 on-policy 更新，而重要性采样校正无法应用于确定性恢复策略。
AI.method: 核心是PPO的无偏修正：1）提出仅在安全时间步使用得分函数的无偏策略梯度估计器，避免评估恢复策略的密度（即使恢复策略是确定性的也有效）；2）在恢复触发状态使用闭式价值函数（当动力学和恢复策略均为确定性时）；3）增加模仿损失，仅在恢复成功时复制恢复策略的动作。三者共同构成一个即插即用的PPO修改。
AI.result: 在HalfCheetah、Ant和Unitree Go1三个环境上，与标准PPO相比，训练期间摔倒次数分别减少233倍、48倍和26倍，同时最终奖励持平或更高。在Ant上（恢复策略不可靠），该方法唯一达到最佳最终奖励80%的算法。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效解决了安全恢复策略带来的偏差问题，在不牺牲最终性能的前提下极大降低了训练中的物理损坏风险，为真实机器人上的安全强化学习提供了实用方案。

title: Deceptive Grounding: Entity Attribution Failure in Clinical Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary:
Retrieval-augmented generation evaluation checks whether model claims are factually grounded in retrieved documents. It does not check whether retrieved evidence is attributed to the correct entity.
  A clinical RAG response can pass every automated check (zero hallucinations, near-perfect faithfulness, real citations) while presenting drug Y's clinical evidence as evidence about queried drug X. We term this deceptive grounding (DG): a failure invisible to faithfulness, hallucination, and citation checks because every claim is sourced from a real document, about the wrong entity.
  Using a controlled factorial benchmark across 13 models, we find DG rates spanning 8-87% at peak adversarial conditions. Medical and biomedical fine-tuned models reach up to 86.7%; domain specialization amplifies the failure rather than mitigating it.
  A controlled ablation identifies the mechanism: removing entity-specific clinical evidence from retrieved documents eliminates entity-attribution failure entirely, shifting all failures to confabulation. The two failure modes respond to the same trigger, taking different paths.
  Production measurement across 740 drug-disease pairs finds 7.8% overall DG in a deployed RAG system, rising to 13.6% for recently approved drugs. Entity-attribution verification (checking that cited evidence applies to the queried entity) detects DG at 97.0% precision and 98.7% DG recall (IPW-adjusted human gold standard); no existing framework implements it.

AI.tldr: The paper identifies a failure mode in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) called deceptive grounding (DG), where a model correctly cites a real document but the evidence pertains to a different entity than the query (e.g., using drug Y's clinical data to answer about drug X). Current faithfulness and hallucination checks miss this. Across 13 models, DG rates reach 8–87% under adversarial conditions, with medical fine-tuned models as high as 86.7%. A production RAG system shows 7.8% overall DG, rising to 13.6% for recently approved drugs. The authors propose entity-attribution verification, achieving 97.0% precision and 98.7% recall, and show that removing entity-specific evidence eliminates DG, shifting failures to confabulation.
AI.motivation: Current RAG evaluation only checks whether model claims are factually grounded in retrieved documents, but does not verify whether the retrieved evidence is attributed to the correct entity. This blind spot can lead to harmful errors in high-stakes domains like clinical decision support, motivating the need to expose and measure deceptive grounding.
AI.method: The authors construct a controlled factorial benchmark across 13 models (general-purpose, medical, biomedical) to measure DG rates under varying adversarial conditions. They perform a controlled ablation to isolate the mechanism, then measure DG in a deployed RAG system across 740 drug-disease pairs. Finally, they evaluate entity-attribution verification as a detection method against a human gold standard.
AI.result: DG rates span 8–87% at peak adversarial conditions; medical/biomedical fine-tuned models reach up to 86.7%. Removing entity-specific clinical evidence eliminates DG entirely, shifting failures to confabulation. In production, 7.8% overall DG is observed, rising to 13.6% for recently approved drugs. Entity-attribution verification detects DG at 97.0% precision and 98.7% recall.
AI.conclusion: Entity-attribution verification is a necessary but missing component in RAG evaluation. Domain specialization amplifies deceptive grounding rather than mitigating it. The two failure modes (DG and confabulation) share the same trigger but diverge in path, so evaluating entity attribution is critical for trustworthy RAG, especially in clinical applications.

title: Probing Diffusion Denoising Dynamics for Contrastive Representation Learning
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models exhibit unprecedented generative capability and contain rich intermediate representations that can be useful for discriminative vision tasks. Motivated by this observation, we study a focused question: how can the denoising dynamics of a pretrained diffusion model be adapted to support discriminative representation learning while preserving its generative behavior under parameter-efficient updates? We present D$^3$CL as an investigation of this question. Our key observation is that noisy latents at different diffusion timesteps can be interpreted as stochastic views of the same underlying image, enabling a contrastive objective to be coupled with the standard denoising reconstruction loss. This formulation provides a simple way to probe the interaction between generative denoising and discriminative representation learning without training from scratch. To keep the adaptation lightweight, we apply LoRA updates to a pretrained Stable Diffusion backbone while freezing the original model parameters. D$^3$CL provides strong empirical evidence that reconstruction and noise-level contrastive objectives can be complementary: on ImageNet-1K, it obtains 80.1% linear-probing accuracy and an FID of 5.56 for $256 \times 256$ unconditional generation. Additional ablations on the design space suggest that the usefulness of diffusion features depends on where and how denoising states are sampled. These results establish D$^3$CL as a parameter-efficient adaptation framework for pretrained diffusion models, showing that noise-level contrastive learning can structure denoising representations for discriminative tasks while maintaining generative performance.

AI.tldr: 提出 D³CL，一种参数高效的适应框架，通过将噪声级对比学习与扩散模型的去噪重建损失结合，使得预训练的文本到图像扩散模型（如 Stable Diffusion）在保持生成性能的同时，也能学习判别性视觉表示。在 ImageNet-1K 上，线性探测准确率达 80.1%，FID 为 5.56。
AI.motivation: 预训练的扩散模型包含丰富的中间表示，可用于判别性视觉任务。但如何在不损失生成能力的前提下，以参数高效的方式将扩散模型的去噪动态适应到判别性表示学习是一个未解决的问题。
AI.method: 将不同去噪时间步的噪声潜变量视为同一图像的随机视图，在标准去噪重建损失之外引入对比学习目标；使用 LoRA 对预训练 Stable Diffusion 主干进行轻量级更新，保持原始模型参数冻结。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet-1K 上，线性探测准确率达 80.1%，无条件生成 FID 为 5.56（256×256）。消融实验表明扩散特征的有效性取决于去噪状态的采样位置和方式。
AI.conclusion: D³CL 表明噪声级对比学习可以结构化扩散模型的去噪表示以服务于判别性任务，同时维持生成性能，是一种参数高效的适应框架。

title: LongMedBench: Benchmarking Medical Agents for Long-Horizon Clinical Decision-Making
comment: Submitted manuscript prior to peer review in MICCAI 2026
summary: In this work, we introduce LongMedBench, a real-world EHR-based benchmark for long-horizon clinical decision-making. Prior evaluations of LLM-based medical agents have largely emphasized short-context knowledge QA and tool use. However, real-world medical care is inherently longitudinal, and clinicians must aggregate evidence across repeated visits, tests, and evolving treatments. Therefore, long-horizon interaction is essential for realistic assessment. LongMedBench is constructed via a reproducible pipeline that integrates MIMIC-IV admission records and clinical notes into time-series event streams and long-context memory datasets, enabling long-horizon, multi-session interactions between agents and a clinical environment. It comprises 335 patients, with 19.72 inpatient visits per patient on average and 44.91 medical events per visit. Guided by the long-horizon decision process, we propose an evaluation taxonomy with three suites: fact-based QA, temporal reasoning, and long-horizon decision-making. This taxonomy measures how agents understand and leverage historical patient information over extended horizons. Our experiments show that while recent LLMs can make good use of explicit timestamps, they have challenges in implicit time inference; The RAG and agent memory system can improve the performance of information retrieval tasks, but the performance of decision-making tasks is highly dependent on the model's immediate context.

AI.tldr: LongMedBench 是一个基于真实 EHR 数据的医序决策基准，用于评估 LLM 在长期医疗过程中的表现。它包含 335 名患者，平均每位患者有 19.72 次住院就诊，每次就诊有 44.91 个医疗事件。通过可复现的流水线构建，将病历和临床笔记转化为时间序列事件流和长上下文记忆数据集。基准包括三个评估套件：事实型 QA、时间推理和长程决策。实验表明，当前 LLM 能利用显式时间戳但在隐式时间推理上存在困难；RAG 和智能体记忆系统可提升信息检索任务，但决策任务表现高度依赖模型的即时上下文。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 医学评估大多强调短上下文知识问答和工具使用，但真实医疗护理是纵向的，临床医生需要跨多次就诊、检查和治疗方案来聚合证据，因此需要长程交互能力的评估。
AI.method: 通过可复现的流水线整合 MIMIC-IV 入院记录和临床笔记，构建时间序列事件流和长上下文记忆数据集。在此基础上提出包含事实型 QA、时间推理和长程决策三个套件的评估分类法。
AI.result: 实验发现：当前 LLM 能良好利用显式时间戳，但在隐式时间推理上存在挑战；RAG 和智能体记忆系统可提升信息检索任务性能，但决策任务的表现高度依赖模型的即时上下文。
AI.conclusion: LongMedBench 为评估 LLM 在真实长期临床决策中的能力提供了基准，揭示了现有模型在长程上下文理解和隐式时间推理方面的不足，并指出提升决策任务需要更强的情境感知能力。

title: BlockServe: Block-Grained Continuous Batching for High-Throughput Diffusion LLM Serving
summary: Efficient serving of diffusion large language models (dLLMs) is hindered by convergence heterogeneity: when batching multiple requests, different sequences converge at different rates, causing faster requests to stall behind slower stragglers and introducing compute bubbles and tail latency. We present BlockServe, a continuous batching framework that integrates block-grained scheduling -- immediately evicting completed requests at block boundaries -- with mixed-state execution that extends dual cache and parallel decoding to heterogeneous batches via gather-scatter indexing. Furthermore, a compute-aware admission controller expands effective batch capacity through token-budgeted refill. On Dream and LLaDA across five benchmarks, BlockServe achieves 1.9--10.6$\times$ throughput over Fast-dLLM with comparable generation quality, establishing block-grained scheduling as a foundation for high-throughput offline dLLM inference.

AI.tldr: BlockServe通过块粒度调度和混合状态执行解决了扩散大语言模型服务中的收敛异质性瓶颈，在Dream和LLaDA上相比Fast-dLLM实现了1.9-10.6倍的吞吐量提升。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型(dLLM)在批量服务时存在收敛异质性（convergence heterogeneity）问题：不同序列的收敛速度不同，导致快请求被慢请求（stragglers）阻塞，产生计算气泡和尾延迟，严重影响服务效率。
AI.method: 1) 块粒度调度（block-grained scheduling）：在块边界立即驱逐已完成的请求；2) 混合状态执行（mixed-state execution）：通过gather-scatter索引将双缓存和并行解码扩展到异构批次；3) 计算感知的准入控制器（compute-aware admission controller）：通过令牌预算的重新填充（token-budgeted refill）扩展有效批次容量。
AI.result: 在Dream和LLaDA模型上，覆盖五个基准测试，BlockServe相较于Fast-dLLM实现了1.9-10.6倍的吞吐量提升，同时保持可比的生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 块粒度调度可作为高吞吐离线dLLM推理的基础范式，有效解决了收敛异质性带来的性能瓶颈。

title: Self-Guided Test-Time Training for Long-Context LLMs
summary: Long-context processing has become increasingly important for large language models (LLMs), but simply extending the context window does not guarantee effective utilization of long inputs. As input length grows, accuracy often degrades, indicating that models still struggle to identify and use the evidence most relevant to a question. A promising way to improve long-context utilization is test-time training (TTT), which treats the test context as a training example for instance-specific parameter adaptation. However, applying TTT to the entire long context is prohibitively expensive, while adapting on randomly sampled spans introduces severe noise. Because most spans in a long context are irrelevant to the specific question, training on them may even degrade the base model's performance. Our preliminary study shows that TTT is highly sensitive to training-span quality: on LongBench-v2, TTT on randomly sampled spans hurts performance, whereas TTT on oracle spans substantially improves it. Motivated by this, we propose a simple method, Self-Guided TTT (S-TTT): before adaptation, the model identifies the evidence spans it should learn from, and the standard language-modeling training objective is applied only to those selected spans. On two challenging long-context reasoning benchmarks, LongBench-v2 and LongBench-Pro, S-TTT improves accuracy for both Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, achieving up to a 15% relative improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Self-Guided TTT (S-TTT)方法，通过在测试时让模型自己识别相关证据片段并仅在这些片段上进行训练，从而高效地提升长上下文利用能力，在LongBench-v2和LongBench-Pro上取得最高15%的相对准确率提升。
AI.motivation: 长上下文处理对大语言模型越来越重要，但单纯扩展上下文窗口并不能保证有效利用长输入，准确率随长度增加而下降。测试时训练（TTT）是一种有前景的方法，但直接对整个长上下文进行TTT代价过高，而在随机采样片段上训练又会引入噪声甚至降低性能。因此需要一种高效且能利用相关证据的TTT方法。
AI.method: 提出Self-Guided TTT (S-TTT)，在适应之前，模型先自行识别应该学习的证据片段（即与问题相关的部分），然后仅在这些选定片段上应用标准的语言建模训练目标。该方法避免了随机采样的噪声，也无需对整个上下文进行训练。
AI.result: 在LongBench-v2和LongBench-Pro两个长上下文推理基准上，S-TTT提升了Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct的准确率，相对提升最高达15%。
AI.conclusion: S-TTT是一种简单有效的方法，通过让模型自主选择高质量训练片段进行测试时训练，显著提升了长上下文任务的表现，验证了训练片段质量对TTT的关键影响。

title: OmniMapBench: Benchmarking Visual-Centric Reasoning on Diverse Map Documents
summary: Recent advancements in LVLMs necessitate robust benchmarks for complex, visually grounded reasoning. A critical limitation is identified in many document understanding benchmarks: visual content is often reducible to text, enabling high performance without genuine visual grounding. To address this limitation, OmniMapBench is introduced to foster visual-centric reasoning for map documents. The benchmark comprises 2,096 manually annotated question-answer pairs across 1,603 map documents from nine categories. It is designed to probe a hierarchy of skills, ranging from perception to multi-step visual reasoning. To quantify benchmark properties, a simple yet effective benchmark-level metric is proposed: the Visual Dependency Index (VDI), defined as the accuracy drop when images are replaced with question-agnostic descriptions. OmniMapBench exhibits higher VDI than established benchmarks, which quantitatively validates its focus on irreducible visual reasoning. Comprehensive evaluations of 25 leading LVLMs are conducted on OmniMapBench. A significant performance gap is observed, with the top-performing model achieving only 75.03\% accuracy. This result underscores the challenges posed by OmniMapBench to current LVLMs. This work aims to catalyze progress in visual-centric reasoning for document understanding of LVLMs. The dataset and code are publicly available at https://github.com/SIGMME/OmniMapBench.

AI.tldr: 提出 OmniMapBench 基准，专门用于评估 LVLM 在地图文档上的视觉中心推理能力。包含 2,096 个手工标注的问答对和 1,603 个地图文档，涵盖九类地图。同时提出视觉依赖指数 (VDI) 来衡量基准对视觉信息的不可约性。在 25 个主流 LVLM 上评测，最佳模型仅达 75.03% 准确率，揭示了当前模型在真实视觉推理上的显著不足。
AI.motivation: 现有文档理解基准中视觉内容常可被文本替代，导致模型无需真正视觉理解即可获得高分。为克服这一局限，需要构建一个强调视觉中心推理的基准，推动 LVLM 在地图文档这类视觉密集型任务上的进步。
AI.method: 1) 构建 OmniMapBench 数据集：包含 2,096 个问答对，源自 1,603 份地图文档，覆盖 9 个类别；问题设计从感知到多步视觉推理的分层技能。2) 提出视觉依赖指数 (VDI)：用与问题无关的文本描述替换图像后模型准确率的下降量，量化基准对视觉信息的依赖程度。3) 在 25 个 LVLM 上开展系统评测。
AI.result: OmniMapBench 的 VDI 显著高于已有基准，表明其确实需要不可约的视觉推理。25 个 LVLM 中表现最好的模型准确率仅为 75.03%，整体性能差距明显，证明该基准对当前模型具有挑战性。
AI.conclusion: OmniMapBench 能有效催化 LVLM 在文档理解中视觉中心推理的发展。数据和代码已开源，为后续研究提供标准化测试平台。

title: Communication-Efficient Digital-Twin Coordination for Heterogeneous LLM Embodied Agents over Computing Power Networks
summary: Embodied agent teams powered by heterogeneous large language models (LLMs) are being widely deployed in physical artificial intelligence such as smart factories, warehouses, and service robotics. To enable collaboration among such an agent team, efficient coordination mechanisms that operate reliably under limited network resources are required. However, existing heterogeneous LLM-agent coordination frameworks that rely on multi-round natural-language-based conversations introduce three coupled challenges. First, inter-agent dialogue incurs communication overhead that grows rapidly with team size. Second, the quality of coordination is constrained by the heterogeneous capabilities of the agent team's LLMs. Third, agents may suffer from action delays due to iterative negotiation. To address these challenges, we propose LDT-Coord, a networked coordination framework built upon a lightweight digital twin (DT). Specifically, each agent independently selects its intended action and reports both the action decision and a structured temporal constraint over shared resources to the DT server, thereby decoupling coordination performance from natural-language reasoning ability. Then, DT executes a training-free, rule-based orchestrator algorithm to resolve cross-agent conflicts and returns coordination instructions to prevent such conflicts. To further reduce communication overhead, we formulate agent reporting control as a constrained partially observable Markov decision process (C-POMDP) and solve it with the PPO-Lagrangian algorithm. Simulation results show that LDT-Coord achieves a task success rate comparable to conventional coordination methods while reducing communication overhead by more than 70x and maintaining robustness under LLM heterogeneity.

AI.tldr: 提出LDT-Coord框架，利用轻量级数字孪生解耦异构LLM智能体团队的协调性能与自然语言推理能力，通过结构化时序约束和规则协调器解决冲突，并采用C-POMDP与PPO-Lagrangian算法控制通信开销，在保持任务成功率的同时将通信量降低70倍以上。
AI.motivation: 现有的异构LLM智能体协调框架依赖多轮自然语言对话，带来三个耦合挑战：1) 通信开销随团队规模快速增长；2) 协调质量受限于LLM的异构能力；3) 迭代协商导致动作延迟。亟需一种非对话式的、轻量级的协调机制来解耦这些问题。
AI.method: 1) 每个智能体独立选择意图动作，向DT服务器报告动作决策和结构化时序约束（而非自然语言），解耦协调性能与LLM推理能力；2) DT执行无需训练的规则协调器算法解决跨智能体冲突并返回协调指令；3) 将智能体报告控制建模为约束部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（C-POMDP），使用PPO-Lagrangian算法求解以降低通信开销。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，LDT-Coord在任务成功率上与传统协调方法相当，同时将通信开销降低超过70倍，并在LLM异构性下保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: LDT-Coord通过数字孪生和结构化约束机制，有效解决了异构LLM智能体团队协调中通信效率、异构能力和动作延迟的耦合问题，为资源受限环境下的具身智能体团队协作提供了可行方案。

title: TSRouter: Dynamic Modality-Model Selection for Time Series Reasoning
summary: Time series reasoning is essential for real-world problem-solving. While both Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can reason about time-series data, their capabilities are complementary: LLMs process time series as text sequences and thus preserve exact numerical understanding, but struggle with global patterns, whereas VLMs efficiently capture these patterns by visualizing time series but may lose fine-grained details. Moreover, models vary significantly in task-specific expertise and inference costs. Dynamically selecting the most suitable modality and model for each query is therefore crucial, yet challenging because it requires modeling the complex interactions among tasks, queries, modalities, and models, which carry rich contextual signals. To this end, we introduce TSRouter, a graph-based dynamic routing framework. TSRouter constructs a heterogeneous graph of task, query, modality, and model nodes to contextualize the interactions among query characteristics, modality attributes, and model capabilities. TSRouter formulates routing as a candidate scoring problem, where each modality-model pair is evaluated based on user-defined performance-cost preferences to select the optimal candidate. Comprehensive evaluations on 4 distinct time series reasoning tasks reveal that TSRouter substantially outperforms diverse baselines with 16\% to 46\% relative improvements. Furthermore, TSRouter demonstrates robust zero-shot plug-and-play generalization to unseen models and novel tasks and preserves high performance while reducing computational overhead through cost-aware optimization. Our code is available at https://github.com/tianyi-lab/TSRouter.

AI.tldr: TSRouter是一个基于图的动态路由框架，通过构建任务、查询、模态和模型的异构图，为时间序列推理任务动态选择最优的模态-模型组合，在4个任务上取得16%-46%的相对提升，并支持零样本泛化到未见模型和新任务。
AI.motivation: LLM和VLM在处理时间序列数据时各有优劣：LLM保留精确数值但难以捕捉全局模式，VLM善于捕获全局模式却可能丢失细粒度细节。不同模型在任务专长和推理成本上差异显著，因此需要动态选择最合适的模态和模型来处理每个查询。
AI.method: TSRouter构建包含任务、查询、模态和模型节点的异构图来上下文化交互信息，将路由问题形式化为候选评分问题，基于用户定义的性能-成本偏好对每个模态-模型对进行评估，选择最优候选。
AI.result: 在4个不同的时间序列推理任务上，TSRouter相对于多种基线方法实现了16%-46%的相对提升，展现出对未见模型和新任务的鲁棒零样本泛化能力，并通过成本感知优化在降低计算开销的同时保持高性能。
AI.conclusion: TSRouter作为一种图-based动态路由框架，有效解决了时间序列推理中多模态和多模型的动态选择问题，兼顾性能与成本，具有良好的泛化性和实用性。

title: A Sovereign, Open-Source Foundation Model for German and English
summary: We present Soofi S 30B-A3B, a sovereign, open-source Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) hybrid Mamba Transformer foundation model for German and English. Its hybrid design activates only 3B of 30B parameters per token and keeps the inference cache near-constant as context grows, giving it a decisive throughput advantage over dense models for long-context, high-concurrency deployment. Pretrained on roughly 27 trillion tokens with deliberately up-weighted German, Soofi S matches dense 14 to 27B models on aggregate English and German benchmarks while achieving the best code aggregates in both languages among 17 open base models, and outperforms every European sovereign baseline in our comparison, including ones far larger in active parameters. Among fully open models, Soofi S obtains the highest English and German evaluation scores, ahead of Olmo 3 32B and Apertus 70B. Soofi S was built end-to-end on the German Industrial AI Cloud, a sovereign HPC scale AI infrastructure operated by Deutsche Telekom in Munich. Soofi S will be released under highly permissive, open-access terms: weights, selected intermediate checkpoints, full per-source data accounting, hyperparameters, and training and evaluation code. Where source licenses permit, data-construction artifacts are released under permissive licenses; commercially licensed sources are documented with aggregate statistics and exact mixture accounting.

AI.tldr: Soofi S 30B-A3B is a sovereign, open-source Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) hybrid Mamba Transformer foundation model for German and English, with 30B total parameters but only 3B active per token. Pretrained on ~27T tokens with up-weighted German, it matches dense 14-27B models on benchmarks, achieves best code aggregates among 17 open base models, and outperforms all European sovereign baselines. Built on Deutsche Telekom's sovereign HPC infrastructure, it will be released under permissive open-access terms including weights, code, data accounting, and hyperparameters.
AI.motivation: There is a need for a sovereign, open-source large language model that natively handles both German and English with high efficiency, transparency, and competitive performance, while being deployable on European AI infrastructure to reduce reliance on non-European models and cloud providers.
AI.method: The model uses a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) hybrid Mamba Transformer architecture with 30B total parameters and 3B active parameters per token. The hybrid design keeps the inference cache near-constant as context grows, enabling efficient long-context deployment. Training data consists of ~27 trillion tokens with deliberately up-weighted German content. The model was trained end-to-end on the German Industrial AI Cloud, a sovereign HPC infrastructure operated by Deutsche Telekom in Munich.
AI.result: Soofi S matches dense models with 14-27B active parameters on aggregate English and German benchmarks. It achieves the best code aggregates in both languages among 17 open base models, and outperforms every European sovereign baseline, including far larger active-parameter models. Among fully open models, it scores highest in English and German evaluations, surpassing Olmo 3 32B and Apertus 70B. The model will be released with full transparency including weights, intermediate checkpoints, per-source data accounting, hyperparameters, and training/evaluation code.
AI.conclusion: Soofi S demonstrates that a sovereign European MoE hybrid model with 3B active parameters can match or exceed much larger dense models, establishing a new state-of-the-art for open German-English foundation models. Its open-access release under permissive terms promotes transparency, reproducibility, and European AI sovereignty.

title: Toward Active Object Detection for UAVs in the Wild: A Large-Scale Dataset, Benchmark and Method
summary: Object detection is a fundamental component in numerous Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) applications, yet it has long been plagued by hindrances like occlusion or target pixel scarcity. Active Object Detection (AOD) provides a novel paradigm to address these challenges via active vision, while UAV-based AOD research remains scarce due to the lack of high-quality datasets and benchmarks for algorithm development and evaluation. To fill this gap, this paper presents ATRNet-LUDO, the first large-scale real-world dataset for UAV-Ground Active Object Detection (UGAOD). It contains 121,000 multi-view panoramic multi-target aerial images and 1.21 million local single-target slices, covering 10 vehicle targets across 40 scenarios. It enables the construction of diverse training and testing environments for UAV agent interaction and active observation policy learning. Based on this dataset, we establish a comprehensive evaluation benchmark for AOD policy learning methods. Most existing AOD policies rely on Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) but suffer from poor generalization. Evaluations on our benchmark reveal a significant generalization gap between training and testing performance, highlighting an urgent need for solutions. To this end, we leverage the Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) to construct a world model that enhances state representation learning, and propose AOD-JEPA by incorporating AOD-specific prior knowledge. Extensive experiments validate its effectiveness and superiority. We hope ATRNet-LUDO and the benchmark will advance research in the UGAOD field. The dataset and code are soon available at https://github.com/Leo000ooo/LUDO_dataset.

AI.tldr: The paper introduces ATRNet-LUDO, the first large-scale real-world dataset for UAV-Ground Active Object Detection (UGAOD), comprising 121,000 multi-view panoramic images and 1.21 million local slices. It establishes a benchmark for evaluating Active Object Detection (AOD) policies, revealing generalization gaps in existing Deep Reinforcement Learning methods. To address this, the authors propose AOD-JEPA, which leverages Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture for enhanced state representation learning, demonstrating effectiveness and superiority.
AI.motivation: UAV-based Active Object Detection (AOD) is hindered by occlusion and target pixel scarcity. However, research is scarce due to lack of high-quality datasets and benchmarks for algorithm development and evaluation. Existing DRL-based AOD policies suffer from poor generalization.
AI.method: The authors construct ATRNet-LUDO, a large-scale real-world dataset with multi-view panoramic multi-target aerial images and local single-target slices. They establish a comprehensive evaluation benchmark for AOD policy learning. To improve generalization, they leverage Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) to construct a world model for state representation learning, proposing AOD-JEPA with AOD-specific prior knowledge.
AI.result: The dataset and benchmark are created, and the proposed AOD-JEPA method is validated through extensive experiments, showing effectiveness and superiority over existing methods.
AI.conclusion: ATRNet-LUDO and the benchmark aim to advance UGAOD research. The dataset and code will be made publicly available.

title: Fictional Worldbuilding: Multi-Agent LLM Collaboration with Hierarchical Context Compression and Iterative Review
summary: Worldbuilding, the construction of coherent fictional worlds, is a foundational task in game design and literary creation. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer new possibilities for automated content generation, but their application to worldbuilding faces three challenges: context explosion that grows linearly with the building process, the tension between creative diversity and content consistency, and the absence of automated quality assurance. This paper presents AutoWorldBuilder, a multi-agent collaborative system that addresses these challenges through five integrated components: a structured concept network with conflict detection; a DAG-based hybrid batch scheduler that groups tasks by semantic locality; a four-layer context compression mechanism achieving approximately 90% token reduction; an iterative review system with specialized Auditor agents that improves proposal pass rates from 42% to over 85%; and a skill-driven agent architecture supporting zero-code extension with differentiated temperature configuration. Two experiments across 20 diverse worldbuilding tasks, using GPT-OSS 120B and DeepSeek v3.2 as LLM backends, demonstrate a 95.0% success rate. The system generated 56-103 self-consistent concepts per world in 18-31 minutes with zero-conflict delivery. The architectural patterns validated here, including layer-as-budget compression, semantic-locality scheduling, and separation of generation and review, transfer to the broader class of knowledge-intensive, multi-agent LLM applications.

AI.tldr: AutoWorldBuilder是一个多智能体协作系统，通过结构化概念网络、DAG混合批调度器、四层上下文压缩（约90% token缩减）、迭代审查系统和技能驱动架构，解决大语言模型在虚构世界构建中的上下文爆炸、创意多样性与一致性矛盾、缺乏自动质量保证三大挑战。在20个任务中实现95%成功率，每个世界生成56-103个自洽概念，零冲突交付。
AI.motivation: 世界构建是游戏设计和文学创作的基础任务，LLM为自动化内容生成带来新可能，但面临三个挑战：构建过程中上下文线性增长导致的上下文爆炸；创意多样性与内容一致性之间的张力；缺乏自动质量保证机制。现有方法难以同时应对这些挑战。
AI.method: 提出AutoWorldBuilder多智能体协作系统，包含五个集成组件：①结构化概念网络与冲突检测；②基于DAG的混合批调度器，按语义局部性分组任务；③四层上下文压缩机制，实现约90% token缩减；④迭代审查系统，配备专业Auditor智能体，将提案通过率从42%提升至85%以上；⑤技能驱动智能体架构，支持零代码扩展和差异化温度配置。
AI.result: 在20个多样化世界构建任务上，使用GPT-OSS 120B和DeepSeek v3.2作为LLM后端，实现95.0%成功率。每个世界在18-31分钟内生成56-103个自洽概念，零冲突交付。提案通过率从42%提升至85%以上。
AI.conclusion: 该系统中验证的架构模式——包括layer-as-budget压缩、语义局部性调度、生成与审查分离——可迁移到更广泛的知识密集型多智能体LLM应用中。

title: Training, Reading, and Editing Legible Transformers
summary: A transformer can be built from operators that are legible by construction -- bounded, named units that read as fuzzy set operations rather than dense activations -- but legibility must be pressed for during training, and the pressure has a failure mode. A crispness penalty meant to sharpen a bounded operator into a decisive detector instead collapses it into a dead constant. An identity, E[v(1-v)] = mu(1-mu) - var, shows why -- the penalty is a variance-minimizer blind to the difference between a live detector and a constant -- and names the fix: a per-channel variance floor, the target legibility metric written as a loss, which recovers both legibility and quality. A learned per-unit fraction then retires the hand-set reserved-GELU partition of prior work: given the choice the model keeps no unit as pure GELU and routes 87% of its load-bearing computation through crisp operators. The result is the most legible transformer we have built -- 78% of its feed-forward operands and 50% of its attention value channels are crisp-and-contextual detectors, and per-head legibility rises from 18% in shallow layers to 78% in deep ones. Read in the correct rotated per-layer frame, these units separate a clean detection (what a unit responds to) from a harder naming (what its output decodes to); and because the objective makes each unit crisp and sparse, edits to them are far more local -- 50-184x in the deep layers where the edit sites concentrate -- and can target explicit conjunctions a single neuron cannot express. Finally, a between-unit decorrelation pressure exposes a legibility dial: it trades a circuit's reuse for independence at no quality cost, turning concepts into single, surgically editable units and a prediction into a short explanation read off a handful of named operations. Quality holds at parity with a conventional baseline throughout.
