AI.tldr: 本文提出一种通过可读性约束构建Transformer的方法：使用模糊集操作替代密集激活，通过方差惩罚+可读性损失使78%的前馈算子和50%的注意力通道成为清晰可解释的检测器，且编辑局部性提升50-184倍，质量与基线持平。
AI.motivation: 现有Transformer的激活是密集、不可解释的，虽然可以通过事后分析方法解释，但模型本身并非天生可读。构建"天生可读"（legible by construction）的Transformer是目标，但直接施加清晰度惩罚会导致算子坍缩为死常数。
AI.method: 1）识别清晰度惩罚失效的根本原因：E[v(1-v)] = μ(1-μ) - var，证明该惩罚本质是方差最小化，无法区分活检测器与常数；2）提出修正方案：引入每通道方差下限（per-channel variance floor），将目标可读性指标直接写为损失函数；3）学习每单元分数替代手工预设的GELU分区；4）加入单元间去相关压力作为可读性调节旋钮。
AI.result: 1）78%前馈算子和50%注意力值通道为清晰检测器；2）逐头可读性从浅层18%提升到深层78%；3）编辑局部性在深层提升50-184倍；4）质量与基线持平；5）模型不保留任何纯GELU单元，87%的计算负载通过清晰算子完成；6）去相关使概念变为单个可手术编辑的单元，预测变为简短解释。
AI.conclusion: 通过正确的损失设计，可以在不牺牲质量的前提下构建高度可读的Transformer。可读性与质量并非不可兼得，关键是在训练过程中施加正确的压力。单元间去相关提供了一个可读性调节旋钮，允许在不损失质量的情况下在电路复用与独立性之间权衡。

title: Test-Time Scaling for Small VLMs on Multilingual Visual MCQ
summary: Test-time scaling (TTS) reliably improves reasoning in large language models, but whether it transfers to small open vision-language models remains unclear. We examine this on EXAMS-V, a multilingual visual multiple-choice benchmark, comparing self-consistency, describe-then-reason with PRM-guided beam search, and two post-hoc selectors across Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct and Qwen3.5-4B. What matters is the conditions under which TTS runs, not the search or verification machinery. The largest factor is parseability: an early prompt format left many chains reasoning correctly yet never committing to an answer letter, which a standard answer cue and a guided repair step largely remove. A larger decoding budget removes the rest: raising the per-chain token limit from 1k to 2k recovers 3.7 pp, whereas sampling more chains (8 to 16) adds only 0.15 pp. Once chains have room to finish, elaborate methods contribute little: PRM-guided beam search trails plain self-consistency by 0.39 pp at over eight times the cost, and neither a training-free generative critic nor a trained multimodal PRM beats majority vote across both policies. The largest gain comes instead from the policy model itself (+11.4 pp). Our best configuration reaches 84.1% on the held-out ImageCLEF 2026 test split, ranking first on the Visual MCQ leaderboard.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了测试时缩放（TTS）在小规模开源视觉语言模型上的迁移效果，发现解析性和解码预算（而非搜索或验证机制）是主要影响因素，最佳配置在EXAMS-V多语言视觉多选题基准上达到84.1%准确率，排名第一。
AI.motivation: 测试时缩放（TTS）在大型语言模型中能可靠提升推理能力，但在小型开源视觉语言模型中是否同样有效尚不清楚，本文旨在验证其迁移性。
AI.method: 在EXAMS-V多语言视觉多选题基准上，比较了自一致性、先描述后推理结合PRM引导的束搜索以及两种事后选择器，使用Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct和Qwen3.5-4B模型，分析了提示格式、解码预算、搜索策略等因素的影响。
AI.result: 解析性是最大影响因素：早期提示格式导致推理正确但未提交答案；标准答案提示和引导修复大幅改善。增大解码预算有效：每链token限制从1k增至2k提升3.7个百分点，而增加采样链数（8到16）仅提升0.15个百分点。复杂方法贡献有限：PRM引导的束搜索比自一致性低0.39个百分点且成本高8倍；无训练生成式批评器和训练好的多模态PRM均未超越多数投票。最大增益来自策略模型本身（+11.4个百分点）。最佳配置达84.1%，位列视觉多选题排行榜第一。
AI.conclusion: 对于小型视觉语言模型，测试时缩放的有效性主要取决于解析性和解码预算等基础条件，而非复杂的搜索或验证机制；策略模型本身的能力提升是最重要的因素。

title: GeoTrace: Geometry-Aware Trajectory Token Compression for Video Large Language Models
summary: Although Video Large Language Models (Video LLMs) have shown strong performance in video understanding, their efficiency is still limited by the large number of visual tokens. Existing video token compression methods typically rely on frame-wise saliency or heuristic token merging, which can over-focus on locally salient regions and produce ambiguous fused features. To address these issues, we propose GeoTrace, a training-free spatiotemporal token compression framework that decomposes video evidence into exact skeleton tokens and traceable residual event tokens. Specifically, Contextual Farthest-Point Anchoring (CFPA) preserves salient, context-consistent, and high-coverage skeleton tokens, while Trajectory-Constrained Residual Condensation (TCRC) compresses residual tokens through one-to-one temporal trajectories and constrained near-manifold condensation, producing traceable event tokens with reduced ambiguity. We evaluate GeoTrace on four Video LLMs across four video understanding benchmarks, and the results demonstrate its effectiveness and generalization across different model architectures and scenarios. On LLaVA-OneVision, with only 10\% visual tokens retained, GeoTrace achieves a \(12.99\times\) TFLOPs reduction while preserving 99.1\% of the vanilla performance. Overall, GeoTrace offers a compact and traceable token representation for efficient and robust Video LLM inference. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/guohuan-xie/GeoTrace.git}{\texttt{Code}}.

AI.tldr: GeoTrace是一种无需训练的时空令牌压缩框架，通过上下文最远点锚定（CFPA）保留关键骨架令牌，并利用轨迹约束残差凝聚（TCRC）压缩残差令牌，在不同Video LLM上仅用10%视觉令牌即可保持99.1%性能，同时降低12.99倍TFLOPs。
AI.motivation: 现有视频令牌压缩方法依赖逐帧显著性或启发式令牌合并，容易过度关注局部显著区域并产生模糊的融合特征，限制了Video LLM的效率。
AI.method: 提出GeoTrace框架，包含两个核心模块：1) 上下文最远点锚定（CFPA）保留显著、上下文一致且高覆盖率的骨架令牌；2) 轨迹约束残差凝聚（TCRC）通过一一对应的时间轨迹和约束近流形凝聚压缩残差令牌，生成可追踪的事件令牌。
AI.result: 在四个Video LLM和四个视频理解基准上验证有效性和泛化性。在LLaVA-OneVision上，仅保留10%视觉令牌，实现12.99倍TFLOPs减少，同时保持99.1%的原始性能。
AI.conclusion: GeoTrace提供了一种紧凑且可追踪的令牌表示，用于高效且鲁棒的Video LLM推理。

title: How Does Bayesian Causal Discovery Fail? Characterising Structural Consequences in Linear Gaussian Networks under Latent Confounding
summary: Bayesian causal discovery is widely used for its ability to quantify epistemic uncertainty over directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) through posterior inference. However, its behaviour under latent confounding remains poorly understood, as existing work typically notes that confounding breaks identifiability without characterising how the posterior distribution over DAGs responds. In this work, we analyse posterior behaviour under latent confounding in linear Gaussian causal models, focusing on additive latent confounding between exactly two observed variables. We derive a critical correlation threshold above which the score function favours graphs with a spurious edge between the confounded variables, and show that this threshold decreases with sample size -- more data lowers the correlation required for the spurious edge to be favoured. Beyond this threshold, we characterize two distinct posterior failure regimes determined by the local structure around the confounded variables. Our findings are supported by exact posterior computations on multiple graph structures, demonstrating both the predicted failure regimes.

AI.tldr: This paper analyzes posterior behavior in Bayesian causal discovery under latent confounding in linear Gaussian models, focusing on additive confounding between two observed variables. It derives a correlation threshold above which spurious edges are favored, shows threshold decreases with sample size, and characterizes two posterior failure regimes.
AI.motivation: Existing work on Bayesian causal discovery notes that latent confounding breaks identifiability but does not characterize how the posterior distribution over DAGs responds. This paper aims to fill that gap by analyzing posterior behavior under latent confounding.
AI.method: The authors analyze linear Gaussian causal models with additive latent confounding between exactly two observed variables. They derive a critical correlation threshold analytically and study posterior behavior via exact computations on multiple graph structures.
AI.result: The score function favors graphs with a spurious edge between confounded variables when correlation exceeds a threshold that decreases with sample size. Two distinct posterior failure regimes are identified, characterized by the local structure around the confounded variables.
AI.conclusion: The findings provide a theoretical characterization of how latent confounding affects Bayesian causal discovery, showing that more data can actually exacerbate the problem by lowering the threshold for spurious edges. The failure regimes are demonstrated via exact computations.

title: FairSelect: A Systematic Evaluation of Multi-Level and Intersectional Algorithmic Fairness
comment: 15 pages, 5 tables, Submission to Health Informatics Knowledge Management Conference 2026
summary: Algorithmic fairness methods are increasingly used to identify and mitigate bias in machine learning models, yet most approaches are evaluated in isolation and along single demographic axes. This limits practical guidance for selecting fairness strategies, where disparities may arise across intersectional subgroups and across multiple stages of the modeling lifecycle. This work presents FairSelect, a toolkit for systematically evaluating fairness mitigation strategies applied individually and in combination across preprocessing, inprocessing, and postprocessing stages. FairSelect supports multiple model architectures, intersectional subgroup evaluation, and comparison of fairness utility tradeoffs across baseline, single method, and multi level configurations. The framework was validated using synthetic clinical datasets designed to represent specific bias mechanisms and a real-world replication of two-year stroke risk prediction among patients with atrial fibrillation. Synthetic experiments showed that targeted fairness methods generally reduced intended subgroup disparities, while combined strategies produced larger average fairness improvements with modest utility tradeoffs. In the clinical prediction task, mitigation effects were highly variable, with some combinations improving both fairness and predictive performance while others were ineffective or counterproductive. These findings demonstrate that fairness interventions interact in nonadditive and context dependent ways. FairSelect provides a practical framework for systematically identifying fairness strategies that improve subgroup equity while preserving model performance in clinical machine learning.

AI.tldr: FairSelect是一个用于系统评估公平性缓解策略的工具包，支持预处理、处理中、后处理阶段的单独和组合应用，并在合成和临床数据集上验证，发现公平性干预效果具有非加性和上下文依赖性。
AI.motivation: 现有公平性方法通常孤立评估且仅考虑单人口统计学轴，缺乏对交叉子群和多阶段建模生命周期中公平性策略选择的实际指导。
AI.method: FairSelect工具包支持多种模型架构、交叉子群评估，比较基线、单一方法和多级配置下的公平性-效用权衡。通过合成临床数据集（模拟特定偏差机制）和真实世界的心房颤动患者两年卒中风险预测任务进行验证。
AI.result: 合成实验中，针对性公平性方法通常减少预期子群差异，组合策略带来更大的平均公平性改进且效用损失适度；临床预测任务中，缓解效果高度变化，有些组合同时改善公平性和预测性能，有的无效或适得其反。
AI.conclusion: 公平性干预以非加性和上下文依赖的方式相互作用，FairSelect提供了系统识别公平性策略的实用框架，可在保持模型性能的同时改善子群公平性。

title: Normalisation-Based Likelihood Ratio Estimation for Forensic Authorship Verification
summary: Authorship verification (AV) is the task of determining whether two texts were written by the same author. In a forensic context, the strength of AV evidence can be quantified using likelihood ratios. Most AV methods are score-based and deriving well-calibrated likelihood ratios from these scores requires a separate calibration model. This, in turn, requires additional amounts of case-relevant data, which is often time-consuming to obtain and prepare. This study proposes two novel normalisation techniques, the Square Root Correction and the Hapax Correction, for deriving likelihood ratios from the AV method LambdaG without the need of a calibration model (Nini et al. 2026). These corrections are designed to mitigate the overestimation of evidential strength that may result from long or highly repetitive texts. Performance is evaluated against logistic regression calibration across fifteen corpora and a range of text lengths (100-9,500 tokens), using the log-likelihood ratio cost (Cllr). The proposed methods achieve performance comparable to logistic regression calibration, with the Hapax Correction outperforming it in approximately 45% of tests (weighted by corpora). Furthermore, performance was more frequently close (within 5%) when the Hapax Correction was outperformed by logistic regression calibration, compared with the reverse comparison. Eliminating the need to train a calibration model reduces data-requirements, time and complexity, thereby increasing the accessibility and transparency of forensic text comparison. This combination of empirical performance and practical advantages supports the adoption of the proposed methods in forensic settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了两种无需校准模型即可从LambdaG方法中导出似然比的新归一化技术——平方根校正和罕用词校正，用于法医文本比较中的作者身份验证。实验表明，这些方法在性能上与逻辑回归校准相当，其中罕用词校正在大约45%的测试中表现更优，同时减少了数据需求、时间和复杂度。
AI.motivation: 在法医语境下，作者身份验证（AV）的证据强度需用似然比量化，但现有基于分数的AV方法需要额外的校准模型来导出校准良好的似然比，这通常需要大量案件相关数据，耗时且复杂。为了降低数据需求、提高法医文本比较的可及性和透明性，本研究探索了无需校准模型即可直接导出似然比的方法。
AI.method: 提出了两种归一化技术：平方根校正（Square Root Correction）和罕用词校正（Hapax Correction），用于从LambdaG方法（Nini et al. 2026）中导出似然比，无需单独的校准模型。这些校正旨在缓解因文本过长或高度重复导致的证据强度高估问题。在15个语料库和多种文本长度（100-9,500词）上，使用对数似然比成本（Cllr）指标，与逻辑回归校准进行性能对比评估。
AI.result: 所提方法实现了与逻辑回归校准相当的性能。罕用词校正在大约45%的测试（按语料库加权）中优于逻辑回归校准；当被逻辑回归校准超越时，罕用词校正的性能更频繁地接近（在5%以内）后者。平方根校正也表现出可比性能。
AI.conclusion: 消除校准模型训练需求可减少数据需求、时间和复杂度，从而提高法医文本比较的可及性和透明度。结合实证性能和实践优势，所提方法支持在法医场景中采用。这为作者身份验证提供了一种更高效、更易用的似然比推导途径。

title: Adaptive Latent Trajectory Anchoring for Action Segmentation Dataset Condensation
summary: Dataset condensation for action segmentation synthesizes compact, informative representations of long, untrimmed video datasets. The existing approach relies on Variational Autoencoders and an iterative latent optimization; it is computationally expensive and suffers from over-smoothed reconstructions and rigid temporal constraints. This paper proposes to shift the condensation paradigm from optimization-based inversion to deterministic latent mapping. By leveraging Denoising Diffusion Implicit Models, we represent action segments as continuous trajectories anchored by sparse latent points in the noise manifold. To maximize representational efficiency, we introduce an adaptive allocation mechanism that dynamically redistributes the anchoring budget based on segment-wise reconstruction difficulty. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in segmentation performance across common datasets. Notably, our approach achieves performance parity with real data training while maintaining a condensation ratio of 2.4\% on Breakfast dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于去噪扩散隐式模型（DDIM）的动作分割数据集压缩方法，通过确定性潜映射替代传统基于VAE的迭代优化，并引入自适应锚点分配机制，在Breakfast数据集上以2.4%的压缩比达到与真实数据训练相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于VAE和迭代潜优化的数据集压缩方法计算成本高，且存在重建过平滑和时序约束僵化的问题，亟需更高效、高质量的压缩范式。
AI.method: 将压缩从优化反演转变为确定性潜映射；利用DDIM将动作片段表示为连续轨迹，由噪声流形上的稀疏潜在点锚定；提出自适应分配机制，根据片段重建难度动态重新分配锚定预算。
AI.result: 在多个公共数据集上显著优于现有方法，在Breakfast数据集上以2.4%的压缩比达到与真实数据训练相同的性能。
AI.conclusion: 确定性潜映射结合扩散模型与自适应锚点分配，能高效、高质量地压缩长视频数据集，为动作分割提供了一种新的有效范式。

title: ProofCouncil: An LLM Agent for Solving Open Mathematical Problems
comment: 25 pages, 7 figures. ProofCouncil appears as System A (IMProofBench ProofCouncil) in the official FirstProof second-batch report (arXiv:2606.18119). Code and agent-building library: https://github.com/eth-sri/proof-council
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown increasing promise in solving open problems in mathematics. However, their performance can be further improved through agentic workflows tailored to real-world mathematical practice. To this end, we introduce ProofCouncil, a mathematical agent that is designed to tackle open problems using an author-critic architecture. ProofCouncil served as a submission to the second batch of FirstProof, a challenge consisting of 10 real-world mathematical problems that agents must solve autonomously. Its submissions for 6 of the 10 problems were judged by the referees to be correct up to at most minor revisions, showing the best performance among participating teams. We also evaluate ProofCouncil on 30 open problems collected from mathematical researchers. Among the 21 solutions that received human feedback, 5 were judged completely correct, 2 more were judged promising pending final verification, and a further 8 contained useful partial progress. In this short paper, we describe the development of ProofCouncil and the agent-building library used to create it, which we release as open source to the community.

AI.tldr: ProofCouncil 是一个基于作者-评论家架构的数学智能体，在第一轮 FirstProof 挑战中表现最佳（6/10 问题正确至多需微小修订），并在 30 个开放数学问题中取得 5 个完全正确、2 个有希望、8 个部分进展的结果。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在解决开放数学问题方面展现出潜力，但可通过更贴近真实数学实践的智能体工作流进一步提升性能。为此，作者设计了 ProofCouncil 来探索这一方向。
AI.method: 采用作者-评论家（author-critic）架构，构建一个数学智能体，使其能够自主处理开放问题。论文还描述了用于构建该智能体的开源库。
AI.result: 在 FirstProof 第二批挑战的 10 个问题中，6 个被评为最多需微小修订的正确解，性能优于所有参赛团队。在 30 个开放问题中，21 个获得人类反馈，其中 5 个完全正确，2 个有希望但需最终验证，8 个包含有用的部分进展。
AI.conclusion: ProofCouncil 展示了智能体工作流在提升 LLM 数学问题解决能力方面的有效性，其开源库可促进社区进一步研究。

title: Eluna: An Agentic LLM System for Automating Warehouse Operations with Reasoning and Task Execution
summary: Warehouse operations are governed by Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) that encode complex, multi-system decision logic, which must be executed reliably under strict time constraints, yet LLM agents lack mechanisms to enforce procedural compliance and degrade under the context overload full SOP specifications introduce. We present Eluna, a production-deployed agentic system for reliable SOP execution. Eluna is a graph-guided, multi-agent framework that encodes SOPs as directed acyclic graphs with progressive disclosure and delegates independent tasks to parallel sub-agents, each with persistent code execution and live data access. To meet production latency and accuracy needs, we use asymmetric episodic distillation where a strong teacher is improved through episodic error memories, then a smaller student is fine-tuned on the corrected trajectories with memory stripped, internalizing corrections without inference-time overhead. On a 13-task benchmark and two production applications, our fine-tuned models match or exceed their teacher, beat all larger off-the-shelf baselines, and reach 94% expert agreement on the ticket processing application.

AI.tldr: Eluna是一个已在生产中部署的图引导多智能体系统，通过将SOP编码为有向无环图并采用渐进式披露、并行子代理及非对称情节蒸馏等方法，实现了仓库操作中标准操作程序的可靠执行，在13任务基准和两个生产应用中达到或超越专家水平（最高94%专家一致性）。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体缺乏执行程序合规的机制，且在完整SOP规范引入时会因上下文过载而性能下降，无法满足仓库操作中复杂多系统决策逻辑的可靠执行需求。
AI.method: 1) 将SOP编码为有向无环图（DAG）并采用渐进式披露；2) 多智能体框架将独立任务委托给并行子代理，每个子代理拥有持久代码执行和实时数据访问能力；3) 非对称情节蒸馏：强教师模型通过情节错误记忆不断改进，然后小规模学生模型在剔除记忆的校正轨迹上进行微调，在无推理开销的情况下内化校正。
AI.result: 在13任务基准和两个生产应用中，微调模型匹配或超越教师模型，击败所有更大的现成基线模型，在工票处理应用中达到94%的专家一致性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的图引导多智能体框架结合非对称情节蒸馏方法能有效解决LLM在复杂SOP执行中的合规性和上下文过载问题，在实际生产环境中取得了优于大规模基线模型的性能。

title: FreyaTTS Technical Report
summary: We introduce Freya-TTS, a compact, tokenizer-free, Turkish-first text-to-speech model designed for highly reliable and efficient conversational synthesis. Freya-TTS is a 183.2M-parameter non-autoregressive conditional flow-matching Diffusion Transformer (DiT) that operates in the frozen continuous latent space of AudioVAE2 (16 kHz encode, 48 kHz decode), allowing the model to focus its capacity on text-to-latent mapping while inheriting high-quality 48 kHz reconstruction. We advance the framework along three key dimensions: (1) rule-free end-to-end modeling from a 92-symbol Turkish character vocabulary without a phonemizer, grapheme-to-phoneme frontend, or discrete speech tokenizer; (2) non-autoregressive parallel denoising, which predicts the entire latent sequence simultaneously over a predicted duration; and (3) a production-oriented two-stage post-training recipe consisting of single-speaker voice locking and short-utterance coverage, improving speaker consistency and robustness on short inputs. On the Freya-TR-Eval benchmark, Freya-TTS achieves a band-matched word error rate (WER) of 8.0% and character error rate (CER) of 3.0%, outperforming substantially larger open-source systems while using a fraction of their parameters. The model achieves a real-time factor of 0.11 on consumer GPUs and runs faster than real time on a laptop CPU, making it well suited for resource-constrained edge deployment. We release the model weights, training and inference code, and evaluation benchmark under the Apache-2.0 license.

AI.tldr: Freya-TTS 是一个 183.2M 参数、无 tokenizer、土耳其语优先的非自回归条件流匹配扩散变换器（DiT），在 AudioVAE2 的冻结连续潜空间中运行，通过端到端字符级建模、并行去噪和两阶段后训练，在极低资源消耗下实现了高保真、低延迟的语音合成。
AI.motivation: 现有 TTS 系统通常依赖 phonemizer、G2P 前端或离散语音 tokenizer，增加了流水线复杂性和误差传播；同时大规模模型在资源受限场景下部署困难。作者希望构建一个紧凑、无 tokenizer、无需规则前端的高质量 TTS 模型，优先支持土耳其语，并能在消费级 GPU 和 CPU 上实时运行。
AI.method: Freya-TTS 采用非自回归条件流匹配 DiT 架构，在 AudioVAE2 的连续潜空间（16 kHz 编码，48 kHz 解码）中操作，实现文本到潜变量的直接映射。关键方法包括：(1) 基于 92 字符土耳其语词汇表的无规则端到端建模，无需 phonemizer、G2P 或离散 tokenizer；(2) 非自回归并行去噪，在预测的时长上同时生成整个潜序列；(3) 两阶段后训练策略：单说话人语音锁定和短话语覆盖，提升说话人一致性和短输入鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在 Freya-TR-Eval 基准上，Freya-TTS 达到带匹配词错误率（WER）8.0% 和字符错误率（CER）3.0%，超越了参数规模大得多的开源系统。在消费级 GPU 上实时因子为 0.11，在笔记本电脑 CPU 上运行速度快于实时。
AI.conclusion: Freya-TTS 证明了紧凑的无 tokenizer 非自回归流匹配 DiT 在资源受限的语音合成中是有效的，尤其适合土耳其语等资源较少语言的高质量、低延迟部署。模型权重、代码和评测基准已以 Apache-2.0 许可开源。

title: REBASE: Reference-Background Subspace Elimination for Training-Free In-Context Segmentation
summary: Training-free in-context segmentation enables new object categories to be introduced at inference time from a single annotated reference image, eliminating the retraining and memory overhead of class-incremental learning. Recent approaches achieve this by combining vision foundation models for semantic correspondence with promptable segmentation networks like SAM. However, their performance is fundamentally limited by the quality of the cross-image similarity map; shared contextual backgrounds between the reference and query systematically elevate similarity in non-target regions, degrading prompt localization. We present REBASE, a training-free framework that explicitly suppresses these spurious contextual correspondences. Our method identifies the low-rank background feature subspace from the reference image and project the reference and query features onto its orthogonal complement in closed form, yielding cleaner semantic matching. We then generate positive point prompts using similarity-weighted farthest-point sampling, paired with a refined dense similarity prior. Without any training or parameter updates, our approach establishes a new state of the art among training-free methods on PACO-Part, FSS-1000, and cross-domain datasets such as ISIC2018, demonstrating that explicit background subspace removal is a highly effective principle for one-shot localization.

AI.tldr: REBASE是一种无需训练的框架，通过显式抑制参考图像与查询图像之间的背景伪对应关系，提升基于基础模型的上下文分割性能。它通过低秩背景特征子空间识别与正交投影实现更干净的语义匹配，并结合相似性加权最远点采样生成提示点，在无需任何训练或参数更新的情况下，在多个数据集上达到训练无关方法的最新最优水平。
AI.motivation: 现有训练无关的上下文分割方法受限于跨图像相似度图的质量——参考图像与查询图像之间共享的上下文背景会系统性地提高非目标区域的相似度，从而干扰提示定位。作者旨在解决这一背景伪对应问题，实现更精确的单样本定位。
AI.method: REBASE首先从参考图像中识别低秩背景特征子空间，然后通过闭式解将参考和查询特征投影到该子空间的正交补上，消除背景相关性；接着利用相似性加权最远点采样生成正点提示，并结合精细化的稠密相似度先验来生成分割掩码。
AI.result: 无需任何训练或参数更新，REBASE在PACO-Part、FSS-1000以及跨域数据集ISIC2018上均取得了训练无关方法中的最佳性能，显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式移除背景特征子空间是一种高效的单样本定位原理，能够有效抑制上下文伪对应，显著提升分割精度。

title: Ceci n'est pas une pipe: AI systems as semantic abstractions
summary: An AI system's output is not the fact or world state it appears to describe, but rather an engineered representation. We propose a semantic framework to describe AI systems, to be able to examine the correctness of such representations. To do so, we distinguish what is justified by accepted domain knowledge, what reference sources say, and what the system can currently use. This allows us to give precise definitions to common failures: extrapolation, refuted or unsupported assertion, sources versus knowledge mismatch, stale or refuted source, added hypotheses, unsupported use... We hope our framework gives a useful vocabulary for specifying and checking AI systems whose outputs, citations, tool calls, and world-changing actions must be justified by reliable claims and explicit authority rather than apparent fluency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个语义框架，用于描述AI系统的输出（工程化表征）而非事实本身，通过区分领域知识、参考来源和系统当前可用信息，精确定义外推、被反驳或无依据断言、来源与知识不匹配、过时或被反驳来源、新增假设、无依据使用等常见失败模式，为验证AI系统输出、引用、工具调用和世界变更行为提供可靠依据的词汇。
AI.motivation: AI系统的输出看似描述事实或世界状态，实则是一种工程化表征，需要一种语义框架来检验这类表征的正确性，以区分什么是基于公认领域知识、参考来源和系统当前可用信息，从而准确界定各种失败情形。
AI.method: 通过区分三类正当性依据（公认领域知识、参考来源、系统当前可用信息），给出外推、被反驳/无依据断言、来源与知识不匹配、过时/被反驳来源、新增假设、无依据使用等失败模式的精确定义，构建一个用于说明和检验AI系统的语义框架。
AI.result: 提出了一个能够精确定义AI系统输出中常见失败模式的语义框架，为要求输出、引用、工具调用和世界变更行为必须基于可靠声明和明确权威（而非表面流畅性）的系统提供有用的词汇。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有助于为AI系统的正确性检验提供一套精确的术语，确保系统的输出、引用、工具调用和行为变更都建立在可验证的可靠依据之上，而非仅仅依赖表面流畅性。

title: NL-PAC: Specification Ambiguity and Certified Minimax Risk Floors in LLM-Mediated Supervision
summary: Large language models increasingly provide labels, evaluations, and feedback for tasks specified in natural language. When a specification admits multiple readings but the supervision channel does not reveal which is operative, additional labels reduce sampling error without resolving the resulting identification problem. We introduce Natural Language PAC (NL-PAC), a framework that uses a fixed model's thresholded decoding law to define admissible labels and candidate targets. The probability that multiple labels are admissible equals the diameter of the pointwise-admissible target class, and under target-blind supervision every learner incurs worst-case risk of at least half this diameter, at every sample size; the exact randomized minimax risk over this class is attained by a data-independent strategy. Finite-sample confidence bounds make these quantities certifiable from held-out unlabeled inputs. In a frozen Qwen~2.5--3B audit, one prespecified prompt yields a positive model-relative certificate, whereas a paraphrase and exact-rule controls yield zero. A held-out bridge audit finds that supplied candidate reading clauses fail the admissibility condition needed to transfer the certificate to coherent readings. The guarantee is specific to the audited model, prompt, threshold, and input distribution; extending it to human interpretations requires external validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Natural Language PAC (NL-PAC)框架，用于分析当自然语言规范存在多重解读时，仅靠增加标注无法解决识别问题的现象。该框架通过固定模型的阈值化解码律定义可接受标签与候选目标，证明在目标盲监督下任何学习器的最小最大风险至少为点态可接受目标类直径的一半，且该风险可通过数据无关策略达到。在冻结的Qwen 2.5-3B模型审计中，预设提示获得正向模型相对证书，而释义与精确规则控制获得零证书；桥接审计发现候选解读子句不满足证书转移的可接受性条件。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型越来越多地被用于对自然语言描述的任务提供标签、评估和反馈。当规范存在多种解读方式，但监督渠道无法揭示哪种解读有效时，额外标注虽能降低抽样误差，却无法解决由多重解读导致的识别问题。现有方法对此缺乏系统性框架，因此需要一种能形式化刻画并量化该识别问题的方法。
AI.method: 提出NL-PAC框架，利用固定模型的阈值化解码律来定义可接受标签和候选目标；定义点态可接受目标类的直径，并证明在目标盲监督下，任何样本量下学习器的风险至少为该直径的一半；推导出有限样本置信界使这些量可从保留的无标签输入中认证；并在Qwen 2.5-3B模型上进行了预设提示、释义与精确规则控制、桥接审计等实验验证。
AI.result: 理论上证明了目标盲监督下最小最大风险的下界与点态可接受类直径的关系，并给出了可达的随机化最小最大策略。实验上，预设提示获得正向模型相对证书，释义与精确规则控制获得零证书；桥接审计发现候选解读子句不满足可接受性条件，无法将证书迁移至连贯解读。
AI.conclusion: NL-PAC框架提供了量化自然语言规范多重解读下识别问题的理论工具。其保证仅限于被审计的模型、提示、阈值和输入分布，扩展到人类解释需要外部验证。该工作揭示了当前LLM评估中因规范歧义导致的核心识别问题，并给出了可认证的风险界。

title: Conceptual Networks for Cross-Linguistic Idiomatic Expressions:A Feature-Based Graph Approach
summary: We present an interpretable network-based framework for representing idiomatic and figurative meaning across eight typologically diverse languages, totaling 160 conventional expressions, the large majority of which are idiomatic. Each expression is annotated with binary conceptual features (containment, concealment, emotional, social, etc.) derived from cognitive-linguistic theory, and pairwise Jaccard similarities define a weighted graph. Community detection reveals that idioms cluster by conceptual schema rather than by language, producing a structure consistent with cognitive-linguistic predictions. The conceptual network captures unique semantic information not present in distributional embeddings, can be scaled via automatic annotation with LLMs, improves downstream idiom detection, and remains robust when enriched with corpus frequencies. Cross-lingual transfer experiments show that conceptual proximity alone can identify acceptable translation equivalents across five language families, with substantial gains over embedding-based baselines. Ablation studies demonstrate that all three feature dimensions -- schemas, roles, and valence -- contribute non-redundantly to both the network's organizational properties and its performance on idiom detection, and that specific graph-derived signals (community membership, neighbor similarity) are particularly informative. The framework offers an interpretable, cross-linguistically stable representation of idiomatic meaning, combining theoretical grounding with practical utility.

AI.tldr: 提出一个可解释的基于网络的框架，用二元概念特征（如包含、隐藏、情感、社会等）对八种语言的160个惯用表达进行标注，通过Jaccard相似性构建加权图。社区检测显示习语按概念图式而非语言聚类；该网络捕获了分布式嵌入中不存在的独特语义信息，可通过LLM自动扩展，提升下游习语检测性能，并在跨语言迁移中优于基于嵌入的基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有习语表示方法（如分布式嵌入）缺乏可解释性，难以捕捉跨语言的习语概念结构。作者希望结合认知语言学理论，构建一个既具有理论依据又具备实用价值的跨语言稳定、可解释的习语语义表示框架。
AI.method: 从认知语言学理论中提取二元概念特征（图式、角色、效价三个维度），对八种语言的160个惯用表达进行人工标注；基于Jaccard相似性构建加权图，进行社区检测分析；利用LLM实现特征自动标注以扩展规模；通过图信号（社区成员关系、邻居相似性）改进下游习语检测任务；进行跨语言迁移实验验证概念相似性对翻译等价物识别的有效性。
AI.result: 习语按概念图式而非语言聚类，与认知语言学预测一致；概念网络捕获了分布式嵌入中缺失的独特语义信息；利用LLM自动标注可扩展网络；图信号能有效提升习语检测性能；跨语言实验中，概念邻近性在五种语系中显著优于基于嵌入的基线；消融实验证明三个特征维度（图式、角色、效价）均贡献非冗余信息。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了可解释、跨语言稳定的习语意义表示，兼具理论扎实性和实际可用性。概念网络可作为分布式嵌入的补充，在跨语言习语理解与翻译等任务中具有重要应用价值。

title: Subtoken Vision Transformer for Fine-grained Recognition
summary: We present Subtoken Vision Transformer (SubViT), a selective image tokenization method for fine-grained visual recognition. Standard Vision Transformers compress each fixed-size patch into a single token, although fine-grained distinctions often depend on localized variations within only a few patches. SubViT addresses this mismatch by representing discriminative patches with multiple subtokens while retaining the original token sequence for global context, thereby allocating additional capacity where it is most needed. Since attention heads encode complementary semantics and extracting attention maps at inference requires an extra backbone forward, we adopt a two-stage training strategy. Stage 1 fine-tunes the ViT using subdivision regions sampled from random attention heads, exposing the model to diverse subdivision patterns. Stage 2 identifies informative attention maps through feature-degradation distances and distills them into a lightweight single-map router, which directly predicts deterministic token-importance scores without a separate attention forward. We evaluate SubViT on Generalized Category Discovery (GCD), a challenging task requiring both fine-grained discrimination and generalization to unlabeled novel categories. Across CUB, FGVC-Aircraft, and Stanford Cars, SubViT improves the average novel-category accuracy of DINOv2 from $81.3\%$ to $84.7\%$, with only $0.50$ ms additional latency and $3.4\%$ more FLOPs, while reducing latency by $73.8\%$ relative to Retina Patch. Results on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet-100 demonstrate its broader applicability.

AI.tldr: SubViT 是一种针对细粒度视觉识别的选择性图像标记化方法，通过为判别性区域分配多个子标记（subtoken）来增加模型容量，同时保留原始标记序列以保持全局上下文。采用两阶段训练策略：第一阶段使用随机注意力头的细分区域微调 ViT，第二阶段通过特征退化距离识别信息丰富的注意力图并蒸馏为轻量级单图路由器，从而无需额外注意力前向传播即可预测标记重要性分数。在 Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) 任务上，SubViT 将 DINOv2 的平均新类别准确率从 81.3% 提升至 84.7%，仅增加 0.50 ms 延迟和 3.4% FLOPs，相比 Retina Patch 延迟降低 73.8%。在 CIFAR-10 和 ImageNet-100 上也展示了广泛适用性。
AI.motivation: 标准 Vision Transformer (ViT) 将每个固定大小的图像块压缩为单个标记，但细粒度视觉识别中的关键差异往往仅集中在少数几个图像块的局部变化上。这种固定粒度的标记化方式无法为判别性区域分配更多计算资源，导致模型在细粒度区分上能力不足。SubViT 旨在解决这一不匹配问题，通过选择性标记化来提升细粒度识别性能。
AI.method: SubViT 采用两阶段训练策略。第一阶段：从随机注意力头中采样细分区域（subdivision regions）用于微调 ViT，使模型暴露于多样的细分模式。第二阶段：通过特征退化距离（feature-degradation distances）识别信息量最丰富的注意力图，并将其蒸馏为一个轻量级单图路由器（single-map router），该路由器可直接预测确定性的标记重要性分数，无需单独的注意力前向传播。在推理时，仅需对判别性区域使用多个子标记（subtoken）进行表示，而保留原始标记序列以保证全局上下文。
AI.result: 在 Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) 任务上，SubViT 将 DINOv2 在 CUB、FGVC-Aircraft 和 Stanford Cars 数据集上的平均新类别准确率从 81.3% 提升至 84.7%，仅增加 0.50 ms 额外延迟和 3.4% 的 FLOPs，相比 Retina Patch 方法延迟降低 73.8%。在 CIFAR-10 和 ImageNet-100 上的实验结果也证明了其广泛适用性。
AI.conclusion: SubViT 通过为判别性区域分配多个子标记，有效地提升了细粒度视觉识别的性能，同时保持了极低的计算开销。该方法在多个数据集上取得了显著的准确率提升，且推理效率高，展示了在实际应用中的潜力。

title: Multimodal Reward Hacking in Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly used to align multimodal large language models (MLLMs), but higher rewards do not always imply better task performance. This risk is amplified when visual evidence is evaluated by text-only or weakly grounded rewards. We study reward hacking in MLLM RL across safety VQA, chart VQA, and stress-test settings, varying reward design, data ambiguity, model scale (2B-32B), and RL algorithm (GRPO, RLOO, DAPO). We introduce Newly Rewarded Failure Rate (NRFR), which measures failures among samples whose proxy reward improves over the SFT baseline. Outcome-only rewards cause severe hacking, reaching 48.1% Reward Hacking Rate (RHR), while NRFR exceeding RHR shows that RL creates new failures rather than merely inheriting them. Scaling reduces but does not eliminate hacking: even the 32B model retains a 54.9% worse rate under outcome-only rewards, whereas answer-aware rewards improve the oracle trend at every scale. Robustness is also algorithm- and scale-dependent: GRPO is consistently most resistant, RLOO remains vulnerable, and DAPO improves substantially from 2B to 8B. Visual-evidence rewards help only with reliable verification: keyword-based checks increase hacking, while VLM-as-judge semantic verification reduces it. Overall, multimodal reward hacking is a systematic result of optimizing imperfect rewards, and robust alignment requires rewards and verifiers that remain reliable under optimization pressure.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多模态大语言模型在强化学习对齐中的奖励破解问题，发现仅依靠结果奖励会导致严重破解（RHR达48.1%），而扩展模型规模、使用答案感知奖励、选择稳健算法（GRPO优于RLOO和DAPO）以及可靠的视觉验证（VLM-as-judge）可缓解但无法完全消除破解。新提出的NRFR指标揭示了RL创造了新失败而非仅继承已有问题。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在强化学习对齐中，更高的奖励并不总是意味着更好的任务表现，尤其是在视觉证据仅由文本奖励或弱监督奖励评估时，奖励破解风险被放大。现有研究对此系统性认识不足。
AI.method: 在安全VQA、图表VQA和压力测试三种场景下，系统变化奖励设计、数据模糊性、模型规模（2B-32B）和RL算法（GRPO、RLOO、DAPO），并提出新指标Newly Rewarded Failure Rate (NRFR)来衡量RL新创造的失败。
AI.result: 结果奖励导致严重破解，RHR达48.1%，NRFR高于RHR说明RL创造新失败；模型规模扩展可缓解但无法消除破解，32B模型在结果奖励下仍有54.9%更差率；GRPO最稳健，RLOO最脆弱，DAPO从2B到8B显著提升；视觉奖励仅在可靠验证下有效，关键词检查反而增加破解，VLM-as-judge语义验证可降低破解。
AI.conclusion: 多模态奖励破解是优化不完美奖励的系统性结果，稳健对齐需要奖励和验证器在优化压力下仍保持可靠。

title: Stochastic Linear Bandits with Partially Observed Actions
summary: The stochastic linear bandit, where actions are represented as vectors and rewards are linear, is a central paradigm for sequential decision making. We study a partially observed variant of this problem in which the learning agent only sees a random subset of coordinates for each action. Such partial observability arises naturally in settings like recommendation and healthcare, where full action descriptions can be expensive or even impossible to obtain. In general, this makes sublinear regret information-theoretically impossible. However, we show that this barrier can be overcome when the action vectors have low intrinsic dimension. We propose an algorithm, TOFU-POV, that estimates the latent action subspace using the masked actions, imputes current actions using an epoch-wise frozen representation, and runs OFUL in the resulting low-dimensional coordinates. Our theory shows that TOFU-POV enjoys a $\sqrt{T}$ regret that scales with the intrinsic action subspace dimension as opposed to the ambient dimension and quantifies the interaction between these quantities and the missingness, decision set size, and subspace conditioning. We also devise a rank-adaptive algorithm that does not require the knowledge of the intrinsic dimension. We complement these guarantees with a lower bound based on a novel product construction that separates usual reward-learning uncertainty from a missingness-dependent cost intrinsic to partial observation. Synthetic and real data experiments support our theory and show that TOFU-POV can substantially improve upon natural baselines in this challenging problem.

AI.tldr: 本文研究部分观测的随机线性bandit问题，其中agent只能看到每个动作向量的随机坐标子集。当动作向量具有低内在维度时，提出TOFU-POV算法，通过估计潜在动作子空间、使用epoch冻结表示进行插补，并在低维坐标上运行OFUL，实现了与内在维度而非环境维度成比例的√T遗憾界，并设计了无需知道内在维度的秩自适应版本。理论下界揭示了一种新的缺失依赖成本。
AI.motivation: 在实际应用（如推荐系统和医疗）中，获取完整动作描述可能成本高昂甚至不可行，agent只能观察到动作向量的随机坐标子集。这种部分可观测性在一般情况下使得次线性遗憾信息理论上不可能，但现有研究未充分探索当动作向量具有低内在维度时是否可克服这一障碍。
AI.method: 提出TOFU-POV算法：(1) 使用掩码动作估计潜在动作子空间；(2) 利用epoch冻结的表示对当前动作进行插补；(3) 在得到的低维坐标上运行OFUL算法。此外设计了秩自适应版本，无需预先知道内在维度。
AI.result: 理论证明了TOFU-POV实现√T遗憾界，该界与内在动作子空间维度而非环境维度成比例；量化了内在维度、缺失率、决策集大小和子空间条件之间的交互。提供了基于乘积构造的信息理论下界，将奖励学习不确定性从缺失依赖成本中分离出来。合成和真实数据实验验证了理论，表明TOFU-POV显著优于自然基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 低内在维度的动作结构可以有效克服部分观测线性bandit的信息理论障碍，TOFU-POV算法在理论和实践中均能利用这种结构实现高效学习；缺失依赖成本是部分观测问题中固有的额外代价。

title: Tokenizer Transplantation: Mitigating Autoregressive Collapse in Edge-Efficient Bengali ASR
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures. Accepted as a poster at the MusIML Workshop, ICML 2026
summary: Lightweight speech recognition models are critical for edge deployment, yet highly optimized architectures like Moonshine often fail on morphologically rich, non-Latin languages such as Bengali. This study identifies the root cause of this failure as the model's English-centric byte-level tokenizer, which fragments Bengali words into high-fertility byte chains and triggers catastrophic autoregressive collapse during inference. To resolve this, a novel vocabulary transplantation pipeline is proposed to replace the decoder vocabulary with the native-script BanglaBERT WordPiece vocabulary and resize the corresponding token embedding matrix. Experimental results demonstrate a reduction in token fertility from 9.16 to 1.30. By decreasing autoregressive sequence length by 85.8%, decoding instability is entirely mitigated. When evaluated on the 882-hour Lipi-Ghor dataset, the modified architecture achieves a competitive 21.54% Word Error Rate (WER) and a Real-Time Factor (RTF) of 0.0053. Ultimately, this research provides a scalable, reproducible blueprint for cross-script adaptation of compact ASR models without the need for resource-intensive pre-training.

AI.tldr: 本文针对轻量级语音识别模型（如 Moonshine）在孟加拉语等形态丰富、非拉丁语言上表现失败的问题，发现根源在于以英语为中心的字节级分词器导致高生育率字节链和自回归崩溃。提出一种词汇移植 pipeline，将解码器词汇替换为原生孟加拉语 BanglaBERT WordPiece 词汇并调整嵌入矩阵。实验表明，词元生育率从 9.16 降至 1.30，自回归序列长度减少 85.8%，解码不稳定被完全消除；在 882 小时 Lipi-Ghor 数据集上达到 21.54% 的词错误率和 0.0053 的实时因子。该研究为紧凑型 ASR 模型的跨脚本适应提供了可扩展、可复现的蓝图，无需资源密集的预训练。
AI.motivation: 轻量级 ASR 模型在边缘部署中至关重要，但高度优化的架构（如 Moonshine）在形态丰富的非拉丁语言（如孟加拉语）上经常失败。作者将失败根因归咎于模型以英语为中心的字节级分词器，该分词器将孟加拉词碎片化为高生育率的字节链，并在推理时触发灾难性自回归崩溃。
AI.method: 提出一种新颖的词汇移植 pipeline，将解码器词汇表替换为原生孟加拉语 BanglaBERT WordPiece 词汇，并相应调整词嵌入矩阵的大小。通过替换分词器，减少词元生育率和自回归序列长度，从而缓解解码不稳定性。
AI.result: 词元生育率从 9.16 降至 1.30，自回归序列长度减少 85.8%，解码不稳定性被完全消除。在 882 小时 Lipi-Ghor 数据集上，修改后的架构达到 21.54% 的词错误率 (WER) 和 0.0053 的实时因子 (RTF)。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为紧凑型 ASR 模型的跨脚本适应提供了一个可扩展、可复现的蓝图，无需资源密集的预训练即可实现有效的跨语言迁移。

title: DETRAM: End-to-end DEtection, Tracking and Recovery of HumAn Meshes
summary: In the task of human mesh recovery (HMR), multi-person scenes are particularly difficult to handle due to the many entities that appear and occlusions between them over time. In particular for video inputs, there is a need to track each entity reliably and consistently. Existing methods rely on pretrained human detection modules, increasing their runtime and limiting the number of tracked entities. We present DETRAM, a unified framework for multi-person HMR and tracking that simultaneously detects, reconstructs, and tracks humans across time, both automatically and via user prompts. DETRAM uses a single transformer decoder with an identity-consistent set of learnable query embeddings that persist across frames: detection queries discover new people, tracking queries maintain pose and shape for existing individuals, and prompt queries follow user-specified identities. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art tracking results on PoseTrack21, 3DPW, BEDLAM, and MuPoTS-3D, and competitive reconstruction accuracy on BEDLAM and 3DPW, while uniquely supporting prompt-based tracking of individuals in multi-person scenes. To our knowledge, this is the first method to unify promptability and multi-person HMR with tracking in an end-to-end trainable framework, enabling user-directed human analysis in videos.

AI.tldr: DETRAM 是一个统一的端到端框架，用于多人人体网格恢复和跟踪，利用单一 Transformer 解码器及三类持久化查询嵌入（检测、跟踪、提示）同时检测、重建和跟踪多个人物，支持自动跟踪和基于用户提示的跟踪。
AI.motivation: 多人场景中人体网格恢复困难，存在大量实体和时空遮挡；现有方法依赖预训练的人体检测模块，增加了运行时开销并限制了可跟踪实体数量。
AI.method: 提出 DETRAM，使用单一 Transformer 解码器，包含三类跨帧持久化的可学习查询嵌入：检测查询用于发现新人物，跟踪查询保持已有人的姿态和形状，提示查询跟随用户指定的身份。通过一次前向传播同时完成检测、重建和跟踪。
AI.result: 在 PoseTrack21、3DPW、BEDLAM 和 MuPoTS-3D 上达到跟踪 SOTA；在 BEDLAM 和 3DPW 上重建精度具有竞争力；是首个统一提示能力与多人 HMR 及跟踪的端到端可训练框架。
AI.conclusion: DETRAM 首次实现了端到端可训练的统一框架，同时支持自动和用户提示驱动的多人人体网格恢复与跟踪，为视频中的人体分析提供了新的灵活性。

title: Shared Selective Persistent Memory for Agentic LLM Systems
summary: Agentic LLM systems that generate code through multi-turn tool use face a fundamental context problem: each session starts from zero, discarding the configuration choices, domain constraints, data schemas, and tool-use patterns that made previous sessions productive. Naively persisting entire conversation histories is token-inefficient and counterproductive: irrelevant context degrades generation quality. We introduce shared selective persistent memory, an architecture that identifies and retains four categories of reusable context (task specifications, data schemas, tool configurations, and output constraints) while discarding session-specific reasoning traces. Crucially, this memory is shared: workspaces encapsulating selective memory can be transferred across users with role-based access control, enabling collaborative reuse without redundant specification. We implement it in a deployed collaborative workspace platform where LLM agents produce, edit, and maintain git-versioned artifacts (dashboards, reports, and data-driven documents) from heterogeneous sources (CSV, SQL, REST APIs, and MCP servers). A complementary zero-token data refresh mechanism decouples generated programs from runtime data, enabling artifact reuse without re-invocation. Across three enterprise scenarios, shared selective persistent memory achieves 96% task completion (vs. 79% without memory and 71% with full history). Zero-token refresh eliminates LLM re-invocation for recurring updates (14x task-time reduction), while summary-driven generation cuts per-invocation token cost by 97x versus raw data injection. A replication on four public datasets confirms generalizability, with zero-token refresh succeeding in 12/12 trials. Notably, naive full-history persistence actively degrades completion by biasing the agent with stale traces, while selective memory outperforms both extremes.

AI.tldr: 提出共享选择性持久记忆架构，通过保留四类可复用上下文（任务规范、数据模式、工具配置、输出约束）并丢弃会话特定推理痕迹，解决多轮工具调用的LLM代理系统的上下文缺失问题。该架构支持跨用户共享，并配合零令牌数据刷新机制，实现高效协作和工件复用。在企业场景中任务完成率达96%，令牌成本降低97倍。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM代理系统在多轮工具调用中面临上下文问题：每次会话从零开始，丢弃之前有效的配置、领域约束、数据模式和工具使用模式。简单持久化整个对话历史既低效又会产生反作用，因为无关上下文会降低生成质量。
AI.method: 提出共享选择性持久记忆架构，识别并保留四类可复用上下文（任务规范、数据模式、工具配置、输出约束），丢弃会话特定的推理痕迹。记忆通过工作空间封装，可跨用户传输并支持基于角色的访问控制。实现为部署的协作工作空间平台，LLM代理从异构数据源（CSV、SQL、REST API、MCP服务器）生成、编辑和维护git版本化的工件（仪表板、报告、数据驱动文档）。配套的零令牌数据刷新机制将生成的程序与运行时数据解耦，实现无需重新调用LLM的工件复用。
AI.result: 在三个企业场景中，共享选择性持久记忆达到96%任务完成率（无记忆79%，全历史71%）。零令牌刷新消除了循环更新的LLM重新调用（任务时间减少14倍），摘要驱动生成将每次调用的令牌成本比原始数据注入降低97倍。在四个公开数据集上的复制实验证实了泛化性，零令牌刷新在12/12次试验中成功。
AI.conclusion: 朴素的全历史持久化会因过时痕迹导致代理偏差而主动降低完成率，选择性记忆优于两种极端方案。共享选择性持久记忆通过保留关键上下文并丢弃无关痕迹，显著提升LLM代理的效率和效果。

title: Federated Low-Rank Koopman Learning for Multivariate Time-Series Anomaly Detection in IoT Systems
summary: Distributed IoT systems generate multivariate time-series streams for monitoring physical assets, servers, and embedded sensing platforms. Detecting abnormal temporal behavior is critical for fault diagnosis, predictive maintenance, and security. However, practical IoT anomaly detection is hindered by decentralized and non-IID data, limited bandwidth, and the constrained computation and memory of edge devices. This paper proposes FedKAD, a resource-efficient federated Koopman anomaly detection framework for distributed IoT multivariate time series. Unlike deep-learning-based anomaly detectors that require training and communicating large neural models, FedKAD learns normal temporal dynamics through lightweight sliding-window Koopman representations. Federated training is formulated as a low-rank consensus problem, where raw sensor streams and local reduced dynamics remain on device while only compact subspace variables are exchanged with the server. To optimize the shared representation under orthonormality constraints, we develop a federated Stiefel-ADMM algorithm and provide convergence and stationarity analysis under partial client participation. During inference, each client detects anomalies locally by measuring the prediction residual between observed future trajectories and the learned Koopman dynamics. Experiments on four widely used multivariate time-series anomaly detection benchmarks show that FedKAD maintains or improves detection performance compared with federated deep-learning baselines. More importantly for IoT deployment, FedKAD provides up to $2.1\times10^3$ faster training, $80\times$ lower communication, and $79\times$ lower inference latency than neural baselines, confirming its suitability for resource-constrained edge devices.

AI.tldr: 提出 FedKAD，一种面向分布式物联网多变量时间序列的轻量级联邦Koopman异常检测框架，通过滑动窗口Koopman表示学习正常时序动力学，利用联邦Stiefel-ADMM算法优化共享表示，在保持检测性能的同时大幅降低训练、通信和推理开销，适合资源受限的边缘设备。
AI.motivation: 分布式物联网系统生成的多变量时间序列流需要进行异常检测，但由于数据分散且非独立同分布、带宽有限、边缘设备计算和存储资源受限，传统深度学习方法难以部署。因此需要一种资源高效的联邦异常检测方法。
AI.method: FedKAD 采用轻量级滑动窗口Koopman表示学习正常时序动力学，将联邦训练建模为低秩共识问题，原始数据与局部约简动力学保留在本地，仅交换紧凑子空间变量；提出联邦 Stiefel-ADMM 算法优化带正交性约束的共享表示，并提供了部分客户端参与下的收敛性与稳定性分析；推理时通过预测残差进行本地异常检测。
AI.result: 在四个多变量时间序列异常检测基准上，FedKAD 在检测性能上与联邦深度学习方法持平或更优；在 IoT 部署方面，训练速度提升高达 2100 倍，通信量降低 80 倍，推理延迟降低 79 倍。
AI.conclusion: FedKAD 是一种资源高效的联邦 Koopman 异常检测框架，适合资源受限的边缘设备，在保持检测性能的同时显著降低了训练、通信和推理开销。

title: Toward Real-Time Sentence-Level Sign Language Translation
summary: Most sign language understanding systems operate at the level of isolated signs, limiting their usefulness in natural communication. We study sentence-level sign language translation (SLT) with the primary goal of real-time deployment rather than proposing a new translation architecture. We fine-tune a SHuBERT-ByT5 translation stack on a uniformly sampled 9,872-example subset of How2Sign, selected because of compute and storage constraints, using QLoRA while keeping SHuBERT frozen. The model obtains a validation BLEU of 16.7 and, on the test split, BLEU 15.9 and BLEURT 44.7. The main contribution is a hardware-aware streaming system: a Raspberry Pi 4B reference client provides camera capture, local text display, and speech output, while compute-intensive perception and translation run on a CPU/GPU backend. The capture protocol remains client-agnostic, so the same backend can serve a browser, phone, or laptop. Chunked ingestion, bounded queues, parallelized perception, temporal reordering, and a sentence-boundary state machine reduce mean post-finalization response latency from 1.873 to 1.354 seconds (27.71%) and P95 latency from 2.919 to 2.130 seconds (27.03%) over the complete 9,872-example working subset.

AI.tldr: 本文研究句子级手语翻译（SLT），目标是实现实时部署。通过QLoRA微调SHuBERT-ByT5翻译栈（在How2Sign子集上），并设计了一套硬件感知的流式系统（Raspberry Pi 4B客户端+CPU/GPU后端），将平均响应延迟降低27.71%，P95延迟降低27.03%。
AI.motivation: 大多数手语理解系统仅处理孤立手势，限制了自然交流中的实用性。本文旨在实现句子级手语翻译的实时部署，而非提出新的翻译架构。
AI.method: 在均匀采样的9,872样本How2Sign子集上，使用QLoRA微调SHuBERT-ByT5翻译栈（冻结SHuBERT）。设计硬件感知流式系统：Raspberry Pi 4B作为参考客户端负责摄像头采集、本地文本显示和语音输出；CPU/GPU后端负责感知和翻译。采用分块摄入、有界队列、并行感知、时序重排序和句子边界状态机等技术优化延迟。
AI.result: 验证集BLEU 16.7，测试集BLEU 15.9、BLEURT 44.7。优化后平均响应延迟从1.873秒降至1.354秒（降幅27.71%），P95延迟从2.919秒降至2.130秒（降幅27.03%）。
AI.conclusion: 该系统实现了句子级手语翻译的实时部署，通过流式架构和延迟优化显著提升了响应速度，且客户端无关的设计使后端可服务于多种设备。

title: Beyond Time Shifts: Adapting Omni-LLM as a Reference-Free Evaluator for Generative Audio-Visual Models
summary: As audio-visual generative models evolve into world simulators, cross-modal synchronization stands as a critical proxy for assessing the consistency of world dynamics and causality in generated content. However, existing evaluation metrics presume structural correctness, reducing synchronization to mere temporal alignment. Consequently, they fail on generative outputs, especially when exhibiting structural hallucinations and asymmetric cross-modal relations, which currently \textbf{mandate expert human annotation to assess synchronization.} This dependency introduces a critical paradox: \emph{human evaluators rely on relative, reference-dependent comparisons, whereas automated metrics require reference-free, absolute scalars.} We resolve this paradox by proposing a framework that distills relative human perception into a continuous, globally consistent metric. First, we introduce SynthSync, a dataset of generative failures ranked via pairwise human annotations. Second, we adapt the Omni-LLM equipped with a continuous latent projection to translate relative human rankings into continuous absolute values. Third, we propose Real-Valued Group Relative Policy Optimization ($\mathbb{R}$-GRPO) to internalize the global causal structure of synchronization via listwise score distributions. Empirically, our metric achieves state-of-the-art human preference alignment. We leverage this estimator to establish a standardized benchmark, advancing AV-Gen assessment from low-level signal correlation to visually grounded causality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将人类相对感知转化为连续绝对度量的框架，用于评估音视频生成模型中的跨模态同步性，解决了现有指标因结构性幻觉和非对称跨模态关系而失效的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有音视频同步评估指标假设输出结构正确，仅关注时间对齐，无法处理生成模型中常见的结构性幻觉和非对称跨模态关系，导致必须依赖人工专家评估，但人类评估是相对比较，而自动化指标需要绝对标量，两者存在根本矛盾。
AI.method: 1) 构建SynthSync数据集，包含成对人工排序的生成失败样本；2) 采用带连续潜在投影的Omni-LLM，将相对人类排序转化为连续绝对值；3) 提出实值组相对策略优化(R-GRPO)，通过列表级得分分布内化同步的全局因果结构。
AI.result: 该指标在人类偏好对齐上达到最优性能，并建立了标准化基准，将音视频生成评估从低级信号相关性推进到视觉接地因果关系。
AI.conclusion: 通过将人类相对感知蒸馏为连续全局一致的度量，解决了评估悖论，为生成模型中的跨模态同步提供了可靠的自动化评估方案。

title: SAGEAgent: A Self-Evolving Agent for Cost-Aware Modality Acquisition in Multimodal Survival Prediction
summary: Does every cancer patient truly need a complete diagnostic workup for accurate survival prediction? In multimodal clinical oncology, diagnostic modalities follow a clinically mandated order of escalating burden -- from demographics collected at intake to genomic profiling requiring specialized tissue analysis. Current multimodal survival methods either assume all modalities are available or passively handle missing data, but none actively reason about whether acquiring the next modality is justified for a given patient along this ordered workflow. We formulate this as a sequential decision problem and propose SAGEAgent (Sequential Acquisition Guided by Experience), a self-evolving LLM-based clinical agent that decides which diagnostic modalities to acquire for each patient, balancing predictive accuracy against clinical invasiveness. SAGEAgent reasons about each patient's evolving diagnostic state through clinical tools that translate numerical predictions into text, an episodic memory that retrieves similar past cases, and a semantic memory that accumulates reusable decision patterns from experience. Experiments on a glioma cohort combining TCGA-LGG, TCGA-GBM, and BraTS with four diagnostic modalities demonstrate that SAGEAgent achieves competitive survival prediction accuracy while reducing average acquisition burden by 55%.

AI.tldr: 提出SAGEAgent，一种基于LLM的临床智能体，能够主动决策是否为每位癌症患者获取下一级诊断模态信息，在保持生存预测准确性的同时将平均获取负担降低55%。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态生存预测方法要么假设所有模态可用，要么被动处理缺失数据，但没有任何方法主动推理在临床有序工作流中获取下一模态是否对特定患者合理，缺乏平衡预测准确性与临床侵入性的智能决策机制。
AI.method: 将诊断模态获取问题建模为序列决策问题，提出SAGEAgent：利用LLM作为核心推理引擎，通过临床工具将数值预测转化为文本、情景记忆检索相似历史病例、语义记忆积累可复用决策模式，在临床规定的有序工作流中动态决定是否需要获取下一级诊断模态。
AI.result: 在结合TCGA-LGG、TCGA-GBM和BraTS的胶质瘤队列上，使用四种诊断模态（人口统计学、影像学、组织病理学、基因组学），SAGEAgent在保持有竞争力的生存预测准确性的同时，将平均获取负担降低了55%。
AI.conclusion: 并非每位癌症患者都需要完整的诊断检查来获得准确的生存预测，通过智能的模态获取决策可以显著降低临床负担而不牺牲预测性能，为个性化诊断路径优化提供了新范式。

title: Optimal Top-$k$ Identification from Pairwise Comparisons
summary: We study the active learning problem of fixed-confidence top-$k$ identification from noisy pairwise comparisons. In this problem, an algorithm sequentially chooses pairs of items to compare, observes the outcomes, and stops when it can return the set of top-$k$ items with error probability at most $δ$. The objective is to design such a $δ$-correct procedure that minimizes the expected number of comparisons (the sample complexity). This problem falls within the broader literature on fixed-confidence pure exploration in bandit models, where a common target is asymptotic optimality: the algorithm's expected sample complexity matches the information theoretic lower bound as $δ\to 0$. Asymptotically optimal procedures have been developed for a range of fixed-confidence pure-exploration problems, however to the best of our knowledge, for top-$1$, or more generally top-$k$ identification from pairwise comparisons under latent utility models an asymptotically optimal algorithm has not been established. In this setting, we develop such an algorithm. We characterize the structure of the lower bound and formulate it as a saddle-point problem. This structure enables a computationally efficient primal-dual procedure that learns the asymptotically optimal comparison allocation online. We then construct an adaptive comparison-allocation algorithm that tracks the allocation learned by the primal-dual procedure and prove it is asymptotically optimal.

AI.tldr: 本文针对固定置信度下从噪声成对比较中识别前k项的问题，提出了一种渐近最优的自适应比较分配算法。该算法通过将下界结构表征为鞍点问题，利用高效的原始-对偶过程在线学习最优比较分配，并证明了其期望样本复杂度在δ→0时达到信息论下界。
AI.motivation: 在固定置信度纯探索的带状模型问题中，对于基于潜在效用模型的成对比较下的top-1或更一般的top-k识别，尚缺乏渐近最优的算法。本文旨在填补这一空白，设计一种在期望样本复杂度上达到信息论下界的δ-正确算法。
AI.method: 首先刻画下界的结构，将其表述为一个鞍点问题。然后利用该结构设计一个计算高效的原始-对偶过程，在线学习渐近最优的比较分配。最后构建一个自适应比较分配算法，跟踪该原始-对偶过程学习的分配，并证明其渐近最优性。
AI.result: 提出了一个渐近最优的自适应比较分配算法，证明其期望样本复杂度在δ→0时匹配信息论下界。
AI.conclusion: 本文为基于潜在效用模型的成对比较下top-k识别问题提供了首个渐近最优算法，丰富了固定置信度纯探索的理论与方法。

title: Task-Specific Multimodal Question Answering Agents via Confidence Calibration and Incremental Reasoning for QANTA 2026
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure. Accepted at the EMM-QA 2026 Workshop, ICML 2026 (Non-Archival). Rank #1 overall system in the QANTA 2026 Challenge
summary: We present our submission to the QANTA 2026 shared challenge at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Efficient Multimodal Question Answering (EMM-QA). Quanta evaluates multimodal quizbowl systems that answer pyramid-style questions from incrementally revealed text and accompanying images while operating under realistic efficiency constraints. The challenge consists of two distinct tasks: Tossup questions, which require deciding when to answer under uncertainty, and Bonus questions, which emphasize accurate answer selection and human adoption. To address these differing objectives, we develop a task-specific two-agent architecture. Our Tossup agent utilizes a GPT-4o-mini-class model (referred to as GPT-4.1-mini in the competition logs) with confidence-calibrated answering and a domain-specific numeric reasoning policy that reduces overconfident predictions from isolated quantitative clues. Our Bonus agent uses GPT-4o-class model (referred to as GPT-4.1) with leadin-aware reasoning, structured relational reasoning, and multimodal evidence integration to improve exact answer selection. Rather than relying on a retrieval pipeline or model ensembles, our approach emphasizes efficient reasoning policies and confidence calibration within a hosted-only environment. Our system achieved the highest overall leaderboard score of 0.402, including a Tossup score of 0.238 and a Bonus Effect score of 0.164. The results demonstrate that lightweight, task-specific reasoning strategies can provide strong performance on resource-constrained multimodal question answering benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了面向QANTA 2026挑战的双智能体架构，分别针对Tossup问题（基于GPT-4.1-mini，置信度校准+领域数值推理策略）和Bonus问题（基于GPT-4.1，引导感知推理+结构化关系推理+多模态证据融合），在不依赖检索管道或模型集成的前提下，实现了最高整体排行榜得分0.402，证明了轻量级任务特定推理策略在资源受限的多模态问答中的有效性。
AI.motivation: QANTA 2026挑战赛要求系统在效率约束下回答递进式文本与图像结合的问答问题，包含Tossup（不确定性下决定何时作答）和Bonus（精确答案选择与人工采纳）两个任务目标不一致的任务，现有方法难以同时兼顾。
AI.method: 提出任务特定的双智能体架构：Tossup智能体使用GPT-4o-mini类模型，结合置信度校准和领域数值推理策略，减少对孤立数值线索的过度自信预测；Bonus智能体使用GPT-4o类模型，集成引导感知推理、结构化关系推理和多模态证据融合。整个系统在仅托管环境中运行，不依赖检索管道或模型集成。
AI.result: 系统获得最高整体排行榜得分0.402，其中Tossup得分0.238，Bonus Effect得分0.164。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级、任务特定的推理策略能够在资源受限的多模态问答基准上提供强劲性能，验证了无需复杂检索或集成即可高效应对多目标任务的设计思路。

title: A Coreset Selection Framework with Ensemble Aggregation for Image Classification
summary: The rapid growth of image data has produced large-scale datasets, raising concerns about the time and memory costs of model training. Selecting representative training subsets, however, remains challenging: individual sample contributions are unclear, and model behavior varies across datasets and runs. We address these challenges with a framework that combines coreset selection with an ensemble aggregation over multiple runs. For coreset selection, we propose SCOre-Stratified Selection (SCOSS), which partitions the training data into intervals based on a chosen score and samples from each interval. The ensemble combines predictions from multiple runs, each performed on an independently sampled training subset. As baselines, we use moderate and random selection, each in original and class-balanced versions. We assess the framework with Simple Graph Convolution (SGC) and Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifiers under different sampling ratios. Experiments show that SCOSS is competitive with baselines, often the best choice for SGC, and enables favorable trade-offs between accuracy and efficiency. On the fine-grained dataset, SGC with SCOSS outperforms SVMs when using fewer labeled samples. The code and supplementary materials are publicly available at http://scoss.lucasvalem.com.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合核心集选择（SCOSS算法）与集成聚合的框架，用于从大规模图像数据中高效选取代表性训练子集。SCOSS基于得分将数据分层采样，集成方法聚合多次独立采样的预测结果。实验表明，SCOSS在SGC和SVM分类器上表现优异，尤其在细粒度数据集上，SGC+SCOSS用更少标注样本超越SVM。
AI.motivation: 大规模图像数据集的训练时间和内存成本高昂，而现有子集选择方法面临两个核心挑战：单个样本的贡献不明确，且不同数据集和运行中模型行为存在差异。
AI.method: 提出SCOSS（Score-Stratified Selection），基于某个得分指标将训练数据划分为多个区间，再从每个区间中均匀采样。同时构建集成框架，对多次独立采样子集分别训练并聚合预测结果。使用SGC和SVM分类器在不同采样率下评估，并与随机选择、中等选择及各自的类平衡版本对比。
AI.result: SCOSS在多数场景下与基线方法竞争力相当，常是SGC的最优选择；在细粒度数据集上，SGC配合SCOSS使用更少标注样本即可超越SVM。
AI.conclusion: SCOSS结合集成聚合的框架能够在大规模图像数据上实现精度与效率之间的有利权衡，代码已开源。

title: Beyond Fixed Representations: The Vocabulary and Verifier Gaps in Open-Ended AI
summary:
Modern AI systems are increasingly being evaluated for their ability to reason, code, prove theorems, use tools, and long-horizon research tasks. These are powerful capabilities, but they share a structural limitation: the representational frame within which the model operates, including its conceptual vocabulary, the space of admissible solutions it can search, and the criteria by which success is evaluated, is typically fixed and supplied in advance. This paper argues that building stronger intelligent systems capable of open-ended innovation requires additional classes of operations: the creation, stabilization, and reuse of new representational primitives, which alter the space being searched rather than simply searching within it.
  We characterize the distance between current AI systems and genuinely open-ended intelligence through two gaps. The first is the vocabulary gap, the difficulty of inventing and stabilizing new representational primitives rather than merely recombining existing ones. The second is the verifier gap, the difficulty of judging the value of a new primitive when its full payoff may be visible only after future reuse. We interpret both gaps through a unified framework of intelligence as cognitive discrepancy reduction. By viewing intelligent behaviors as a sequence of cognitive transformations, we distinguish intra-space transformations which operate within a fixed representational frame, from generative transformations which may modify the frame itself. On this basis, we propose a ladder of innovation autonomy and outline several directions for advancing open-ended AI, including objectives that reward useful representational change, persistent memory architectures for invented primitives, and adaptive verification mechanisms capable of evolving alongside the representations they evaluate.

AI.tldr: 本文指出当前AI系统（如推理、编码、定理证明等）受限于固定的表征框架（概念词汇、解空间、评价标准），无法实现真正的开放式创新。作者提出两个关键差距——词汇差距（创造新表征基元而非组合已有基元）和验证差距（评估新基元长期价值），并通过“智能即认知差异缩减”的统一框架区分了框架内变换与生成式变换，进而提出创新自主性阶梯以及推动开放式AI发展的若干方向。
AI.motivation: 现有AI系统在推理、编码、定理证明、工具使用和长周期研究任务上表现出强大能力，但结构性地受限于固定的表征框架（概念词汇、可搜索解空间、成功评判标准），无法实现真正开放式的创新。作者旨在揭示这一根本局限，并探索如何构建能够创造、稳定和重用新表征基元的智能系统。
AI.method: 通过定义两个核心差距（词汇差距与验证差距）来刻画当前AI与开放式智能之间的距离，并提出“智能即认知差异缩减”的统一框架，将智能行为视为一系列认知变换，并区分为框架内变换（固定表征框架内操作）与生成式变换（可修改框架本身）。在此基础上构建了创新自主性阶梯，并提出了三类推进开放式AI的方向：奖励有用表征变化的目标函数、用于存储发明基元的持久记忆架构、以及能随表征共同演化的自适应验证机制。
AI.result: 识别了两个关键障碍：词汇差距——系统难以发明和稳定新的表征基元而只能重组已有基元；验证差距——新基元的全部价值可能只有在未来重用后才能显现，导致当前难以评判其效用。通过认知差异缩减框架，形式化区分了框架内变换与生成式变换，并提出了创新自主性阶梯（从固定框架内操作到框架本身可被修改的逐级递进）。
AI.conclusion: 要实现开放式创新，AI系统必须超越在固定表征框架内搜索的模式，具备创造、稳定和重用新表征基元的能力。具体推进方向包括：设计能奖励有用表征变化的训练目标、构建持久记忆架构以系统性地积累发明基元、以及发展能随所评估表征共同进化的自适应验证机制。这些方向共同指向一个更具生成性和自主性的AI范式。

title: AlphaZero in Sparsely Rewarded Games: Limits and Auxiliary Supervision
summary: AlphaZero has demonstrated that a neural-guided Monte Carlo Tree Search can achieve superhuman performance, but strong play does not necessarily imply perfect play. We study this gap in two oracle-evaluable domains with contrasting structure: Connect Four, a solved partisan game with exact game-theoretic values, and Chomp, an impartial game whose optimal play is governed by Grundy-number structure. Under a unified self-play $+$ MCTS pipeline, we compare vanilla AlphaZero, a multi-frame variant (limited to Chomp), and an AlphaZero Auxiliary Loss (AZAL) that adds oracle-derived policy supervision. We find that vanilla AlphaZero achieves strong play across both domains but cannot preserve the exact trajectories required for optimal play: in Connect Four, it fails to maintain the optimal line of play, while in Chomp, it fails to consistently restore the $g=0$ invariant. On rectangular Chomp boards, multi-frame inputs alone do not remove this gap. Nevertheless, AZAL substantially improves oracle consistency across multi-seeded full-game traces and sampled-state evaluations. On Chomp, AZAL reaches perfect full-game oracle consistency on 10x11 and high but not complete consistency on 9x10; on Connect Four, AZAL improves oracle-match rate and delays the first oracle mistake, but does not reach perfect play.

AI.tldr: 本文研究AlphaZero在强玩法与完美玩法之间的差距，选择了两个可评估的完美信息博弈——解决了的偏序博弈Connect Four（四子棋）和由Grundy数结构支配的公平博弈Chomp。在统一的自对弈+MCTS框架下，对比了原始AlphaZero、多帧变体（仅限Chomp）以及引入Oracle衍生策略监督的AlphaZero辅助损失方法（AZAL）。结果表明，原始AlphaZero虽能实现强玩法，但无法保持最优轨迹；多帧输入不能消除这一差距；而AZAL大幅提升了Oracle一致性，在Chomp的10x11棋盘上达到完美玩法，在9x10上接近完美，在Connect Four上改善了Oracle匹配率并延迟了首次失误，但未达到完美。
AI.motivation: AlphaZero在神经网络引导的蒙特卡洛树搜索中展现了超人类水平，但强玩法并不等价于完美玩法。本文旨在探究这一差距，选择两类具有对比结构且可被Oracle评估的博弈领域（已解出的偏序博弈Connect Four与基于Grundy数的公平博弈Chomp），以检验AlphaZero类方法能否真正学到最优策略。
AI.method: 采用统一的自对弈+MCTS流程，比较三种变体：原始AlphaZero、仅用于Chomp的多帧输入变体（Multi-frame），以及引入Oracle衍生策略监督的AlphaZero辅助损失方法（AZAL）。AZAL在标准AlphaZero损失基础上增加辅助损失，使其策略头输出与已知最优策略（Oracle策略）对齐。实验通过多种子全游戏轨迹和采样状态评估来衡量Oracle一致性。
AI.result: 原始AlphaZero在两个领域均实现强玩法，但无法保持最优轨迹：在Connect Four中无法维持最优行棋路线，在Chomp中无法持续恢复g=0不变量。仅靠多帧输入（Chomp）无法消除此差距。AZAL则大幅提升了Oracle一致性：在Chomp的10x11棋盘上达到完美全程Oracle一致性，9x10上高度但非完全一致；在Connect Four上AZAL提高了Oracle匹配率并延迟了首次Oracle失误的出现，但未达到完美玩法。
AI.conclusion: 强玩法与完美玩法之间存在本质差距，AlphaZero的自对弈学习范式不足以保证最优性。引入Oracle监督的辅助损失（AZAL）能显著改善一致性，但即使在可完全评估的博弈中，完全达到完美玩法仍具挑战，表明仅靠数据驱动的方法难以捕获精确的最优决策边界。

title: Equivariant Filter for High Performance Image Tracking using an Event Camera
summary: Image tracking is the problem of estimating the transformation that relates a moving image of a scene to an original reference image. The problem is important in control of autonomous vehicles or robots, where the image encodes information about the motion of the camera or environment, as well as in pure computer vision applications. In this paper, we present an equivariant filter design for high performance tracking of planar image transformations using an event camera. The design exploits the Asynchronous Event Blob (AEB) tracker (Wang et al., 2024) to extract feature-position measurements from the raw event stream, and an equivariant filter to compute an affine image translation and rotation using the special Euclidean group symmetry. The equivariant filter incorporates an equivalent-measurement update step that de-correlates the (highly temporally correlated) feature-position measurements provided by the AEB tracker. We evaluate the design experimentally using two datasets involving general and fast rotational motion. We benchmark results against direct optimisation (estimating the relative transformation from the raw blob tracks), and a covariance intersection approach for overcoming data correlation. Our design provides smooth image tracking for features moving up to 7000 pixels per second on the image plane.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于等变滤波器的事件相机平面图像变换跟踪方法，利用异步事件斑点（AEB）跟踪器提取特征位置测量值，并结合SE(2)对称性计算仿射变换，通过等效测量更新步骤去相关时间相关性，实现了高达7000像素/秒的特征平滑跟踪。
AI.motivation: 图像跟踪在自动驾驶、机器人控制及计算机视觉中至关重要，传统基于帧的相机在高速运动下性能受限。事件相机具有高时间分辨率，但现有方法未充分利用其对称结构。本文旨在设计一种高性能等变滤波器，利用事件相机的优势实现快速、平滑的平面图像变换跟踪。
AI.method: 方法结合了异步事件斑点（AEB）跟踪器从原始事件流中提取特征位置测量，并设计了一个等变滤波器，利用特殊欧几里得群（SE(2)）对称性估计仿射图像变换（平移和旋转）。滤波器包含一个等效测量更新步骤，用于去相关AEB跟踪器提供的高度时间相关测量值。
AI.result: 在两个涉及一般和快速旋转运动的数据集上进行了实验评估，与直接优化方法和协方差交集方法进行了对比。所提设计能够对图像平面上运动速度高达7000像素/秒的特征实现平滑跟踪。
AI.conclusion: 该等变滤波器设计成功实现了事件相机下高速运动的平滑图像跟踪，证明了利用对称性和去相关处理在提升跟踪性能方面的有效性。

title: Knowledge Graphs and Explainable AI as Complementary Resources for Urban Mining
comment: Accepted for presentation at the AISE Workshop @ IJCAI-ECAI 2026
summary: Pre-demolition assessment, the regulated audit process at the heart of urban mining, is an information process in which AI support must serve qualified auditors who remain accountable for the decisions taken. The relevant unit of value is not prediction accuracy alone, but the defensibility of the supported decisions: their legibility, plausibility, sourcing, and contestability. Explainable AI techniques and domain knowledge graphs each address parts of this requirement, and existing taxonomies have catalogued their integration. The literature is descriptively rich but structurally under-specified: what remains less developed is a structural account of why specific integrations produce artefacts neither resource can provide alone. This paper offers a complementarity-theoretic interpretation grounded in the IS resource-based tradition. We propose four consolidated KG-XAI integration modes (Lifting, Constraining, Typing, and Revising), each defined as a typed operation over XAI artefacts and knowledge-graph substrate structures. Each mode unlocks a distinct property of defensibility and contributes to the kind of regulatory artefact pre-demolition assessment demands. A fire-door example from the urban-mining process illustrates the modes using the W3C Linked Building Data stack and valuation extensions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于互补性理论的KG-XAI集成模式（提升、约束、类型化、修正），用于增强城市矿产中拆前评估的决策可辩护性（可读性、合理性、可溯源性和可争议性），并以防火门案例展示了该框架在W3C关联建筑数据栈中的应用。
AI.motivation: 现有文献虽然对XAI与知识图谱的集成进行了分类描述，但缺乏结构化的理论解释来说明为什么特定的集成能产生单一资源无法提供的制品。拆前评估作为受监管的审计过程，需要的不只是预测准确性，而是决策的可辩护性，因此需要更严谨的理论基础来指导AI支持系统的设计。
AI.method: 基于IS资源基础观中的互补性理论，提出了四种结构化的KG-XAI集成模式：Lifting（提升）、Constraining（约束）、Typing（类型化）和Revising（修正），每种模式定义为对XAI制品和KG底层结构的类型化操作。通过城市矿产中的防火门案例，使用W3C关联建筑数据栈和估值扩展进行说明。
AI.result: 四种集成模式各自解锁了可辩护性的不同属性：Lifting增强可读性，Constraining增强合理性，Typing增强可溯源性，Revising增强可争议性。这些模式共同构成了符合监管要求的决策支持制品，弥补了单一XAI或KG方法在可辩护性上的不足。
AI.conclusion: 该互补性理论框架为KG-XAI集成提供了结构化的理论基础，明确了不同集成模式如何贡献于决策的可辩护性，对受监管的城市矿产拆前评估等领域的AI系统设计具有指导意义。未来可进一步验证这些模式在其他领域中的适用性。

title: Group Invariant Spectral Embedding
summary: Spectral embedding methods are widely used for dimensionality reduction and clustering of high-dimensional datasets with intrinsic low-dimensional structures. Although many datasets of practical interest exhibit invariance under symmetries such as rotations, standard spectral embedding methods do not account for this, treating symmetry-related data points as unrelated. Our approach to this problem is to incorporate the symmetries directly into the affinity kernels used for spectral embedding. We analyze the case of a Riemannian data manifold $M$ with symmetries given by a compact Lie group~$G$ and prove that, under suitable conditions, graph Laplacians constructed from three types of invariant kernels converge pointwise to explicit second-order differential operators on the quotient space $M/G$. Our analysis implies improved convergence rates, as the effective dimension drops according to the dimension of the group. We validate our approach on datasets with $\mathrm{SO}(2)$ or $\mathrm{SO}(3)$ symmetry, and show that $G$-invariant spectral embedding recovers the intrinsic geometry of the data, in contrast to standard spectral embedding, which fails to do so even in the limit of infinite data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将数据对称性（如旋转）直接嵌入谱嵌入的亲和核中，证明在紧李群作用下，三类不变核构建的图拉普拉斯算子逐点收敛到商空间上的二阶微分算子，有效维度随群维度降低，从而提升收敛速度，并在SO(2)/SO(3)对称数据集上验证了该方法能恢复数据内在几何结构，而标准谱嵌入即使在无限数据极限下也失效。
AI.motivation: 许多实际高维数据集具有内在的低维结构且对旋转等对称性保持不变，但标准谱嵌入方法将对称相关的数据点视为无关，未能利用这一结构信息。
AI.method: 将对称性直接融入谱嵌入的亲和核中；分析紧李群G作用下的黎曼数据流形M，证明三类不变核构造的图拉普拉斯算子逐点收敛到商空间M/G上的二阶微分算子。
AI.result: 有效维度随群维度降低，收敛速度提升；在SO(2)和SO(3)对称数据集上，G不变谱嵌入能恢复数据内在几何结构，标准谱嵌入即使无限数据极限也失效。
AI.conclusion: G不变谱嵌入能有效利用数据对称性，提升收敛性能并恢复内在几何，优于标准谱嵌入方法。

title: Integrating Large Language Models and Graph Convolutional Networks for Semi-Supervised Image Classification
summary: While the growing availability of image data has driven significant advances, labeling datasets remains costly and time-consuming. Therefore, semi-supervised approaches such as Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs), which learn from both labeled and unlabeled data, have emerged as a promising solution. One of the primary challenges in applying GCNs to image classification is graph construction, since, unlike in citation networks or similar domains, images typically do not come with a predefined structural representation. For visual data, most studies construct graphs based on the similarity between feature vectors from pretrained deep learning backbones, typically by employing kNN or reciprocal kNN algorithms. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown remarkable capability in capturing high-level semantics, their integration with GCNs for image classification remains underexplored. Aiming to fill this gap, our approach uses a Vision Language Model (VLM) to generate textual image descriptions, which are then processed by an LLM to estimate semantic similarity scores between connected images. These scores guide the pruning of edges in kNN and reciprocal kNN graphs, filtering out semantically irrelevant neighbors. Experimental results reveal that leveraging LLMs for graph refinement can improve classification accuracy, particularly for kNN graphs and some backbones. The source code is publicly available at http://gcnllm.lucasvalem.com.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用大语言模型（LLM）对kNN和互kNN图进行边剪枝，过滤语义不相关的邻居，以提升图卷积网络（GCN）在图像分类任务中的表现。
AI.motivation: 图像数据标注成本高，半监督GCN虽有效，但图像领域缺乏预定义图结构；现有方法依赖特征相似性构建kNN图，缺乏对语义信息的利用；LLM虽能捕获高层语义，尚未被用于优化GCN图结构。
AI.method: 使用视觉语言模型（VLM）生成图像文本描述，再由LLM估算连接图像之间的语义相似度分数，据此对kNN和互kNN图进行边剪枝，移除语义无关的邻居。
AI.result: 实验表明，利用LLM进行图细化能够提升分类准确率，尤其对kNN图和部分骨干网络效果显著。
AI.conclusion: LLM引导的图结构优化可以有效增强GCN在图像分类中的性能，代码已开源。

title: TrustX Agent Risk Classification Framework (ARC): Risk-Tiering Internally Created Agentic AI Systems
comment: This is a working paper on our risk classification tool, with iterations currently underway
summary: The proliferation of agentic AI systems across enterprise and public-sector contexts has outpaced the capacity of general-purpose AI risk frameworks to classify and govern them. In this paper, we introduce the TrustX Agent Risk Classification Framework, a structured, repeatable instrument that can be applied to seven types of agentic AI systems and is grounded in foundational pre-existing AI governance frameworks. At the core of the framework is a twelve-dimension scoring rubric that robustly quantifies the risk. This rubric is combined with other components, such as the GPA + IAT classification model and the five-level autonomy framework derived from existing literature. These inputs produce a three-tier governance output with mapped control recommendations. A specialised Coding Assistant extension is also included to account for nuances specific to this type of agentic AI system. We then use an illustrative example to show our framework in practice. ARC is intended for AI governance practitioners, risk officers, developers, and regulators, and it will regularly undergo iteration as we continue to expand it and make it more robust. The community can access the interactive framework here: https://arc.responsible.ai/

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TrustX智能体风险分类框架（ARC），这是一个基于现有AI治理框架的结构化、可重复的风险评估工具，适用于七种类型的智能体AI系统。其核心是一个十二维评分量表，结合GPA+IAT分类模型和五级自主性框架，输出三级治理建议，并包含代码助手扩展。该框架面向AI治理从业者、风险官、开发者和监管者，并持续迭代更新。
AI.motivation: 企业及公共部门中智能体AI系统的快速普及已超越通用AI风险框架的分类和治理能力，亟需专门针对智能体AI系统的结构化风险评估工具。
AI.method: 基于现有AI治理框架，构建了包含十二维评分量表、GPA+IAT分类模型和五级自主性框架的TrustX智能体风险分类框架（ARC），可对七种智能体AI系统进行风险评估，并输出三级治理建议与对应控制措施。同时针对代码助手类智能体设计了专门扩展。
AI.result: 形成了一个可交互的、结构化的风险分类框架，并通过示例演示了其实际应用，面向AI治理从业者、风险官、开发者和监管者开放使用。
AI.conclusion: ARC框架为智能体AI系统的风险治理提供了系统化、可重复的操作工具，弥补了通用框架的不足，并将持续迭代以增强鲁棒性和覆盖面。

title: Sensitivity-Aware Thresholding and Token Routing for Activation Sparsification in Large Language Models
summary: Efficient inference in Large Language Models (LLMs) requires deciding where computation can be reduced while preserving model quality. We study this problem through multilayer perceptron (MLP) activation sparsification and token-level conditional routing. We first propose Sensitivity-Aware Thresholding for Sparsity (SATS), a threshold calibration method to choose layerwise gate thresholds using a local MLP output sensitivity proxy rather than calibrating thresholds directly from activation percentiles. While SATS retains the existing mechanism of sparsifying MLP activations by thresholding gate activations, it replaces percentile-based calibration with a sensitivity-aware selection rule. We then introduce a lightweight token routing framework that dynamically selects between a base path and a modified path on a per-token basis, rather than applying the modified computation uniformly to all tokens. We evaluate both methods on multiple recent open-weight LLMs. Our results show that SATS improves over the threshold-based sparsification baseline at matched actual sparsity and that token routing yields a more favorable quality-throughput trade-off than static activation modification baselines. Overall, our results suggest that improved threshold calibration and token routing can improve the quality-throughput trade-off in LLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出SATS（敏感度感知阈值稀疏化）方法，用局部MLP输出敏感度代理替代基于百分位的阈值校准，以及一种基于token的条件路由框架，在多个开源LLM上实现了更好的质量-吞吐量权衡。
AI.motivation: LLM高效推理需要在保持模型质量的同时减少计算量，现有方法如基于百分位的激活稀疏化或静态修改全部token的计算路径，未能充分利用每个token的差异性，且阈值校准不够精准。
AI.method: 1) SATS：通过局部MLP输出敏感度代理（而非激活百分位）来校准每层的门控阈值，在保持阈值稀疏化机制的同时优化阈值选择。2) Token路由：为每个token动态选择基础路径或修改路径，而非对所有token统一应用修改。
AI.result: 在多个开源LLM上，SATS在同等实际稀疏度下优于基于百分位的阈值稀疏化基线；Token路由比静态修改所有token的基线获得了更好的质量-吞吐量权衡。
AI.conclusion: 改进的阈值校准（SATS）和token级条件路由能有效提升LLM推理的质量-吞吐量权衡。

title: Event Stream based Multi-Modal Video Anomaly Detection: A Benchmark Dataset and Algorithms
summary: Video anomaly detection (VAD) is critical for automated surveillance but remains fragile under challenging conditions such as illumination variations, fast motion, and complex backgrounds when relying solely on visible light videos. To address these limitations, we propose EVAD, an event enhanced VAD framework that jointly exploits conventional video and event streams captured by bio inspired event cameras. Event sensors asynchronously capture brightness changes with high temporal resolution, offering robustness to motion blur and extreme lighting, and providing motion salient cues complementary to video based visual information. To support multi modal VAD research, we construct a large scale visible event benchmark comprising 6.3 billion events and 376,368 video frames collected under diverse illumination levels, motion patterns, and background complexities, filling the gap of realistic and scalable datasets for event based anomaly detection. Building upon this dataset, we design a contrastive multi modal pretraining framework to learn discriminative event representations by aligning semantic embeddings across event streams, visible videos, and textual descriptions. An adaptive fusion module then dynamically integrates event based temporal cues with video based spatial semantics, improving robustness to environmental disturbances. Experiments on benchmarks and the proposed TJUTCM Pha dataset demonstrate that E VAD consistently outperforms methods, validating the effectiveness of event-based sensing for VAD in real world scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EVAD框架，联合利用传统视频和事件相机数据（生物启发式事件流）进行视频异常检测，并构建了包含63亿事件和37.6万帧的大规模可见光-事件基准数据集TJUTCM Pha。通过对比多模态预训练对齐事件、视频和文本语义，并设计自适应融合模块整合事件时序线索与视频空间语义，在多个基准上取得最先进的异常检测性能。
AI.motivation: 传统基于可见光视频的异常检测在光照变化、快速运动、复杂背景等挑战性场景下表现脆弱，现有方法缺乏对事件流这一互补模态的利用，且缺少大规模真实场景的可见光-事件多模态异常检测数据集。
AI.method: 1）构建大规模可见光-事件基准数据集（6.3B事件+376,368帧，覆盖多样光照、运动、背景条件）；2）设计对比多模态预训练框架，对齐事件流、可见光视频和文本描述的语义嵌入；3）提出自适应融合模块，动态整合基于事件的时序线索与基于视频的空间语义。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集和自建TJUTCM Pha数据集上，EVAD持续优于现有方法，验证了事件流感知对真实场景异常检测的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 事件相机提供的高时间分辨率、运动显著线索能有效弥补传统视频在极端光照和快速运动下的不足，多模态融合框架为鲁棒的异常检测提供了新范式。

title: Agora: Enhancing LLM Agent Reasoning Via Auction-Based Task Allocation
summary: Enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language model (LLM) agents requires effective orchestration of diverse expert models and tools. However, existing frameworks typically call APIs based on coarse-grained matching between tasks and the functions of expert models or tools, while overlooking critical factors such as performance variability and cost efficiency among functionally similar alternatives. To address this, we propose Agora, a framework that introduces an incentive-compatible auction mechanism for dynamically allocating tasks to expert models and tools. By treating reasoning steps as tradeable items, Agora enables agents to bid based on their rectified competence-ensuring that critical logic is routed to the most capable solver rather than the most overconfident one. Evaluations across five benchmarks show that Agora improves over matched single-model, routing, and cascade baselines under comparable candidate pools, while exposing a controllable cost-quality trade-off through a single auction parameter.

AI.tldr: 提出Agora框架，通过激励相容的拍卖机制动态分配任务给专家模型和工具，将推理步骤作为可交易物品，基于修正后的能力进行竞价，在五个基准测试中优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体框架通常基于粗粒度的任务-功能匹配来调用API，忽略了功能相似的替代方案之间的性能差异和成本效率问题。
AI.method: 提出Agora框架，引入激励相容的拍卖机制，将推理步骤视为可交易物品，智能体基于修正后的能力（rectified competence）进行竞价，确保关键逻辑路由到最有能力的求解器而非最自信的求解器。
AI.result: 在五个基准测试上，Agora在可比候选池下优于单模型、路由和级联基线，并通过单个拍卖参数暴露可控的成本-质量权衡。
AI.conclusion: Agora通过拍卖机制有效解决了专家模型和工具的动态分配问题，实现了成本与质量之间的可控权衡。

title: Model Agnostic Graph Prompt Learning for Crystal Property Prediction
summary: Graph Neural Networks have emerged as a powerful tool for the fast and accurate prediction of various crystal properties. These models often encode domain-specific knowledge into their graph encoding modules, which increases their parameter size and makes their performance heavily dependent on domain expertise. Added to this, explicitly incorporating all chemical and structural features, that might influence a specific crystal property into the GNN encoder, is a challenging task. In this work, we propose a soft prompt learning framework that captures latent features essential for property prediction, which are not explicitly provided to the GNN. We introduce a novel multilevel graph prompt learning framework comprising both node-level and graph-level soft prompts. At the node level, we capture the local chemical semantics of different atom types, while at the graph level, we encode the global structural symmetry of the crystal graph. Our proposed prompt learning framework is lightweight and seamlessly integrates with any existing GNN encoder.
