Extensive experiments on popular benchmark datasets show that incorporating prompt learning significantly improves (3\% - 15\%) the performance of state-of-the-art GNN models in crystal property prediction tasks. Furthermore, the learned soft prompts enable cross-property knowledge transfer, enhancing prediction performance for properties with limited training data. Code is available at https://github.com/shrimonmuke0202/Prompt.git

AI.tldr: 提出了一种多层级图提示学习框架（节点级和图级软提示），用于捕获晶体属性预测中未显式提供的潜在特征，可无缝集成到现有GNN编码器中，在基准数据集上将性能提升3%-15%，并支持跨属性知识迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有GNN晶体属性预测模型高度依赖领域知识编码，参数规模大且性能受限于专家经验；显式整合所有可能影响属性的化学与结构特征十分困难。因此需要一种能自动捕获潜在特征、减轻领域依赖的轻量级方法。
AI.method: 提出多层级图提示学习框架：节点级软提示捕获不同原子类型的局部化学语义，图级软提示编码晶体图的全局结构对称性。该框架轻量且可与任意现有GNN编码器无缝集成。
AI.result: 在多个流行基准数据集上，融入提示学习使现有最优GNN模型的性能提升3%-15%；此外，学到的软提示支持跨属性知识迁移，能改善训练数据有限属性的预测效果。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的多层级图提示学习框架能有效捕获潜在特征，显著提升GNN在晶体属性预测中的表现，并实现知识迁移，为现有模型提供了灵活且高效的增强手段。

title: Event Burst Trigger: An Availability Backdoor Attack on Event-Based SNN Object Detection
comment: The 56th Annual IEEE/IFIP International Conference on Dependable Systems and Networks (DSN 2026)
summary: Event-based vision and spiking neural networks (SNNs) are increasingly adopted for edge intelligence under strict latency and energy constraints. However, the vulnerability of event-based SNN object detection models to availability backdoor attacks remains insufficiently studied. This paper presents Event Burst Trigger (EBT), an availability backdoor attack targeting SNN-based object detection models. EBT injects carefully crafted event-based triggers into the training data, which induce temporally concentrated event streams during inference. These burst-like activations increase the number of phantom (i.e., spurious) object candidates, and consequently inflate the computational cost of the post-processing stage, particularly Non-Maximum Suppression (NMS). We evaluate EBT on SpikeYOLO, the state-of-the-art SNN-based object detector, under a poison-only threat model that does not require modifications to the model architecture, loss function, or inference pipeline. Experimental results show that while detection accuracy remains largely preserved, with mAP@0.5 decreasing by less than 0.099, the latency of the NMS stage increases by up to 38%. This indicates that NMS can become a dominant availability bottleneck in event-based SNN object detection. Experiments on an edge platform further show that the proposed attack elevates baseline resource utilization and reduces scheduling slack without inducing conspicuous peaks in resource usage. In addition, STRIP-based backdoor detection fails to reliably distinguish the proposed attack from benign inputs. These results characterize a previously underexplored availability backdoor threat in event-based SNN object detection systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Event Burst Trigger (EBT)，一种针对基于事件视觉和脉冲神经网络（SNN）的目标检测模型的可用性后门攻击。通过注入精心构造的事件触发流，导致推理时非极大值抑制（NMS）阶段计算延迟最高增加38%，而检测精度仅下降不到0.099 mAP@0.5，且传统后门检测方法STRIP难以区分。
AI.motivation: 事件视觉与SNN模型在边缘智能中应用广泛，但其对可用性后门攻击的脆弱性尚未被充分研究。现有工作多关注分类任务或模型完整性攻击，缺乏针对SNN目标检测模型可用性的后门威胁分析。
AI.method: EBT攻击通过在训练数据中注入时间上高度集中的事件触发流（burst-like activation），使得推理时产生大量虚假目标候选框，从而显著增加NMS阶段的计算开销。攻击采用仅投毒（poison-only）威胁模型，无需修改模型架构、损失函数或推理流程。
AI.result: 在SpikeYOLO上，EBT使NMS延迟最高增加38%，而mAP@0.5下降不超过0.099；在边缘平台上表现为资源利用率上升和调度余量减少，无明显资源使用峰值；STRIP检测方法无法可靠区分攻击样本与良性输入。
AI.conclusion: NMS可能成为事件驱动SNN目标检测系统中主导的可用性瓶颈，EBT揭示了一类此前未被充分探索的可用性后门威胁，对边缘智能系统的安全性设计具有重要警示意义。

title: ConceptSMILE: Auditing the Trustworthiness of Concept-Based Explainable AI
summary: Concept-based explainable artificial intelligence (AI) can make model reasoning more human-understandable, but concept-level outputs are not automatically trustworthy. We introduce ConceptSMILE, a model-agnostic perturbation-based auditing framework for evaluating the reliability of concept-based explanations. Rather than replacing SMILE, ConceptSMILE extends its perturbation-based logic from feature- or region-level attribution to the auditing of human-understandable concept explanations. The framework perturbs input regions, measures concept-response shifts, applies locality weighting, and fits an XGBoost surrogate to approximate local concept behaviour. Reliability is assessed through attribution accuracy, surrogate fidelity, faithfulness, stability, and consistency. We evaluate ConceptSMILE on retinal fundus images by comparing MedSAM-derived visual concepts with VLM-based semantic concepts. Results show that reliability varies across concepts and pathways: MedSAM achieves stronger spatial attribution and the highest surrogate fidelity ($R^2 = 0.8503$, $R_w^2 = 0.8465$), while the VLM pathway shows stronger vessel faithfulness and stronger stability under selected artefact conditions. ConceptSMILE provides an independent audit layer for evaluating the trustworthiness of concept-based XAI.

AI.tldr: ConceptSMILE 是一个模型无关的、基于扰动的审计框架，用于评估概念可解释人工智能（XAI）中概念级解释的可靠性。它通过扰动输入区域、测量概念响应偏移、应用局部性加权并拟合 XGBoost 代理模型来近似局部概念行为，从归因准确性、代理保真度、忠实性、稳定性和一致性五个维度评估可靠性。在视网膜眼底图像上的实验表明，MedSAM 视觉概念具有更强的空间归因和代理保真度（R²=0.8503），而 VLM 语义概念在血管忠实性和特定伪影下的稳定性方面更优。
AI.motivation: 概念级可解释 AI 虽然能使模型推理更符合人类理解，但概念级输出本身并非自动可信。现有方法缺乏独立、通用的审计机制来评估概念解释的可靠性，因此需要一种模型无关的审计框架来衡量概念级解释的可信度。
AI.method: ConceptSMILE 扩展了 SMILE 的基于扰动的逻辑，从特征或区域级别的归因审计升级到人类可理解的概念解释审计。具体流程为：扰动输入区域 → 测量概念响应的偏移 → 应用局部权重 → 拟合 XGBoost 代理模型以近似局部概念行为。可靠性评估使用五个指标：归因准确性、代理保真度（R² 和加权 R²）、忠实性、稳定性和一致性。实验将 MedSAM 导出的视觉概念与 VLM 导出的语义概念进行对比。
AI.result: 在视网膜眼底图像数据集上，MedSAM 视觉概念实现了更强的空间归因和最高的代理保真度（R²=0.8503，R_w²=0.8465），而 VLM 语义概念在血管结构的忠实性以及特定伪影条件下的稳定性方面表现更强。不同概念和路径下的可靠性存在差异，表明 ConceptSMILE 能够有效区分各类概念解释的可信度水平。
AI.conclusion: ConceptSMILE 为概念级 XAI 提供了一种独立的审计层，能够系统评估概念解释的可靠性。该框架模型无关且通用，有助于判断哪些概念解释更值得信赖，为可解释 AI 的可信度评估提供了新的工具和标准。

title: Correlation-Aware Contextual Bandits with Surrogate Rewards for LLM Routing
summary: We study contextual bandit problems with correlated arms and access to surrogate reward signals produced by a machine learning model, motivated by applications such as large language model (LLM) routing. Unlike classical contextual bandits that rely solely on bandit feedback and assume conditional independence across arms, our setting allows context-dependent inter-arm correlations and auxiliary reward information that may be noisy or misspecified. We propose algorithms that leverage such surrogate rewards through two complementary designs. A coupled reward-mixing approach pools true and surrogate rewards to accelerate learning when surrogate signals are reliable, while a decoupled prediction-mixing approach maintains separate estimators for bandit feedback and surrogate rewards and adaptively combines their predictions. This decoupling yields robustness to surrogate misspecification, recovering regret guarantees comparable to reward-only bandit methods in the worst case, while achieving improved regret when surrogate predictions are sufficiently informative. We provide theoretical regret analyses for both approaches and evaluate them on LLM routing benchmarks under varying accuracy versus cost trade-offs. The results demonstrate improved sample efficiency and consistently better accuracy-cost trade-offs compared to standard contextual bandit baselines and strong static routing methods.

AI.tldr: 本文研究具有臂间相关性和辅助替代奖励信号的上下文赌博机问题，受大语言模型路由等应用启发。提出了两种互补算法：耦合奖励混合方法（当替代信号可靠时加速学习）和解耦预测混合方法（鲁棒应对替代信号误设）。理论分析了遗憾界，并在LLM路由基准上验证了改进的样本效率和更优的准确率-成本权衡。
AI.motivation: 经典的上下文赌博机假设臂间条件独立性且仅依赖赌博机反馈，但在LLM路由等实际应用中，不同臂（如不同大小的LLM）之间存在上下文相关的相关性，且存在由机器学习模型产生的替代奖励信号（可能带有噪声或误设）。现有方法无法有效利用这些结构信息，因此需要设计能同时利用臂间相关性和辅助替代奖励来加速学习并鲁棒应对误设的新算法。
AI.method: 提出两种利用替代奖励的设计：1) 耦合奖励混合（coupled reward-mixing）：将真实奖励与替代奖励直接混合，在替代信号可靠时加速学习；2) 解耦预测混合（decoupled prediction-mixing）：分别维护赌博机反馈和替代奖励的估计器，并自适应地组合它们的预测，从而对替代信号的误设具有鲁棒性，在最坏情况下恢复仅依赖真实奖励的遗憾界。两种方法均提供了理论遗憾分析。
AI.result: 在LLM路由基准上的实验表明，所提方法在样本效率上优于标准上下文赌博机基线，并在准确率-成本权衡上始终优于静态路由方法。理论分析证明了两种方法的遗憾界，解耦方法在最坏情况下可与纯奖励方法相当，在替代信号足够好时则取得更优遗憾。
AI.conclusion: 本文展示了在上下文赌博机中，通过精心设计的耦合/解耦策略可以有效利用臂间相关性和替代奖励信号，在保持鲁棒性的同时提升学习效率。该工作对LLM路由等实际应用具有重要价值，并为更充分利用替代反馈的相关研究提供了理论框架和实用算法。

title: VTaMo: Video-Text Alignment Model for Sign Language Translation
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures, 8 tables. Accepted to ECCV 2026
summary: Sign language translation (SLT) converts continuous sign videos into spoken language text. Gloss-free approaches leverage pre-trained visual encoders and language models but rely on implicit cross-modal alignment from translation supervision alone. We present VTaMo, a framework that introduces explicit multi-granularity alignment at three levels: (1) local alignment via entropy-regularized optimal transport with a learnable null token for fine-grained frame-to-token correspondences; (2) global alignment via a learnable orthogonal transformation that calibrates embedding space geometry through Earth Mover's Distance; and (3) position-aligned contrastive learning for discriminative token-level representations. Experiments on Phoenix-2014T, CSL-Daily, How2Sign, and OpenASL demonstrate consistent state-of-the-art performance, with ablations confirming the complementary contributions of each component. Code is available at https://github.com/junyi2005/vtamo.

AI.tldr: VTaMo是一种面向手语翻译（SLT）的框架，通过引入显式的多粒度对齐（局部最优传输对齐、全局正交变换校准、位置对比学习），在多个数据集上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有无词汇（gloss-free）SLT方法依赖预训练编码器和语言模型，但仅靠翻译损失进行隐式跨模态对齐，缺乏显式、多粒度的对齐机制，导致模态对齐不充分。
AI.method: 提出VTaMo框架，包含三个显式对齐模块：(1) 局部对齐：基于熵正则化最优传输+可学习空标记，实现细粒度帧到词元对应；(2) 全局对齐：通过学习正交变换，利用Earth Mover's Distance校准嵌入空间几何；(3) 位置对齐对比学习：用于判别性token级表示。
AI.result: 在Phoenix-2014T、CSL-Daily、How2Sign、OpenASL四个数据集上取得一致的最优（SOTA）结果，消融实验验证了各组件的互补贡献。
AI.conclusion: 显式的多粒度对齐能有效提升无词汇手语翻译性能，局部、全局、位置三种对齐机制相互补充。

title: 4D Human-Scene Reconstruction from Low-Overlap Captures
comment: Accepted to SIGGRAPH Conference Papers '26. First two authors contributed equally. Project page: https://sisyphm.github.io/studiorecon-page/
summary: Existing volumetric capture of dynamic human performance achieves high fidelity with dense camera arrays. However, in real-world scenarios, only a handful of low-overlap cameras are available, which degrades the output quality and leaves large areas unobserved. Recent 4D reconstruction methods have focused on low-overlap settings, yet they still produce noticeable artifacts in under-observed regions. Video diffusion models have emerged as another option, but they show geometrically inconsistent results for humans. To address these limitations, we propose StudioRecon, a pipeline that reconstructs 4D human scenes from sparse, low-overlap cameras by decoupling background and humans. We densify background supervision by synthesizing hundreds of camera-controlled novel views with a video diffusion model. We also robustly initialize deformable Gaussian humans with cross-view identity association and triangulated multi-view keypoint fitting. Finally, our recursive enhancement module with motion-adaptive consistency injection harmonizes the composed output, thereby further avoiding remaining artifacts. We achieve state-of-the-art novel view synthesis across four real-world datasets and demonstrate applications such as novel trajectory rendering and human replacement.

AI.tldr: StudioRecon 提出了一种从稀疏、低重叠相机阵列中重建 4D 人体场景的管线，通过解耦背景与人体、利用视频扩散模型合成数百个相机可控新视角以稠密化背景监督、结合跨视角身份关联与三角化多视角关键点拟合鲁棒初始化可变形高斯人体、以及采用运动自适应一致性注入的递归增强模块来消除伪影，在四个真实数据集上实现了最先进的新视角合成效果，并展示了新颖轨迹渲染和人体替换等应用。
AI.motivation: 现有基于密集相机阵列的体积极捕捉方法能实现高保真动态人体重建，但实际场景中往往只有少量低重叠相机，导致输出质量下降并留下大量未观测区域。虽然最近的 4D 重建方法针对低重叠场景进行了优化，但仍会在欠观测区域产生明显伪影。视频扩散模型虽可作为替代方案，但在人体上会出现几何不一致的结果。因此需要一种能从稀疏低重叠相机中高质量重建 4D 人体场景的方法。
AI.method: StudioRecon 采用解耦背景与人体的策略，首先通过视频扩散模型合成数百个相机可控的新视角来稠密化背景监督；然后利用跨视角身份关联和三角化多视角关键点拟合来鲁棒初始化可变形高斯人体；最后通过一个带有运动自适应一致性注入的递归增强模块来融合输出并消除残存伪影。
AI.result: 在四个真实世界数据集上达到了最先进的新视角合成效果，并展示了新颖轨迹渲染和人体替换等应用。
AI.conclusion: StudioRecon 通过解耦背景与人体、扩散模型合成多视角、鲁棒初始化与递归增强，有效解决了稀疏低重叠相机下 4D 人体重建的难题，实现了高质量的新视角合成与多种应用。

title: Variable-Length Generative Protein Design via Generalized Poisson Flow
summary: The ability to generate variable-length proteins is crucial in protein design, where the optimal length is often unknown and tightly coupled to designability. Current diffusion- and flow-based generative models typically require the protein length to be specified before sampling, limiting their flexibility in exploring the feasible design space. To address this limitation, we introduce Generalized Poisson Flow (GPFlow), a variable-length generative framework that learns the rate function of an inhomogeneous generalized Poisson process by minimizing its negative log-likelihood. We establish population-level guarantees for recovering the joint multimodal distribution and derive an upper bound on the KL divergence between the data and generated distributions. We comprehensively evaluate GPFlow across structure and sequence design, motif scaffolding, and peptide co-design, spanning Euclidean, categorical, and Riemannian modalities to fully validate its variable-length generation quality. In unconditional design, GPFlow improves structural designability and achieves the best distributional fitness for sequence design compared to their corresponding fixed-length baselines, while perfectly recovering the length distribution. In conditional motif scaffolding, GPFlow ranks first on 10 of 16 structure-based design tasks with significantly more unique successes and also achieves more passed tasks in sequence-based design. In peptide co-design, GPFlow remains competitive even without access to a native-length oracle.

AI.tldr: GPFlow is a variable-length generative model for proteins based on an inhomogeneous generalized Poisson process, enabling length-agnostic sampling and outperforming fixed-length baselines in structure and sequence design tasks.
AI.motivation: Current diffusion- and flow-based generative models for proteins require the protein length to be specified before sampling, which limits flexibility in exploring the feasible design space where the optimal length is often unknown and tightly coupled to designability.
AI.method: GPFlow learns the rate function of an inhomogeneous generalized Poisson process by minimizing its negative log-likelihood. It establishes population-level guarantees for recovering the joint multimodal distribution and derives an upper bound on the KL divergence between the data and generated distributions.
AI.result: In unconditional design, GPFlow improves structural designability and achieves the best distributional fitness for sequence design while perfectly recovering the length distribution. In conditional motif scaffolding, it ranks first on 10 of 16 structure-based tasks with significantly more unique successes and achieves more passed tasks in sequence-based design. In peptide co-design, GPFlow remains competitive even without access to a native-length oracle.
AI.conclusion: GPFlow provides a flexible variable-length generation framework that effectively handles the coupling between length and designability, showing strong performance across multiple protein design modalities and tasks.

title: Learning More from Less: Reinforcement Learning from Hindsight
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly used to post-train vision-language-action (VLA) models, but every update consumes robot rollouts that are slow and costly to collect, making sample efficiency a central concern. Manipulation tasks typically provide only sparse rewards, so a weak policy fails almost every rollout early in training and has little to learn from, even when those failures execute coherent behavior. Such a failure, however, is a success at a different task. We present Learning from Hindsight (LfH), which brings hindsight relabeling to RL post-training of VLAs by scoring failed rollouts against the tasks they actually achieved. A single vision-language model relabels both the instruction and the reward, proposing a hindsight instruction for a group of failed rollouts and scoring how well each satisfies it, and the policy trains on the relabeled and original rollouts jointly. Because VLAs generalize across language, relabeling in language lets the policy learn more from the same trajectories. On out-of-distribution LIBERO-PRO tasks, where standard RL improves only slowly, LfH achieves $5\times$ improvement in sample efficiency, and outperforms a dense progress-reward baseline. The gains hold across VLA backbones and on a physical Franka robot.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Learning from Hindsight (LfH)方法，通过将失败的机器人轨迹重标定为其他任务的成功经验，利用视觉-语言模型同时重标定指令和奖励，显著提升VLA模型在RL后训练中的样本效率，在LIBERO-PRO任务上实现5倍改进。
AI.motivation: 强化学习后训练VLA模型时，机器人轨迹收集缓慢且成本高，样本效率至关重要。操作任务通常只提供稀疏奖励，弱策略在训练早期几乎所有轨迹都失败，而失败轨迹其实可能在其他任务上是成功的。因此需要利用这些失败的轨迹来提高样本效率。
AI.method: 提出LfH方法，将事后重标定引入VLA模型的RL后训练。用一个视觉-语言模型对一组失败轨迹同时重标定指令和奖励：提出事后指令（hindsight instruction）并评估每条轨迹对该指令的满足程度。策略同时在重标定后的轨迹和原始轨迹上联合训练。
AI.result: 在分布外的LIBERO-PRO任务上，标准RL提升缓慢，而LfH实现了5倍的样本效率提升，并超过了密集进度奖励基线。该优势在多个VLA骨干网络和真实的Franka机器人上均得到验证。
AI.conclusion: LfH通过语言空间的重标定，让VLA策略从相同的轨迹中学到更多，显著提升了样本效率，是一种有效的VLA模型后训练方法。

title: IB-Flow: Information Bottleneck-Guided CFG Distillation for Few-Step Text-to-Image Generation
summary: While large-scale text-to-image generative models have achieved unprecedented visual performance, their inherent reliance on multi-step iterative solvers incurs severe inference latency. Few-step distillation targeting the Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) trajectory has emerged as the prevalent dual-dimensional compression paradigm. However, existing frameworks remain subjugated by a coarse-grained blind injection paradigm that perpetually enforces a globally static guidance strength while indiscriminately sampling the supervisor timestep. This state-agnostic design completely disregards the intrinsic nature of image generation as a dynamic evolutionary process characterized by progressive entropy reduction, which not only restricts the performance boundary of few-step compression but also precipitates severe CFG over-conditioning artifacts. To transcend these limitations, we re-examine the distillation procedure through the theoretical lens of Information Theory, formally modeling it as a dynamic mutual information game constrained by the Information Bottleneck (IB) principle. Specifically, we dismantle traditional blind assumptions via a dual-track adaptive framework. To determine the injection target, we propose an instance-aware selection mechanism that transmutes the intractable KL divergence constraint into a zero-overhead closed-form solution predicated on the local vector field norm. To regulate the injection strength, we introduce an entropy-aware schedule that dynamically decays alongside the SNR, applying maximal thrust for initial structural anchoring before smoothly reverting to the natural manifold to refine micro-details. Extensive empirical evaluations corroborate that our framework fundamentally eradicates over-conditioning artifacts, shattering the performance ceiling to achieve SOTA generative fidelity under extremely stringent 2-step configurations.

AI.tldr: 本文针对文本到图像生成模型的多步迭代推理延迟问题，提出了一种基于信息瓶颈理论的双轨自适应蒸馏框架。该框架通过实例感知的注入目标选择和熵感知的注入强度调度，动态调整分类器自由引导（CFG）轨迹，从根本上消除了过条件伪影，在极严格的2步配置下实现了最先进的生成保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有少步蒸馏方法采用粗粒度的盲注入范式，使用全局静态引导强度且不加区分地采样监督时间步，忽略了图像生成是渐进熵减的动态演化过程。这种状态无关的设计不仅限制了少步压缩的性能边界，还会导致严重的CFG过条件伪影。因此，需要一种能感知生成动态过程的自适应蒸馏框架。
AI.method: 将蒸馏过程重新建模为受信息瓶颈（IB）原理约束的动态互信息博弈，提出双轨自适应框架：1）注入目标选择：将难解的KL散度约束转化为基于局部向量场范数的零开销闭式解，实现实例感知的注入点选取；2）注入强度调节：引入熵感知调度，沿信噪比（SNR）动态衰减，在初始结构锚定阶段施加最大推力，随后平滑回归自然流形以细化微观细节。
AI.result: 大量实证评估证实，该框架从根本上消除了过条件伪影，突破了性能上限，在极严格的2步配置下实现了最先进的生成保真度。
AI.conclusion: 通过信息瓶颈理论重新审视蒸馏过程，提出自适应双轨机制，有效解决现有盲注入范式的缺陷，为少步压缩蒸馏提供了新的理论视角和实用方法。

title: COBS: Cumulant Order Block Sparse Attention
summary: Block sparse attention is a hardware friendly way to alleviate the key-value (KV) cache read bottleneck in large language models (LLMs). However, it is not prevalent among leading open-weight LLMs, which rely instead on dense attention or fine-grained selection, thereby motivating our analysis. We study DeepSeek's Native Sparse Attention (NSA) as a representative method, whose three-branch design lets us isolate block selection, the most challenging and consequential stage. We formalize selection and reduce it to ranking blocks by a single quantity, the attention mass: the sum of a block's attention scores. We show that if selection retrieves the blocks with the largest attention mass, block sparse attention can match the quality of dense attention. However, computing the exact attention mass requires reading every key, so the problem of block selection ultimately reduces to approximating this mass from a compact summary instead of the full keys. Via a cumulant expansion, we show why existing methods falter: their selection strategies attempt to estimate the attention mass, but are confined to a first-order approximation. Therefore, we propose COBS (Cumulant Order Block Sparse Attention), an attention method that builds on NSA, incorporating a novel selector that stores a compressed second-order statistic per block. On the 32k RULER long-context retrieval benchmark, COBS raises the NSA baseline's mean score from 0.2999 to 0.8195, approaching dense attention at 0.9040 and closing about 86% of the gap, while using only 1.21x the KV cache read traffic of the NSA baseline and 15.15x less read traffic than dense. The same model preserves short-context behavior and attains lower position-wise negative log-likelihood (NLL) than dense attention in our comparison.

AI.tldr: Block sparse attention can match dense attention quality if block selection is based on attention mass, but exact computation requires all keys. Existing first-order approximations are insufficient. COBS uses compressed second-order statistics to approximate attention mass, achieving near-dense quality on long-context retrieval with substantially less KV cache read traffic.
AI.motivation: Block sparse attention is hardware-friendly but not widely adopted in leading open-weight LLMs, which prefer dense attention or fine-grained selection. The paper analyzes DeepSeek's NSA to isolate the block selection stage, aiming to understand why existing methods underperform and how to improve them.
AI.method: Formalizes block selection as ranking blocks by attention mass (sum of attention scores). Shows optimal selection (largest mass) matches dense quality. Proves via cumulant expansion that existing methods use only first-order approximations. Proposes COBS, which builds on NSA and stores a compressed second-order statistic per block to better estimate attention mass.
AI.result: On the 32k RULER long-context retrieval benchmark, COBS raises NSA baseline mean score from 0.2999 to 0.8195, approaching dense attention at 0.9040 (closing ~86% of the gap). Uses 1.21x the KV cache read traffic of NSA baseline and 15.15x less than dense. Preserves short-context behavior and achieves lower position-wise NLL than dense attention.
AI.conclusion: Block sparse attention with second-order selection can closely approach dense attention quality while maintaining significant efficiency gains, offering a practical path for long-context LLMs.

title: Super-Tuning: From Activation-Aware Pruning to Sparse Fine-Tuning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) remain expensive to fine-tune because full-parameter updates require substantial memory, compute, and per-task storage. We study whether saliency signals originally developed for pruning can be reused to choose where a model should adapt. We propose Super, a sparse parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) method that fixes a small trainable support using a Wanda-style activation-weighted magnitude score [Sun et al., 2023] computed from a calibration pass. We then introduce Supra, a hybrid adapter that combines this sparse update with LoRA while preserving a matched trainable-parameter budget through a simple budget-splitting rule. In single-seed Math17K arithmetic experiments on Llama-3.2-1B and Meta-Llama-3-8B, the best Super/Supra variants achieve the highest average accuracy among the tested schedule-selected adapter configurations. We also include a PaFi-style magnitude-only support as a closest training-free sparse baseline and find that low-score supports under both magnitude and Wanda-style orderings can be effective. These results suggest that simple pruning-inspired orderings can provide useful fixed sparse supports for PEFT, especially when combined with low-rank adapters.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种基于剪枝启发式排序的稀疏参数高效微调（PEFT）方法：Super（利用Wanda风格的激活加权幅度分数确定固定可训练支持）和Supra（将稀疏更新与LoRA结合的混合适配器），在Math17K算术任务上，最佳变体在预算匹配的适配器配置中取得最高平均准确率，表明剪枝启发式排序可为PEFT提供有效的固定稀疏支持。
AI.motivation: 全参数微调需要大量内存、计算和每任务存储，导致大型语言模型微调成本高昂，亟需更高效的参数高效微调方法。
AI.method: Super方法通过校准前向传播计算Wanda风格的激活加权幅度分数，据此选择一小部分参数作为可训练支持（固定稀疏更新）；Supra则通过简单的预算分配规则，在保持总可训练参数预算不变的前提下，将稀疏更新与LoRA低秩适配器结合，形成混合适配器。同时引入PaFi风格的纯幅度排序支持作为无训练稀疏基线。
AI.result: 在单种子Math17K算术实验（Llama-3.2-1B和Meta-Llama-3-8B）中，最佳Super/Supra变体在所有测试的调度选择适配器配置中取得了最高平均准确率。实验还发现，无论是基于幅度还是Wanda风格的排序，低分支持集也能有效工作。
AI.conclusion: 简单的剪枝启发式排序（如Wanda风格和纯幅度排序）可以为参数高效微调提供有用的固定稀疏支持，尤其在与低秩适配器结合时效果更佳。

title: Super-Generalist: Towards Comprehensive and Accurate Medical Image Understanding via Generalist-Specialist Synergy
summary: Medical images require comprehensive and accurate interpretation to support the diagnosis of diverse clincial conditions. Recent vision-language generalist models offer broad task coverage and promising zero-shot capabilities, yet often lack fine-grained anatomical and lesion awareness for reliable diagnosis and spatial interpretability. In contrast, supervised specialist models achieve strong performance on specific tasks but typically lack generalization across diseases and anatomies. In this work, we present SuG, a Super-Generalist framework that unifies generalist vision-language learning with specialist objectives, enabling both broad generalization and specialist-level diagnostic capability. We perform specialist-enhanced vision-language alignment in SuG by incorporating spatial priors from multiple segmentation experts, including anatomy, class-specific lesion and class-agnostic lesion segmentors that captures lesions beyond anatomies annotated during training. To improve lesion grounding capability, we leverage lesion masks as spatial priors to calibrate text-conditioned visual attention, encouraging disease-related semantics to focus on clinically relevant regions. We evaluate SuG on extensive chest and abdominal CT benchmarks, including CT-RATE, Merlin, MedVL-CT69K, and several in-house tumor datasets. SuG achieves state-of-the-art performance across a wide range of disease diagnosis tasks and surpasses specialist models on several critical tumor diagnosis benchmarks. Furthermore, SuG demonstrates strong lesion grounding capability, including robust generalization to lesion types lacking class-specific supervision.

AI.tldr: SuG 是一个超通用框架，统一了通用视觉语言学习与专用目标，实现了医学图像诊断的广泛泛化与专家级诊断能力。
AI.motivation: 医学图像需要全面准确的解读；通用模型缺乏细粒度解剖和病变意识，而专用模型缺乏跨疾病和跨解剖的泛化能力。SuG旨在弥合两者差距。
AI.method: SuG通过整合多个分割专家（解剖、类别特异性病变、类别无关病变）的空间先验，执行专用增强的视觉语言对齐。利用病变掩码作为空间先验校准文本条件视觉注意力，使疾病相关语义聚焦于临床相关区域。
AI.result: 在CT-RATE、Merlin、MedVL-CT69K及多个内部肿瘤数据集上取得最先进性能，在多个关键肿瘤诊断基准上超越专用模型，并展现出强大的病变定位能力，包括对缺乏类别监督的病变类型的稳健泛化。
AI.conclusion: SuG有效统一了通用与专用能力，实现了广泛的疾病诊断和精确的病变定位，为医学图像诊断提供了新的范式。

title: EvoLP: Self-Evolving Latency Predictor for Model Compression in Real-Time Edge Systems
comment: Author's accepted version. Published in IEEE Embedded Systems Letters
summary: Edge devices are increasingly utilized for deploying deep learning applications on embedded systems. The real-time nature of many applications and the limited resources of edge devices necessitate latency-targeted neural network compression. However, measuring latency on real devices is challenging and expensive. Therefore, this letter presents a novel and efficient framework, named EvoLP, to accurately predict the inference latency of models on edge devices. This predictor can evolve to achieve higher latency prediction precision during the network compression process. Experimental results demonstrate that EvoLP outperforms previous state-of-the-art approaches by being evaluated on three edge devices and four model variants. Moreover, when incorporated into a model compression framework, it effectively guides the compression process for higher model accuracy while satisfying strict latency constraints. We open source EvoLP at https://github.com/ntuliuteam/EvoLP.

AI.tldr: EvoLP是一个新颖高效的框架，用于准确预测深度学习模型在边缘设备上的推理延迟，并能在网络压缩过程中不断进化以提高预测精度。实验表明，EvoLP在三个边缘设备和四种模型变体上优于现有方法，并能有效指导模型压缩过程，在满足严格延迟约束的同时保持较高模型精度。
AI.motivation: 边缘设备资源有限且许多应用需要实时响应，因此需要进行延迟目标导向的神经网络压缩。然而，直接在真实设备上测量延迟既困难又昂贵，亟需一种高效准确的延迟预测方法。
AI.method: 提出EvoLP框架，它能够准确预测边缘设备上模型的推理延迟，并且在网络压缩过程中能够不断进化（自我更新）以提高延迟预测的精度。
AI.result: 在三个边缘设备和四种模型变体上的实验表明，EvoLP优于先前最先进的方法。当集成到模型压缩框架中时，它能有效引导压缩过程，在满足严格延迟约束的同时实现更高的模型准确率。
AI.conclusion: EvoLP是一种高效且可进化的延迟预测器，能有效解决边缘设备上模型压缩中的延迟估计难题，并已开源。

title: Mach-Mind-4-Flash Technical Report
summary: We present Mach-Mind-4-Flash, a 35B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) agentic model with 3B activated parameters. Through post-training optimization alone without scaling pre-training compute, the model achieves performance on par with or surpassing that of 100B-parameter-class models. By introducing scalable agentic interaction environments for large-scale reinforcement learning, the model attains significant performance gains on real-world application tasks. Our pipeline comprises three stages: (1) a unified RL/OPD training infrastructure with dynamic multi-teacher scheduling and operator-level acceleration, delivering 17\% end-to-end training speedup; (2) multiple domain-specific RL experts trained in parallel across Reasoning, General, and Agent tracks, then fused into a single generalist via Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD) -- a routed reverse-KL objective that eliminates the see-saw degradation of mixed-reward RL; (3) Hybrid Median-length Policy Optimization (HMPO), a single-stage token-efficiency method that compresses reasoning chains by 19--46\% with $\le$0.7 percentage-point accuracy loss. Mach-Mind-4-Flash scores 92.70 on AIME'26, 82.82 on IFBench, 80.74 on Behavioral-SafetyBench, 75.80 on BFCL-v4, 72.31 on BrowseComp-zh, and 84.20 on ClawBench -- leading or matching models with 10--30$\times$ its activated size at a fraction of the inference cost.

AI.tldr: Mach-Mind-4-Flash 是一个35B参数的MoE智能体模型（3B激活参数），仅通过后训练优化即达到或超越100B参数级别模型的性能。其核心创新包括：统一RL/OPD训练基础设施、多专家并行训练与多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）、以及混合中长序列策略优化（HMPO），在多个基准测试上领先或持平10-30倍激活参数量的模型。
AI.motivation: 在不扩展预训练计算量的前提下，通过后训练优化使小参数模型达到大模型的性能水平，解决大模型推理成本高昂的问题。
AI.method: 三阶段后训练流水线：(1) 统一RL/OPD训练基础设施，含动态多教师调度与算子级加速，实现17%端到端训练加速；(2) 多个领域专用RL专家（推理/通用/智能体）并行训练，通过多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）融合为通用模型，采用路由化反向KL散度消除混合奖励RL中的跷跷板退化；(3) 混合中长序列策略优化（HMPO），单阶段令牌效率方法，压缩推理链19-46%且准确率损失≤0.7个百分点。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上取得领先或持平成绩：AIME'26得分92.70、IFBench 82.82、Behavioral-SafetyBench 80.74、BFCL-v4 75.80、BrowseComp-zh 72.31、ClawBench 84.20，以极小推理成本匹配10-30倍激活参数量的模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过创新的后训练优化策略，小参数MoE模型可以实现与大模型相媲美的性能，为高效部署提供了可行路径。

title: Weaving Light and Time: Unified Harmonic-Geometric Representation Learning for Dense RGB-Event Parsing
summary: Fusing standard RGB frames with asynchronous event streams has emerged as a definitive paradigm for robust perception in degraded environments. Although unified backbones have recently gained traction in multi-modal vision, adapting them to the RGB-Event domain remains fundamentally challenging. Existing architectures either resort to decoupled dual encoders that double computational overhead, or adopt generic unified designs that fail to resolve implicit geometric parallax and cross-spectral aliasing under the extreme representational divide between dense intensity grids and sparse kinematic spikes. To transcend these bottlenecks, we present Evita, the first unified backbone specifically engineered for dedicated dense RGB-Event parsing. To achieve profound modal synergy, Evita explicitly embeds a suite of intrinsic co-learning modules directly into every encoder layer. Specifically, it features Geometric Parallax Rectification for adaptive spatial alignment, Harmonic Spectral Resonance for texture transfer exclusively in the complex frequency domain, and Transient Global Routing for event-driven asymmetric attention. To guarantee robust feature extraction against spatial misalignments and decouple representations from specific event encodings, we construct N-ImageNetV2 alongside a stochastic event representation mixing pretraining protocol, empowering the network to seamlessly accommodate arbitrary event formats in downstream tasks. Extensive evaluations across the DELIVER, DDD17, and DSEC benchmarks confirm that Evita establishes new state-of-the-art metrics while delivering a superior accuracy-latency trade-off for real-time multimodal perception.The code are publicly available at: https://github.com/chaineypung/Evita.

AI.tldr: Evita是首个专门为密集RGB-事件流联合解析设计的统一骨干网络，通过内嵌几何视差校正、谐波谱共振和瞬态全局路由等共学习模块，并配合N-ImageNetV2数据集和随机事件表征混合预训练协议，在多个基准上实现了最先进的精度-延迟平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有RGB-事件多模态感知方法要么采用解耦双编码器导致计算开销翻倍，要么采用通用统一设计但无法解决密集强度网格与稀疏运动尖峰之间的极差表征鸿沟所导致的隐式几何视差和跨光谱混叠问题。
AI.method: 提出Evita统一骨干网络，在每个编码器层内嵌三个共学习模块：(1) 几何视差校正模块实现自适应空间对齐；(2) 谐波谱共振模块在复数频域进行纹理迁移；(3) 瞬态全局路由实现事件驱动的非对称注意力。同时构建N-ImageNetV2数据集和随机事件表征混合预训练协议，解耦特征与特定事件编码格式。
AI.result: 在DELIVER、DDD17和DSEC三个基准上取得新的SOTA指标，并在实时多模态感知中实现优越的精度-延迟平衡。
AI.conclusion: Evita是首个专门为RGB-事件密集解析设计的统一骨干网络，通过内嵌共学习模块有效解决了模态融合中的几何与频谱问题，为实际部署提供了高效方案。

title: Pitfalls and Remedies for Multi-Task Bayesian Optimization
summary: Bayesian optimization routinely warm-starts a target experiment with data from related source tasks, and the multi-task Gaussian process is the textbook surrogate for the job. We revisit this default in a controlled setting and find that it misestimates the cross-task correlation even in the simplest non-trivial case, affinely related source and target tasks, where a working transfer learning method should obviously succeed. We trace the failure to two independent structural mechanisms. Per-task standardization, the textbook fix for the affine slice ambiguity, propagates a finite-sample alignment error into the recovered correlation. The marginal likelihood itself identifies the correlation only at a per-sample rate that a Gaussian process at non-overlapping designs further dilutes. We propose three conservative remedies that follow from the analysis: promoting per-task means and scales to model parameters, restricting the task covariance to non-negative correlations, and co-locating part of the source and target designs. Across synthetic multi-task problems and surrogate-based hyperparameter tuning transfer, these remedies recover the target-only baseline on the simple instances, while the broader failure persists on harder instances and across most rank-based and latent-context variants.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了贝叶斯优化中常用的多任务高斯过程迁移学习方法，发现即使在最简单的仿射相关源任务与目标任务情况下，该方法也会错误估计跨任务相关性。作者将失败归因于两个独立的结构性机制：每任务标准化带来的有限样本对齐误差，以及边际似然函数仅以每样本速率识别相关性，这在非重叠设计中进一步稀释。据此提出三种保守补救措施：将每任务均值和尺度提升为模型参数、限制任务协方差为非负相关、以及将部分源任务与目标任务设计共置。在合成多任务问题和基于代理的超参数调优迁移中，这些补救措施在简单实例上恢复了仅使用目标数据的基线性能，但在更困难的实例及大多数基于排序和潜在变量的变体上，更广泛的失败依然存在。
AI.motivation: 默认的多任务高斯过程在贝叶斯优化迁移学习中，即使在最简单仿射相关的源任务与目标任务情况下也会错误估计跨任务相关性，这违背了迁移学习方法应当成功的基本预期。作者希望揭示这一失败的根源并提出有效补救措施。
AI.method: 通过控制实验分析多任务高斯过程的两个结构性失败机制：1) 每任务标准化（针对仿射切片模糊性的标准修复）会传播有限样本对齐误差到恢复的相关性中；2) 边际似然仅以每样本速率识别相关性，且高斯过程在非重叠设计下进一步稀释该速率。基于分析提出三种保守补救措施：将每任务均值和尺度作为模型参数学习、限制任务协方差矩阵为非负相关、以及将部分源任务与目标任务设计点共置。
AI.result: 在合成多任务问题和基于代理的超参数调优迁移实验中，提出的补救措施在简单（仿射相关）实例上恢复了仅使用目标数据的基线性能，表明能够修复基本失败。但在更困难的实例及大多数基于排序和潜在变量的迁移学习变体上，同样的失败模式依然存在，表明问题尚未完全解决。
AI.conclusion: 多任务高斯过程的默认实践存在根本性缺陷，即使简单迁移场景也会失败。提出的保守修复方案在简单情况下有效，但更广泛的多任务迁移学习仍然面临挑战，需要进一步研究更鲁棒的方法。

title: Neural Collapse Is Forbidden: Information Floors in Language Models
summary: Within-class variance in language-model representations is commonly read as incomplete neural collapse. We argue it is allocated information storage, and that the allocation obeys a law. A one-line centering identity voids a family of simplex equiangular-tight-frame claims, including our own earlier ones; in dimensionless variance shares across 14 models, macro-category structure carries only 4-12% of representational variance and within-token context carries 79-91%, stable across a 100x parameter range. On the theory side, token-level weight decay penalizes a category in proportion to its type count, not its occurrence mass, reducing next-token prediction to an imbalanced K-class problem whose optimum orders category norms by type count. A converse floor, proved for binary categories, forces within-category dispersion to be at least proportional to the conditional mutual information I(token; context | category). The law holds: identity dispersion, not total variance, tracks this information across every tested model and partition, under a model-free estimate and even across models, where one model's information predicts another's dispersion; and over pretraining the category share overshoots, decays, and partially recovers, because the information it must carry never left.

AI.tldr: 本文提出语言模型表示中的类内方差并非不完全神经坍缩，而是分配的信息存储，并遵循一条定律。通过14个模型的分析，发现宏观类别结构仅占表示方差的4-12%，而词内上下文占79-91%。理论推导了权重衰减对类别范数的影响，并证明了类内离散度至少与条件互信息成正比。该定律在多个模型和预训练阶段中成立。
AI.motivation: 传统观点将语言模型表示中的类内方差视为不完全神经坍缩的迹象。本文旨在反驳这一解释，论证类内方差实际上是信息存储的分配，且这种分配服从某种定律，从而揭示表示空间中的信息结构。
AI.method: 对14个不同规模的语言模型进行表示方差分解，计算宏观类别和词内上下文的方差占比。理论分析方面，从token级权重衰减出发，推导其对类别范数的影响，将下一token预测视为不平衡K类问题，并证明二元类别中类内离散度与条件互信息I(token; context | category)的下界关系。通过跨模型和预训练阶段的实验验证定律。
AI.result: 宏观类别结构仅占表示方差的4-12%，词内上下文占79-91%，且跨100倍参数范围稳定。理论表明权重衰减按类型计数而非出现频率惩罚类别，最优类别范数按类型计数排序。类内离散度至少与条件互信息成正比。标识离散度（而非总方差）追踪该信息，跨模型和预训练阶段成立，一个模型的信息可预测另一个模型的离散度。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型表示中的类内方差是信息存储的分配，服从标识离散度与条件互信息之间的定律。该发现挑战了神经坍缩的解释，为理解表示学习中的信息分配提供了新视角。

title: What Pixels Are Enough? SEAMS: Sufficiency Saliency via MSE-Preservation Soft-Masks
summary: Saliency maps are most useful when they identify the image regions that are sufficient to preserve a model's behaviour. We introduce SEAMS, a sufficiency-based saliency method that directly optimises a soft mask using a preservation objective. Given a frozen differentiable model output, such as a class probability, CLS embedding, or token representation, SEAMS searches for a compact mask that preserves the selected output. The approach relies on a simple optimisation framework based on soft masks, a learnable budget, and a three-way image composite generated entirely from the query image. As a result, it requires no auxiliary distractor dataset, architecture-specific attribution mechanism, or differentiable top-k relaxation. Experiments with frozen ViT-S/16 and ConvNeXt models show that the same optimisation pipeline can generate object-level, class-conditioned, and token-level explanations by changing only the preserved target. The resulting masks are compact, interpretable, stable across random initialisations, and competitive on insertion and deletion benchmarks. Our results also indicate that different architectures often rely on different sufficient evidence while achieving similar preservation fidelity, highlighting the architecture-dependent nature of visual explanations.

AI.tldr: SEAMS 是一种基于充分性的显著性方法，通过优化软掩码来直接保留冻结模型的目标输出（如类别概率、CLS嵌入或token表示），无需辅助数据集或架构特定机制，生成的掩码紧凑、可解释且稳定，在插入/删除基准上表现优异，并揭示了不同视觉架构依赖不同充分证据的现象。
AI.motivation: 传统显著性方法通常关注模型对哪些区域敏感（必要性），但实际应用中更关心哪些区域足以维持模型行为。现有方法常依赖辅助数据集、架构特定机制或不可微分的 top-k 松弛，缺乏一个统一、简便且基于充分性的框架。
AI.method: SEAMS 采用一种简单的优化框架：利用软掩码、可学习的预算（控制掩码紧凑度）以及完全由查询图像生成的三路图像复合（前景、背景、混合），通过最大化保留目标输出的保真度来优化掩码。该方法仅需冻结的微分模型，不引入额外数据或架构修改。
AI.result: 在冻结的 ViT-S/16 和 ConvNeXt 模型上实验表明，仅改变保留目标（如类别概率、CLS嵌入、token表示），同一优化管道即可生成对象级、类别条件和 token 级解释。所得掩码紧凑、可解释、对随机初始化稳定，在插入和删除基准上具竞争力。不同架构在达到相似保真度时依赖不同的充分证据，说明视觉解释具有架构依赖性。
AI.conclusion: SEAMS 提供了一个简洁、统一且有效的基于充分性的显著图生成方法，揭示了模型解释的架构依赖性，为理解视觉模型行为提供了新工具。

title: A Survey on the Green Development of Large Models: From Resource-Efficient Architectures to Hardware-Software Co-Design
comment: This paper has been accepted by CJE (2026), paper homepage: https://cje.ejournal.org.cn/article/doi/10.23919/cje.2025.00.438
summary: The rapid expansion of large-scale AI models has led to significant performance breakthroughs across diverse domains, yet it has also raised critical concerns regarding computational costs, energy consumption, and environmental sustainability. This survey provides a comprehensive overview of the green development of large models, emphasizing resource-efficient architectures and full-stack hardware-software co-design. We systematically review recent advances in efficient model construction, including attention operator optimization, linear-complexity architectures, and model sparsification and merging, as well as training and deployment strategies such as data-efficient learning, parameter-efficient fine-tuning, and computational compression. Beyond algorithmic improvements, we explore energy-efficient AI hardware, including mainstream AI chips, memory optimization, cross-platform deployment, and sustainable infrastructure. Furthermore, we examine how large models are being applied to sustainability-critical domains such as DeepSeek, remote sensing interpretation, national-scale infrastructure, and global initiatives. Finally, we discuss key challenges and future directions, highlighting the need for continual learning paradigms, memory-centric hardware, and standardized evaluation protocols. This survey aims to offer a holistic roadmap toward sustainable, scalable, and socially responsible development of large models. Paper homepage: https://cje.ejournal.org.cn/article/doi/10.23919/cje.2025.00.438

AI.tldr: 本文综述了大模型绿色发展的资源高效架构与全栈软硬件协同设计，涵盖高效模型构建（注意力优化、线性复杂度架构、模型稀疏化与合并）、训练部署策略（数据高效学习、参数高效微调、计算压缩）、节能AI硬件（芯片、内存优化、跨平台部署）以及大模型在可持续性关键领域的应用，并讨论了持续学习范式、内存中心硬件和标准化评估等未来方向。
AI.motivation: 大模型在性能取得突破的同时，带来了巨大的计算成本、能源消耗和环境可持续性问题，亟需探索绿色、可持续的发展路径。
AI.method: 采用系统性综述方法，从高效模型构建（注意力算子优化、线性复杂度架构、模型稀疏化与合并）、训练部署策略（数据高效学习、参数高效微调、计算压缩）、节能AI硬件（AI芯片、内存优化、跨平台部署、可持续基础设施）以及大模型在可持续关键领域的应用等多个维度进行全面梳理。
AI.result: 系统整理了大模型绿色发展的关键技术进展，包括注意力优化、线性复杂度架构、模型稀疏化与合并、数据高效学习、参数高效微调、计算压缩技术，以及主流AI芯片、内存优化、跨平台部署和可持续基础设施等方面的成果。
AI.conclusion: 大模型的绿色发展需要持续学习范式、内存中心硬件和标准化评估协议等未来方向的支持，旨在为可持续、可扩展且具有社会责任的大模型发展提供整体路线图。

title: TSR-Ego: Temporally Guided Stereo Refinement Framework for Egocentric 3D Human Pose Estimation
summary: Egocentric 3D human pose estimation from head-mounted stereo cameras is challenging due to fisheye distortion, severe self-occlusion, and frequent truncation of body joints outside the camera field of view. Recent stereo egocentric methods have improved performance through heatmap lifting, stereo correspondence, and transformer-based refinement, but they often rely heavily on frame-local evidence or use temporal information only as auxiliary pose-level context. This limits robustness when current-frame stereo cues are weak, occluded, or ambiguous. We propose TSR-Ego, a temporally guided stereo framework that couples short-term motion evidence with projection-guided feature sampling. The model first enriches dense stereo feature maps using a causal depthwise-separable temporal convolution, allowing past visual evidence to influence the feature space before deformable cross-attention. A single-stage causal stereo decoder then refines learned 3D joint queries through temporal self-attention, joint self-attention, and fisheye deformable stereo cross-attention, using the evolving pose estimate to generate 2D sampling references. Unlike methods that apply temporal reasoning mainly after pose prediction, TSR-Ego uses motion context to shape both the sampled stereo features and the joint representations while preserving online inference without future frames. Experiments on UnrealEgo2 and UnrealEgo-RW show state-of-the-art performance, with especially strong gains on real-world sequences.

AI.tldr: 提出TSR-Ego，一种用于头戴式立体相机的自我中心3D人体姿态估计的时序引导立体框架。该方法通过因果深度可分离时间卷积丰富立体特征图，并结合单阶段因果立体解码器（包含时间自注意力、关节自注意力和鱼眼可变形立体交叉注意力），在保持在线推理的同时，利用运动上下文指导特征采样和关节表示，在UnrealEgo2和UnrealEgo-RW上达到最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有自我中心立体姿态估计方法过度依赖单帧局部证据，或仅将时序信息作为辅助的pose-level上下文，当当前帧的立体线索较弱、存在遮挡或模糊时鲁棒性不足。需要一种能够更有效地利用时序信息来增强立体特征和关节表示的方法。
AI.method: 提出TSR-Ego框架：1）使用因果深度可分离时间卷积（causal depthwise-separable temporal convolution）在可变形交叉注意力之前丰富密集立体特征图，使过去视觉证据影响特征空间；2）单阶段因果立体解码器，通过时间自注意力、关节自注意力和鱼眼可变形立体交叉注意力迭代优化学习到的3D关节查询，利用不断演化的姿态估计生成2D采样参考点；3）整个框架保持在线推理，不使用未来帧。
AI.result: 在UnrealEgo2和UnrealEgo-RW数据集上达到最先进性能，特别是在真实世界序列上表现突出。
AI.conclusion: TSR-Ego通过在特征层面和关节表示层面同时引入时序信息（而非仅在姿态预测后使用时序推理），显著提升了自我中心立体姿态估计在困难场景下的鲁棒性和精度。

title: EXHOLD: Experience-Aware Real-Time Hold Control for Large-Scale Ride-Hailing Matching at DiDi
summary:
In large-scale ride-hailing, hold control is a critical mechanism for improving passenger-driver experience. By selectively delaying certain driver-order pairs, the system waits for better opportunities, reduces cancellations, and mitigates wasted driver effort. However, existing industrial hold strategies often rely on heuristic thresholding over multiple predictive models, which can be brittle under non-stationary traffic and hard to optimize for multi-objective experience signals.
  We propose EXHOLD, a deployable two-stage framework decoupling experience-aware pair assessment from hold-time execution. In Stage I, we learn a decision model assigning each driver-order pair to discrete, interpretable experience tiers by optimizing a unified objective that aggregates satisfaction signals across the matching funnel. In Stage II, we solve for a monotone hold-time schedule via constrained optimization over empirical quantiles. This explicitly enforces service guardrails bounding the unnecessary holding of promising matches while maximizing overall experience improvement.
  We evaluate EXHOLD through randomized A/B experiments in DiDi's production system in Brazil. Results show consistent gains in marketplace efficiency and experience: EXHOLD increases trip completion and driver income, significantly reduces passenger cancellations, and improves funnel efficiency. Ablations and behavioral analyses confirm both stages are essential and that the policy makes calibrated decisions under spatiotemporal heterogeneity. EXHOLD is currently deployed, serving production traffic in Brazil.

AI.tldr: EXHOLD 是一个两阶段的网约车 hold 控制框架，通过解耦体验评估与等待时间执行，实现多目标优化。在 DiDi 巴西生产环境的 A/B 实验中，该方法显著提升了订单完成率、司机收入和漏斗效率，同时减少了乘客取消。
AI.motivation: 现有的工业界 hold 策略通常依赖基于多个预测模型的启发式阈值，这在非平稳交通条件下表现脆弱，且难以针对多目标体验信号进行优化。
AI.method: EXHOLD 分为两个阶段：阶段 I 学习一个决策模型，将每个司机-订单对分配到离散、可解释的体验等级，通过聚合匹配漏斗中的满意度信号来优化统一目标；阶段 II 通过基于经验分位数的约束优化求解单调的 hold 时间调度，显式执行服务护栏以限制不必要地延迟有前景的匹配，同时最大化整体体验改善。
AI.result: 在 DiDi 巴西生产系统上的随机 A/B 实验表明，EXHOLD 持续提升了市场效率和体验：增加了订单完成量和司机收入，显著减少了乘客取消，并提高了漏斗效率。消融实验和行为分析证实了两个阶段都是必要的，且策略在时空异质性下做出了校准的决策。
AI.conclusion: EXHOLD 已部署并服务于巴西的生产流量，证明了该框架在实际大规模系统中的有效性和稳健性。

title: Causally Debiased Latent Action Model for Embodied Action Conditioned World Models
summary: Action-conditioned world models (ACWMs) aim to simulate future observations conditioned on embodied actions, offering a promising foundation for robot planning, policy evaluation, and data augmentation. However, learning controllable ACWMs requires large-scale action-labeled data, which remains costly to collect in the real world. Latent action models (LAMs) mitigate this bottleneck by inferring latent actions from unlabeled videos, but existing LAMs are typically trained with reconstruction-only objectives and therefore entangle action-relevant dynamics with action-irrelevant visual factors such as backgrounds and untouched objects. In this work, we identify this action-irrelevant bias as a key obstacle to controllable ACWMs and introduce evaluation metrics to measure latent-action bias, action following, and robustness. We propose CD-LAM, a causally debiased framework for LAM-based ACWMs. CD-LAM introduces three efficient fine-tuning objectives: embodiment-centric reconstruction, action-centric contrastive learning, and latent space calibration, which together encourage embodiment-focused, action-aware, and calibrated non-collapsed latent action representations. Experiments on 2B and 14B ACWM backbones show that CD-LAM substantially improves latent-action controllability, downstream robot-action following, visual fidelity, and adaptation efficiency, requiring only 6k fine-tuning steps and more than 12$\times$ fewer robot-action adaptation updates than the baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CD-LAM，一个因果去偏框架，通过三种高效微调目标（以具身为中心的 reconstruction、以动作为中心的对比学习、潜空间校准）解决潜动作模型中动作无关偏差问题，显著提升动作条件世界模型的可控性和适应性，仅需6k步微调即可实现超越基线的性能。
AI.motivation: 动作条件世界模型（ACWMs）依赖大规模动作标注数据，成本高昂；潜动作模型（LAMs）虽能从无标签视频中推断潜动作，但其仅使用重建目标训练，导致动作相关动态与动作无关视觉因素（如背景、未触碰物体）纠缠不清，形成动作无关偏差，阻碍了可控ACWMs的实现。
AI.method: CD-LAM引入三种高效微调目标：(1) 以具身为中心的重建（embodiment-centric reconstruction），聚焦智能体自身变化；(2) 以动作为中心的对比学习（action-centric contrastive learning），增强动作感知表征；(3) 潜空间校准（latent space calibration），防止潜空间坍塌。三者共同促进具身聚焦、动作感知且校准的非坍塌潜动作表征。
AI.result: 在2B和14B规模的ACWM骨干上实验表明，CD-LAM显著提升了潜动作可控性、下游机器人动作跟随能力、视觉保真度和适应效率。仅需6k步微调，且相比基线减少了12倍以上的机器人动作适应更新次数。
AI.conclusion: CD-LAM有效解决了LAM中的动作无关偏差问题，为高效学习可控动作条件世界模型提供了可行方案，大幅降低了机器人规划与策略评估中的数据标注成本。

title: Quantum Circuits in Diffusion Models: A Fair-Comparison Study and a Mechanistic Analysis of Angle-Embedding Failures
summary: We study the integration of variational quantum circuits (VQCs) into diffusion models through a squeeze-and-excitation (SE) channel-modulation scaffold that isolates the quantum contribution. Using a role-matched classical control and multi-seed significance testing across DDPM and latent diffusion on MNIST and CIFAR-10, with a score-based NCSN study on MNIST, we find that quantum cores achieve comparable mean FID to the classical control across DDPM and latent diffusion, while paired sampling-seed tests for EfficientSU2 detect no statistically significant difference. Although the quantum cores use $4.5$--$9\times$ fewer core parameters than the role-matched control, parameter-matched classical controls attain comparable mean FID, so the experiments do not establish a quantum parameter-efficiency advantage. We further identify a structural failure in score-based NCSN: the unbounded score target, proportional to $1/σ$, drives angle-embedding inputs far beyond the $2π$ period of rotation gates, causing phase aliasing and collapse of the quantum modulator. A bounding transformation, $θ\leftarrow π\tanh(\cdot)$, maps inputs to the non-aliasing domain and substantially improves both quantum cores. Since all circuits are classically simulated at a few-qubit scale, we do not claim quantum advantage. Instead, the study provides a fair-comparison protocol for quantum-enhanced generative models and a mechanistic account of when and why angle embeddings fail.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了变分量子电路（VQCs）与扩散模型的集成，通过挤压激励（SE）通道调制框架隔离量子贡献。在DDPM和潜在扩散（MNIST和CIFAR-10）以及基于分数的NCSN（MNIST）上，通过角色匹配的经典控制和多种子显著性测试，发现量子核心在DDPM和潜在扩散中实现了与经典控制相当的平均FID。尽管量子核心使用的核心参数比角色匹配控制少4.5-9倍，但参数匹配的经典控制也达到了相当的FID，因此实验未能证明量子参数效率优势。此外，研究发现了基于分数的NCSN中的结构性失败：无界分数目标（与1/σ成正比）驱动角度嵌入输入远超旋转门的2π周期，导致相位混叠和量子调制器崩溃。通过边界变换θ←π tanh(·)将输入映射到非混叠域，显著改善了量子核心。由于所有电路都在几量子比特尺度上经典模拟，因此不声称量子优势。该研究提供了量子增强生成模型的公平比较协议，以及角度嵌入何时及为何失败的机制性解释。
AI.motivation: 当前缺乏公平、严谨的协议来比较量子增强生成模型与经典基线，且对于变分量子电路在扩散模型中的应用效果及其潜在优势（如参数效率）缺乏系统性评估。此外，角度嵌入在基于分数的模型中的失效机制尚未被充分理解。
AI.method: 通过挤压激励（SE）通道调制框架将VQCs集成到扩散模型中，使用角色匹配的经典控制进行多种子显著性测试，在DDPM、潜在扩散和基于分数的NCSN上评估。针对NCSN中的角度嵌入崩溃问题，提出边界变换θ←π tanh(·)进行修复。
AI.result: 量子核心在DDPM和潜在扩散中实现了与经典控制相当的FID；量子核心参数更少但未显示出参数效率优势（参数匹配的经典控制FID相当）；在基于分数的NCSN中发现角度嵌入因分数目标无界而崩溃，边界变换可显著改善。
AI.conclusion: 该研究未证明量子优势（因经典模拟），但提供了一个公平比较量子增强生成模型的协议，并揭示了角度嵌入在基于分数的模型中的根本性失效机制及修复方法。

title: HiHR: Hierarchical Hyperbolic Representation for Aerial-Ground Person Re-Identification
comment: Accepted by ECCV2026. More modifications may be performed
summary: Aerial-Ground Person Re-IDentification (AG-ReID) aims to retrieve the same person across heterogeneous aerial and ground camera platforms. Although great progress has been made, existing methods remain suboptimal due to the direct feature alignment across views, overlooking view-specific cues. To address this issue, we propose a novel Hierarchical Hyperbolic Representation (HiHR) framework for AG-ReID. More specifically, we first extract multi-granularity features based on pre-trained visual-text encoders. Then, we propose a Text-guided Multi-granularity Fusion (TMF) to fuse multi-granularity features and enhance the representation ability of identity features. Furthermore, we introduce the Hierarchical Hyperbolic Learning (HHL) to construct a hierarchical feature structure in a hyperbolic space. This hierarchy includes a coarse level that ensures identity separability and cross-view consistency, and a fine level that preserves view-specific discriminative cues. As a result, our proposed framework can effectively aggregate view-invariant and view-specific discriminative features for AG-ReID. Extensive experiments on four AG-ReID benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework. The source code is available at https://github.com/YangQiWei3/HiHR.

AI.tldr: 提出层次化双曲表示（HiHR）框架，通过文本引导的多粒度融合和层次化双曲学习，在双曲空间中构建包含粗粒度（身份可分离与跨视角一致）和细粒度（视角特定判别线索）的层次特征结构，有效聚合视角不变与视角特定特征，在四个AG-ReID基准上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有空地跨视角行人重识别方法直接进行特征对齐，忽略了视角特定线索，导致性能次优。
AI.method: 1) 基于预训练视觉-文本编码器提取多粒度特征；2) 提出文本引导的多粒度融合（TMF）增强身份特征表示；3) 提出层次化双曲学习（HHL），在双曲空间中构建粗粒度（身份可分离与跨视角一致）和细粒度（视角特定判别线索）的层次特征结构。
AI.result: 在四个AG-ReID基准数据集上的大量实验证明了框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: HiHR框架通过层次化双曲表示有效聚合视角不变与视角特定判别特征，解决了AG-ReID中直接特征对齐忽视视角线索的问题。

title: Power Flow Feasibility Assessment Using Variational Graph Autoencoders
summary: Data-driven methods, including graph neural networks, have been studied for accelerating power flow calculations in recent years, but very little attention has been paid to the solution feasibility, which can be obtained by traditional solvers. This paper presents a Variational Graph Autoencoder (VGAE) that detects the power flow solution feasibility, using the IEEE 118-bus case, to assess the validity of the solutions provided by AI-driven solvers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用变分图自编码器（VGAE）检测潮流解的可行性，并在IEEE 118节点系统上验证其评估AI驱动求解器提供解的有效性。
AI.motivation: 数据驱动方法（如图神经网络）虽被用于加速潮流计算，但很少关注解的可行性，而传统求解器可保证可行性。因此需要一种方法检测AI驱动求解器所得解的可行性。
AI.method: 采用变分图自编码器（VGAE）来检测潮流解是否可行，并在IEEE 118节点标准算例上进行实验。
AI.result: VGAE能够有效检测AI驱动求解器提供潮流解的可行性，评估其有效性。
AI.conclusion: VGAE为数据驱动潮流求解器的解可行性检测提供了一种可行方案，有助于提升AI方法在电力系统应用中的可靠性。

title: YeTI: You Only Need Two Noisy Images for Real-World sRGB Noise Generation
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Includes supplementary material
summary: Real-world sRGB image denoising remains challenging due to the nonlinear characteristics of sensor noise and the difficulty of acquiring aligned clean-noisy image pairs. Supervised denoisers often overfit to limited paired datasets, while self-supervised methods still depend on sufficiently diverse noisy observations. These limitations motivate scalable noise synthesis methods that can model real-world noise without clean ground truth or camera metadata. We propose YeTI, a real-world sRGB noise generation framework that learns from only two noisy observations of the same scene. YeTI uses a Reconstruction Autoencoder to disentangle scene structure and noise characteristics, and models the latent noise distribution with a one-step Conditional Diffusion Transformer trained using consistency objectives. Given a single noisy input at inference time, YeTI generates realistic, signal-dependent noise while preserving the underlying scene content. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of YeTI across real-world benchmarks. We evaluate noise generation on SIDD and further assess generalization on SIDD+, MAI2021, and SID, covering smartphone and diverse consumer-camera sensors. Downstream denoising results on DND further show that denoisers trained with YeTI-synthesized images achieve strong real-world performance, highlighting the practical value of clean-image-free and metadata-free noise generation.

AI.tldr: YeTI提出了一种仅需同一场景两张带噪观测即可学习真实sRGB噪声生成的方法，利用重建自编码器解耦场景结构与噪声，并通过一致性训练的扩散Transformer建模噪声潜分布，在无干净图像和元数据的条件下生成逼真的信号相关噪声，下游去噪任务验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 真实sRGB图像去噪面临传感器噪声非线性特性以及干净-噪声对齐图像对难以获取的挑战。监督方法易过拟合于有限的配对数据，自监督方法仍依赖足够多样的噪声观测。现有局限促使需要一种无需干净真值和相机元数据即可建模真实噪声的可扩展合成方法。
AI.method: YeTI框架包含两个核心组件：1) 重建自编码器（Reconstruction Autoencoder），用于解耦场景结构与噪声特征；2) 基于一致性目标训练的单步条件扩散Transformer（Conditional Diffusion Transformer），用于建模潜空间中的噪声分布。推理时仅需单张含噪输入即可生成逼真的信号相关噪声。
AI.result: 在SIDD上进行噪声生成评估，并在SIDD+、MAI2021、SID上验证泛化能力（覆盖智能手机和多种消费级相机传感器）。下游去噪实验在DND基准上表明，使用YeTI合成图像训练的去噪器达到了很强的真实世界性能。
AI.conclusion: YeTI证明了无需干净图像和相机元数据的噪声生成方法的实用价值，为真实世界去噪提供了可扩展的数据增强方案。

title: Present but Rescaled: Chat-to-Agent Transfer of Additive Activation Steering
summary: Additive activation steering (injecting a scaled residual-stream direction during generation) is calibrated almost entirely in single-turn chat, yet the models it targets are increasingly deployed as tool-using ReAct agents. We present the first systematic chat-to-agent transfer study of additive steering, coupling behavioral measurement with a representation read-out in a matched-information design: the same items rendered as plain chat or as a ReAct tool-use episode, with matched-norm random-direction controls and the transcript re-encoded every turn to exclude KV-cache contamination. Transfer is real but rescaled, and the right description is a dissociation: the injected direction reaches the late layers at near-full strength in every setting and model tested (install-site agent-over-chat ratios 0.83-1.16 across three families), while the behavioral coupling is reset per model and context. On Qwen2.5-7B a refusal bypass vector amplifies in the agent (T = 1.45, CI [1.20, 1.78], N = 300); across a powered uniform-protocol distribution the coupling spans amplification (Gemma-2-9B T = 2.00) to attenuation (Yi-1.5-9B T = 0.43, CI [0.29, 0.60]), with no universal constant and a single clean attenuator against a universal sign. Directional ablation of the same axis does not amplify (T = 0.93, CI including 1) while additive injection amplifies (T = 1.50), a 20.1-point gain difference (CI [13.4, 26.8]) that identifies an additive-specific mechanism. Two pre-registered instruments converge to localize the rescaling to the ReAct format scaffold, before any tool observation, rather than to the observation boundary where a dilution account would predict it. The safety implication is immediate and unpredictable: agentic deployment amplifies steering-based refusal bypass by up to 2.00x on some models while others attenuate, so a deployment cannot assume a given model is safe under additive steering.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文首次系统研究了加法激活引导（additive steering）从单轮对话（chat）迁移到工具使用代理（ReAct agent）场景中的行为。研究发现，引导方向在模型深层几乎完全传递（代理/对话比率0.83-1.16），但行为耦合效果因模型和上下文而异：拒绝绕过向量在Qwen2.5-7B上放大（T=1.45），在Gemma-2-9B上放大（T=2.00），在Yi-1.5-9B上衰减（T=0.43）。重新缩放定位在ReAct格式框架（format scaffold）层面，而非工具观测边界。安全启示：代理部署不可预测地改变引导效果，不能假定某模型在加法引导下是安全的。
AI.motivation: 加法激活引导主要在单轮对话场景中校准，但目标模型越来越多地被部署为使用工具的ReAct代理。目前缺乏对加法引导从对话到代理场景迁移的系统研究。
AI.method: 采用匹配信息设计（matched-information design），将相同内容分别呈现为普通对话和ReAct工具使用场景，使用匹配范数的随机方向控制，每轮重新编码转录以排除KV-cache污染。通过行为测量和表征读出（representation read-out）相结合，检验引导效果的迁移情况。
AI.result: 引导方向在深层几乎完全传递（安装位点代理/对话比率0.83-1.16）。行为耦合被每个模型和上下文重置：拒绝绕过在Qwen2.5-7B上放大（T=1.45），Gemma-2-9B上放大（T=2.00），Yi-1.5-9B上衰减（T=0.43）。定向消融（ablation）不放大（T=0.93），而加法注入放大（T=1.50），增益差20.1点。重新缩放定位在ReAct格式框架，而非观测边界。
AI.conclusion: 代理部署会不可预测地改变加法引导的效果——某些模型放大拒绝绕过达2.00倍，另一些则衰减。因此，不能在加法引导下假设某模型安全，这具有直接的安全启示。

title: Glob3R: Global Structure-from-Motion with 3D Foundation Models
summary: Recent 3D geometric foundation models, such as VGGT, provide robust feed-forward 3D reconstruction by directly predicting camera poses and 3D scene points from input images. However, their results remain inaccurate, and scaling them to long sequences or large unordered image sets typically requires chunk-wise processing, which can introduce drift and inconsistency. We present Glob3R, a global SfM-style reconstruction built on 3D foundation models. Our key idea is to explicitly optimize feed-forward geometric predictions. To this end, we augment a frozen Pi3X backbone with a lightweight dense matching head that predicts image warps between selected reference frames and neighboring views. These dense warps are converted into sparse but reliable multi-view feature tracks, which provide correspondence constraints for global optimization. We further introduce a keyframe-based sliding-window association strategy that propagates tracks and relative poses across overlapping windows, enabling scalable reconstruction. Finally, we perform global motion averaging and bundle adjustment to refine camera poses, reduce scale inconsistencies, and recover dense scene geometry. Extensive experiments on indoor, outdoor, large-scale driving, and unordered SfM benchmarks demonstrate that Glob3R achieves robust and accurate reconstruction. It consistently improves over feed-forward foundation-model baselines and recent scalable reconstruction methods, while being more robust than classical SfM pipelines. The refined poses also lead to higher-quality neural rendering, validating the benefit of combining foundation-model priors with global geometric optimization. Project page: https://junyuandeng.github.io/Glob3r

AI.tldr: Glob3R提出了一种基于3D基础模型的全局SfM风格三维重建方法，通过冻结Pi3X骨干网络并添加轻量级密集匹配头来预测图像扭曲，将其转化为稀疏但可靠的多视图特征轨迹，再结合滑动窗口关联策略和全局运动平均与光束法平差优化，从而在室内外、大规模驾驶和无序SfM基准上实现比现有基础模型和经典SfM更鲁棒、更精确的重建，并提升神经渲染质量。
AI.motivation: 现有3D几何基础模型（如VGGT）虽能前馈预测相机位姿和场景点，但结果不够精确，且处理长序列或大规模无序图像集时需要分块处理，导致漂移和不一致性。
AI.method: (1) 冻结Pi3X骨干网络，附加轻量级密集匹配头，预测参考帧与邻帧之间的图像扭曲；(2) 将密集扭曲转换为稀疏可靠的多视图特征轨迹，为全局优化提供对应约束；(3) 提出基于关键帧的滑动窗口关联策略，跨重叠窗口传播轨迹和相对位姿，实现可扩展重建；(4) 执行全局运动平均和光束法平差，优化相机位姿、消除尺度不一致并恢复稠密场景几何。
AI.result: 在室内、室外、大规模驾驶和无序SfM基准测试中，Glob3R在鲁棒性和精度上均优于前馈基础模型基线和近期可扩展重建方法，且比经典SfM管线更鲁棒；优化的位姿还提升了神经渲染质量。
AI.conclusion: 将基础模型先验与全局几何优化相结合，能够有效克服纯前馈方法的精度不足和分块处理的漂移问题，实现鲁棒且可扩展的三维重建。

title: A Personalized Computational Framework for Assessing the Sufficiency of Partially Observed Data in Healthcare AI models
summary: Achieving early and timely diagnosis and treatment for disease is a major challenge. Recent applications of machine learning (ML) algorithms trained on patient data have shown promise in many different settings for predicting the patient health state. A challenge often faced when applying these ML algorithms is that at any given time, not all clinical variables (features) needed as input to perform prediction tasks are available. We define the concept of full-feature-capacity (FFC) to refer to prediction performance when such algorithms make use of all features on which they were trained. We then introduce Feature Sufficiency Analysis (FSA) - an analysis for determining whether a subset of all clinical features needed by an AI model is sufficient to achieve FFC. FSA estimates the underlying distributions of missing variables conditioned on features that are available. FSA provides a patient-specific assessment of whether the existing set of measured features achieves FFC. If yes, then there is no need to acquire further inputs and a ML-based prediction. We provide two case studies: prediction of need for postoperative prolonged ventilation in patients recovering from heart surgery; 10-year mortality prediction in an outpatient cohort. We also demonstrate that FSA also provides a clinically interpretable feature-ranking methodology based on prediction sufficiency, identifies intrinsically hard-to-predict patient populations, and has the potential to perform cost-aware optimization for clinical data acquisition. FSA provides a generic computational approach for determining whether incomplete clinical information is sufficient to support trustworthy AI-assisted clinical decision-making, thereby facilitating the prospective deployment of healthcare AI systems across diverse clinical settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出特征充分性分析（FSA），用于判断在机器学习预测中，当前可用的临床特征子集是否足以达到全特征容量（FFC）的预测性能，从而避免获取额外不必要的特征。FSA通过估计缺失变量在给定可用特征下的条件分布，实现患者级别的充分性评估。在术后长期通气和十年死亡率预测两个案例中验证了有效性，并展示了特征排序、识别难以预测的患者群体以及成本感知数据采集优化等能力。
AI.motivation: 应用机器学习进行疾病预测时，常面临临床变量（特征）不全的问题，而现有算法通常需要完整特征才能达到最佳性能。如何判断已有特征是否足够做出可靠预测，以避免不必要的额外数据采集，是一个关键挑战。
AI.method: 定义全特征容量（FFC）概念，提出特征充分性分析（FSA），通过估计缺失变量在已有特征条件下的分布，对每个患者判断当前特征集是否足以达到FFC水平的预测性能。
AI.result: 在心外科术后长期通气需求预测和门诊患者十年死亡率预测两个案例中验证了FSA的有效性。FSA还能提供基于预测充分性的临床可解释特征排序，识别内在难以预测的患者群体，并支持成本感知的临床数据采集优化。
AI.conclusion: FSA提供了一种通用计算方法，用于判断不完整的临床信息是否足以支持可信的AI辅助临床决策，从而促进医疗AI系统在不同临床场景中的前瞻性部署。

title: AnythingReality: Robust Online Gaussian Splatting SLAM for Open-Vocabulary VR Scene Exploration
summary: We present a novel integrated architecture for robust online 3D Gaussian splatting, real-time VR exploration, and speech-driven Vision-Language-Model interaction. Unlike methods assuming clean depth or external poses, our system combines ORB-SLAM3-based pose estimation with online Gaussian reconstruction for noisy real-world data. A VR pipeline enables immersive exploration of incremental reconstructions; a semantic module transcribes voice commands, generates scene descriptions, and records points of interest. Against state-of-the-art online Gaussian splatting methods, we improve image quality on our dataset (+14.5% PSNR, +8.6% SSIM, -14.3% LPIPS) and TUM-RGBD (+11.7% PSNR, +7.8% SSIM, -21.6% LPIPS), with comparable or superior frame rates via quality-speed configurations. We achieve an 88% VLM object-recognition rate.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种集成鲁棒在线3D高斯泼溅、实时VR探索和语音驱动VLM交互的架构，无需干净深度或外部位姿，在噪声现实数据上结合ORB-SLAM3位姿估计与在线高斯重建，显著提升图像质量并实现88%的VLM物体识别率。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖干净深度图或外部位姿，难以处理现实世界的噪声数据。本文旨在构建一个鲁棒、在线且支持交互的3D高斯泼溅系统，能够在嘈杂环境中实时重建、沉浸式探索并通过语音命令进行语义理解。
AI.method: 系统将ORB-SLAM3位姿估计与在线高斯泼溅重建集成，支持VR沉浸式探索，并加入语义模块实现语音转录、场景描述生成和兴趣点记录。通过质量-速度配置权衡性能。
AI.result: 在自建数据集上PSNR提升14.5%，SSIM提升8.6%，LPIPS降低14.3%；在TUM-RGBD上PSNR提升11.7%，SSIM提升7.8%，LPIPS降低21.6%；帧率可比或更优；VLM物体识别率达88%。
AI.conclusion: 该集成架构在噪声现实数据上实现了鲁棒的在线3D高斯泼溅重建、实时VR探索和语音驱动的视觉-语言交互，显著优于现有方法，为沉浸式场景理解与交互提供了有效方案。

title: COAST: Context-Aware Differential Learning for Gene Expression Prediction in Spatial Transcriptomics
summary: Spatial transcriptomics enables profiling of spatial gene expression but is limited by high cost and low throughput, motivating prediction from H&E histopathology images. Existing context-aware methods mainly supervise absolute expression, while relative expression relationships between spots are rarely used explicitly. We propose COAST, a context-aware differential learning framework for spatial gene expression prediction. COAST conditions the local and global context features with type-specific modulation and aggregates the target and context spot tokens using a Transformer encoder to capture both fine-grained local patterns and slide-level structure. It is trained with a joint objective that combines absolute expression regression with signed differential regression between the target and context spots. Experiments on multiple spatial transcriptomics datasets show consistent improvements in correlation- and distribution-based metrics, demonstrating the effectiveness of context-aware differential learning for histology-based spatial gene expression prediction.

AI.tldr: COAST是一个上下文感知的差异学习框架，用于从H&E组织病理学图像预测空间基因表达。它通过类型特定的调制结合局部和全局上下文特征，使用Transformer编码器聚合目标点和上下文点token，并通过联合目标（绝对表达回归+目标与上下文点之间的有符号差异回归）进行训练，在多个空间转录组数据集上取得了优于现有方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 空间转录组学能够分析空间基因表达，但成本高、通量低，因此需要从H&E组织病理学图像进行预测。现有上下文感知方法主要监督绝对表达值，而很少显式利用表达值之间的相对关系。
AI.method: 提出COAST框架，包含：1) 类型特定的调制来条件化局部和全局上下文特征；2) Transformer编码器聚合目标点和上下文点token，捕捉细粒度局部模式和切片级结构；3) 联合训练目标，结合绝对表达回归和目标点与上下文点之间的有符号差异回归。
AI.result: 在多个空间转录组数据集上，COAST在基于相关性和基于分布的指标上取得了一致的改进，证明了上下文感知差异学习对于基于组织学的空间基因表达预测的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 上下文感知差异学习（即利用目标点与上下文点之间的表达相对关系）能有效提升从H&E图像预测空间基因表达的性能，COAST框架验证了这一思路的有效性。

title: Semantic Hardness Is Not Visual Hardness: Sign-Aware Hard Negative Mining for Sign Language Retrieval
summary: Sign Language Retrieval (SLRet) enables efficient access to sign language content but remains fragile in fine-grained scenarios where visually similar signs must be distinguished. We show that this limitation does not stem from model capacity, but from ineffective hard negative supervision. Specifically, we formulate fine-grained retrieval failures as a negative distribution mismatch: semantically distinct yet visually confusable signs are rarely treated as hard negatives, while existing text-based mining strategies fail to capture such visual ambiguity. To address this issue, we propose Sign-Aware Hard Negative Mining (SAN), which constructs hard negatives based on visual confusability in the sign embedding space rather than linguistic similarity. Experiments on PHOENIX-2014T demonstrate that SAN substantially improves fine-grained retrieval performance while preserving coarse-grained accuracy, highlighting the importance of aligning negative supervision with visual ambiguity in sign language retrieval.

AI.tldr: 针对手语检索中细粒度场景性能脆弱的问题，论文提出了一种基于视觉混淆度的难负样本挖掘方法（SAN），通过在视觉嵌入空间而非语言相似性空间构建难负样本，有效解决了负分布不匹配问题，显著提升了细粒度检索性能。
AI.motivation: 现有手语检索方法在细粒度场景（即视觉相似但语义不同的手语）中表现脆弱，根本原因不在于模型容量不足，而在于难负样本监督无效——传统基于文本的负样本挖掘策略无法捕捉视觉混淆性，导致语义不同但视觉易混淆的样本很少被作为难负样本处理。
AI.method: 提出Sign-Aware Hard Negative Mining (SAN)，在视觉嵌入空间中基于视觉混淆度而非语言相似性来构建难负样本，从而对齐负样本监督与真实的视觉歧义。
AI.result: 在PHOENIX-2014T数据集上，SAN在显著提升细粒度检索性能的同时保持了粗粒度检索的准确性。
AI.conclusion: 负样本监督必须与视觉歧义对齐，才能有效提升手语检索在细粒度场景下的鲁棒性。

title: Understanding Schedule-Free Methods in Nonconvex Optimization: Rate Guarantees and Escaping Saddles
summary: Schedule-Free methods have attracted growing interest for alleviating the burden of designing and tuning a learning rate scheduler, while matching and sometimes even outperforming optimizers with tuned schedulers. Despite their strong empirical results, their convergence theory in nonconvex optimization, where modern machine learning objectives typically arise, has remained largely unexplored. In this paper, we provide worst-case analyses of Schedule-Free gradient descent and Schedule-Free stochastic gradient descent, in their standard form and without auxiliary modifications or restrictive conditions, for smooth but possibly nonconvex objectives. Based on a Lyapunov analysis derived from the continuous-time limiting ordinary differential equation associated with these methods, we show that Schedule-Free gradient descent and Schedule-Free stochastic gradient descent achieve the optimal worst-case convergence rates attainable among first-order methods. We further formulate Schedule-Free gradient descent as a nonautonomous dynamical system and prove strict-saddle avoidance under an arbitrarily small one-time perturbation. These theoretical results provide a better understanding of the strong performance that Schedule-Free methods demonstrate.

AI.tldr: 本文提供了Schedule-Free梯度下降和随机梯度下降在非凸优化中的最坏情况收敛率分析，证明它们达到了一阶方法的最优收敛速率，并证明了严格鞍点回避性质，从而解释了其强大的经验性能。
AI.motivation: Schedule-Free方法在实践中表现优异，但缺乏非凸优化下的收敛理论支持。本文旨在填补这一理论空白，为这些方法的强经验性能提供理论依据。
AI.method: 采用连续时间极限常微分方程的Lyapunov分析方法，对标准形式的Schedule-Free梯度下降和随机梯度下降进行最坏情况分析，无需辅助修改或限制性条件；同时将Schedule-Free梯度下降建模为非自治动力系统，证明其在一阶扰动下可避免严格鞍点。
AI.result: 证明了Schedule-Free梯度下降和随机梯度下降在光滑非凸目标上达到一阶方法的最优最坏情况收敛速率；并证明了Schedule-Free梯度下降在任意小的单次扰动下能够避免严格鞍点。
AI.conclusion: 这些理论结果揭示了Schedule-Free方法在无学习率调度情况下仍能表现优异的原因，为理解和改进该类方法提供了理论基础。

title: REMIND: RE-Identification with Memory for INDoor Navigation
summary:
Mobile robots operating indoors must re-identify previously observed objects after long temporal gaps, significant viewpoint changes, and severe illumination variations. This remains a challenging problem: multi-object tracking methods are optimized for short-term association of pedestrians and vehicles at video rates, person and vehicle re-identification approaches lack persistent memory mechanisms, and state-of-the-art video object segmentation techniques rely on reactive distractor filtering rather than enforcing global identity consistency.
  To address these limitations, we present REMIND, an online tracker designed for long-term multi-object re-identification of generic indoor objects from monocular RGB imagery, requiring neither camera pose nor depth. Motivated by evidence from visual cognition that humans rely on accumulated appearance familiarity and spatial context rather than explicit self-localization, REMIND combines frozen DINOv3 features with a dual-bank multi-prototype appearance memory, part- and background-level descriptors, a neighbour-context reasoning module exploiting spatial co-occurrence, and joint Hungarian assignment with ambiguity-aware safeguards. On a purpose-built indoor dataset featuring controlled revisits and dense same-class clutter, REMIND reaches 90.35% IDF1, nearly 20 points above a state-of-the-art video object segmentation baseline and more than 36 above a strong tracking-by-detection baseline. On ScanNet++, it attains the highest IDF1 in every setting but one, end-to-end detection over all scenes, where the tracking-by-detection baseline is marginally ahead while REMIND still associates and recovers identities more accurately; it also completes every scene, whereas the video object segmentation baseline exhausts GPU memory on 66.9% under YOLO detections. The complete system, evaluation framework, and dataset are publicly released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出REMIND，一种基于单目RGB的室内通用物体长期多目标重识别跟踪器。它结合冻结的DINOv3特征、双库多原型外观记忆、部分与背景级描述子、邻域上下文推理模块以及联合匈牙利分配与歧义感知机制，在自建室内数据集上达到90.35% IDF1，远超现有方法，在ScanNet++上也取得领先表现。
AI.motivation: 现有方法存在明显局限：多目标跟踪优化于短期关联，行人/车辆重识别缺乏持久记忆机制，视频目标分割依赖反应式干扰过滤而缺乏全局身份一致性。室内移动机器人在长时间间隔、大视角变化和严重光照变化下需要重识别物体，现有技术无法满足这一需求。
AI.method: REMIND由五个核心组件构成：(1) 冻结的DINOv3视觉特征；(2) 双库多原型外观记忆（dual-bank multi-prototype appearance memory）；(3) 部件级与背景级描述子（part- and background-level descriptors）；(4) 利用空间共现的邻域上下文推理模块（neighbour-context reasoning）；(5) 联合匈牙利分配与歧义感知安全机制（joint Hungarian assignment with ambiguity-aware safeguards）。不依赖相机位姿或深度信息。
AI.result: 在自建室内数据集上达到90.35% IDF1，比视频目标分割基线高出近20个点，比强跟踪-检测基线高出36个点以上。在ScanNet++上，REMIND在除端到端全场景检测外的所有设置中获得最高IDF1，且对每一场景均能完整处理，而视频目标分割基线在66.9%的场景下因GPU内存溢出而失败。
AI.conclusion: REMIND有效解决了室内移动机器人的长期多目标重识别问题，通过结合视觉认知启发的累积外观熟悉度与空间上下文机制，无需位姿或深度信息即可实现全局身份一致性。完整系统、评估框架和数据集均已公开发布。

title: Application of machine learning to monster level prediction in tabletop RPG game design
summary: Designing balanced adversaries is a central but labor-intensive task in tabletop role-playing game (TTRPG) development. In systems such as Pathfinder, each monster is described by many numerical attributes that jointly determine its power, summarized as an ordinal level. We investigate whether machine learning can support designers by predicting this level from a monster's attributes, framing the task as tabular ordinal regression. We introduce what is, to our knowledge, the first dataset built specifically for TTRPG monster-level prediction, derived from publicly available Pathfinder Second Edition data. Using it, we compare classical regression models with rounding schemes, dedicated tabular ordinal regression algorithms, and neural networks with ordinal-aware losses. To mirror real design workflows, we evaluate all models under chronological and expanding-window protocols with several complementary metrics. Results show that tree-based ensembles outperform linear models and neural approaches, achieving near-perfect ordinal ranking and high predictive accuracy. Explainable AI analyses, such as feature importance and error distributions, show that the model is aligned with human intuition and follows patterns grounded in game rules. Together, these results show that machine learning can reliably approximate designer judgments and serve as an effective computer-aided tool for monster balancing and broader TTRPG system design.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了如何利用机器学习预测《开拓者》第二版（Pathfinder 2E）中怪兽的等级（Level），将其建模为表格序数回归问题。研究首次构建了专门用于TTRPG怪物等级预测的数据集，比较了多种模型（经典回归、序数回归算法、神经网络等），发现基于树的集成模型表现最佳，达到近乎完美的排序准确性。可解释性分析表明模型符合人类直觉和游戏规则。该工作可辅助游戏设计师进行怪物平衡性调整。
AI.motivation: 在桌游角色扮演游戏（TTRPG）开发中，设计平衡的敌人（怪物）是一项核心但劳动密集型的任务。在Pathfinder等系统中，每个怪物由许多数值属性描述，这些属性共同决定其战力，最终汇总为一个序数等级。手工调整这些属性以确保平衡极为繁琐，因此需要自动化工具辅助设计师。
AI.method: 将怪物等级预测建模为表格序数回归问题。首次构建了专用于TTRPG怪物等级预测的数据集（基于Pathfinder 2E公开数据）。比较了多种方法：经典回归模型（配合舍入方案）、专用表格序数回归算法、以及使用序数感知损失的神经网络。采用时间顺序和扩展窗口的评估协议以模拟真实设计工作流，使用多种互补指标评估。
AI.result: 基于树的集成模型（如随机森林、梯度提升树）显著优于线性模型和神经网络方法，达到近乎完美的序数排序准确性和高预测精度。可解释性分析（特征重要性、误差分布）表明模型预测符合人类直觉，并且遵循基于游戏规则的规律模式。
AI.conclusion: 机器学习能够可靠地近似设计师的判断，可作为怪物平衡性调整和更广泛的TTRPG系统设计的有效计算机辅助工具。

title: Rethinking Monocular Depth Embedding for Generalized Stereo Matching
summary: Generally, monocular methods capture rich contextual priors but lack geometric precision, whereas stereo methods are geometrically accurate yet struggle in textureless and occluded regions. Several approaches attempt to combine their strengths to enhance the generalization of stereo matching (SM) by aligning monocular depth with stereo information. However, establishing a stable and generalizable alignment is challenging, and unreliable monocular cues can substantially degrade performance. This paper rethinks monocular depth embedding. First, to prevent shortcut learning, we reduce branch coupling instead of expanding network width. Second, we construct soft constraints instead of hard ones from monocular depth to improve tolerance to monocular depth errors. Based on the principles, we integrate monocular information into both feature extraction and GRU iterations. Specifically, the monocular depth map is fused with the RGB image to sharpen depth boundary perception and suppress matching ambiguities. The fused image is then used for feature extraction, allowing the contextual features to encode global geometric information. Furthermore, the monocular depth gradient feature is employed to guide disparity updates, helping to escape local oscillations. Finally, to address the boundary blurring of supervised disparity caused by data augmentation, we propose an edge confidence estimation method and an edge-aware loss function. Our method achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on multiple standard benchmarks, demonstrating excellent generalization while improving accuracy. The code is available at https://github.com/linliboabc-maker/stereo-matching-digital.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的单目深度嵌入方法用于立体匹配，通过减少分支耦合避免捷径学习、构建软约束提高对单目深度误差的容忍度，将单目信息整合到特征提取和GRU迭代中，并提出了边缘置信度估计和边缘感知损失函数，在多个标准基准上达到了SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有立体匹配方法中，单目方法具有丰富上下文先验但缺乏几何精度，立体方法几何精确但在无纹理和遮挡区域效果差。尽管已有工作尝试结合两者优势，但建立稳定且可泛化的对齐具有挑战性，且不可靠的单目线索会严重降低性能。
AI.method: 1) 减少分支耦合而非扩展网络宽度以防止捷径学习；2) 构建软约束而非硬约束以提高对单目深度误差的容忍度；3) 将单目深度图与RGB图像融合以增强深度边界感知并抑制匹配歧义；4) 融合图像用于特征提取，使上下文特征编码全局几何信息；5) 利用单目深度梯度特征指导视差更新，帮助逃离局部振荡；6) 提出边缘置信度估计方法和边缘感知损失函数解决数据增强导致的监督视差边界模糊问题。
AI.result: 在多个标准基准上达到了SOTA性能，在提升精度的同时展现了优秀的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过重新思考单目深度嵌入方式，提出了一种更稳定、更鲁棒的立体匹配方法，有效结合了单目和立体方法的优势。

title: Interference and Retention in Continual Learning
summary:
Continual learning commonly relies on post-hoc mechanisms such as replay, elastic regularization, or distillation. This work argues that forgetting should instead be modeled directly as interference between tasks. In the frozen-feature regime, forgetting from learning a new task is exactly the interference energy induced on the old task. In deep networks, the same quantity is recovered through path-averaged curvature with minimal additional forward passes.
  When task supports are disjoint, forgetting can be eliminated structurally and when task supports overlap in conflicting directions, a non-zero distortion floor is unavoidable. The same geometry optimally merges models through task-aware orthogonalization. From this analysis we derive Interference-Gated Functional Allocation (IGFA), a replay-free, Fisher-free method that shares directions when tasks align and protects them when they conflict. Across benchmarks, IGFA achieves lossless retention when tasks are structurally separable and moves unavoidable cost from irreversible forgetting into deferred but recoverable plasticity when they are not. It matches the strongest replay-free structural baselines on dissimilar-task streams and improves on unconditional projection when similarity makes transfer worth preserving.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将遗忘建模为任务间的直接干扰，基于几何分析推导出干扰门控功能分配（IGFA）方法，无需重放或Fisher信息，在任务可分离时实现无损保留，否则将不可逆遗忘转化为可恢复的可塑性。
AI.motivation: 现有持续学习依赖回放、弹性正则化或蒸馏等事后机制，但遗忘本质上源于任务间的干扰，应该直接建模而非事后补偿。
