AI.method: 通过冻结特征下的干扰能量分析，引入路径平均曲率来近似深度网络中的干扰；利用任务支撑集的几何关系（不重叠则无遗忘，重叠冲突则存在不可消除的畸变）进行任务感知正交化；提出IGFA，无需重放和Fisher矩阵，在任务对齐时共享方向，冲突时保护方向。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，IGFA在任务结构可分离时实现无损保留；在不可分离时将不可逆遗忘转化为可恢复的可塑性；在异质任务流上与最强的无重放结构基线持平，在相似任务上优于无条件投影方法。
AI.conclusion: 遗忘的几何本质决定了其最小成本，IGFA通过干扰门控在保留与可塑性之间实现最优权衡，为持续学习提供了新的理论视角和实用方法。

title: TextileNet: Towards Zero-shot Text-style Segmentation of Manuscripts
comment: accepted for publication in the ICDAR 2026 workshop (peer reviewed) "IWCP: 4th International Workshop on Computational Paleography"
summary: Automatic writer identification systems have progressed remarkably in recent years, yet their deployment in archival paleography remains limited by the scarcity of labeled training data, open scribe sets, and degraded image quality. We present TextileNet, a fully convolutional multi-task network trained exclusively on synthetic data to produce dense pixel-level texture embeddings, which we transfer zeroshot to historical manuscript analysis. As an original contribution to evaluation methodology, we designed a paleographic visual quiz of 80 pair and triplet questions and administered it to a range from lay participants to senior paleographers under strict anonymity, establishing to our knowledge for the first time a human baseline for script-style discrimination on late medieval text. We employ TextileNet embeddings to perform zero-shot retrieval on sub-word granularity for hand and gender identification. Our experimental results help in building the credibility of TextileNet in the paleographic domain, but more than that demonstrate in experimental terms that the question of gender in handwriting needs to be treated with caution.

AI.tldr: TextileNet 是一个全卷积多任务网络，仅使用合成数据训练生成密集像素级纹理嵌入，用于零样本历史手稿分析；同时通过设计古文字视觉测验建立了人类基线，实验表明手写性别判断需谨慎对待。
AI.motivation: 自动笔迹识别系统虽进展显著，但在档案古文字学中部署受限，主要由于标注训练数据稀缺、抄写者集合开放以及图像质量退化。现有方法难以适应实际古文字研究需求。
AI.method: 提出 TextileNet，一种全卷积多任务网络，仅凭合成数据训练即可产生密集像素级纹理嵌入，实现零样本迁移到历史手稿分析。作为方法论贡献，设计了包含 80 个配对与三选一问题的古文字视觉测验，面向从普通参与者到资深古文字学家的匿名受试者，首次建立了中世纪晚期手稿风格区分的人类基线。
AI.result: 利用 TextileNet 嵌入在子词粒度上实现了零样本检索，用于笔迹身份和性别识别。实验结果支持了 TextileNet 在古文字学领域的可信度，但更关键的是实验表明：手写中的性别问题需谨慎对待。
AI.conclusion: TextileNet 为缺乏标注数据的古文字分析提供了有效的零样本解决方案；同时，通过人类基线实验揭示了手写性别判别并非可靠特征，对相关研究方向提出了警示。

title: Temporal Knowledge Graph Forecasting under Distribution Shifts: A Synthetic Evaluation
summary: Temporal knowledge graphs (TKGs) represent evolving relational systems, whose underlying data-generating processes often change over time. Yet, TKG forecasting models are commonly evaluated only on empirical benchmark datasets that provide limited insight into the models' robustness to such distribution shifts. Recognising this issue, we study TKG forecasting under controlled shift environments using a synthetic TKG generator that encodes three temporal and structural properties -- recurrence, homophily, and periodicity -- as data-generating mechanisms. This allows us to evaluate seven forecasting architectures under stationary and shifting regimes. Our experiments suggest that robustness in TKG forecasting is highly signal-dependent. Recurrence-based and periodic regularities are largely recoverable under stationary conditions, and simple memory-based baselines can be competitive when recurrence dominates the data. However, structural breaks reveal limitations in model adaptivity, with shifts in latent entity-community structure posing the strongest challenge in our study. Overall, our findings improve the understanding of the capabilities and limitations of current TKG models confronted with temporal distribution shifts.

AI.tldr: 本文通过合成时序知识图谱生成器，系统研究了七种TKG预测模型在分布漂移下的鲁棒性，发现模型对特定信号（如重复性、周期性）的鲁棒性高度依赖数据特征，且结构突变尤其是隐式实体-社区结构漂移对模型适应性构成最大挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有TKG预测模型仅在经验基准数据集上评估，无法揭示其对分布漂移的鲁棒性。作者旨在通过可控的漂移环境系统评估模型在时序和结构特性变化下的表现，填补这一研究空白。
AI.method: 使用合成TKG生成器，编码重复性、同质性和周期性三种数据生成机制，构建平稳和漂移两种实验环境，对七种TKG预测架构进行对比评估。
AI.result: 在平稳条件下，基于重复性和周期性的规律可被较好恢复，简单记忆基线在重复性主导时具备竞争力；但结构漂移揭示了模型适应性的局限，其中隐式实体-社区结构漂移是最具挑战性的变化类型。
AI.conclusion: TKG预测的鲁棒性高度信号依赖，当前模型在面临时间分布漂移时存在显著能力边界，尤其对社区结构变化适应不足，为未来模型设计提供了重要启示。

title: From Classification to Localization and Clinical Validation: Large-Scale Development of a Deep Learning System for Thoracic Disease Detection on Chest Radiographs in Thailand
summary: Chest radiography (CXR) remains the most widely used thoracic imaging modality, yet expert interpretation is constrained by a severe shortage of radiologists in Thailand and across Southeast Asia. Local adaptation of deep learning models to Thai data has been shown to substantially improve accuracy on Thai populations. Here we present the development and comprehensive validation of the chest radiograph analysis model in Inspectra CXR version 5, a deep learning system that performs multi-label thoracic disease classification and weakly supervised lesion localization within a single model. The architecture couples a DenseNet-121 backbone with Attend-and-Compare Modules (ACM) and a Probabilistic Class Activation Map (PCAM) aggregation layer, producing a per-condition classification score and heatmap simultaneously. The model was developed on 874,858 frontal chest radiographs with paired radiologist reports from Siriraj Hospital, Bangkok. On a held-out, radiologist-verified in-domain test set of 19,871 cases, it achieved a mean AUROC of 0.994 (mean sensitivity 92.4%, specificity 98.6%) across nine clinically important conditions. On an independent generalization set of 5,992 cases from 13 hospitals across Thailand, the mean AUROC was 0.970, indicating robust transfer across sites. For localization, evaluated on 4,549 radiologist-annotated cases, the model attained a mean lesion-localization fraction (LLF) of 77.9% at 0.59 non-lesion localizations per image. In a usability evaluation with five thoracic radiologists, the system reached a classification concordance of 93.6%, a localization concordance of 94.7%, and a mean System Usability Scale (SUS) score of 89. These results indicate that a locally developed, localization-capable CXR system can deliver high accuracy, generalize across heterogeneous Thai hospitals, and earn the trust of practicing radiologists.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种基于深度学习的胸片分析系统 Inspectra CXR version 5，该系统采用 DenseNet-121 骨干网络结合 Attend-and-Compare Modules (ACM) 和 Probabilistic Class Activation Map (PCAM) 聚合层，实现多标签胸部疾病分类和弱监督病灶定位。模型在泰国 Siriraj 医院的 874,858 张胸片上训练，在内部测试集上达到平均 AUROC 0.994，在涵盖 13 家医院的泛化集上达到 0.970，病灶定位 LLF 为 77.9%，放射科医生 usability 评估中 SUS 得分为 89，表明该系统准确性高、泛化能力强且获得放射科医生信任。
AI.motivation: 东南亚地区（尤其是泰国）放射科医生严重短缺，导致胸片解读受限。虽然有深度学习模型可用于胸片分析，但本地化适配对提高泰国人群的准确性至关重要。因此，作者开发了一个本地化、具有病灶定位能力的胸片分析系统，以解决资源匮乏地区的临床需求。
AI.method: 模型架构：DenseNet-121 作为骨干网络，结合 Attend-and-Compare Modules (ACM) 和 Probabilistic Class Activation Map (PCAM) 聚合层，实现多标签分类和弱监督病灶定位。训练数据：874,858 张来自 Siriraj 医院的正面胸片及配对放射科报告。验证：内部验证集（19,871 例）、多中心泛化集（13 家医院，5,992 例）、病灶定位验证集（4,549 例放射科医生标注病例）以及 5 位放射科医生的可用性评估。
AI.result: 内部测试集：9 种重要疾病的平均 AUROC 0.994，平均敏感性 92.4%，特异性 98.6%。泛化集：平均 AUROC 0.970。病灶定位：平均病灶定位分数 (LLF) 77.9%，每张图像非病灶定位 0.59 个。可用性评估：分类一致性 93.6%，定位一致性 94.7%，系统可用性量表 (SUS) 平均得分 89。
AI.conclusion: 本地开发的、具备定位能力的胸片分析系统能够在泰国多家医院实现高准确性和良好的泛化能力，并获得了放射科医生的信任。这表明在资源有限的地区，本地化深度学习模型可以成为有效的辅助诊断工具。

title: All you need is SAMPAT
summary: The current state of the art in AI/ML rests on deep neural architectures, which, in general, suffer from a lack of interpretability. Interpretability is crucial to gleaning insights while analyzing experimental data, where quantitative predictions may not be adequate for a scientist. We present a three layer neural architecture, SAMPAT (Smooth Approximation via Multivariate Polynomials and Analytic Transformations), that can provably learn a continuous, everywhere differentiable function, that can approximate any smooth function arbitrarily closely. SAMPAT's approximant can be expressed as a closed and compact algebraic, analytic expression, providing complete interpretability. Experiments on synthetic and benchmark datasets indicate that SAMPAT yields competitive performance with simpler representations. For many tasks, a two layer SAMPAT suffices. By imposing restrictions on the connectivity between neurons, SAMPAT may be used to provide a range of approximants, including regular and trigonometric polynomials, rational expressions, Gaussians, mixtures of Gaussians, as well as arbitrary combinations of the same; without restrictions, it learns a suitable structure. SAMPAT may be used to factorize polynomials and model nonlinear systems. With the addition of skip connections, a 4 to 6 layer SAMPAT is adequate to represent a substantive range of methods widely used in AI/ML, allowing the choice of a model's family, not just its parameters, to also be optimized as part of the learning process.

AI.tldr: SAMPAT 是一种三层神经网络架构，通过多元多项式和解析变换实现平滑逼近，其输出为封闭的代数/解析表达式，具有完全可解释性。实验表明其性能与简单表示方法相当，且两层结构即可满足多数任务。通过限制连接可生成多项式、三角函数、有理函数、高斯混合等多种形式；加入跳跃连接后，4-6 层 SAMPAT 可表示多种主流 AI/ML 方法，允许在训练中优化模型族而非仅参数。
AI.motivation: 当前 AI/ML 的深度神经网络缺乏可解释性，而科学家分析实验数据时不仅需要定量预测，更需要理解模型的内在机理。因此，本文旨在设计一种既保持强大逼近能力又具有完全可解释性的神经网络架构。
AI.method: 提出 SAMPAT（Smooth Approximation via Multivariate Polynomials and Analytic Transformations）架构，包含三个神经网络层，能够学习连续可微函数，并以封闭、紧凑的代数/解析表达式表达逼近结果。通过限制神经元之间的连接方式，可生成正则多项式、三角多项式、有理函数、高斯函数及混合高斯等；无限制时自动学习合适结构。引入跳跃连接后，4-6 层即可覆盖众多 AI/ML 方法。
AI.result: 在合成数据和基准数据集上，SAMPAT 取得了与简单表示方法相竞争的性能。许多任务中仅需两层 SAMPAT 即可。该架构能因式分解多项式、建模非线性系统。加入跳跃连接后，4-6 层 SAMPAT 足以表示 AI/ML 中广泛使用的方法，使得模型族的选择也可作为学习过程的一部分进行优化。
AI.conclusion: SAMPAT 在保持较强逼近能力的同时提供了完全可解释性，其紧凑的解析表达式有助于科学家理解模型行为。此外，通过对连接方式的约束和跳跃连接的引入，SAMPAT 能够灵活地表示多种模型结构，从而在训练中同时优化模型族与参数。

title: Dynamic Inverse Rendering for Enhanced Material-Lighting Decomposition
comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026. Project page: https://razayunus.github.io/DIR
summary: Decomposing outgoing surface radiance into material and illumination during inverse rendering is essential for applications such as relighting and augmented reality, yet it is severely ill-posed since multiple combinations can result in the same observed colour. Capturing an object under multiple lighting conditions usually helps resolve this ambiguity as it constrains the optimization towards correct solutions. In this work, we explore the potential of reconstructing rigidly moving objects -- which provides observations of diverse light-surface interactions -- to resolve the material-lighting ambiguity in inverse rendering. For this purpose, we introduce a relightable approach that marries object tracking and reconstruction with inverse rendering for general rigidly moving objects. Our experimental analysis on synthetic data demonstrates that motion can be an advantage for disentangling material and lighting: the reconstructed material is significantly more accurate when the object is observed under rigid motion than when it is static. Moreover, results on RGB videos of real hand-held objects show that our pipeline preserves this advantage even under noisy real-world conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用刚性运动物体来解耦材料与光照的逆渲染方法，通过融合物体跟踪、重建与逆渲染，在合成数据和真实视频上证明运动有助于更准确地分离材质和光照。
AI.motivation: 逆渲染中分解表面辐射率为材质和光照是严重病态问题，传统方法通过多光照条件来缓解歧义，但需要额外采集。本文探索利用物体刚性运动提供多样的光-表面交互，从而在不增加采集负担的情况下解决材质-光照歧义。
AI.method: 提出一种可重光照的逆渲染管线，将物体跟踪与三维重建整合起来，对任意刚性运动物体进行逆渲染，从多视角运动观测中联合优化材质与光照。
AI.result: 合成数据实验表明，物体在刚性运动下重建的材质精度显著高于静态情况；真实手持物体的RGB视频结果也证明该管线在嘈杂真实环境中仍能保持运动带来的优势。
AI.conclusion: 物体刚性运动能为逆渲染提供有效的多光照约束，显著提升材质-光照解耦的准确性，且该方法适用于实际手持场景，具有实用价值。

title: Forget Narrowly, Retain Broadly: Unlearning as an Asymmetric Generalization Problem
summary: Machine unlearning in LLMs is the targeted removal of specific knowledge while preserving all other capabilities, critical for privacy and safety. Yet existing benchmarks measure it unreliably. They miss knowledge that resurfaces under paraphrased or indirect queries, a failure we call under-forgetting, and lack the semantic, syntactic, and lexical probes needed to verify that unrelated knowledge is preserved, a failure we call over-forgetting. Both failures reflect an asymmetric generalization problem. Forget evaluation must cover diverse query formulations of the same target facts, testing whether forgetting holds beyond exact training prompts. Retain evaluation must probe a far larger and implicitly defined set, namely every fact disjoint from the forget target. The retain set thus defines the effective forget set, yet current datasets provide no fine-grained annotation of this forget-retain boundary. We address this with SUITE, an evaluation protocol and training corpus that captures forget-retain structure for real-world factual domains. Methods trained on SUITE improve substantially, showing that training data is as important as algorithmic design. Building on the obtained insights, we introduce JensUn++, an unlearning algorithm that achieves the best forget-retain utility trade-off across three LLMs, in both sequential and joint unlearning settings. Code and datasets are available at https://amitpeleg.github.io/forget-narrowly-retain-broadly

AI.tldr: 提出了SUITE，一个针对LLM机器遗忘的评估协议和训练语料库，解决了遗忘不足（under-forgetting）和遗忘过度（over-forgetting）的问题，并基于此提出了JensUn++遗忘算法，在三个LLM上实现了最佳的遗忘-保留权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM机器遗忘基准测试不可靠：它们无法检测到在释义或间接查询下重新浮现的知识（遗忘不足），也缺乏语义、句法和词汇探针来验证无关知识是否被保留（遗忘过度）。这反映了不对称泛化问题：遗忘评估必须覆盖目标事实的多种查询表述，而保留评估必须探测与遗忘目标不相交的每个事实，但当前数据集缺乏对遗忘-保留边界的细粒度标注。
AI.method: SUITE是一个评估协议和训练语料库，它捕捉了现实世界事实领域的遗忘-保留结构，提供了细粒度的遗忘-保留边界标注。基于SUITE获得的见解，提出了JensUn++遗忘算法，该算法在顺序和联合遗忘设置中均能实现最佳的遗忘-保留效用权衡。
AI.result: 在SUITE上训练的方法相比现有方法有显著提升。JensUn++在三个LLM上，在顺序和联合遗忘设置中均取得了最好的遗忘-保留权衡效果。
AI.conclusion: 训练数据与算法设计在机器遗忘中同等重要。SUITE为评估提供了更可靠的基准，JensUn++为遗忘提供了更有效的算法。

title: Simon-SR: Spatially Adaptive Modulation and Visual Prompt Adaptation for Text-Reinforced Super-Resolution
summary: Single Image Super-Resolution (SISR) reconstructs high-quality images from low-resolution inputs. While recent multi-modal methods improve perceptual quality, they remain sensitive to erroneous priors and require expensive annotations. To address these issues, we propose Simon-SR, a multi-modal SISR framework leveraging learnable prompts for efficient semantic mining and robust text-image fusion. Our approach combines Contrastive Prompt Learning with Prompt-Guided Spatially Adaptive Refinement to enhance multi-modal alignment. Experiments demonstrate that Simon-SR surpasses state-of-the-art methods, achieving maximum improvements of 0.50 dB in PSNR, 0.0133 in SSIM, and 0.0695 in LPIPS. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: Simon-SR is a multi-modal single image super-resolution framework that uses learnable prompts and contrastive learning to improve semantic mining and text-image fusion, achieving state-of-the-art results on PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS metrics.
AI.motivation: Existing multi-modal SISR methods improve perceptual quality but are sensitive to erroneous priors and require expensive annotations, limiting their practicality.
AI.method: The framework combines Contrastive Prompt Learning with Prompt-Guided Spatially Adaptive Refinement to enhance multi-modal alignment and robust text-image fusion.
AI.result: Simon-SR surpasses state-of-the-art methods, achieving maximum improvements of 0.50 dB in PSNR, 0.0133 in SSIM, and 0.0695 in LPIPS.
AI.conclusion: The proposed learnable prompt-based approach effectively addresses the limitations of prior multi-modal SISR methods, offering a more robust and annotation-efficient solution for high-quality image reconstruction.

title: LionVote: Per-Layer Learning Rate Adaptation for Lion
summary: Per-layer diagnostics reveal that, at the prescribed learning rate, Lion's effective scale is 2.6-2.8x too high for attention and MLP parameters and ~2x too high for normalization layers on ViT-Tiny/CIFAR-100; this 32% cross-layer-type disparity cannot be reproduced by a single global rate. The measurement comes from LionVote, a per-layer learning rate mechanism in which each parameter tensor maintains a compound level, a persistent integer updated every c epochs by two diagnostics (gradient direction stability and momentum health) resolved by a validation loss tiebreaker. Voting thresholds derive from geometric identities, the EMA time constant, and a noise-floor estimate; cadence is bounded structurally and selected by ablation. On ViT-Tiny/CIFAR-100, LionVote achieves 69.7% top-1 accuracy vs. Lion's 69.0% (p < 0.02, Welch's t-test) and AdamW's 68.8%. Per-layer adaptation value depends on both architectural heterogeneity and task; on uniform CNN architectures tuned SGD with cosine annealing remains dominant, and on ViT architectures gains are task-dependent.

AI.tldr: 论文提出LionVote，一种逐层学习率机制，通过梯度方向稳定性和动量健康两种诊断指标动态调整每层学习率，解决了Lion优化器在不同层类型（注意力/MLP vs 归一化层）间有效尺度不匹配的问题。在ViT-Tiny/CIFAR-100上达到69.7% top-1准确率，优于Lion的69.0%和AdamW的68.8%。
AI.motivation: Lion优化器在预设学习率下，不同层类型的有效尺度差异显著：注意力/MLP参数的有效尺度是归一化层的2.6-2.8倍 vs 2倍，这种32%的跨层类型差异无法通过单一全局学习率解决。因此需要逐层自适应学习率机制来匹配各层实际需求。
AI.method: LionVote：每个参数张量维护一个复合级别（compound level），每c个epoch通过两个诊断指标（梯度方向稳定性与动量健康）进行更新，若诊断结果冲突则由验证损失作为决胜局。投票阈值源自几何恒等式、EMA时间常数和噪声地板估计；更新节奏通过结构约束和消融实验确定。
AI.result: 在ViT-Tiny/CIFAR-100上，LionVote达到69.7% top-1准确率，显著优于Lion的69.0%（p<0.02）和AdamW的68.8%。逐层自适应带来的收益取决于架构异质性和任务：在均匀CNN架构上，经调优的SGD+余弦退火仍占主导；在ViT架构上收益则与任务相关。
AI.conclusion: 逐层学习率自适应在异构架构（如ViT）上有显著价值，但并非通用解决方案；其有效性依赖于架构的层级异质程度和具体任务。对于同质化CNN架构，传统的SGD+余弦退火仍然竞争力强。

title: CtrlVTON: Controllable Virtual Try-On via Visual-Instance-Prompt Segmentation
summary: Virtual try-on (VTO) has made significant progress in realistically transferring garments onto a target person. Yet most systems give the user little control over how a garment should be worn -- its size (loose or fitted), style (e.g., tucked in or untucked, open or closed), and spatial placement on the body. We address this gap with two complementary contributions. First, we define and solve Visual-Instance-Prompt Segmentation via VIP-SAM: given a flatlay image of a garment, segment that specific instance in a photograph of a person wearing it. This is an instance-level task, distinct from the typically studied category-level segmentation. Second, we introduce CtrlVTON, a controllable VTO framework that recasts try-on as an image editing problem and adds segmentation masks as pixel-level control over garment layout, including style, size, and spatial placement on the body. VIP-SAM and CtrlVTON each achieve state-of-the-art results on their respective tasks. In particular, CtrlVTON generates images that follow user-provided layouts far more faithfully than the strongest proprietary editing systems while matching them on garment fidelity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两个互补贡献：一是VIP-SAM，用于根据平面衣物图像在穿着照片中分割出该特定衣物实例（实例级分割）；二是CtrlVTON，一个可控虚拟试穿框架，将试穿视为图像编辑问题，利用分割掩码提供像素级控制（包括尺寸、风格和空间位置）。两个方法在各自任务上达到最优，CtrlVTON在遵循用户布局上远超最强商业编辑系统，同时保持衣物保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有虚拟试穿系统在衣物转移上取得进展，但缺乏对穿着方式（尺寸松紧、风格如塞入/未塞入、敞开/闭合、空间位置）的用户控制。
AI.method: 提出VIP-SAM进行实例级衣物分割（给定平面图，在穿着照片中分割该具体实例）；提出CtrlVTON，将试穿重构为图像编辑问题，利用分割掩码作为像素级控制，实现尺寸、风格和空间布局的精细调节。
AI.result: VIP-SAM和CtrlVTON在各自任务上达到最先进水平。CtrlVTON生成的图像在遵循用户提供布局方面远优于最强商业编辑系统，同时衣物保真度相当。
AI.conclusion: 通过实例分割和可控试穿框架，显著提升了虚拟试穿的用户控制能力，实现了更灵活、更符合用户意图的衣物转移效果。

title: Autoregressive latent diffusion for 3D molecule generation
summary: Three-dimensional (3D) molecule generation has been dominated by diffusion models, which achieve strong generation quality but typically require the molecular size to be specified a priori. Recent autoregressive approaches have substantially narrowed the performance gap while naturally supporting variable-length generation and conditioning on partial molecular context. However, balancing unconditional and context-conditioned generation remains challenging. We introduce KRONOS, a latent autoregressive diffusion framework that generates molecules in the latent space of a pre-trained autoencoder, jointly modeling molecular graph topology and geometry, while retaining the flexibility of autoregressive generation. We further introduce a mixed training strategy inspired by Fill-in-the Middle (FIM) paradigm, enabling both unconditional and fragment-conditioned molecular generation within a single left-to-right autoregressive model. Experiments on QM9 and GEOM-Drugs demonstrate that KRONOS achieves leading unconditional generation performance among autoregressive methods, while remaining competitive with diffusion models. Moreover, fragment-conditioned generation is achieved with negligible impact on unconditional generation performance, demonstrating that both generation paradigms can be supported within a single architecture.

AI.tldr: KRONOS是一种潜自回归扩散框架，结合了自回归生成和扩散模型的优势，在预训练自编码器的潜空间中生成3D分子，并采用Fill-in-the-Middle混合训练策略，同时支持无条件生成和片段条件生成，在QM9和GEOM-Drugs数据集上达到了自回归方法中的领先水平，且与扩散模型竞争力相当。
AI.motivation: 现有3D分子生成方法中，扩散模型需要预指定分子大小，而自回归方法虽支持变长生成和上下文条件化，但在平衡无条件生成和条件生成方面存在挑战。KRONOS旨在统一两种生成范式，在单一架构中同时支持无条件生成和片段条件生成。
AI.method: KRONOS采用潜自回归扩散框架，在预训练自编码器的潜空间中生成分子，联合建模分子图拓扑和几何结构。引入受Fill-in-the-Middle (FIM)范式启发的混合训练策略，使单个从左到右的自回归模型同时支持无条件生成和片段条件生成。
AI.result: 在QM9和GEOM-Drugs数据集上，KRONOS在无条件生成性能上达到了自回归方法中的领先水平，并与扩散模型竞争力相当。片段条件生成对无条件生成性能影响可忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: KRONOS成功证明了在单一架构中可以同时支持无条件生成和片段条件生成两种范式，为3D分子生成提供了更灵活的解决方案。

title: SVF-CR: Synchronized Visual-Facial Cross-Refinement for Multimodal Ambivalence and Hesitancy Recognition
summary: Ambivalence and hesitancy are subtle behavioral states that are expressed through a combination of verbal content, facial behavior, visual context, and acoustic cues. Effective recognition therefore requires not only extracting informative unimodal representations, but also modeling how temporally aligned behavioral evidence interacts across modalities. In this paper, we propose a synchronized visual-facial cross-refinement framework (SVF-CR) with pairwise multimodal evidence fusion for ambivalence and hesitancy recognition. The proposed method first extracts whole-video segment tokens and cropped-face segment tokens using the same temporal partition. The synchronized visual and facial tokens are refined through intra-modal self-attention and bidirectional visual-facial cross-attention, allowing whole-video context and local facial behavior to mutually refine each other before evidence construction. We then construct segment-level visual-facial evidence using consistency and discrepancy modeling, followed by temporal self-attention and attention pooling. Textual and acoustic features are lightly refined through context self-attention and are fused with the enhanced visual-facial evidence at the final decision stage using pairwise evidence fusion. Experiments on the BAH (Behavioral Ambivalence/Hesitancy) public evaluation split show that the proposed synchronized visual-facial cross-refinement improves public macro-F1 over both global visual-face token fusion and synchronized evidence baselines, achieving a public macro-F1 of 0.7156. Code is available at : https://github.com/hiinnnii/BAH-Challenge-ECCV2026\_SVF-CR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出同步视觉-面部交叉精炼框架（SVF-CR），通过时空对齐的多模态交互和成对证据融合，在BAH数据集上实现0.7156的宏F1，用于识别矛盾心理和犹豫行为。
AI.motivation: 矛盾心理和犹豫是微妙行为状态，依赖于言语、面部、视觉上下文和声学线索的复合表达，现有方法难以有效建模跨模态间时序对齐的行为证据交互。
AI.method: 1) 对完整视频和裁剪面部进行同步时空分块提取tokens；2) 通过模态内自注意力和双向视觉-面部交叉注意力实现上下文与局部面部行为的相互精炼；3) 构建段级一致性/差异性证据并使用时序自注意力和注意力池化；4) 文本和声学特征经轻量精炼后，通过成对证据融合在决策层融合增强的视觉-面部证据。
AI.result: 在BAH公开评估集上，SVF-CR达到0.7156的宏F1，优于全局视觉-面部token融合和同步证据基线。
AI.conclusion: 同步视觉-面部交叉精炼和成对多模态证据融合能有效提升矛盾心理/犹豫识别性能，代码已开源。

title: Multimodal Scenario Similarity Search for Autonomous Driving
summary: Large-scale autonomous-driving datasets contain vast numbers of recorded scenarios, creating a need for efficient retrieval methods that can identify situations similar to a given query. Existing approaches typically rely on either visual representations or motion-based descriptions, making it difficult to understand their relative strengths and limitations for scenario retrieval. In this work, we present a multimodal framework for autonomous-driving scenario retrieval that combines visual and trajectory-based representations within a unified retrieval pipeline. We investigate two trajectory-based approaches: Exo-Trajectory, an explicit matching method based on surrounding-agent motion, and ScenarioFormer, a transformer-based representation learned from object trajectories using contrastive learning. We compare these approaches against strong vision-based baselines and analyze their behavior across a diverse set of driving scenarios. Experimental results show that trajectory representations provide strong retrieval performance for motion-centric events such as cut-ins, turning maneuvers, and traffic queueing, while visual embeddings excel when appearance cues are informative. Most importantly, combining visual and trajectory information consistently improves retrieval quality, yielding the best overall performance. These findings demonstrate that appearance and motion capture are complementary notions of scenario similarity and motivate multimodal retrieval systems for autonomous-driving data mining, dataset curation, and scenario-based validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个多模态框架，结合视觉和轨迹表示用于自动驾驶场景检索。实验表明轨迹表示对运动相关事件（插入、转弯、排队）效果好，视觉嵌入在外观线索重要时占优，两者融合可获得最佳检索性能。
AI.motivation: 大规模自动驾驶数据集包含海量场景，现有检索方法要么依赖视觉表示要么依赖运动描述，难以理解各自优缺点。需要统一框架来比较并融合这两种互补的相似性度量。
AI.method: 提出多模态检索框架，包含两种轨迹方法：Exo-Trajectory（基于周围智能体运动的显式匹配）和ScenarioFormer（基于对比学习的Transformer轨迹表示），与强视觉基线对比，并探索视觉与轨迹融合策略。
AI.result: 轨迹表示在切入、转弯、排队等运动中心事件中检索性能强；视觉嵌入在外观信息丰富时表现好；两者融合一致提升检索质量，达到最优效果。
AI.conclusion: 外观和运动捕获是场景相似性的互补概念，应构建多模态检索系统用于自动驾驶数据挖掘、数据集整理和基于场景的验证。

title: Risk-Aware General-Utility Markov Decision Processes
summary: We study general-utility Markov decision processes (GUMDPs) with risk-aware objectives. In this framework, an agent aims to optimize a risk measure of the distribution of objective values, where the objective function depends on the frequency of visitation of states induced by the agent's policy. First, we motivate, propose, and formalize risk-aware GUMDPs, which enable agents and decision makers to trade off expected performance by risk aversion while benefiting from the rich set of objectives that can be cast under the framework of GUMDPs. We focus our attention on the entropic risk measure (ERM). Second, we show how we can solve risk-aware GUMDPs with ERM objectives by resorting to online planning techniques. In particular, we propose an approach based on Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to provably solve risk-aware GUMDPs up to any desired accuracy. Third, we provide a set of experimental results showcasing that our approach is successful when optimizing for a spectrum of risk-aware behaviors in the context of GUMDPs under diverse tasks (standard MDPs, maximum state entropy exploration, imitation learning, and multi-objective MDPs).

AI.tldr: 本文研究了具有风险意识目标的一般效用马尔可夫决策过程（GUMDP）。作者首先形式化了风险感知的GUMDP，并重点关注熵风险度量（ERM）。然后，他们提出了一种基于蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）的在线规划方法，可证明地求解风险感知GUMDP至任意精度。实验表明该方法在标准MDP、最大状态熵探索、模仿学习和多目标MDP等多种任务中有效。
AI.motivation: 现有的GUMDP框架缺乏对风险敏感性的考虑，而现实中的决策者往往需要在期望性能与风险规避之间进行权衡。本文旨在将风险度量引入GUMDP，使智能体能够优化目标值分布的风险度量，从而实现风险感知的决策。
AI.method: 形式化了风险感知的GUMDP，采用熵风险度量（ERM）作为风险目标。提出基于蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）的在线规划算法，可证明地求解该问题至任意精度。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法在标准MDP、最大状态熵探索、模仿学习和多目标MDP等不同任务中，能够成功优化一系列风险感知行为。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的风险感知GUMDP框架和基于MCTS的求解方法能够有效支持智能体在多种任务中权衡期望性能与风险规避，拓展了GUMDP的应用范围。

title: Parameter-Efficient Vision-Language Adaptation with Continuous Metadata Conditioning for Animal Re-Identification
comment: This is the author's version of the paper accepted for publication in Expert Systems with Applications. The final authenticated version will be available from the publisher
summary: Long-term animal re-identification (ReID) must remain robust to gradual morphological evolution and seasonal appearance shifts. Although recent vision-language models provide strong pretrained visual representations, adapting them to longitudinal ecological settings remains challenging, particularly under identity and temporal distribution shifts. We present a parameter-efficient CLIP adaptation framework for animal ReID and introduce a continuous metadata-conditioning mechanism that incorporates numerical attributes directly into the prompt representation during training. While low-rank visual adaptation, prompt-based supervision, and cross-modal alignment provide the adaptation framework, the proposed metadata-conditioning strategy constitutes the primary methodological contribution. By preserving the continuous structure of numerical metadata rather than discretizing it into textual categories, the proposed approach enables smooth modulation of the embedding space during training while maintaining a purely visual inference pipeline. Experiments on a seven-year longitudinal fish dataset and multiple wildlife benchmarks demonstrate improved performance under closed-set, open-set, and time-aware evaluation protocols. The results demonstrate that continuous metadata conditioning improves robustness to longitudinal appearance variation and temporal distribution shifts, while parameter-efficient adaptation enables a purely visual inference pipeline without requiring metadata at test time. Code and evaluation splits can be found at: https://github.com/AnilOsmanTur/MetaPrompt-ReID.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种参数高效的CLIP适应框架用于动物再识别，并引入连续元数据条件机制，通过在训练时将数值属性直接注入提示表示来实现嵌入空间的平滑调制，同时保持纯视觉推理流程。在长时序鱼类数据集和多个野生动物基准上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 长期动物再识别需要应对形态演变和季节外观变化，现有视觉-语言模型适应纵向生态场景仍面临身份和时间分布漂移的挑战。
AI.method: 基于CLIP的参数高效适应框架，包含低秩视觉适应、提示监督、跨模态对齐，核心贡献是连续元数据条件机制，将数值元数据连续地融入提示表示，避免离散化为文本类别。
AI.result: 在七年鱼类数据集和多个野生动物基准上，在闭集、开集和时间感知评估协议下均表现提升，提高了对长期外观变化和时间分布漂移的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 连续元数据条件机制提升了鲁棒性，参数高效适应实现了无需测试时元数据的纯视觉推理管线。

title: Shortcut Trajectory Planning for Efficient Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Diffusion-based trajectory planners have shown strong performance in offline reinforcement learning, but their iterative denoising process often incurs high inference cost. Consistency-based planners reduce the number of sampling steps, yet they typically rely on a two-stage teacher--student distillation pipeline that increases training cost and may introduce instability. We propose Shortcut Trajectory Planning (STP), an offline model-based reinforcement learning framework that incorporates shortcut models as efficient trajectory generators. STP trains a conditional shortcut trajectory model in a single stage, supports adjustable one-step and few-step inference through step-size conditioning, and selects candidate plans using a critic augmented with feasibility-aware correction. Across standard D4RL benchmarks, including locomotion, navigation, manipulation, and dexterous control tasks, STP achieves strong performance while simplifying the training pipeline for fast generative planning.

AI.tldr: 提出Shortcut Trajectory Planning (STP)，一种离线模型强化学习框架，通过单阶段训练条件捷径轨迹模型，支持可调的一步/少步推理，结合可行性感知校正的评论家选择候选计划，在D4RL基准上取得强性能且简化了训练流程。
AI.motivation: 扩散规划器推理成本高，一致性规划器虽减少采样步但依赖两阶段师生蒸馏，训练成本高且不稳定。需要一种高效、稳定、训练简单的轨迹生成方法。
AI.method: STP框架包含单阶段训练的条件捷径轨迹模型（shortcut model），通过步长条件化（step-size conditioning）实现可调的一步或几步推理；并使用带有可行性感知校正的评论家（critic）来筛选候选计划。
AI.result: 在D4RL基准的多个任务（运动、导航、操作、灵巧控制）上，STP取得了强性能。
AI.conclusion: STP在保持强性能的同时简化了训练流程，实现了快速生成式规划。

title: Robustifying Vision-Language Models via Test-Time Prompt Adaptation
summary: Pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) such as CLIP achieve strong zero-shot generalization, but their performance degrades sharply under adversarial perturbations. Existing test-time adaptation methods typically rely on sample-level confidence heuristics, overlooking the intrinsic distributional structure of the data. This sample-centric approach limits robustness, as it fails to distinguish confident adversarial mispredictions from true semantic consistency. In this work, we observe that adversarial distortion is structurally brittle: while holistic representations are corrupted, semantic integrity is often preserved in the distribution of augmented views. Motivated by this insight, we propose RITA, a Robust test-tIme prompt-TAdaptation framework that shifts from sample-level estimates to distribution-level alignment. Specifically, RITA employs optimal transport to align the distribution of augmented visual features with textual prototypes, mitigating adversarial outliers and rectifying cross-modal semantic misalignment. Furthermore, we introduce a dynamic cache to progressively accumulate reliable cues from the test stream for online refinement. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RITA significantly improves adversarial robustness without compromising clean accuracy.

AI.tldr: 针对预训练视觉语言模型（如CLIP）在对抗扰动下性能下降的问题，提出RITA框架，利用最优传输在测试时对齐增强视图的分布与文本原型，并引入动态缓存在线积累可靠线索，从而提升对抗鲁棒性且不损失干净精度。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时自适应方法依赖样本级置信度启发式，忽略数据内在分布结构，难以区分置信度高的对抗误判与真实的语义一致性；观察发现对抗扰动在结构上是脆弱的，整体表征被破坏但语义完整性在增强视图的分布中得以保留。
AI.method: 提出RITA框架：1) 从样本级估计转向分布级对齐，使用最优传输将增强视觉特征的分布与文本原型对齐，缓解对抗异常值并纠正跨模态语义错位；2) 引入动态缓存，逐步从测试流中积累可靠线索进行在线优化。
AI.result: 大量实验表明RITA显著提升对抗鲁棒性，同时不降低干净样本上的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 分布级对齐比样本级方法更有效利用测试时数据的内在结构，动态缓存机制可在线增强鲁棒性；RITA为VLM测试时对抗防御提供了新思路。

title: Graph Neural Networks for Scalable and Transferable Node Centrality Approximation
summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) provide a learning-based framework for approximating graph quantities that are expensive to compute exactly. This paper investigates GNNs for scalable approximation of betweenness and closeness centrality, formulated as a node-ranking problem. Exact centrality values are used as supervision, and ranking quality is evaluated using Kendall's tau rank correlation. We study whether message-passing GNNs can learn transferable structural representations across different graph topologies rather than only fitting the distribution used during training. On unseen Erdos renyi graphs, the proposed models achieve tau = 0.851 for betweenness and tau = 0.894 for closeness. A large-scale betweenness model trained on graphs with N = 5,000 nodes achieves tau = 0.938, demonstrating scalability. Mixed-distribution training on Erdos renyi, Barabasi-Albert, and Gaussian Random Partition graphs improves betweenness transfer across graph families. In contrast, closeness centrality remains more sensitive to community-structured graphs and shows reduced transfer to real-world topologies. Finally, GNN inference achieves up to a 97.7x speedup over exact computation. These results show that mixed-distribution training can improve structural transfer in GNN-based centrality approximation, while identifying closeness centrality's sensitivity to topology as an open challenge.

AI.tldr: 本文研究使用图神经网络（GNN）来近似计算介数中心性和接近中心性，将其建模为节点排序问题。实验表明，混合分布训练能提升不同图拓扑间的结构迁移能力，GNN推理相比精确计算加速最高达97.7倍，同时指出接近中心性对社区结构敏感是开放挑战。
AI.motivation: 中心性指标（如介数、接近中心性）是图分析中的重要工具，但精确计算在大规模图上成本高昂。现有方法难以在可扩展性和跨拓扑泛化能力之间取得平衡。本文探索GNN能否学习可迁移的结构表示，从而在不同图结构上高效近似中心性排序。
AI.method: 采用消息传递GNN，以精确中心性值作为监督，将问题转化为节点排序任务，使用Kendall's tau评估排序质量。训练数据包括Erdos-Renyi、Barabasi-Albert、Gaussian Random Partition等图分布，并测试混合分布训练对跨图家族迁移的影响。
AI.result: 在未见过的Erdos-Renyi图上，介数中心性τ=0.851，接近中心性τ=0.894；大规模模型（N=5000）介数τ=0.938。混合分布训练改善了介数中心性在不同图族间的迁移，但接近中心性在社区结构图上迁移效果下降。GNN推理相比精确计算加速97.7倍。
AI.conclusion: 混合分布训练能提升GNN中心性近似中的结构迁移能力，但接近中心性对拓扑敏感性问题仍需进一步研究。GNN在可扩展性和泛化性上表现出潜力。

title: Hydra++: Real-Time Hierarchical 3D Scene Graph Construction With Object-Level Shape Estimation
comment: 8 pages, 12 figures, accepted in Proc. IEEE/RSJ IROS
summary: 3D scene graphs provide a hierarchical abstraction of environments by encoding spatial entities, such as objects and places, and their relationships. However, existing scene graph systems model object geometry coarsely, relying on partial point clouds or class-level CAD templates, which limits instance-specific shape detail. This paper presents Hydra++, a system-level investigation into how learning-based object shape estimators can be integrated into a hierarchical 3D scene graph pipeline. Hydra++ incorporates category-agnostic shape estimation and a reprojection-mask consistency check to reject degenerate predictions from partial observations or imprecise segmentation. In its default CRISP-based configuration, Hydra++ performs online scene graph construction; slower estimators such as SAM3D are evaluated as modular alternatives to demonstrate generalization-latency trade-offs. Furthermore, to address the challenges of sparse and noisy depth measurements in outdoor environments, Hydra++ supports a hybrid LiDAR-camera configuration for large-scale operation, improving scene-level reconstruction quality. Experiments in both simulation and real-world outdoor campus scenarios demonstrate that Hydra++ improves object- and scene-level reconstruction quality. Project page is available at https://hydra-plusplus.github.io/.

AI.tldr: Hydra++是一个将学习型物体形状估计器集成到分层3D场景图管道中的系统，通过类别无关形状估计和重投影掩码一致性检查来提升物体和场景级别的重建质量，支持在线构建和混合LiDAR-相机配置，适用于室内外环境。
AI.motivation: 现有3D场景图系统对物体几何的建模较为粗糙，依赖部分点云或类别级CAD模板，缺乏实例级别的形状细节。为了解决这一问题，需要将学习型物体形状估计器集成到层次化3D场景图流程中，以获得更精细的几何表示。
AI.method: Hydra++集成了类别无关的形状估计方法，并引入重投影掩码一致性检查来剔除因部分观测或不精确分割导致的退化预测。默认采用基于CRISP的配置实现在线场景图构建，同时将SAM3D等较慢的估计器作为模块化替代方案以展示泛化-延迟权衡。针对室外环境中深度测量稀疏且有噪声的问题，支持混合LiDAR-相机配置用于大规模操作，提升场景级重建质量。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实世界室外校园场景中的实验表明，Hydra++在物体级别和场景级别的重建质量上均有所提升。
AI.conclusion: Hydra++通过集成形状估计器有效提升了3D场景图中物体几何的细节层次，并且通过混合传感器配置适应室外大规模场景，为场景图构建提供了更精确的几何表示。

title: Foveation-Guided Dynamic Token Selection for Robust and Efficient Vision Transformers
summary: The human visual system (HVS) employs foveated sampling and eye movements to achieve efficient perception, conserving both metabolic energy and computational resources. Drawing inspiration from this robustness and adaptability, we introduce the Foveated Dynamic Transformer (FDT), a foveation-guided dynamic token-selection architecture that integrates these mechanisms into a vision transformer framework. The FDT exhibits strong resilience to various types of noise and adversarial attacks, despite not being explicitly trained for such challenges. This inherent robustness is achieved through the use of fixation and foveation modules: the fixation module identifies fixation points to filter out irrelevant information, while the foveation module generates foveated embeddings with multi-scale information. At the 50% fixation-budget setting, FDT achieves higher accuracy than DeiT-S (81.9% vs. 80.9%) while reducing multiply-accumulate operations by 34.57%, highlighting one operating point on its accuracy-efficiency trade-off. These attributes position FDT as an HVS-inspired step toward artificial neural networks that combine adaptive computation with improved resilience.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Foveated Dynamic Transformer (FDT)，一种受人类视觉系统启发、基于注视点引导的动态令牌选择视觉Transformer架构，在低计算预算下实现了比DeiT-S更高的精度，并具有内在的抗噪声和对抗攻击鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 受人类视觉系统（HVS）中注视点采样和眼动机制的启发，希望将这种高效感知、节省代谢能量和计算资源的鲁棒性与适应性引入视觉Transformer框架中。
AI.method: 提出FDT架构，包含两个核心模块：（1）注视模块（fixation module），用于识别注视点以过滤无关信息；（2）中心凹模块（foveation module），生成具有多尺度信息的中心凹嵌入（foveated embeddings），实现动态令牌选择。
AI.result: 在50%注视预算设置下，FDT在ImageNet上达到81.9%的精度（高于DeiT-S的80.9%），同时将乘累加操作（MACs）减少34.57%。此外，FDT在未经过专门对抗训练的情况下，展现出对多种噪声和对抗攻击的内在鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: FDT作为受HVS启发的步骤，展示了将自适应计算与增强鲁棒性相结合的人工神经网络方向，在精度-效率权衡曲线上提供了有竞争力的操作点。

title: Learning Physics-Informed Surrogate Model of Linear Elastic Displacement Fields from Geometry
summary: This work aims to develop a fast and physically consistent surrogate model for real-time structural health monitoring of fractured elastic domains. We propose a physics-informed DeepONet framework that predicts displacement fields from both boundary conditions and fracture geometry, using a dedicated encoding strategy for the latter and without relying on finite-element-generated training data. The traction-free condition on the fracture boundary is imposed weakly through a localized penalty term. The presented numerical example focuses on one representative fracture geometry, demonstrating the feasibility of the formulation and laying the groundwork for extensions to surrogate modeling across diverse fracture geometries.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于物理信息的DeepONet代理模型，用于断裂弹性体的实时结构健康监测，该模型无需有限元训练数据，通过弱约束处理裂缝边界条件，实现位移场预测。
AI.motivation: 开发快速且物理一致的代理模型，用于实时结构健康监测中的断裂弹性域，避免依赖有限元生成训练数据的高成本。
AI.method: 采用物理信息DeepONet框架，通过专用编码策略表示裂缝几何，利用局部惩罚项弱施加裂缝边界上的无牵引条件。
AI.result: 数值示例针对一种代表性裂缝几何验证了公式的可行性，为扩展到多种裂缝几何的代理建模奠定了基础。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够快速预测位移场，无需有限元数据，为实时结构健康监测提供物理一致的代理模型。

title: Decoupling Language Guidance from Backbones for Text-Guided Medical Segmentation
summary: Text-guided medical image segmentation leverages clinical semantics to improve lesion delineation, yet many existing models bind cross-modal fusion, supervision, and decoder design into a task-specific architecture. Such tight coupling makes it difficult to reuse language guidance modules across heterogeneous vision and text backbones, and often requires redesigning the network when the encoder pair changes. This paper presents BTHA, a backbone-transferable hierarchical adapter framework for text-guided medical image segmentation. BTHA is built around a stable feature-level interface: given multi-scale visual features and a text representation, it injects semantic guidance through shape-preserving adapters while maintaining the decoder-side tensor contract. To make this interface effective, we introduce a Hierarchical Coarse-to-Fine Supervision Strategy that decomposes learning into global image-text alignment, multi-scale auxiliary localization, and boundary-aware final mask refinement. We further design a Scale-Adaptive Gated Semantic Guidance (SAGSG) adapter, where resolution-specific gates adaptively control textual injection and channel recalibration suppresses redundant cross-modal responses. Evaluations across diverse vision and text backbones show that the same adapter and supervision design remains effective across convolutional and transformer-based visual encoders as well as different language encoders. Experiments on four public datasets further demonstrate that BTHA improves strong text-guided baselines with modest computational overhead.

AI.tldr: BTHA是一个骨干网络可迁移的分层适配器框架，通过特征级接口和粗到细的分层监督策略，实现文本引导的医学图像分割，且在不同视觉和文本骨干网络上保持有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有文本引导医学图像分割模型将跨模态融合、监督和decoder设计紧密耦合到特定任务架构中，导致语言引导模块难以跨异构视觉和文本骨干复用，更换编码器对时通常需要重新设计网络。
AI.method: 提出BTHA框架，包含：(1) 稳定的特征级接口，通过保持形状的适配器注入语义引导并维持decoder张量契约；(2) 层次化粗到细监督策略，分解为全局图文对齐、多尺度辅助定位和边界感知最终掩码精炼；(3) 尺度自适应门控语义引导(SAGSG)适配器，通过分辨率特定门控控制文本注入，通道重校准抑制冗余跨模态响应。
AI.result: 在多种视觉和文本骨干网络（卷积与Transformer）上验证了同一适配器和监督设计的有效性，在四个公共数据集上提升了强文本引导基线性能，且计算开销适中。
AI.conclusion: BTHA实现了骨干网络可迁移的文本引导医学图像分割，解耦了跨模态融合与特定架构的绑定关系，具有良好的泛化性和实用性。

title: Fully Trainable Deep Differentiable Logic Gate Networks and Lookup Table Networks
summary: We introduce a novel method for both partial and full optimization of the connections in deep differentiable logic gate networks (LGNs) and lookup table networks (LUTNs). Our training method utilizes a probability distribution over a set of connections per gate/lookup table (LUT) input pin, selecting the connection with highest merit, all whilst the optimal gate types or LUT-entries are learned in parallel. We show that the connection-optimized LGNs outperform standard fixed-connection LGNs on the Yin-Yang, MNIST Handwritten Digits and Fashion-MNIST benchmarks, while requiring only a fraction of the number of logic gates. We achieve 98.92% on the MNIST dataset with two layers of 8000 gates. With only one layer of 8000 gates, we obtain 98.45%, showing that our method requires almost 50 times fewer gates compared to fixed-connection LGNs. Training stability up to ten layers has been ensured by employing a high learning rate, straight-through estimators and trimming constant-output gate types. Additionally, we present a LUT neuron description that enables stable training with backpropagation, tested up to 6-layer deep networks. The model requires four times fewer trainable parameters and still achieves a higher accuracy compared to the fixed-connection LGN training algorithm. Our connection-training algorithm also works well for the LUTNs, achieving an accuracy of 98.88% for two layers of 2000 6-input LUTs.

AI.tldr: 提出一种针对可微逻辑门网络(LGN)和查找表网络(LUTN)的连接优化训练方法，通过概率分布选择最佳连接，同时学习最优门类型/LUT条目。该方法显著减少了所需逻辑门数量（在MNIST上以8000门两层网络达98.92%，比固定连接LGN减少约50倍门数），并在多个基准测试上超越固定连接模型。此外，LUT神经元描述支持高达6层的稳定反向传播训练，参数减少4倍且精度更高。
AI.motivation: 旨在优化深度可微逻辑门网络和查找表网络的连接结构，以解决固定连接LGNs需要大量逻辑门的问题，同时保持或提升模型性能，并实现更深层网络的稳定训练。
AI.method: 对每个门/LUT输入引脚维护一组候选连接的概率分布，训练时选择具有最高"价值"的连接，同时并行学习最优门类型或LUT条目。采用高学习率、直通估计器(straight-through estimators)和修剪常输出门类型来确保多达十层的训练稳定性。对于LUT网络，提出一种新的LUT神经元描述以支持反向传播稳定训练。
AI.result: 连接优化的LGN在Yin-Yang、MNIST和Fashion-MNIST上优于固定连接版本。MNIST上两层8000门达98.92%，单层8000门达98.45%，门数减少约50倍。LUT网络两层2000个6输入LUT达98.88%。参数减少4倍且精度更高。训练稳定至十层(LGN)和六层(LUTN)。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的连接优化方法能显著降低逻辑门/LUT数量需求，同时提升或保持准确率，且支持更深层网络的稳定训练，为可微逻辑网络的高效学习提供了有效途径。

title: SigLIP-HD by Fine-to-Coarse Supervision
summary: High-quality visual representation is a long-standing pursuit in computer vision. In the context of multimodal LLMs (MLLMs), feeding higher-resolution images can produce more fine-grained visual tokens. However, it introduces additional computational and design complexity, due to multiple forward passes and post-processing of increased tokens. Before simply adopting a higher resolution, have we truly unlocked the model's full perception capability at a standard resolution? Therefore, we study an interesting problem: how to achieve fine visual perception under lower cost without larger images. We present SigLIP-HD in this work. The core is a highly simple fine-to-coarse supervision design. We enforce the coarse feature of a mid-resolution image to mimic the fine-grained feature of its high-resolution version. We build this framework on the advanced SigLIP 2 model. Our final model produces better visual tokens at exactly the same inference budget. It is validated on extensive MLLM benchmarks and consistently delivers stronger results than our baseline model, especially on OCR-related tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SigLIP-HD，一种无需更高分辨率图像即可提升多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）视觉表征质量的方法。核心是简单的“由细到粗”（fine-to-coarse）监督设计：强制中等分辨率图像的粗粒度特征模仿其高分辨率版本的细粒度特征。基于SigLIP 2构建，在相同推理预算下生成更优的视觉token，在OCR等任务上显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 传统上为提升MLLMs视觉感知能力，采用更高分辨率图像以产生更精细的视觉token，但这增加了计算和设计复杂度（额外的前向传播和token后处理）。作者质疑：在直接采用更高分辨率之前，是否已充分挖掘模型在标准分辨率下的感知能力？因此，目标是在不引入更大图像的情况下，实现低成本的精细视觉感知。
AI.method: 提出SigLIP-HD框架，核心是“由细到粗”的监督设计：强制中等分辨率（mid-resolution）图像的粗粒度特征去模仿其高分辨率版本的细粒度特征。该框架基于SigLIP 2模型构建，通过这种特征模仿学习，使得模型在标准分辨率推理时能产生更高质量的视觉token，且推理预算不变。
AI.result: 在多个MLLM基准上，SigLIP-HD相比基线模型（使用相同推理预算的标准分辨率模型）持续取得更强的结果，尤其在OCR相关任务上提升显著。验证了在相同计算开销下，通过特征模仿可有效提升视觉表征质量。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明，在MLLMs中，无需提升输入图像分辨率，仅通过设计合适的监督策略（fine-to-coarse特征模仿）即可释放模型在标准分辨率下的感知潜力，获得更优的视觉token，从而实现性能提升。该工作为高效视觉表征学习提供了新思路。

title: On-Device Adaptive Battery Power Prediction for Electric Vehicles
comment: 6 pages, 3 tables, 5 figures; Accepted to IEEE EdgeCom 2025
summary: Adaptive power management in Electric Vehicles (EVs) requires accurate power prediction. Although deep learning models have emerged as highly effective for time-series forecasting in this domain, their performance is prone to degradation when exposed to data with distributions different from the training data. We introduce a novel approach that enables on-device learning in resource-constrained EV systems to continuously adapt pretrained battery prediction models to new, unseen data. We leverage existing pretrained models by transforming them into adaptable versions that retain critical hyperparameter knowledge from their initial training. We comprehensively investigate both online and offline model adaptation strategies. Our results demonstrate significant improvements in forecasting performance across various models and time horizons, achieving mean absolute error reductions of up to 7.49\% and 14.88\% with online and offline adaptation techniques, respectively. This study highlights the substantial benefit of on-device adaptation, resulting in enhanced battery power predictions than unadapted model deployments in real-world EV scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出一种在资源受限的电动汽车系统中进行设备端学习的方法，持续将预训练的电池预测模型适应到新的、未见过的数据上，通过在线和离线两种适应策略显著提升预测性能。
AI.motivation: 电动汽车自适应电源管理需要精确的功率预测，但深度学习模型在遇到与训练数据分布不同的新数据时性能会下降，因此需要模型适应新分布的能力。
AI.method: 将现有预训练模型转换为可适应版本，保留初始训练的关键超参数知识；系统性地研究了在线适应和离线适应两种模型适应策略。
AI.result: 在线适应和离线适应分别实现平均绝对误差减少最高达7.49%和14.88%，在各种模型和时间范围上均表现出显著的预测性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 设备端适应策略在实际电动汽车场景中相比未适应的模型部署能够显著提升电池功率预测性能，具有重要的实用价值。

title: What VGGT Knows About Overlap: Probing Geometric Foundation Models for Co-Visibility
summary: A fundamental challenge in 3D reconstruction and robotic localization is co-visibility: determining which image pairs share overlapping visible surfaces, particularly in scenarios with minimal overlap. We demonstrate that VGGT implicitly encodes co-visibility as an emergent behavior: without any supervision for this task, its internal representations exhibit a clear hierarchical structure mirroring that of large language models, i.e. early layers build a 3D-aware scene representation, while late layers act as dedicated co-visibility reasoners. In particular, we identify layer L17 as a negative anchor that consistently routes non-co-visible pairs for this backbone, regardless of the evaluation setting, providing task-grounded evidence of layer specialization in a geometry-grounded foundation model. Building on this, we introduce Co-VGGT, which freezes VGGT and trains only a lightweight layer-wise mixture-of-experts head (less than 7.5M parameters) to classify co-visibility from RGB alone, treating each layer as a specialized expert whose geometric abstraction is adaptively weighted per input pair. On the Co-VisiON benchmark, Co-VGGT surpasses the human annotation baseline and improves over prior work by more than 25% pairwise and 10% multiview. Pairwise predictions are well-calibrated (ECE=0.030), enabling direct use as edge weights in visibility graphs for downstream SfM and SLAM pipelines without post-hoc correction. Code and data are available.

AI.tldr: 本文发现VGGT模型隐式编码了共视关系（co-visibility），其内部表示呈现层级结构：早期层构建3D场景表示，后期层充当共视推理器。基于此，提出Co-VGGT，冻结VGGT并训练一个轻量级逐层混合专家头（<7.5M参数），仅从RGB图像分类共视对。在Co-VisiON基准上，Co-VGGT超过人工标注基线，比先前方法提升25%以上（成对）和10%（多视图），预测校准良好（ECE=0.030），可直接用于SfM/SLAM的可见性图。
AI.motivation: 3D重建和机器人定位中的共视性判断是一个基础挑战，特别是在图像重叠区域很小的情况下。现有方法需要大量监督或后处理校正，缺乏高效且可直接使用的方案。
AI.method: 首先分析VGGT的层级表示，发现其隐含共视编码，识别出第17层作为负锚点（negative anchor）。然后提出Co-VGGT，冻结VGGT所有层，训练一个轻量级逐层混合专家（MoE）头，将每层视为一个专家，自适应加权其几何抽象特征，从RGB图像对直接分类共视性。
AI.result: 在Co-VisiON基准上，Co-VGGT超过人工标注基线，成对共视分类提升>25%，多视图提升>10%。预测校准误差ECE=0.030，表明校准良好。
AI.conclusion: Co-VGGT的预测可直接作为可见性图的边权重用于下游SfM和SLAM流水线，无需后处理校正。代码和数据已公开。

title: Data-Efficient Deep Learning: Empirical Guidelines for Training Set Size Estimation in Inertial Sensor Classification
summary: Deep learning models dependency on large-scale inertial datasets presents a significant bottleneck in inertial sensor-based classification tasks, such as human activity recognition and smartphone location recognition. In these domains, data collection requires massive recording campaigns that are complex, time-consuming, and difficult to scale. Currently, data-driven guidelines for determining the minimum sample size required to reach a desired accuracy level do not exist. To address this gap, this study presents a systematic empirical evaluation of learning curve convergence rates in inertial classification. We introduce a unified framework that analyzes classification performance under both binary and multi-class scenarios, and derive an empirical formula to estimate performance relative to dataset size. Testing across six diverse, real-world datasets totaling 102.7 hours of inertial measurements demonstrates that accuracy follows a consistent logarithmic growth pattern, regardless of task complexity. Leveraging this finding, we propose a quantitative stability point metric, defined as the sample size required for the learning curve to stabilize within a predefined mean absolute percentage deviation of its asymptotic maximum. Our analysis reveals that models often reach practical stability with substantially fewer samples than traditional heuristics suggest. Ultimately, we offer a generalizable framework to extrapolate total data requirements from small-scale pilot studies, optimizing the tradeoff between recording effort and model reliability. These findings shift the prevailing paradigm from maximizing data volume toward optimizing data efficiency, offering concrete, data-backed guidelines for planning recording campaigns in inertial sensing applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一框架，系统评估惯性传感器分类任务（如人类活动识别和智能手机位置识别）中学习曲线的收敛速率。通过六个真实数据集（总计102.7小时惯性测量）的实验，发现准确率遵循一致的对数增长模式，并据此提出稳定性点度量指标，证明模型通常在远少于传统启发式方法所需样本量时即可达到实际稳定。最终提供了一个从小型预研外推总数据需求的通用框架，优化记录努力与模型可靠性之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 深度学习模型依赖大规模惯性数据集，但数据收集耗时、复杂且难以扩展，目前缺乏数据驱动的指南来确定达到期望准确率所需的最小样本量。
AI.method: 提出了一个统一框架，分析二分类和多分类场景下的分类性能，推导了经验公式以估计性能与数据集大小的关系。在六个真实世界数据集（共102.7小时惯性测量）上进行测试，提出定量稳定性点度量（基于平均绝对百分比偏差定义学习曲线稳定所需的样本量）。
AI.result: 准确率遵循一致的对数增长模式，与任务复杂度无关。模型通常在远少于传统启发式方法建议的样本量时即可达到实际稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 提供了一个通用框架，可从小型预研外推总数据需求，优化记录努力与模型可靠性的权衡。将范式从最大化数据量转向优化数据效率，为惯性感知应用中的记录规划提供具体的数据支持指南。

title: DGSfM: Depth-Guided Scale-Aware Global Structure-from-Motion
summary: Global Structure-from-Motion (SfM) is an efficient paradigm for recovering camera poses and sparse 3D structure from unordered images. However, its reliance on scale-ambiguous epipolar geometry makes global positioning sensitive to noisy baseline estimates and weak view-graph constraints, while false edges from visually ambiguous pairs can further degrade reconstruction. We propose DGSfM, a depth-aware global SfM pipeline that uses monocular depth maps as a scalable prior while preserving explicit multi-view optimization. For each image pair, we use a depth-aware relative pose solver to convert scale-ambiguous epipolar constraints into scale-aware relative pose constraints. We further improve robustness through view-graph filtering and depth-consistency-based correspondence pruning, which suppress false edges and matches that remain plausible under epipolar geometry alone. Finally, global scale averaging and depth-guided pose-point initialization align monocular depth maps into a common reconstruction scale and provide stable initialization for global positioning and bundle adjustment. Experiments on ETH3D and IMC2021 show that DGSfM consistently improves over strong global SfM baselines across sparse and dense matching front-ends, achieving substantial gains in pose accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/sithu31296/DGSfM.

AI.tldr: DGSfM 是一种深度感知的全局运动恢复结构（SfM）管道，通过利用单目深度图作为可扩展先验，将尺度模糊的对极几何约束转换为尺度感知的相对位姿约束，并结合视图图过滤和深度一致性对应修剪来提升鲁棒性，在 ETH3D 和 IMC2021 数据集上显著优于现有全局 SfM 基线。
AI.motivation: 全局 SfM 依赖尺度模糊的对极几何，导致全局位姿估计对噪声基线估计和弱视图图约束敏感，同时视觉模糊对产生的错误边会进一步恶化重建质量。现有方法缺乏显式的深度信息来消除尺度模糊性，因此需要一种能够利用单目深度先验来提升全局 SfM 鲁棒性和精度的方法。
AI.method: 1) 深度感知相对位姿求解器：将每对图像的尺度模糊对极约束转换为尺度感知的相对位姿约束。2) 视图图过滤与深度一致性对应修剪：抑制仅在对极几何下看似合理的假边和误匹配。3) 全局尺度平均与深度引导的位姿-点初始化：将单目深度图对齐到共同重建尺度，为全局位姿估计和光束法平差提供稳定初始化。
AI.result: 在 ETH3D 和 IMC2021 数据集上，DGSfM 在稀疏和稠密匹配前端均一致地优于强全局 SfM 基线，在位姿精度上取得了显著提升。
AI.conclusion: DGSfM 通过将单目深度先验有效融入全局 SfM 流程，解决了尺度模糊性和假边问题，显著提升了位姿估计的准确性和鲁棒性，为全局 SfM 提供了一种实用的增强方案。

title: SYNRARE: Synthetic Rare Disease EHR Generation for ML Benchmarking
comment: Intended for submission to the Application Notes Bioinformatics Journal
summary:
Motivation: Rare disease (RD) diagnosis is frequently delayed due to the similarities in symptoms to common disease variants. Machine Learning Algorithms applied to Electronic Health Records show promise for accelerating the diagnosis; however, legal and privacy concerns pose significant barriers. To address these issues, Synthetic Data Generation is an alternative method for obtaining Electronic Health Records and can be applied with any Machine Learning algorithm for benchmarking and development purposes. Despite the availability of Synthetic Data Generation algorithms, support for generating a subset of patients that differ in a definable degree from the majority to simulate patients with RD is often lacking.
  Results: We present SYNRARE, a graphical user interface based on the Synthea framework that enables easier modification and generation of synthetic Electronic Health Records of RD patients, which differ only to a definable degree from patients with common diseases, thereby enabling the benchmarking and testing of algorithms under controlled technical conditions. SYNRARE enables researchers to rapidly benchmark their Machine Learning algorithms across any scenario.
  Availability and implementation: SYNRARE, including detailed instructions for installing, is available at https://gitlab.sdu.dk/screen4care/synrare.

AI.tldr: SYNRARE是一个基于Synthea框架的图形用户界面工具，用于生成模拟罕见病患者的合成电子健康记录，这些记录与常见病患者仅在可定义程度上不同，从而支持机器学习算法的基准测试和开发。
AI.motivation: 罕见病诊断常因症状与常见病相似而延误，机器学习算法可用于加速诊断，但法律和隐私问题限制了真实电子健康记录的使用。合成数据生成可作为替代方案，但现有方法缺乏对生成与多数患者有可控差异的亚群（以模拟罕见病患者）的支持。
AI.method: 基于Synthea框架开发SYNRARE图形用户界面，使研究人员能够便捷地修改和生成罕见病患者的合成电子健康记录，并通过可定义的程度控制其与常见病患者的差异。
AI.result: SYNRARE实现了在受控技术条件下生成合成罕见病患者数据，使研究人员能够在各种场景下快速基准测试其机器学习算法。
AI.conclusion: SYNRARE通过提供易于使用的图形界面，解决了合成数据生成中罕见病模拟的不足，为罕见病诊断算法的开发和评估提供了标准化工具。

title: Seeing is Free, Speaking is Not: Uncovering the True Energy Bottleneck in Edge VLM Inference
comment: Accepted to ACM MM 2026. 10 pages, 5 figures
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are the perceptual backbone of embodied AI, but their energy footprint on edge hardware remains poorly understood. Existing efficiency efforts focus predominantly on reducing visual tokens, implicitly treating visual processing as the dominant energy cost. We overturn this implicit assumption through the first systematic energy profiling of on-device VLM inference, spanning five models across three architecture families, four input resolutions, and two hardware platforms (NVIDIA RTX 3070 and Jetson Orin NX). Our analysis yields three findings. First, average inference power is a model-intrinsic constant, invariant to input resolution, image complexity, and prompt type, with less than 5% variation across all conditions. This means that all energy variation across inputs must arise from variation in inference time, not from variation in power draw. Second, each output token costs 11 to 39x more wall-clock time than each input token due to the compute-bound and memory-bound asymmetry between prefill and decode, making output token count the dominant driver of both latency and energy. Third, image complexity, measured by the number of objects in an image, induces up to 4.1x energy differences at identical resolution. This variation arises not from increased visual processing cost, but from differences in output length. These findings expose a fundamental limitation of visual token pruning: even removing all visual tokens saves at most 10% of total energy for fixed-token models. Across models spanning 1 billion to 8 billion parameters, controlling output length saves up to 97% of total energy, with the energy dominance of decoding growing stronger at larger model scale. In short, the true energy bottleneck in edge VLM inference is not what the model sees, but how much it says.

AI.tldr: 通过系统性能耗分析，本文推翻「视觉处理是边缘设备VLM能耗瓶颈」的隐含假设，发现推理功率恒定、输出token数量主导能耗，控制输出长度可节省高达97%能量，而视觉token剪枝最多节省10%。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM能效优化主要聚焦于减少视觉token，默认视觉处理是主要能耗来源。本文旨在通过首次系统性的边缘设备VLM推理能耗剖析，检验并纠正这一隐含假设。
AI.method: 对5个模型（涵盖1B–8B参数）、3种架构、4种输入分辨率、2个硬件平台（RTX 3070和Jetson Orin NX）进行系统能耗测量，分析推理功率、时间、能量与输入分辨率、图像复杂度、提示类型等因素的关系。
AI.result: 1) 平均推理功率是模型固有常数，变化<5%；2) 每个输出token的耗时是输入token的11–39倍，输出token数量主导延迟和能量；3) 图像复杂度（目标数量）通过影响输出长度导致至多4.1倍能耗差异；视觉token剪枝最多节省10%能量，控制输出长度可节省高达97%。
AI.conclusion: 边缘设备VLM推理的真正能耗瓶颈不在于模型“看到”什么（视觉输入），而在于它“说出”多少（输出长度）。因此，能效优化应聚焦于减少输出token数量，而非视觉token剪枝。

title: Similarity search generalisation in contrastive learning with InfoNCE loss
summary: Similarity search is a primary application of embedding models trained by contrastive learning. For one of the most popular contrastive learning loss functions, InfoNCE, we show that the population risk with $k$ negative samples is $O(1/k)$ close to an expected cross-entropy which quantifies deviation between i) a softmax similarity search over unseen data using the learned embedding function, and ii) an idealised softmax search over the same data but using similarity implicitly represented in the positive sample generator. This complements existing interpretations of InfoNCE in the $k\to\infty$ limit which are phrased in terms of mutual information, and alignment versus uniformity in embeddings. To quantify generalisation performance, we introduce a new continuity bound for the InfoNCE loss, obtained via Gâteaux differentiation. The bound preserves the structure of averaging over negative samples present in the loss function and features an ``inverse temperature'' parameter which can be tuned to account for the algorithmic temperature. For embedding functions which are Lipschitz in a parameter, this yields a simple demonstration that the averaging effect of $k$ negative samples in the InfoNCE loss carries over to stabilisation of the generalisation error as $k$ grows.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了对比学习损失函数InfoNCE在相似性搜索中的应用。证明了具有k个负样本的InfoNCE损失的经验风险与一个期望交叉熵之间相差O(1/k)，该交叉熵衡量了学习嵌入的softmax相似性搜索与理想化的基于正样本生成器隐含相似性的softmax搜索之间的偏差。同时，通过Gâteaux微分引入了新的连续性界限，该界限保留了负样本平均结构并包含逆温度参数，表明k个负样本的平均效应有助于随着k增长稳定泛化误差。
AI.motivation: 相似性搜索是嵌入模型的主要应用，而对比学习中的InfoNCE损失函数被广泛使用。现有解释主要关注互信息或嵌入的对齐性与均匀性，但缺乏对有限负样本情况下InfoNCE损失的精确量化以及泛化性能的分析。本文旨在填补这些空白。
AI.method: 理论分析：证明InfoNCE损失的经验风险与期望交叉熵之间的差距为O(1/k)；通过Gâteaux微分推导出新的连续性界限，该界限保留了负样本平均结构并引入逆温度参数；分析Lipschitz嵌入函数下泛化误差的稳定性。
AI.result: 1. InfoNCE损失在k个负样本下的经验风险与期望交叉熵的偏差为O(1/k)。2. 提出的连续性界限展示了负样本平均效应如何有助于泛化误差随k增长而稳定。3. 该界限包含了逆温度参数，可调节以匹配算法温度。
AI.conclusion: 本文对InfoNCE损失在有限负样本下的行为提供了新的理论理解，补充了互信息和对齐-均匀性解释。泛化界限表明增大负样本数量k可以稳定泛化误差，为对比学习实践提供了理论支持。

title: ALICE: Learning a General-Purpose Pathology Foundation Model from Vision, Vision-Language, and Slide-Level Experts
summary: Foundation models are reshaping computational pathology, yet their capabilities remain shaped by pretraining objectives, data sources, and spatial scales, fragmenting complementary expertise across separate backbones. Here we present ALICE, a unified foundation model trained through multi-stage agglomerative distillation that sequentially distills eight vision-only, vision-language, and slide-level teacher models into dedicated modules of a single backbone. ALICE is pretrained on 24,985,184 tile-level pathology images and 155,604 high-resolution images, and evaluated across 21 task scenarios, 96 downstream tasks, and 48 data sources, spanning region-of-interest tissue analysis, vision-language multimodal evaluation, and whole-slide clinical assessment. In all three evaluation settings, ALICE achieved the best average rank among task-matched pathology foundation models. These results demonstrate that agglomerative distillation can consolidate complementary capabilities from specialized models into a unified backbone for broad computational pathology applications. The model is available at https://github.com/WonderLandxD/ALICE.

AI.tldr: ALICE是一个通过多阶段聚合蒸馏训练的统一病理学基础模型，将八种专用教师模型的互补能力蒸馏到单一骨干网络中，在21个任务场景、96个下游任务中达到最优平均排名。
AI.motivation: 现有的病理学基础模型因预训练目标、数据来源和空间尺度的差异，导致互补的专业知识分散在不同的骨干网络中，缺乏统一的模型来整合这些能力。
AI.method: 采用多阶段聚合蒸馏（multi-stage agglomerative distillation），依次将八个教师模型（包括纯视觉、视觉-语言和全切片级别模型）的知识蒸馏到单一骨干网络的专用模块中。模型在24,985,184张Tile级病理图像和155,604张高分辨率图像上预训练。
AI.result: 在21个任务场景、96个下游任务和48个数据源上评估，涵盖区域组织分析、视觉-语言多模态评估和全切片临床评估三个设置，ALICE在所有设置中均达到任务匹配病理基础模型的最佳平均排名。
AI.conclusion: 聚合蒸馏能够将来自专门模型的互补能力整合到统一的骨干网络中，为广泛的病理学应用提供支持。

title: Action-Factored Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Scalable Quantum Device Tuning
summary: Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning is well suited to problems with large parameter spaces and exploitable local structure, such as the tuning of electrostatically-defined quantum-dot arrays. However, if parameter cross-talk is strong, a non-stationary environment from the perspective of any individual agent can destabilize learning - the same effect that plagues manual tuning of such systems. We propose using a factored representation of the action space, learned online, to decouple agents and minimize their interference. Our framework, QADAPT, uses this factorization to efficiently learn shared policies based on local measurements and rewards. With this modular strategy, we achieve zero-shot generalization to unseen quantum device sizes and maintain an approximately constant number of convergence steps to reach target regimes. This work provides a scalable route toward the rapid calibration of large-scale quantum processors.

AI.tldr: 提出了QADAPT框架，采用在线学习的因子化动作空间表示来解耦多智能体，实现零样本泛化到未见过的量子设备尺寸，并保持近似恒定的收敛步数，为大规模量子处理器的快速校准提供了可扩展途径。
AI.motivation: 合作多智能体强化学习适用于具有大参数空间和可利用局部结构的问题（如量子点阵列调谐），但参数串扰会导致环境非平稳，从而破坏学习稳定性，类似于手动调谐中的问题。
AI.method: 提出QADAPT框架，使用在线学习的因子化动作空间表示来解耦智能体并最小化干扰，基于局部测量和奖励高效学习共享策略。
AI.result: 实现了对未见过的量子设备尺寸的零样本泛化，且收敛到目标区域的步数近似恒定。
AI.conclusion: 该模块化策略为大规模量子处理器的快速校准提供了可扩展的途径。

title: The Count Is There, but Misaligned: Understanding and Correcting Counting Failures in VLMs
summary: Despite strong performance on many multimodal tasks, vision-language models (VLMs) still struggle with basic object counting. We investigate whether this reflects missing internal knowledge or a gap between internal representations and verbalized outputs. Training simple probes on activations from four VLMs across five counting datasets reveals that nonlinear probes can reliably detect counting errors, suggesting that VLMs often encode the correct count even when they output the wrong answer. SVCCA analysis shows that probes trained on ground-truth counts and probes trained on model outputs occupy a partially shared activation subspace but read out along misaligned directions. We further validate our findings using a causal steering intervention, proving that strengthening the direction of count-identified probes does improve model counting performance. Motivated by this result, we propose a detector-guided self-correction method that selectively re-prompts the model only when an internal error detector predicts failure. This simple inference-time intervention improves counting accuracy by up to 15.6 absolute percentage points, without any parameter updates. Our results establish activation-based error probing as both a practical tool for improving VLM counting and a mechanistic lens on the gap between internal knowledge and model outputs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了视觉语言模型（VLM）在目标计数任务中表现不佳的原因，发现模型内部表征通常编码了正确的计数值，但输出时存在偏差。通过探针分析、SVCCA和因果干预验证了这一现象，并提出了一种基于内部错误检测器的自纠正方法，在不更新参数的情况下将计数准确率提升最高15.6个百分点。
AI.motivation: 探究VLM在目标计数任务中表现不佳的根本原因：是模型内部缺乏相关知识，还是内部表征与语言输出之间存在脱节。
AI.method: 在四个VLM和五个计数数据集上训练线性/非线性探针检测计数错误；使用SVCCA分析探针子空间对齐程度；通过因果干预（强化计数探针方向）验证内部知识的存在；提出检测器引导的自纠正方法，当内部探针预测到错误时重新提示模型。
AI.result: 非线性探针能可靠检测计数错误，表明模型内部编码了正确计数；SVCCA显示基于真实标签和模型输出的探针共享部分子空间但读出方向不一致；因果干预证明强化计数探针方向可提升计数性能；所提自纠正方法在不更新参数情况下将计数准确率提升最高15.6个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 激活值层面的错误探针既是改进VLM计数的实用工具，也是理解内部知识与模型输出之间差距的机制视角。

title: Active rejection enables reliable generalization of universal machine-learning interatomic potentials
summary: Universal machine learning interatomic potentials (uMLIPs) bridge quantum-mechanical accuracy and large-scale molecular dynamics, but the cost of high-accuracy calculations such as r$^2$SCAN limits training to datasets that remain small relative to the open materials space. Strong average benchmark performance also does not guarantee reliable energy--force predictions for every structure. We propose Adaptive Multi-Teacher Routing (ATR), which reformulates high-fidelity data construction as a structure-wise decision problem under uncertainty. Using a small set of real r$^2$SCAN labels, ATR calibrates multiple pretrained uMLIP teachers and combines structural descriptors, teacher identity, and inter-teacher disagreement to estimate the reliability of each structure--teacher pair. It selects high-confidence predictions for pseudo-label generation and rejects structures for which no teacher is sufficiently reliable. With real r$^2$SCAN labels for only 0.2\% of candidate structures, ATR distils 2.89 million traceable r$^2$SCAN-level pseudo-labels for pretraining. On held-out r$^2$SCAN structures and the MP-r$^2$SCAN benchmark, a lightweight CHGNet trained on the ATR-generated dataset consistently outperforms the baseline and non-routed controls. Finite-temperature molecular dynamics further shows that ATR improves dynamical robustness across multiple material systems, maintaining stable trajectories where baseline simulations undergo catastrophic structural collapse. These results establish active rejection as an effective mechanism for converting multiple pretrained uMLIPs into a scalable and reliable data-construction system for high-fidelity uMLIPs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自适应多教师路由（ATR），将高保真数据构建重新定义为结构层面的不确定决策问题。仅用0.2%的真实r^2SCAN标签，ATR通过校准多个预训练uMLIP教师，结合结构描述符、教师身份和教师间分歧来估计每个结构-教师对的可靠性，选择高置信度预测生成伪标签并拒绝不可靠结构。最终生成289万可溯源的r^2SCAN级别伪标签用于预训练。在保留结构和基准上，基于ATR数据集训练的轻量CHGNet持续优于基线，并在分子动力学中展现出更好的动力学鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 通用机器学习原子间势（uMLIPs）在量子力学精度和大规模分子动力学之间搭建桥梁，但高精度计算（如r^2SCAN）的成本限制了训练数据集的规模，且平均基准性能无法保证每个结构的可靠能量-力预测。
AI.method: 自适应多教师路由（ATR）：利用少量真实r^2SCAN标签校准多个预训练uMLIP教师，组合结构描述符、教师身份和教师间分歧来估计每个结构-教师对的可靠性，选择高置信度预测生成伪标签，拒绝无足够可靠教师的结构。
AI.result: 仅用0.2%真实r^2SCAN标签生成289万可溯源伪标签；轻量CHGNet在保留结构和MP-r^2SCAN基准上持续优于基线和非路由对照；有限温度分子动力学显示ATR提高了多材料系统的动力学鲁棒性，避免结构坍塌。
AI.conclusion: 主动拒绝机制是将多个预训练uMLIP转换为可扩展且可靠的高保真数据构建系统的有效方法。

title: TCLA: Training-Free Class-wise Logit Adaptation for Medical Vision-Language Models
summary: Medical Vision-Language Models (VLMs) exhibit strong zero-shot performance, yet their effectiveness still declines on out-of-distribution (OOD) data due to domain shifts and class bias inherited from large-scale pretraining. Existing few-shot adaptation methods typically introduce additional trainable components, which can be unstable in extremely low-data regimes (e.g., 1-shot), and lack robustness on different medical data. We present TCLA, a purely training-free few-shot adaptation method for Medical VLMs, which is fast and model-agnostic. TCLA corrects inference logits based on a small set of support samples, boosting pretrained VLMs performance by improving inter-class deconfusion and reducing domain shift. Extensive experiments on nine datasets across multiple medical imaging modalities including X-ray, Ultrasound, MRI, CT, Histopathology, demonstrate that TCLA consistently improves OOD performance of Medical VLMs and, in most of cases, outperforms existing training-based adaptation methods.

AI.tldr: TCLA是一种无需训练的少样本自适应方法，通过校正推理logits来提升医学视觉语言模型在OOD数据上的性能，在9个数据集上优于现有训练方法。
AI.motivation: 医学VLM在零样本场景下表现良好，但在分布外数据上因领域偏移和类别偏差性能显著下降。现有少样本自适应方法引入额外可训练组件，在极低数据量（如1-shot）下不稳定且缺乏鲁棒性。
AI.method: TCLA是一种纯训练-free的少样本自适应方法，通过少量支持样本校正推理logits，实现类别间去混淆和减少领域偏移，且与模型无关、计算快速。
AI.result: 在X光、超声、MRI、CT、组织病理学等9个数据集上的实验表明，TCLA一致提升了医学VLM的OOD性能，大部分情况下优于基于训练的自适应方法。
AI.conclusion: TCLA作为一种无需训练、快速且模型无关的方法，能有效提升医学VLM在分布外数据上的泛化能力，为极低数据场景下的自适应提供了稳健解决方案。

title: Wan-Dancer: A Hierarchical Framework for Minute-scale Coherent Music-to-Dance Generation
summary: Generating long-duration, high-definition, and rhythmically synchronized dance videos directly from music remains a significant challenge, primarily due to the temporal constraints of current diffusion models, which typically fail beyond 20 seconds. Existing approaches, whether they rely on intermediate 3D skeletons or on end-to-end video synthesis, suffer from temporal drift, identity inconsistency, and repetitive motion patterns when extended to longer horizons. To address these limitations, we propose a novel hierarchical framework for minute-scale coherent music-to-dance generation. Our method decouples the process into global keyframe planning and local temporal refinement, leveraging full-track musical context to ensure long-range coherence. Key innovations include dynamic frame rate adaptation via time-mapped RoPE embeddings for precise alignment, an optical-flow-based loss function to enhance motion continuity, and motion-speed control to preserve high-fidelity details during rapid movements. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework surpasses the conventional duration barrier, generating stable, 720p/30fps videos exceeding one minute with superior temporal stability. Furthermore, the model exhibits robust versatility across five distinct dance genres, conditioned on both audio and textual prompts, establishing a new state-of-the-art in coherent, long-form dance video synthesis.

AI.tldr: 提出一种层次化框架，将音乐到舞蹈视频生成解耦为全局关键帧规划和局部时间细化，使用时间映射RoPE嵌入、光流损失和运动速度控制，突破20秒限制，生成长达1分钟以上的720p/30fps稳定舞蹈视频，在5种舞蹈风格中均达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型受限于20秒以内的时序约束，基于3D骨架或端到端视频合成的方法在延长时长时出现时序漂移、身份不一致和动作重复等问题，难以生成长时长、高清晰度且节奏同步的舞蹈视频。
AI.method: 提出层次化框架，包含全局关键帧规划（利用完整音乐上下文保证长程连贯性）和局部时间细化两个阶段；创新点包括：基于时间映射RoPE嵌入的动态帧率适配以实现精确对齐、基于光流的损失函数增强运动连续性、运动速度控制以在快速运动中保持高保真细节。
AI.result: 突破传统时长限制，生成超过1分钟的720p/30fps稳定舞蹈视频，具备优越的时间稳定性；在5种不同舞蹈风格上均表现鲁棒，支持音频和文本提示条件，达到长形式舞蹈视频合成的新SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 该层次化框架成功解决了长时舞蹈视频生成中的时序漂移和身份不一致问题，为分钟级连贯音乐到舞蹈生成提供了有效方案，在多项指标上超越现有方法。

title: All Explanations are Wrong, But Many Are Useful: Exploring the Rashomon Explanation Set with Large Language Models
summary: Explaining machine-learning models is increasingly important for decision-making and consumer trust, yet it is widely believed to come at a cost: existing Explainable AI (XAI) methods suffer from a persistent accuracy-explainability trade-off. We argue that this trade-off is not fundamental, but an artifact of treating explanation and prediction as separate objectives; when properly coupled, they become complementary, so that equipping a model to explain itself improves, rather than degrades, its accuracy. We introduce the Rashomon Explanation paradigm, which builds a set of faithful, prediction-guiding explanations rather than a single one, and prove that this set is generally non-empty and that explanation fidelity bounds the performance of the models it guides. To explore this set, we propose RashomonLLM, an Explanation-Prediction-Reflection agentic workflow that generates explanations in natural language by iteratively aligning them with predictions, and we prove it converges and recovers the full set. Across customer-churn classification, clinical survival regression, and industrial click-through prediction on large-scale live-streaming logs, RashomonLLM significantly outperforms state-of-the-art prediction and XAI baselines on both accuracy and explanation quality, with gains driven by explanation fidelity and robust to distribution shifts, temporal splits, and seeds. Our framework thus advances business performance while laying the groundwork for consumer trust.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RashomonLLM框架，通过将解释与预测耦合来克服准确率-可解释性权衡，在多个任务上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有可解释AI（XAI）方法普遍存在准确率-可解释性权衡，作者认为这一权衡并非本质问题，而是将解释和预测作为独立目标处理的人为产物；当两者适当耦合时，它们变得互补，使模型自我解释反而能提高准确率。
AI.method: 提出Rashomon解释范式，构建一组忠实且指导预测的解释而非单个解释，并证明该集合非空且解释忠实度约束了其所指导模型的性能。在此基础上提出RashomonLLM，一个解释-预测-反思的智能体工作流，通过迭代对齐解释与预测来生成自然语言解释，并证明其收敛且能恢复完整集合。
AI.result: 在客户流失分类、临床生存回归和大规模直播日志的点击率预测任务中，RashomonLLM在准确率和解释质量上均显著超越最先进的预测和XAI基线，性能提升由解释忠实度驱动，且对分布偏移、时间分割和随机种子具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在提升商业性能的同时为消费者信任奠定了基础。

title: Promptable Concept Segmentation from Above: Evaluating SAM 3's Zero-Shot and One-Shot Capabilities in Remote Sensing
summary: The deployment of large-scale foundation models, such as the Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM 3), promises a transition toward open-vocabulary, training-free computer vision. However, their capacity to generalize out-of-distribution to the complex, top-down geometric structures of Earth Observation imagery remains largely unquantified. Driven by SAM 3's performance disparities in highly specialized domains, we present a comprehensive, multi-task empirical evaluation across remote sensing scene classification, object detection, and instance segmentation under strict zero-shot and one-shot constraints. To achieve this, we introduce a structural adaptation of SAM 3 by repurposing its decoupled binary presence head into a standalone zero-shot classifier. Furthermore, by systematically isolating textual and visual prompt modalities across five configurations, we explicitly diagnose the alignment mechanics within the model's multimodal decoder. Our findings reveal severe cross-modal interference: while visual prompts successfully align the decoder to complex remote sensing geometry, textual prompts inject misaligned, ground-level semantic bias, actively degrading coordinate regression. To benchmark these capabilities without resource-intensive training, we formulate a novel training-free proxy evaluation protocol for Generalized Zero-Shot tasks (scene classification and instance segmentation). Ultimately, our results demonstrate that SAM 3 avoids the overfitting commonly seen in legacy domain-adapted models, achieving high Harmonic Mean scores in segmentation tasks. However, it remains fundamentally constrained by sub-pixel resolution limits and overhead semantic blind spots, charting a definitive mandate for parameter-efficient geospatial fine-tuning of its multimodal decoder.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了SAM 3在遥感图像零样本/单样本场景分类、目标检测和实例分割中的表现，发现视觉提示有效而文本提示引入语义偏差导致跨模态干扰，并提出了一种无训练代理评估协议，最终指出SAM 3虽避免了过拟合但在亚像素分辨率和俯视语义盲区存在根本性局限，亟需参数高效的地理空间微调。
AI.motivation: 大型基础模型（如SAM 3）在地球观测（EO）遥感图像这一高度专业化、具有自上而下几何结构的领域中的分布外泛化能力尚未被量化，且SAM 3在该领域存在性能差异，因此需要系统评估其零样本和单样本能力。
AI.method: 提出SAM 3的结构适配（将其解耦的二元存在头改造为独立零样本分类器）；设计五种配置系统隔离文本/视觉提示模态以诊断多模态解码器对齐机制；构建无训练代理评估协议用于广义零样本任务（场景分类和实例分割）。
AI.result: 视觉提示能使解码器对齐复杂遥感几何结构，而文本提示注入不对齐的地面级语义偏差，主动退化坐标回归；SAM 3避免了传统领域适配模型的过拟合，在分割任务中取得高Harmonic Mean分数，但受限于亚像素分辨率和俯视语义盲区。
AI.conclusion: SAM 3在地理空间领域存在根本性局限，需要对其多模态解码器进行参数高效的地理空间微调，以克服跨模态干扰、亚像素分辨率限制和俯视语义盲点。

title: TSAI-MetaFraud: A Benchmark Dataset for Financial Fraud Transaction and Behavioral Risk Detection in Metaverse Ecosystems
summary: The emergence of metaverse platforms has created virtual economies that introduce new challenges related to fraud, bot activity, and illicit financial behavior. Despite growing interest in trustworthy metaverse analytics, existing datasets typically focus on user behavior, authentication, or financial transactions in isolation, limiting the development and reproducible evaluation of multimodal fraud detection methods. To address this gap, we present TSAI-MetaFraud, a multimodal, multi-task benchmark dataset for fraud analytics in virtual economies. TSAI-MetaFraud integrates behavioral, transactional, and graph-structured information while incorporating realistic fraud and automated bot scenarios. We define benchmark tasks including transaction fraud detection, cross-modal node classification, temporal link prediction, and weakly supervised fraud detection, and provide baseline evaluations using machine learning models and graph neural networks. By jointly capturing behavioral activity, financial interactions, and relational structure within a unified virtual economy, TSAI-MetaFraud provides a benchmark for advancing multimodal learning, graph mining, fraud analytics, and trustworthy AI in emerging metaverse ecosystems.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍 TSAI-MetaFraud，一个面向虚拟经济中多模态、多任务欺诈分析的综合基准数据集，整合行为、交易和图结构信息，并定义四项基准任务及基线评估，旨在推动元宇宙环境下可信 AI 与欺诈检测研究。
AI.motivation: 现有数据集通常孤立关注用户行为、认证或交易，缺乏同时包含多模态信息（行为、交易、图结构）且支持可重复评估的基准，限制了多模态欺诈检测方法在元宇宙虚拟经济中的发展。
AI.method: 构建 TSAI-MetaFraud 数据集，融合行为、交易和图结构信息，并注入真实欺诈与自动机器人场景；定义交易欺诈检测、跨模态节点分类、时序链接预测、弱监督欺诈检测四项任务；使用传统机器学习与图神经网络提供基线评估。
AI.result: 提供了一个统一的虚拟经济基准数据集 TSAI-MetaFraud，包含多模态信息与四项欺诈分析基准任务，并给出了基线模型性能参考。
AI.conclusion: TSAI-MetaFraud 为元宇宙生态系统中的多模态学习、图挖掘、欺诈分析与可信 AI 研究提供了标准化基准，有助于推动相关领域的可重复评估与算法进步。

title: 4DR360: State Reasoning for Joint 3D Detection and Occupancy Prediction in 4D Radar-Camera Full-Scene Perception
summary: Reliable autonomous driving requires full-scene perception that couples foreground objects with dense semantic layout. Recently, 4D millimeter-wave radar has emerged as a robust and affordable sensor, yet its sparse returns make radar-camera fusion necessary for comprehensive scene understanding. Existing radar-camera methods mainly optimize detection, while dual-task systems usually decode boxes and occupancy with limited interaction.
