To address this gap and advance radar-based multi-task learning, we propose \method, a 4D radar-camera framework for 360$^\circ$ full-scene perception, which models semantic occupancy as a persistent scene state rather than a terminal output. \method{} follows a cross-modal state reasoning paradigm, where the occupancy state is modeled and propagated through stages for coarse-to-fine feature aggregation. Specifically, State-guided BEV Enhancement (SBE) strengthens intra-frame BEV representation, while Doppler-guided Temporal Fusion (DTF) preserves state evidence over longer temporal horizons. Beyond the model, we further extend ManTruckScenes with satellite-map-based generated occupancy labels and pair it with OmniHD-Scenes in a unified cross-dataset detection-and-occupancy protocol. The resulting experiments cover accuracy, robustness, ablation, and efficiency under one radar-camera multi-task evaluation framework. Code and labels will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为OmniHD-Scenes的4D雷达-相机多任务感知框架，通过将语义占据建模为持久场景状态，并采用跨模态状态推理、状态引导的BEV增强（SBE）和多普勒引导的时间融合（DTF）等机制，实现了360°全场景的联合目标检测与占据预测，同时扩展了ManTruckScenes数据集并建立了统一的跨数据集评估协议。
AI.motivation: 现有雷达-相机融合方法主要优化单一检测任务，而双任务系统通常解码边界框和占据时缺乏有效交互；4D毫米波雷达稀疏性强，需与相机融合才能实现全面场景理解，但缺乏兼顾前景目标与密集语义布局的多任务学习框架。
AI.method: 提出OmniHD-Scenes框架，核心是跨模态状态推理范式：1) 将语义占据建模为持久场景状态而非终端输出，通过阶段间传播实现从粗到细的特征聚合；2) 状态引导的BEV增强（SBE）强化帧内BEV表示；3) 多普勒引导的时间融合（DTF）在更长时序上保持状态证据。此外，扩展ManTruckScenes数据集，基于卫星地图生成占据标签，并与OmniHD-Scenes构成跨数据集检测-占据联合评估协议。
AI.result: 在统一的雷达-相机多任务评估框架下进行了精度、鲁棒性、消融实验和效率分析，覆盖检测与占据两个任务维度。
AI.conclusion: OmniHD-Scenes通过状态化的占据建模和跨模态推理，有效弥合了雷达-相机融合中检测与占据任务之间的交互鸿沟，为4D雷达实现360°全场景感知提供了新的多任务学习范式。

title: Statistically Undetectable Backdoors in Deep Neural Networks
summary: We show how an adversarial model trainer can plant backdoors in a large class of deep, feedforward neural networks. These backdoors are statistically undetectable in the white-box setting, meaning that the backdoored and honestly trained models are close in total variation distance, even given the full descriptions of the models (e.g., all of the weights). The backdoor provides access to invariance-based adversarial examples for every input, mapping distant inputs to unusually close outputs. However, without the backdoor, it is provably impossible (under standard cryptographic assumptions) to generate any such adversarial examples in polynomial time. Our theoretical and preliminary empirical findings demonstrate a fundamental power asymmetry between model trainers and model users.

AI.tldr: 该论文展示了在深度前馈神经网络中，攻击者可以在统计上无法检测（白盒设置下总变差距离很小）的情况下植入后门。后门能为每个输入提供基于不变性的对抗样本，将远距离输入映射到异常接近的输出；而没有后门时，在标准密码学假设下无法在多项式时间内生成这类对抗样本。理论与初步实验揭示了模型训练者与使用者之间的权力不对称。
AI.motivation: 揭示模型训练者与使用者之间的根本性权力不对称：训练者可以植入后门，生成对抗样本，而使用者即使拥有完整模型也无法在多项式时间内生成同样的对抗样本。
AI.method: 通过后门植入，使模型在统计上无法检测（白盒环境下总变差距离小），后门提供基于不变性的对抗样本，将远距离输入映射到异常接近的输出。
AI.result: 后门在统计上无法检测（白盒），且能生成对抗样本；而无后门的模型在标准密码学假设下无法在多项式时间内生成此类对抗样本。
AI.conclusion: 存在模型训练者与使用者之间的根本性权力不对称，后门攻击具有统计不可检测性，且只有训练者能高效生成特定的对抗样本。

title: The Effects of Synthetic Data and Label Distribution on Canola Branch Counting
summary: Collecting annotated plant images for automated phenotyping is often slow and expensive. Plant models simulating growth and development can generate unlimited synthetic images with exact labels. However, previous work has established that whether incorporating synthetic data improves performance depends on the ratio of synthetic to real images and the label distribution of the synthetic dataset. To systematically quantify both factors, we train ResNet-18 models on a canola branch-counting task using a calibrated L-system plant model. We vary each factor independently. Synthetic-to-real ratios of 1:5 to 1:22 broadly improve performance; the best ratio (1:7) reduces mean absolute difference by 7.6% over real-only training. For label distribution, a uniform synthetic distribution is strongly suboptimal (abs. diff. of approximately 1.70); interpolating 90% toward the real distribution yields abs. diff. 0.927, whereas Gaussian smoothing of the real label distribution yields the best overall result (abs. diff. 0.912, a 14.7% improvement over real-only). A minimum of 10 synthetic images per label offers a simpler alternative with modest gains, while 100 per label over-corrects and hurts performance.

AI.tldr: 本文系统量化了合成数据对植物表型分析中分支计数任务的影响，发现合成与真实图像比例在1:5至1:22时多数改善性能，最佳比例1:7使平均绝对差值降低7.6%；标签分布方面，对真实分布进行高斯平滑得到最优结果，平均绝对差值0.912，相比仅用真实数据改进14.7%；每标签至少10张合成图像可带来适度提升，但100张则过犹不及。
AI.motivation: 真实植物图像标注成本高且耗时，而合成图像生成成本低且标签精确，但之前研究表明合成数据能否提升性能取决于合成与真实图像的比例及合成数据集的标签分布。本文旨在系统量化这两个因素对植物分支计数任务的影响。
AI.method: 使用经过校准的L-system植物模型生成油菜分支计数任务的合成图像，训练ResNet-18模型。独立变化合成与真实图像比例（1:5至1:22）和合成数据标签分布（均匀分布、插值逼近真实分布、高斯平滑真实分布等），评估平均绝对差值。
AI.result: 合成与真实比例1:5至1:22多数提升性能，最优比例1:7使平均绝对差值降低7.6%；均匀标签分布效果差（平均绝对差值约1.70），90%插值逼近真实分布得到0.927，高斯平滑真实分布取得最佳0.912（比仅用真实数据改进14.7%）。每标签至少10张合成图像有适度提升，100张则损害性能。
AI.conclusion: 合成数据可有效提升植物表型分析性能，但需谨慎选择比例和标签分布；高斯平滑真实标签分布是最优策略，而过量合成数据或不当分布可能适得其反。

title: GatedLinear: Adaptive Routing of Complementary Linear Bases for Time Series Forecasting
summary: Time series forecasting requires models to capture diverse, often mutually exclusive, temporal dynamics, from smooth trend continuation to nonstationary drift and strict phase-aligned recurrence. While recent deep learning models have improved accuracy, they typically force these diverse patterns through a single computational backbone governed by fixed algorithmic inductive biases (e.g., self-attention or spectral filtering). This single-mechanism approach often struggles with the profound heterogeneity of real-world series, where different variables and forecast horizons necessitate fundamentally different predictive treatments. To address this, we propose GatedLinear: a lightweight framework that frames forecasting as the adaptive routing of complementary linear bases. GatedLinear leverages a pool of three specialized mechanisms: a global trend-seasonal basis for smooth projection, a difference-based incremental basis for nonstationary drift, and a phase-aligned recurrence basis for explicit cyclic reuse. To dynamically orchestrate these distinct behaviors, we introduce a Tri-Factorized Fusion Gate that disentangles routing decisions into channel-specific preferences, horizon-aware offsets, and phase-indexed biases derived from known future time marks. This design allows the model to perform highly granular, point-wise soft routing across different predictive regimes without stacking computationally heavy neural modules. Experiments on standard benchmarks show that our method achieves state-of-the-art or highly competitive accuracy against recent complex foundational models, while offering explicitly interpretable routing patterns and operating with a substantially smaller parameter footprint.

AI.tldr: GatedLinear提出了一种轻量级框架，通过三因素融合门控机制在三种互补的线性基（全局趋势-季节、差分增量、相位对齐循环）之间自适应路由，实现对异构时间模式的灵活预测，在保持小参数量下达到SOTA精度。
AI.motivation: 传统时序预测模型使用单一计算骨架（如自注意力或谱滤波）处理所有模式，难以应对真实序列中多样且互斥的时序动态（如平滑趋势、非平稳漂移、相位对齐周期），不同变量和预测 horizon 需要本质上不同的预测策略。
AI.method: 提出GatedLinear框架，核心包括：(1) 三种专门线性基：全局趋势-季节基、差分增量基、相位对齐循环基；(2) Tri-Factorized Fusion Gate（三因素融合门），将路由决策分解为通道偏好、horizon感知偏移、基于已知未来时间标记的相位索引偏置，实现逐点软路由。
AI.result: 在标准基准上达到或超过近期复杂基础模型的SOTA精度，提供可解释的路由模式，参数量显著更小。
AI.conclusion: 通过轻量级线性基和结构化门控路由替代重型神经网络堆叠，能更高效地处理时序预测中的模式异质性，兼具性能、可解释性和参数效率。

title: Revisiting Euler-Angle Regression with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
summary: In many real-world systems, including articulated robots and biomechanical models, rotations are defined in joint space and naturally parameterized by Euler angles with bounded ranges. Yet regressing Euler angles remains challenging, as their discontinuities and singularities often destabilize training. In this work, we revisit Euler-angle regression and show that its effectiveness depends critically on the interaction between rotation representation, regression architecture, and domain constraints. We introduce a new framework that combines range-aware Euler modeling with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN), which replace fixed node-wise activations with learnable univariate functions on edges. We further provide theoretical analysis indicating that bounded Euler ranges motivate a near-additive structure in the regression function, which favors the additive functional form of KAN, and we confirm this trend empirically. Extensive experiments on controlled rotation regression, object pose estimation, and robotic and human inverse kinematics demonstrate consistent improvements in accuracy, convergence, and efficiency. The code will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合范围感知欧拉角建模与KAN网络的框架，通过理论分析和实验验证，有效解决了欧拉角回归中的不连续性和奇异性问题，在多个任务上提升了精度、收敛速度和效率。
AI.motivation: 欧拉角回归因存在不连续性和奇异性，常导致训练不稳定。现有方法效果取决于旋转表示、回归架构和域约束的交互，但缺乏系统性研究。
AI.method: 提出范围感知的欧拉角建模与KAN（Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks）结合的新框架。KAN用可学习的单变量函数替代固定节点激活函数。理论分析表明有界欧拉角范围促使回归函数近似可加结构，有利于KAN的加法函数形式。
AI.result: 在受控旋转回归、物体姿态估计、机器人及人类逆运动学等任务上，该方法在精度、收敛速度和效率上均取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架有效改善了欧拉角回归的性能，验证了旋转表示、架构与域约束协同设计的重要性。

title: CoCoT-EEG: Contrastive-Pretrained Multiscale Convolutional Transformer for EEG Decoding
summary: Self-supervised pretrained foundation models (FM) have shown early promise for non-invasive electroencephalogram (EEG) decoding applications. Many recent large-scale models converged on the approach of tokenizing raw EEG followed by masked reconstruction pretraining. However, this recipe has been shown to be suboptimal for data, like EEG, with high noise amplitude and information confined to limited dimensions such as narrow frequency bands. Building on this insight, we develop a novel contrastive-pretrained EEG model with multiscale temporal convolution input layers and Transformer encoder blocks (CoCoT). CoCoT matches or beats state-of-the-art reconstruction-pretrained EEG models on extensive benchmark decoding tasks with heterogeneous electrode configurations. Furthermore, CoCoT trained from scratch outperforms previous single-task decoding models and even rivals pretrained models, showcasing the architecture's flexibility and data efficiency. Through systematic ablations, including model architecture and pretraining objective, we demonstrate the viability of contrastive learning for building EEG FMs while suggesting key architectural design considerations, prompting further investigations in alternative large-scale pretraining strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoCoT，一种基于对比学习的EEG基础模型，采用多尺度时序卷积输入和Transformer编码器架构。与当前主流的掩码重建预训练方法相比，CoCoT在多个异构电极配置的基准解码任务上达到或超越最先进的预训练模型。从头训练的CoCoT甚至优于以往的单任务解码模型，并可与预训练模型媲美，展现了架构的灵活性和数据效率。系统消融实验证明对比学习对EEG基础模型的有效性，并为架构设计提供了关键指导。
AI.motivation: 现有EEG基础模型多采用"原始EEG分词+掩码重建预训练"范式，但该方法对EEG这种高噪声、信息集中在有限维度（如窄频带）的数据并非最优。作者旨在探索对比学习作为替代预训练策略，以构建更有效的EEG基础模型。
AI.method: 提出CoCoT模型，其架构包含多尺度时序卷积输入层（用于从不同时间尺度提取特征）和Transformer编码器块。预训练采用对比学习目标，而非传统的掩码重建。在异构电极配置的多个基准解码任务上进行评估，并进行系统消融（架构和预训练目标）。
AI.result: CoCoT在多个基准任务上匹配或超越基于重建预训练的SOTA模型。从头训练的CoCoT优于以往单任务解码模型，甚至与预训练模型性能相当。消融实验验证了对比学习对EEG基础模型的可行性，并揭示了关键架构设计因素。
AI.conclusion: 对比学习是构建EEG基础模型的有效预训练策略，CoCoT架构具有数据效率和灵活性。研究提示应进一步探索替代大规模预训练策略，并关注架构设计以提升EEG解码性能。

title: Evolution of Accuracy and Visual-Cognitive Errors in a Decade of Vision-Language AI Models
summary: Vision language models (VLMs) have made remarkable progress in visual reasoning during the last decade. Most evaluations have used simple scenes (MS-COCO) that do not showcase complex human interactions or behaviors, only a handful of non-curated human descriptions as a benchmark, and have not focused on understanding the model's error types. Here, we introduce the Complex Social Behavior (CSB) dataset, containing 100 images depicting complex social interactions/behaviors. We analyze the progression of scene descriptions over a decade (2017-2025) of VLMs (four pre-Multimodal Large Language Models, MLLMs, and five MLLMs). We evaluate the accuracy of the models and 20 human descriptions relative to a gold standard on the CSB dataset and on a sample from MS-COCO. We analyzed five visual-cognitive error types: object detection, recognition, hallucination, scene understanding, and spatial dependence. The CSB dataset showed a more pronounced improvement than MS-COCO in scene description accuracy, with pre-MLLMs achieving much lower accuracy than the bottom-ranked human descriptions and MLLMs attaining accuracies similar to the top-ranked human descriptions. We show that MLLMs have eliminated the gap in scene description accuracy between simpler MS-COCO scenes and scenes depicting complex behaviors (CSB). MLLMs have almost eliminated all error types in our tested datasets, except for occasionally relying on different image regions for scene descriptions than humans do (spatial dependence error). We also show that detection, recognition, and hallucination errors have the highest impact on scene description accuracy. Together, our findings provide a more thorough evaluation of how visual language models have advanced over the last decade.

AI.tldr: 本文提出复杂社会行为（CSB）数据集，系统评估了视觉语言模型（VLM）从2017到2025年（4个预多模态大语言模型和5个多模态大语言模型）在描述复杂社会交互场景方面的进展。与简单场景（MS-COCO）相比，CSB数据集上模型描述准确度提升更显著；多模态大语言模型（MLLM）已消除两类场景间的准确度差距，并几乎消除了所有视觉认知错误类型（目标检测、识别、幻觉、场景理解、空间依赖），但空间依赖错误仍偶有出现。检测、识别和幻觉错误对描述准确度影响最大。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型评估多基于简单场景（如MS-COCO），缺乏对复杂人类社会交互行为的考察，且未深入分析模型错误类型。因此需要构建包含复杂社会行为的基准数据集，并系统评估模型多年来的进展与错误模式。
AI.method: 构建包含100张复杂社会交互图像的CSB数据集；选取2017-2025年间4个预MLLM和5个MLLM，以及20名人类描述者；在CSB和MS-COCO样本上，以金标准为参照评估描述准确度；分析五种视觉认知错误类型：目标检测、识别、幻觉、场景理解、空间依赖。
AI.result: CSB数据集上模型描述准确度提升比MS-COCO更显著；预MLLM准确度远低于最差人类描述，而MLLM准确度接近最佳人类描述；MLLM已消除MS-COCO与CSB之间的准确度差距；MLLM几乎消除了所有错误类型，但空间依赖错误仍存在；检测、识别和幻觉错误对准确度影响最大。
AI.conclusion: 多模态大语言模型在复杂社会行为场景理解上取得显著进步，基本消除了与人类描述的差距以及各类视觉认知错误，但空间依赖错误仍需关注。本研究为视觉语言模型的长期演进提供了更全面的评估视角。

title: Graph-Regularized Low-Rank Matrix Completion by Variable Projection
summary: We address the low-rank matrix completion problem by incorporating graph regularization into the existing Riemannian Trust-Region Matrix Completion (RTRMC) framework. The latter uses the geometry of the low-rank constraint to remodel the problem as an unconstrained optimization problem on a single Grassmann manifold. Our approach, named Graph-Regularized RTRMC (GR-RTRMC), exploits the inherent relationships between rows and columns of the matrix. By using these relationships, we aim to improve the accuracy and robustness of matrix completion, particularly in scenarios where the underlying data exhibits strong correlations between rows or columns.

AI.tldr: 本文在RTRMC框架中引入图正则化，提出GR-RTRMC方法，利用矩阵行与列之间的内在关系提高低秩矩阵补全的准确性和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有RTRMC方法仅利用低秩约束的几何结构，未充分利用矩阵行与列之间的关联信息，导致在数据存在强相关性的场景下补全精度和鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 将图正则化项融入RTRMC框架，在Grassmann流形上将问题建模为无约束优化，利用行与列之间的关系约束优化过程。
AI.result: 提升了矩阵补全的准确性和鲁棒性，尤其在行或列具有强相关性的数据场景下表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 图正则化能有效利用数据内在的结构关系，增强低秩矩阵补全方法的性能。

title: OpenLongTail: Generative Scaling of Long-Tail Driving Data
summary: Scaling robust driving policies is fundamentally bottlenecked by the scarcity of edge cases in curated datasets. While the real world continuously captures these critical events, such long-tail events remain underutilized when collected from heterogeneous sources. Specifically, diverse but valuable in-the-wild long-tail videos lack the full view coverage required for training policy models, often missing multi-view poses or originating solely from monocular dash cameras. This modality gap prevents these ubiquitous observations from being converted into scalable training data for long-tail generalization. We introduce OpenLongTail, an open-source generative data engine for scaling autonomous driving policies under long-tail events. To transform heterogeneous data sources into view-aligned and temporally coherent multi-view assets that are useful for policy learning, we develop a pose-informed extrapolative view synthesis pipeline that generates the missing views. We further enhance cross-view consistency and the temporal alignment for the newly generated views by injecting Plücker ray geometry into the scalable generation engine. By synthesizing heterogeneous long-tail data, we observe a significant improvement in closed-loop driving robustness in handling long-tail events. By measuring the extrapolative view synthesis and pose metrics, we validate the effectiveness of OpenLongTail in visual fidelity, cross-view consistency, and ego-trajectory recovery.

AI.tldr: OpenLongTail is an open-source generative data engine that converts heterogeneous long-tail videos (e.g., monocular dashcam footage) into view-aligned, temporally coherent multi-view training data for autonomous driving policies. It uses pose-informed extrapolative view synthesis with Plücker ray geometry to generate missing views, enabling closed-loop driving robustness improvements in long-tail scenarios.
AI.motivation: The scarcity of edge-case data in curated datasets bottlenecks scaling robust driving policies. Although the real world continuously captures long-tail events, these observations from heterogeneous sources (e.g., monocular dashcams) lack multi-view coverage, preventing their use as training data for policy models.
AI.method: OpenLongTail employs a pose-informed extrapolative view synthesis pipeline to generate missing views from heterogeneous data sources, producing view-aligned and temporally coherent multi-view assets. It enhances cross-view consistency and temporal alignment by injecting Plücker ray geometry into the generation engine.
AI.result: Synthesizing heterogeneous long-tail data leads to significant improvement in closed-loop driving robustness when handling long-tail events. Evaluations on extrapolative view synthesis and pose metrics validate effectiveness in visual fidelity, cross-view consistency, and ego-trajectory recovery.
AI.conclusion: OpenLongTail effectively scales autonomous driving policies under long-tail events by transforming diverse but incomplete real-world observations into usable multi-view training data, overcoming the modality gap that previously hindered utilization of in-the-wild long-tail videos.

title: Semantic Pareto-DQN: A Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning Framework for Financial Anomaly Detection
comment: BRACIS 2026 - 36th Brazilian Conference on Intelligent Systems
summary: Financial anomaly detection suffers from extreme class imbalance, causing traditional single-objective algorithms to exhibit ``fraud collapse'', defaulting to the majority class and failing to balance anomaly interdiction with customer friction. To overcome this without distortive data resampling, we propose the Semantic Pareto-DQN, a multi-objective reinforcement learning framework. Our approach synthesizes heterogeneous transaction features into cohesive natural-language narratives, encoded by large language models, thereby producing a robust, scale-invariant state representation. The agent optimizes a vectorial reward that explicitly decouples financial efficacy, operational friction, and semantic discovery. By mapping the continuous Pareto frontier, the system dynamically navigates the asymmetric costs of missed anomalies versus false positives. Empirical evaluations across E-Commerce fraud and UCI Credit datasets show that semantic Pareto-DQN successfully shatters the zero-recall trap. It achieves superior minority-class recall compared to scalarized baselines, providing an alternative to trade bounded operational friction for financial anomaly discovery.

AI.tldr: 提出语义帕累托-DQN，一种多目标强化学习框架，通过大语言模型将异构交易特征编码为自然语言叙事，构建稳健状态表示；采用向量化奖励解耦金融效能、运营摩擦与语义发现，沿帕累托前沿动态决策，在不进行数据重采样的条件下解决金融异常检测中的极端类别不平衡和"欺诈崩溃"问题。
AI.motivation: 传统单目标算法在金融异常检测中因极端类别不平衡导致"欺诈崩溃"（默认预测为多数类），且难以在异常拦截与客户摩擦之间取得平衡；现有数据重采样方法具有扭曲性，亟需一种不依赖重采样的多目标优化方案。
AI.method: 提出语义帕累托-DQN：1) 利用大语言模型将异构交易特征合成连贯的自然语言叙事，生成稳健、尺度不变的状态表示；2) 设计向量化奖励函数，显式解耦金融效能、运营摩擦与语义发现三个目标；3) 通过映射连续帕累托前沿，动态导航误报与漏报的非对称成本。
AI.result: 在电子商务欺诈和UCI Credit数据集上的实验表明，语义帕累托-DQN成功打破零召回陷阱，相比标量化基线取得了更优的少数类召回率，能够以有界运营摩擦为代价换取金融异常发现能力的提升。
AI.conclusion: 语义帕累托-DQN为金融异常检测提供了一种有效替代方案，无需数据重采样即可在极端不平衡场景下实现多目标权衡，平衡异常拦截率与客户摩擦，为实际部署提供了可调节的帕累托前沿映射机制。

title: Scalable Visual Pretraining for Language Intelligence
summary: The rapid progress of large foundation models has been driven predominantly by pretraining on large-scale text corpora. However, many forms of knowledge are conveyed through visual representations, where figures, typeset equations, and page layouts carry rich information that cannot be faithfully or completely captured by text alone. Yet current pretraining approaches discard these visual cues by converting visually rich sources, such as documents and web pages, into plain text for learning language intelligence. This paper challenges the default assumption that language models must be trained on text-only representations and shows that Visual Pretraining is a scalable learner for foundation model intelligence. To this end, we conduct a systematic study of unsupervised visual pretraining paradigms that directly leverage visual documents without text extraction. Across multiple backbones and benchmarks, visual pretraining on the same underlying corpora consistently outperforms text-only pretraining, offering an efficient pathway to scalable language intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了语言模型必须仅从文本预训练的默认假设，提出并系统研究了直接利用视觉文档（包含图表、公式、布局等）的无监督视觉预训练范式。实验表明，在相同语料上，视觉预训练在多种骨干网络和基准测试中 consistently 优于纯文本预训练，为可扩展的语言智能提供了高效途径。
AI.motivation: 当前大型基础模型的预训练主要依赖大规模文本语料，但许多知识以视觉形式（图表、公式、页面布局）呈现，仅用文本无法忠实捕获。作者旨在打破“语言模型必须使用纯文本预训练”的默认假设，探索视觉预训练作为可扩展的基座模型学习范式。
AI.method: 系统研究无监督视觉预训练范式，直接利用视觉文档（无需文本提取）进行预训练，与纯文本预训练对比。在多种骨干网络（backbones）和基准测试上进行评估。
AI.result: 在相同语料上，视觉预训练在多个骨干网络和基准测试中始终优于纯文本预训练，证明了视觉预训练是一种可扩展的基座模型智能学习方式。
AI.conclusion: 视觉预训练是一种高效且可扩展的基座模型学习途径，挑战了纯文本预训练的主流做法，为利用视觉信息提升语言智能提供了新方向。

title: SolarChain-Eval: A Physics-Constrained Benchmark for Trustworthy Economic Agents in Decentralized Energy Markets
summary: As agentic AI systems are increasingly applied to cyber-physical environments, their evaluation requires assessment of both task performance and trustworthiness. In decentralized energy markets, autonomous agents may improve market utility, but may also exploit invalid physical data, create artificial liquidity, and produce unstable governance decisions. Therefore, we propose SolarChain-Eval, a physics-constrained benchmark for evaluating trustworthy economic agents. It formulates market governance as a Gymnasium-compatible Markov Decision Process, where agents make hourly decisions. SolarChain-Eval evaluates each policy across multiple dimensions, including market utility, physical safety, slippage, action smoothness, spatial fairness, and auditability. To support agentic evaluation, SolarChain-Eval incorporates an LLM-based Planner/Auditor layer. The Planner defines episode-level action bounds and audit rules, while the Auditor reviews and revises high-risk actions. All interventions are recorded through structured logs, including trigger signals, proposed actions, revised actions, and audit rationales. Experiments with static, random, myopic, RL, and RL+LLM policies reveal a clear utility-safety trade-off. RL agents improve market utility but can still produce unsafe behavior. When the physics penalty is removed, reward-maximizing agents exploit invalid generation and increase artificial liquidity. The LLM Planner/Auditor improves auditability and mitigates selected risks, but it cannot fully compensate for a misspecified reward function. These results indicate that trustworthy agentic AI evaluation requires both physical constraints and transparent intervention traces. We release data and code as open access on GitHub for replicability.

AI.tldr: 提出了 SolarChain-Eval，一个物理约束的基准测试，用于评估可信经济智能体。该基准将市场治理建模为 Gymnasium 兼容的 MDP，包含 LLM Planner/Auditor 层。实验表明效用-安全性权衡，RL 智能体提升效用但可能不安全，LLM 审计可缓解部分风险但无法完全弥补错误奖励函数。
AI.motivation: 智能体 AI 系统在物理网络环境中的应用需要同时评估任务性能和可信度。在去中心化能源市场中，自主智能体可能提升市场效用，但也可能利用无效物理数据、创造虚假流动性、产生不稳定的治理决策。因此需要一个物理约束的基准来评估可信经济智能体。
AI.method: 提出 SolarChain-Eval 基准，将市场治理建模为 Gymnasium 兼容的 MDP，智能体每小时做出决策。包含 LLM-based Planner/Auditor 层：Planner 定义 episode 级别的动作边界和审计规则，Auditor 审查并修正高风险动作。所有干预通过结构化日志记录（触发信号、建议动作、修正动作、审计理由）。
AI.result: 静态、随机、短视、RL 和 RL+LLM 策略的实验显示了清晰的效用-安全性权衡。RL 智能体提升市场效用但仍可能产生不安全行为。移除物理惩罚后，奖励最大化智能体利用无效发电并增加虚假流动性。LLM Planner/Auditor 改善了可审计性并缓解了选定的风险，但无法完全弥补错误指定的奖励函数。
AI.conclusion: 可信智能体 AI 评估需要物理约束和透明的干预痕迹。SolarChain-Eval 通过物理约束和 LLM 审计层提供了评估框架，但 LLM 审计不能替代正确的奖励函数设计。

title: PanoWorld: Real-World Panoramic Generation
summary: In this work, we aim to address the challenge of long-range memory in panoramic world models by exploiting the rotation-equivariant property of omnidirectional representations, where rotation can be treated as an implicit geometric transformation.Building on this insight, we propose PanoWorld, which simplifies camera trajectories into translations via fixed headings for both current-action modeling and long-range memory through Dense Panoramic Ray-Conditioning (DPRC) and Geometry-aware Memory Augmentation (GMA).Then, a three-stage training pipeline is introduced to progressively optimize each component. To better evaluate physical consistency under large-scale spatial variations and diverse illumination conditions, where existing datasets are relatively stable, we construct World360, a large-scale dataset consisting of both real-world video clips collected via panoramic unmanned aerial vehicles and high-quality simulated clips generated by AirSim360.Extensive experiments on World360 demonstrate the effectiveness of PanoWorld, outperforming alternative methods by a large margin.Our models, training code, and dataset will be publicly available. More information can be found on our project page: https://lihaoy-ux.github.io/panoworld-page/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PanoWorld，利用全景表示中的旋转等变性质，通过固定航向将相机轨迹简化为平移，结合密集全景射线条件（DPRC）和几何感知记忆增强（GMA）实现全景世界模型中的长程记忆，并构建了包含真实无人机视频和高仿真视频的大规模数据集World360，实验表明该方法大幅优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 全景世界模型中长程记忆的挑战。现有数据集在较大空间变化和多样光照条件下的物理一致性评估方面相对稳定，缺乏更具挑战性的基准。
AI.method: 提出PanoWorld框架，核心创新包括：(1) 利用全景表示的旋转等变性质，将旋转视为隐式几何变换，通过固定航向将相机轨迹简化为平移；(2) 密集全景射线条件（DPRC）用于当前动作建模；(3) 几何感知记忆增强（GMA）用于长程记忆；(4) 三阶段训练流程逐步优化各组件；(5) 构建World360数据集，包含真实无人机全景视频和AirSim360生成的高质量模拟视频。
AI.result: 在World360数据集上的大量实验表明，PanoWorld大幅优于其他替代方法。
AI.conclusion: 模型、训练代码和数据集将公开可用，推动全景世界模型的研究。
